Microecon is never fun but so long as you put in the time and use the many resources he makes available, you're alright. He explains tough concepts well and can adjust accordingly. Great professor.

Prof. Ackermann is a good guy but a bad teacher. 2 tests count for 70% of your overall grade. He wants to do his best, but he just isn't a very effective teacher. You have to study his graphs and equations if you want to do good on tests.
He wants everyone to succeed! Great professor, I enjoyed his class because lectures did not feel like classic boring lectures.

Great guy. Down to earth, friendly, very positive and upbeat. Makes lectures fun and engaging. Ties in current events and news while staying apolitical, makes interesting TopHat polls. People complaining about the difficulty are the ones skipping or on their phones. Show up, pay attention, do the work, and you will do well

Professor Ackermann is a nice guy, but very unprofessional. He deviates from lecture way too much and doesn't clearly explain what he's teaching. I recommend reviewing the TopHat questions more than the Connect ones. Also, get a tutor and visit the TA's office hours for real help.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I really like him as a person. Tries to be different than other econ profs for 202 because he gives more credit for participation and homework. This doesn't offset the fact that the exams are 30 questions long and you only have 50 minutes to do it. Everyone pretty much fails them. If you're 1% away from a higher grade, he isn't going to round it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: We can drop one test but honestly his tests aren't like his review guides and its ridiculous. He gives super easy examples in class then on the test they are nothing like the study guide. He's a cool teacher but there is so much he could do to improve on teaching including examples, gibing hw that actually helps us learn, improve how he explains.

Class is hard but also a joke. For Fall 2019 the curve on the class was massive because of how bad students were doing. For example you only needed a 84% in the class to 4.0. but getting the 84% was challenging. Im a above average student, study well and hard, an i only managed to 3.5 the class. 3.5 isn't terrible but expected to do better.

biggest piece of advice for this class is to keep up with practicing the concepts because everything builds on each other and it can get very confusing very quickly. Actually attempt to do the homework and definitely do the practice problems that he provides! These problems are very similar or  even the same as the questions that are on the exams
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Ackermann is a real gem. I switched and put myself in his EC 202 next semester. TopHat mandatory every class but curves your attendance grade 10%. Posts tons of practice problems and most appear on his exams. You can drop one exam out of the 3 (includes final). Super funny guy and really cares about his students. Curves the class too!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof Ackerman is very passionate and knowledgable about economics. The lectures are very good and he has amazing slides, but sitting in on lectures is not enough to succeeding in the course: there are lots of online Connect homework assignments and tests are very challenging. Overall, good guy and very generous overall course grade curve.
Talks too much about himself, often gets confused about what hes teaching and cant seem to explain something in a non-confusing manner. Exams are brutal, good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is so nice and is fun to listen to lecture. There's a weekly homework but it's all easy if you pay attention. The textbook is free. All quizzes and exams are open note and she provides lecture notes for every class.

This class is so easy. One assignment a week. Attendance is mandatory but it's only worth five points of your overall grade so you're fine if you don't go. Exams and quizzes use lockdown browser but she moved every one to taking it remote so it didn't matter. Easy ISS to 4.0.

Her class is not difficult in the slightest, with quizzes and exams being open-note.

Assignments are straightforward. 

She has a midterm which covers the first textbook and a final that covers the second; her final is not cumulative.

Unfortunately, her lectures are not all that interesting. I often found myself confused in certain sections.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Bryant has been my favorite professor at MSU so far. I took her class to meet a school requirement but found myself actually interested in her lectures and the material. The textbook is free and though attendance is mandatory, she is very understanding. She wants you to do well!

Super nice professor who cares about the material she's teaching and cares about students. Very straight forward and easy class. Every quiz question was bar for bar from the combined lecture notes SHE would provide and let you print and take to the quiz. Not possible to fail. Also canceled class or finished early many times. 10/10

She is one of my favorite professors at MSU. She genuinely is passionate about the material she teaches and that reflects in her lectures. She also cares about her students and wants them to succeed. The quizzes and exams are open note, so you can actually focus on learning the material during class rather than memorizing. Take this class!!
TAKE THIS CLASS FOR UR ISS REQUIREMENT. SHES SO CUTE I LOVE HER AND CLASS WAS SO EASY AND SHE IS VERY CHILL AND TEXTBOOK IS FREE!
Amazing professor and very passionate about teaching. She somehow made every lecture interesting. 100% would take again
super sweet!! i loved the class its easy and workload is not heavy at all. exams are open note lock down browser. hws super easy. book is free!
Dr. Bryant is the best professor at MSU. Even though the class was just a general requirement, I was interested in learning.
dr bryant is so caring i would highly recommend
Dr. Bryant is one of the best professors I've had at MSU. She is very caring and compassionate. She let us use open notes on all of our quizzes.
Good professor, open note quizzes and tests makes things very easy. She posts all lecture notes and slides, doesn't stray much from the notes on quizzes and tests.

I had her for iss 210 and this class was very good. As long as you do the discussion posts and do good on the tests you will get a good grade. The tests were open note and you can print out the lecture notes she made and the tests were very self explanatory. I would 100% take this class again

Professor Bryant is admirably kind, charismatic, and understanding of student circumstances. She is very passionate about social issues and the content her class teaches. Her effort to maintain unbiassed perspectives while being educational about the topics she lectures about is evident and appreciated.

She was an extremely easy class but it was definitely the most pointless class and the biggest waste of time. Her lectures just go over the readings basically word for word so you really only need to do one or the other but she makes attendance mandatory for some reason. Easy class but such a waste. She also gives short notice for canceled class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Bryant was such an amazing professor, the work load was very light in this class. We had weekly discussion posts, a few quizzes, and exams. But for all the quizzes and exams she allowed you to use notes and she had lecture notes available on d2l that had the exact answers to the test. Attendance was taken but not graded.
Probably the best professor I've had by far, the class was enjoyable and I learned so much.. She is great with grading and I have never dreaded doing her work. 10/10
Easy class, easy grade. Would definitely take her class again!
Very easy class, I highly recommend taking it.

She's such a sweetheart! During her first lecture, she said something under the lines of wanting all of us to get A's (which she said was 100% possible) and she hoped to be able to interact with all of us. Her feedback to our online papers/responses shows she cares about our performance, and her lectures are easy to navigate.

Super sweet professor who actually cares about students. She's really understanding and literally designs the class so you can get an A. It's so easy, everything is open note, and you don't even need to read any of the books to pass. 10/10 recommend as an easy ISS if you need one to take.

By far one of my favorite professors so far. She cares more about you asking questions than the grade you receive. Class is super easy, and every quiz and exam is open note. She is an amazing professor, and this class challenged me to question my views!

Very easy class, every exam and quiz was open notes provided by her. Attendance isn't mandatory but her lectures are pretty interesting and really easy to reach outside of class. I would def recommend for anyone.
Dr. Amber Bryant clearly understands students and does everything possible to help them succeed in her class.

Absolutely LOVE Dr. Bryant. clear, easy-to-follow lectures. The only downside I could see is the pace can be a little fast for notetaking but the tests and quizzes and exams are NOT cumulative! So you have lots of little breaks.

Dr. Bryant was a very good professor. She is very understanding of students and truly wants to see them succeed in her class. Tests we all open-note, so as long as you prepared yourself well, you could pass. Overall 10/10.

The first half of this class is super easy, she sends you a notes packet to print out and you can use it on the exam and the exam is word-for-word from the notes. The second half requires you to do the reading, but the exams are taken at home so... The lectures are a little boring but Dr Bryant is very sweet and friendly.

Professor Bryant is the best. She is kind and lectures are actually pretty interesting. Attendance isn't mandatory to get a good grade and there is minimal work in the class. Open note on every quiz and exam, so the easiest 4.0 ever. I actually learned a lot in this class as well, so I highly recommend taking this class with professor Bryant.
I really really enjoyed her as a teacher!!! I would recommend everyone to take her class. You can tell she really loves what she is doing.

TAKE THIS CLASS WITH THIS PROFESSER. The best and most understanding professor I've ever had. Everything is open note and there are only weekly discussion posts. Lectures aren't required, but I would go because the class is so interesting and gives a different perspective. Definitely would take it if you want a 4.0.

Dr. Bryant is an amazing professor, she is very kind and likes to have fun in class. The class is made up of 4 quizzes, a midterm, a final, and discussion posts every week. All of the tests are open note and she gives you her lectures notes, where she pulls the quiz questions from. This is a very easy class and also very interesting.

Dr. Bryant is an amazing and understanding person. Her lectures are very beneficial and prepare you well for quizzes. The class's only reading is really only required during the second half of the semester and its relatively short, but MSU should really have more professors like her.

Amber Bryant is one of the sweetest professors I have had at MSU. She is super understanding and wants you to succeed in her class. There is extra credit. Open notes quizzes. If you pay attention in class then you will get a 4.0
Very laid back and cool.

Dr. Bryant is a great professor. The lesson plan is clear; you have similar weekly assignments, which helps create a schedule. As long as you show up to class, pay attention, and do the work, you will get a 3.5. She and her TA are available out of class in case of any problems. I would definitely go out of my way to take one of her courses again.

She was chill and even told us that she understands that we are all in different situations and it's okay if we can pass the class without going. Loved her, tests are open note and online, and she posts the combined lecture notes so you can just go off of those

Dr. Bryant is a great professor, is caring and always willing to listen; allowed me to turn in late assignments as well which not all profs do. Simple class, show up twice a week and take notes/pay attention and you will bare minimum 3.5 this class. Would highly recommend as it is straight forward, no trick questions or pop quizzes. Take this class

This professor really cares and wants to see her students succeed. Her lectures were interesting and she made sure to incorporate a variety of teaching methods to keep students engaged. She also provided many opportunities for extra credit and resources such as lecture notes to help students learn.

Bryant is super nice and the class was very easy. Everything is open note so you just have to print out the slide shows and guided notes. I recommend lectures as it makes the quizzes easier to take, but all the notes are available so it's fine to miss a lecture. Pretty boring, but I did learn some interesting and useful things about education!
Lots of discussion posts, quizzes and readings. Some info on slides was confusing. She was a very good teacher though and I would taker her class again. Just show up to class and you'll be fine!

best professor by far, if you attend the lectures and go through the notes you will 100% pass the class. She also is very kind and passionate about what she teaches. I loved her energy. The quizzes, tests, midterm, and final were open notes! please please take her class i am so glad i had Bryant as my prof. she has a very kind soul.
This course was really easy with not many homework assignments at all but the lectures were very boring and not engaging but an easy A. We also got to leave class early most days so that's a plus.

A great lecturer. She makes the class very simple and interesting. Often the tests are open notes. She is very willing to work with you to get you to the grade you want. She provides a lot of extra credit opportunities. She wants what is best for her students.
I enjoyed this class and Dr. Bryant was a great professor, you could tell that she is very passionate about her job which makes learning just as enjoyable.
My favorite professor so far she was easy and helped me get a 4.0 highly recommended
My favorite teacher EVER. She was so understanding and would give me extensions whenever I asked. So many opportunities for extra credit too!

professor bryant is a pretty good professor and seems very knowledge on the topics taught during class. i enjoyed having her as my professor and would definitely recommend her for as a great ISS prof!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Eh

Very good down to earth, relatable professor, that is also a good teacher, workload was good and the quizzes and tests I felt very prepared for ( and most of them were open note). Class wasn't any harder than it needed to be and having her as a professor was fun, and I would definitely like to have her as a professor again.

Dr. Bryant's class was very nice. All of her tests and quizzes (including midterm and final exam) were open note. As long as you take notes, you are almost guaranteed an A. There's one discussion post per week and she also offers 3-4 extra credit assignments. She's a very sweet lady.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: All her quizzes, the midterm, and the final are open notes. Make sure you know how to use your notes and can find things easily. Textbooks are required but you can make do without reading them.
Loved her and would definitely take her class again! All quizzes and tests are open note, and she gives you both lecture notes and guided notes for all, if not most, of them. Class was pretty easy!

Dr. Bryant is amazingggg! Not only is she a great teacher but she is very kind and understanding. The class is not bad at all you have two textbooks that you cover throughout the semester. Each week you have discussion posts, and most tests are open note. 10000000% reccomend.

Super lecture heavy, but if you didn't go most of the time you wouldn't understand what was happening. She is kind and when she isn't just reading off the slides and gets us to participate it's a fun class and she's a great teacher. Also all exams and tests are open note.
So kind and accommodating! You can tell she is passionate about what she teaches. She keeps lectures interesting and fun. Only a discussion post a week and a few quizzes. Definitely recommend.

The class was based off two textbooks where you would read 50-75 pages a week. Lectures would primarily go over what you read/learned about within this reading. If you show up to class/read you are basically guranteed a 4.0. She gave a decent amount of easy extra credit as well.

She is absolutely amazing! She gives clear expectations, tells you how you will succeed in the class, gives phenomenal feedback, and answers any questions we have. Attendance is not mandatory, but it is helpful to be in class to hear what she says that aren't in the slides. Overall best professor I've had this semester!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Bryant is very kind and caring and wants to help you succeed. Quizzes and tests are open note, and homework is usually a discussion board due once a week. I find the material very interesting, and I would definitely take one of her classes again!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is amazing, she is so kind and will answer all your questions, she give you information that you probably never knew you needed. Her quizzes and tests are easy (open note) and she shares her lecture notes. If you go to class and pay attention then you will pass, a lot of people don't read the textbooks but I did and they helped me a lot.

This professor is extremely easygoing. Lots of lectures but they are interesting and engaging. Minimal assignments and open note tests, midterm, and final. If you pay attention to lectures and copy notes you won't need to worry about reading the textbooks.

She is an amazing professor who cares about her students and the information that she teaches. She makes the content interesting through her lectures. If you just show up for class you should be able to pass no problem. Open-note tests, mid-term, and final.
Overall a great teacher, she loves feedback from students.
She really cares about her students and is such a sweet person. A lot of reading but it is easy to keep up with and tests and quizzes are open note.
Allowed to drop grades. Open-note quizzes. Takes the time to help individual students.
Good professor, teaches well.
Easy class, just do the discussion posts and check the lecture notes for the quizzes.
All exams and quizzes are open notes, so definitely an easy A class as long as you take good notes. She made the lectures as fun and as interesting as possible.

She is awesome! Quizzes are online, open notes. She posts all of her lecture notes in case you want to look through. No projects, just quizzes and worksheets. Content is interesting and she is easy to listen to.
Super nice and understanding, take good notes and show up when you can because it will help you.

This class was easily my favorite class of my first ever college semester. Professor Bryant really did a wonderful job easing us students into the college curriculum and managed to make the class engaging and productive.
She was really easy and laid back. A couple books read but open note quizzes and exams, fairly easy class and fun.
Lecture heavy, but a great class to take! She is very straightforward with information and the level of difficulty is more on the easier side. Extremely respectable and understanding.

I really enjoyed this class with Dr. Bryant! She was very very sweet, you can tell she deeply cares about her students and those around her. Her classes are mostly lecture based on 2 different textbooks. She makes the class more interesting by including documentaries/movie days, and she gives out extra credit quite often. Quizzes are open book too!

Very easy class if you show up to her lectures and keep up with readings. Quizzes are not difficult and she gives you good lecture notes. Not many assignments a week only discussion posts that are very easy to answer.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Bryant was a great professor! While some lectures were heavy with material she often used tools to make them more engaging, such as google polls or other ways to get class opinions on the content. Lecture notes are also posted weekly for important ideas and to help on open note quizzes which personally helped me better understand the readings.

I would definitely recommend anyone to take this class, it was really informative and laid back as far as workload. I feel like I really gained a lot from this class but also didn't have to worry about it.

Easy A, some interesting lectures, great person, very caring, I learned a lot in the course and did not struggle with grades. Although the lectures sometimes feels like she is just reading off a sheet of paper rather than being an expert on some of the subjects.

Although the course is lecture heavy, she finds a way to teach the lecture in a chill and conversational type manner. She gives you her own lecture notes before a quiz which are super helpful and she lets you print them out and have them during a quiz. Overall I would highly recommend taking her course because she is very down to earth.
she was a very good professer made the material intresting and lectures while being a little dull she would add non graded inclass activities that made it easier to understand and more enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Bryant is a passionate professor, you can tell she cares about what she's teaching. Attendance is not mandatory, and for the most part, everything covered in lectures is posted online. Exams/Quizzes are all open notes, which are also posted online. Overall, the class was very easy and I would recommend it!
Great professor, just take notes on the lectures and all quizzes will be easy. She is very straight forward and understanding. She wants her students to succeed and puts them first.

Very caring and passionate professor. She would help you out if you reach out to her personally. Coming to class is not mandatory as everything is on the lecture notes. All exams are open notes and just print out the notes she gave you and earn your easy A.

Overall very easy class. You will do well if you read the notes, which are posted. Going to class can be helpful since she goes over her lecture notes a little more thoroughly but it is not mandatory. Actually useless lectures, learned almost everything on my own. He even took a day out to talk to us about grad school and told us all about his gap year abroad. Dr. Becker is awesome, totally recommend!

Dr. Becker was a really good professor. He was very enthusiastic and passionate about the class. Definitely recommend reading the textbook. Mark had been my favorite professor. He is like the dad version of Seth Rogen and I enjoyed every single lecture. Professor Bodea is one of the most knowledgeable professors in the PLS department. She is very kind and caring for all of her students. Professor Bodea outlines the course exactly in the syllabus, and the course follows the textbook exactly. There is no way to do badly in the class if you participate, study, and read the textbook. Bad reviews are from people who didn't put in the work, didn't attend class, or did not read the textbook.

I really liked her as a professor and enjoyed most of the content, however there was just so much work to where I felt like I was not genuinely learning anything. reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Bodea knows exactly what she is talking about. This class is by no means easy, but I found that attending office hours and doing the textbook reading, I got along just fine.
You need to be willing to work hard but class is one of the best I've ever taken. Professor Bodea is incredible.
Clearly outlines the course in the syllabus. You need to study to earn your grade. Would recommend office hours!
Very informative class. Would recommend 100%

Professor Bodea is kind and knowledgable. She cares deeply about all of her students which would be evident to aynone who attends her office hours. Ross has been my favorite professor by far. His lectures are enjoyable and he is very funny. He cares very much about his students success.

reviews.comment:
I dont understand why she has so many negative reviews. the year I had her is this year so 2024-2025, and all I can say is is that she is a very caring professor and one can email her for help plus there are TA hours for support. 

If you visit her lectures and do the homework you'll be good. Her mock exam sheets for practice are splendid.

reviews.comment: I did not like the notes she created and made us buy and found Rstudio to be tricky. I would not recommend skipping class as it's easy to fall behind (no lectures are posted) In person exams were relatively easy and coding exams were taken at home. I found her to be irritating in lecture, but would recommend her if you are willing to put in effort

She is kind, understanding, and extremely straightforward. I could never make it to her office hours and my TA was bad, so I always resorted to emailing. She gave me very clear and detailed answers in a timely manner. The homework was never anything difficult or unexpected. I have never taken stats before, and it was a great first experience.

I loved Professor Horr! She went slowly during her lectures to make sure that everyone understood, but her pacing was never off this semester. If for some reason we didn't get to something in time for the homework, she always pushed back the due date. Responds to emails quickly. Exams are straightforward and reflect directly off of the course pack.

Professor Horr was a decent professor and not bad for statistics. She is very concise with how the class is laid out and there are no surprises when it comes to exams either. Exams are exactly like the study guide, lecture notes are posted, HW is due the same day every week. Only complaint is her explanations are bad and lectures are boring.

I loved how transparent she was! She would send clear criteria on what the exam would cover. She sent annotated lecture noted every week so I actually never went to class and was able to do great in the course. She is very accommodating. Overall, I thought her pacing has gotten much better from previous reviews.

The professor was very kind. Lecture was 3x a week but not mandatory to attend. There were 6 essays that had to be done with your recitation group but were easy and not time-consuming. The homework was pretty tough but overall not a bad course!

Pretty boring class, but she did the best she could. Very easy exams but homework was hard and graded on accuracy, work with other people. She gives a coursepack so it's easy to follow along with her. Coding sucks but she can't do anything about it. Wouldn't do it again but I had to do it for my major so there wasn't a choice.

This professor did a good job and was fair in class policies. As someone who has taken a class with a truly horrible stats professor in the past, Dr. Horr is a great professor. Just go to lecture, recitation, and do your homework and you'll be fine. She gives a fill in the blank textbook for class notes, so lecture is incredibly easy to follow.

I didn't have much of an opinion on her. It was her first year teaching, and it kind of showed, the class was always behind and we rushed to finish content in the last week. However, I thought she was nice and I thought the class was pretty easy. Her TA's did grade very harshly so that wasn't great.

finished her class and would not recommend--so many better options. lectures weren't mandatory but the class was always a week behind and the hw was due on days scheduled on the syllabus; TAs would teach you the material. unclear grading material and gets mad when you try to fight for your grade as if you spat on her by just sending an email.

She was alright for her first year teaching. Her recitation TAs know absolutely nothing though. Also, her lectures are not recorded, so if you skip class for any reason, be prepared to know nothing. Her course pack also has a million typos and at the end of the semester she had to rush through material so everyone I know basically failed the test.

This was Dr. Horr's first year and I really enjoyed her class. Her lectures were very digestible by all means as long as you pay attention. In-person and take-home exams are very easy. As long as you pay attention and study the concepts you will do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I don't even know what to say. She was new this year, but her behavior was unacceptable. She refused to work with the TAs who, by the way, are going to teach you all of the material because you are constantly behind. She was rude to the TAs and petty at time. Wouldn't even recommend her as a last resort.

She does not explain material well at all. The writing assignments did not deepen understanding of the material at all. We were supposed to get extra credit for doing practice exams, but instead she decided to put it on exams. DO NOT TAKE HER. she was behind all semester and blamed grading on the TA's when they could not even get the answer keys.

I wish I could give this a zero star review. she lacks the ability to teach, let alone a 200+ lecture in college. Is highly unorganized and seems shy and timid where her teaching skills are not there. If it wasn't for mu TA I would've flunked the class. Do not take!! Even if you are a STEM major.

Professor Horr was an absolutely horrendous professor. She was completely clueless to the material and often times copy and pasted the previous professors notes. She rushed through topics which made it difficult to follow along and understand. She has no regard for her students and complains about having to do her job, do not take this class.

She is unorganized and had to skip material as she was behind all semester. Came to class unprepared with a low battery on her ipad and struggled knowing the code to use that students were expected to know. Also coughs aggressively into the mic during lecture. Condescending to students, should just be an elementary school teacher.. or none at all.

This was Prof.Horr's first year here, and she handled the stress of teaching college stats very well. As long as you pay attention and take notes, you will be okay. She teaches you about coding to make calculations easier which I really enjoyed. Very interesting class. I wish I couldve attended her office hours, but my schedule didnt let me
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I got nothing out of this class. The recitation, homework, and lecture content are all extremely different from each other. She gives surface level explanations of difficult topics and does not put in any of her own effort into this course, since she is using content from the previous professor. The disregard for students grades is obvious.

Long story short, this class was awful.  We were so behind throughout the whole semester and she constantly blamed the TAs when it was her slow teaching to blame. Not to mention we had to pay 70 dollars for a course pack that was unhelpful and filled with typos. She did not know what was going on and taught by taking credit for other prof. material

She copies down the previous professor's notes word from word. She rarely takes questions from students and acts as if she didn't see people raising their hands after going on a run on paragraph attempting to explain the material. Definitely does not care about students' success in this course. Was behind the whole semester and crammed at the end.

First semester teaching... Her TA's grade the HW and peer writings extremely inconsistently (Mine was a harsh grader some were not as hard) Her notes are confusing in the course pack and I honestly found them useless. This class wouldn't be so bad if taught by a better Prof. Office hours for help? She says she can't give you answers on the HW...

Content wasn't too bad, she just was not a strong lecturer. She just filled in the guided notes all lecture and did not explain things too much. Grading on peer writing assignments was inconsistent. She wasn't too bad but Zeleke does a better job with the class. She did great for her first semester teaching though. I do recommend the class overall

Prof. Horr did a great job for her first semester here. The classes were short and helpful, and she is accessible for questions inside and out of class. The exams were fair, and enough time is given to complete. The TA you have makes a big impact on your peer writing grades. Mine was a harsh grader and was bad at explaining. Love prof Horr though.

Professor Horr's lectures were very easy to go along with. If you have a question she is very accessible both in and out of class. She gives clear explanations. Tests were very fair and lecture notes outside of class are very accessible. TAs grade the peer homework, which can be a wildcard on grading accuracy. Homework is for accuracy.

I was nervous at the start of the semester because she was new, but she was a great professor, and I learned a lot. Also the tests were incredibly easy if you study even just a little bit.

Lectures can be boring but just stick with it and you won't have any trouble

Prof Chahal is an amazing prof. He lectures very well, gives relevant homework and tests are extremely similar to the practice. That being said it is a very hard course so be prepared for that. Hes also extremely funny.
One of the best professors I have ever had!
Very good lecturer but it is very hard to explain to him outside of the classroom, if you have any question regarding the course ask him at once when the lecture is over.
Good lecturer, but definitely hard to reach outside of class. Exams certainly felt rushed too (many didn't finish in the allotted time frame). Could be worse, but could be better too.

Honestly, he was a pretty decent professor even though he got put in this position because our old prof got removed from his position. However, I wish he didn't treat this class as a side job and actually cared more about his students. He'd be late to his office hours, go very fast in his lectures, and was incredibly hard to reach outside of class.

Dr. Chahal was an amazing professor, especially due to abruptness of his appointment, as he was suddenly made our professor halfway through the semester. His lectures were prepared beforehand and he would explain things very well. His class was hard, so beware. But I genuinely learnt a lot in his class.

This class was easy, just show up to class, but beware of the attendance and the in-class quiz, which opens up just for 1 minute. The exam is open-book and online. She is super friendly and has group workshops, which are not the hardest. Honestly, easy credit for class and would recommend.

Annoying. Every class she just reads notes from a slideshow or plays long videos while she sits and does nothing, really boring class and she doesn't care to put effort in. The group "workshops" she does feel like filler to make it seem that shes doing something. if you want to be remotely interested dont take. + no late credit no matter what
you WILL fall asleep in her class   if you dont want to learn about slums and other stuff dont bother this course

reviews.comment: She's definitely a talker and will not stop, but she is nice. The class is very easy, but it is two hours long and feels repetitive. There is group work every class, attendance is mandatory, and most of your grade depends on it.

Honestly, this class was a joke. It was really easy. There's some group work. All exams are fully open-note and can be taken in your dorm. Extremely easy class, lectures were a little boring. She tends to cancel class at the last minute, which is very inconvenient. Easy class to take if you just need the credits.

She cancels class at least once a week with less than an hour warning. Did not seem interested in helping each student. Just read off slides word for word. Tests are online and open note. Only 3 attendance drops and she takes attendance twice per class.
She was at most okay; she would cancel class less than an hour before it started (she did it at least once a week). There is a lot of group work  and a lot of reading but it is easy

reviews.comment: Random attendance quizzes and in-class quizzes on content every class. Right now, open note exams that you can take on your own, but she says she's planning on changing that. No final. Class is an easy 4.0 if you do the work. Class starts interesting then it just gets boring. Also, she has an obsession with googling news articles while lecturing?

The class is really easy. When I took it, the class was only about European migration with a focus on the 2015 European migrant crisis. The class is interesting if you enjoy social studies. Exams are online, and you don't have to be in the class to take them. Every class, you will have attendance and a quiz of one question relating to the material.

reviews.comment: Extremely easy class, its two lectures a week as long as you show up its a 4.0, all the exams were open book and you could take them from your dorm. Professor genuinely cares about students and tries to help out

reviews.comment: very easy class, except showing up twice a week for boring 2 hour long classes. Barely any work in class (some group assignments) and all exams online. Insanely easy 4.0 but very boring
Good professor, class is fairly easy, tests are online. I just hate going to class because 5:20-7:10pm is awful timing. Looks like I'll end up with a 4.0 or 3.5.

Easiest 4.0 I will probably ever get in college, however she did say she was going to use iClicker for attendance starting spring 2025. Still an easy class even if attendance is mandatory. Exams are online

Might be the easiest class of all time. Attendance is only mandatory when you do workshops (once every week or so). Very easy 4.0

reviews.comment: Very very easy class and the professor is very friendly, just keep up with quizzes and discussion posts.

I LOVED this online class, by far one of my favorite online classes I've taken. Easy to split up the work throughout the week. reviews.comment:
If you can take an online class with her, do it!! I took an online class with her and it was very well structured, with all of our assignments due on Sundays. 

If you take notes on the videos, do all the homework and take notes on all the lectures, you will get an A. Exam questions are taken directly from the material and open note.

reviews.comment: Easy 4.0 class to take to get the ISS requirement out of the way. Attendance isn't mandatory and there is either a quiz, exam or discussion form to do once a week. reviews.comment: Professor was great. Class was easy of you went to lecture and took good notes. Lectures would end usually 15-20 minutes early.

Fairly easy class, very friendly. Attendance is not mandatory but it is difficult to get the lectures from a missed class. Watched some hour long movies in class which we would have questions on on a quiz or exam.
Boring mandatory lectures. If you miss lecture, it's difficult to get the information. ISS 230 with her was easy enough though.

Cowley's class is pretty easy to get an A in. The lectures may seem like fluff, but it's important to show up since some days she'll go over things that will be included on the exams (which are easy). She's extremely lenient, but you do have to put in some effort and also build connections with your classmates, it will help you through the class.

reviews.comment: Cowley is not a bad professor. That being said she has her oddities. She has quite a boring voice and lectures a ton. She also has you watch these movies that are an hour or more but I found them interesting. If you are willing to just sit down for a couple hours a week and work, you will be fine in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Her lectures had no point and the tests had nothing to do with what you learn in class. Just do her a billion hour homework and watch the videos she posts.

Professor Cowley is passionate about what she teaches and makes getting a good grade easy. Acing the tests is easy, as long as you do the work and show up to class during specific lectures. She has a great drop policy and goes over all test material in class. I would take this class again!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: It was a very fun class! I don't understand why there are negative reviews here. She is great. Easy material. You have to push yourself when doing the assignments. That's how I got a 4.0

Cowley was a very nice person and cared about her students success. There are many films to watch and readings to finish but with the time given to complete, it isn't a struggle. The course seemed like it was going to be all fast paced but she made sure things weren't thrown at you at last minute so you could be prepared for the exams-open note.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Cowley has lots of lectures, lots of videos, and movies to watch. I feel like if the class was in person, it'd be a lot more boring. The work and exams were easy, it was just time-consuming. I did like the class because I liked learning about the topics (such as the cold war, the berlin wall, migration, et cetera).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is very nice, but is not very realistic in what she is asking of students. She lectures a lot and drags on and on. She does not post lecture notes online, and It is very hard to keep up and take notes. Also, ISS 230 is very boring! However despite all of that, she is very caring and understanding. She did very well with online transformation.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Really knowledgeable professor & nice lady! Required courses are hard to make interesting, but I just brought a coffee, stayed awake, & ended up learning a good amount! We also watched lots of movies! If you go to class and pay attention you will not fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She literally has the most monotone voice that I have ever heard in my entire life. I took her ISS 230 class. Every class usually has a hour of notes then we watch a foreign movie that is painfully hard to stay awake for that we are actually tested on. Tests are hard. You have to attend every class if you want to get a solid grade. I got a 3.5

Dr. Cangelosi is a great Professor. She is very caring and wants everyone to learn and be engaged, but isn't strict. She does iClicker questions throughout each lecture for attendance, you just need to fill out the questions you don't have to get them correct.

Professor Cangelosi is nice and explains concepts well. However, the exams are very tricky and focus on small details rather than main ideas, making them hard even if you understand the material. Grading depends heavily on tests. Attendance and recitation are also required with a strict sign-in system (sign-in sheet & i-clicker which rarely works).
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Cangelosi was the first and only professor who made me understand chemistry. She is very clear, and you can tell she knows what she's talking about. There is frequent homework and lectures 3 times a week, but a decent amount of grades are dropped at the end of the semester. Exams can be tricky, but the resources she provides are very helpful.

Cangelosi is knowledgeable and explains material well, but the course pace can feel demanding. Lectures meet three times a week with frequent homework. Exams are challenging, and extra credit is limited. Recitation is required, though a few absences are dropped. The material builds heavily on prior chapters, so staying consistent is important.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The lectures are efficient and well taught. Do the mock exams a day or two before and you'll be fine. Tests are easier than homework. Some extra credit but not much. Really a a nice and well organized professor overall. Also - any lecture before an exam will have some type of review material that shows up on the exam so pay attention to that.
Great professor. Teaches well would take her class again
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The class was well taught but you are required to keep up and check your own understanding. Basically everything in the class including recitation, homework, and iClicker questions are graded for completion so you really aren't required to try on them for that part of the grade. However, this will hurt you because these help you understand better.

She was very kind and answers questions well. Exams were somewhat difficult, but if you study you will do well. Homework was easy and graded based on completion, with multiple extra credit opportunities offered.
As long as you pay attention in lectures and put effort into homework and recitations, you will do well in this class.

Her lectures slides are a bit long, but help when studying the learning objectives, which are crucial for the exams. The grading process is very clear and the TAs are helpful during recitation and during lecture.

Great Chem prof, her lectures are very well planned and helpful to understanding the material. Homework very straightforward and short. Recitation activities not too stressful and were helpful. The exams are the hardest part of the course, but you are given good resources to study from. Worst part of course was the ALEKS assignment.

Dr. Cangelosi is a really good professor and person. She explains all the concepts in a way that makes them so easy to understand, and is just an overall nice person. There is a textbook, but I never bought it and easily 4.0ed the class. The exams are heavily weighted, but there are plenty of other categories that cushion your grade.

genuinely such a nice person. lectures were very engaging which made learning the material much easier. she tells you what to do after each lecture and if you do it you will do well in the class. wouldn't want anyone else for cem 141

I LOVED Professor Cangelosi! She did an amazing job with lecturing and made chemistry easy to understand. I would highly recommend this professor if you get to take CEM 141. The exams were a little difficult and confusing at times, but if you attend recitations and put effort into the homework, you're sure to do well.

Dr. Cangelosi goes through lectures quickly, but also explains concepts to you as if you are a child, which I guess can be a good thing considering some concepts can be tricky. She goes over the homework assignments, her tests are straight-forward, and she is caring and lenient with grading. She is probably the best CEM141 professor at MSU.

Very nice lady runs through lectures fast but keeps class engaged. Goes over homework. Make sure to do ALEKS and complete homework. Lot of extra credit offered so do that. I didn't use the textbook. I found tests easy and practice exam helpful. I studied for an hour before each test and always got above a 95. Just try and it'll be fine.

I would say that as far as a cem class goes she does a pretty good job teaching, she is accessible outside of class, and her lectures are easy to follow. HOWEVER, the lectures do not prepare you for the exams. The exams are very difficult, you have to study as you learn you cant cram before the exams and do well.

The homework for CEM 141 is straightforward, and the workload is very manageable. The exams are the only challenging aspect of the course; success requires a deep understanding of the material, which can be achieved by paying attention to the lectures. Professor Cangelosi is excellent at teaching. There are help rooms if you need them.

She is very passionate about chemistry and is willing to help in and out of class. You could ask her what an atom is and she wouldn't judge you. She explains topics well but tends to lecture about the most important stuff in the last 5 min of class. The tests are hard but if you study well, you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: If you can, take Dr. Cangelosi. I've never understood chemistry until I took her class. Her lectures are very easy to follow and understand.There are 4 exams and each are very similar to the lectures and mock exams she gives. You can tell she loves chemistry and she loves to teach. It's very easy to get above a 90 in this class
Very passionate and helpful, exams can be hard if not studied for but she is very supportive and encouraging as well as easy to reach out to

Explained the material very well. Pay attention in lecture and take good notes. Exams are not easy but if you study well you will get an A. Responds to emails very quickly as well. Would definitely recommend this professor.

There are lots of slides and she goes through them fast sometimes, I took them on paper which made it harder to keep up. The TA's are helpful, difficult class (for me), and exams kinda are hard. She provides resources to study with and has office hours.  Recitations can be helpful, but you'll be in a group of 3...

Dr. C kind of talks to you like you're 9. This is something that annoys me personally. She seems nice, but some of the stuff in her lectures are made unclear or are skipped through fast. Her powerpoints are ridiculously long, and the slide numbers don't match her in class slides.

Her exams are heavily weighted and quite difficult. You need to study consistently and pay close attention in every lecture. Don't rely on ChatGPT for homework—it won't help on the exams, which are tough even with solid studying.
Dr Cangelosi is good at teaching I'm just bad at chemistry. Her class was better than the other chem prof I had. She's very kind and understanding. The TA's can be helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr C is an awesome lecturer, she is passionate about her material. I thought the class was boring and moved slowly, but that is not entirely her fault as there are so many sections of the class.
very good professor his class was tough mostly because of the exams, but did well in everything else
This class was tough mostly because of the exams, but did well in everything else. Dr. Cangelosi is an amazing professor though it's definitely just me being bad at the exams.
very good professor. lectures are online if you miss. it was my fault for not paying attention but she explains very well and the office hours and TA's are very helpful. would take again.
She's the best prof at MSU for cem 141. just pay attention in lecture and study and you'll do well. super supportive and great lectures with clear criteria for what to know.
Amazing professor who goes very deep into concepts. There is iClicker for attendance but it is good for accountability, because if you miss a lecture you will fall behind.
Prof Cangelosi was very good. She made lecture easy to understand and kinda fun. Just hated the subject but she was amazing. Tough subject

I made flashcards out of the lecture material after each class and ranged from 80-90 on the exams. If you start studying and pay attention from the first lecture, you will succeed. I didn't attend that many recitations, and it impacted my grade, which kind of upset me a little because I don't think attendance should be graded.

Very nice professor who made sure every student has a chance to get a 4.0. Clear grading expectations. Good explanations. Would recommend to anyone who is bad at chemistry. Goes a bit fast during lectures but all lectures are recorded and posted.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Worst professor in all of msu with a nasty grading structure that depends on if you come to lecture thrice a week at 9 am or not. She must be fired immediately

i loved her personally. the class was mandatory, but it wasn't bad for only 50 minutes. you get homework at least once a week and there's a bunch of extra credit opportunities. the mock exams are very very helpful except the final. i thought the final was hard. just go to class and do the homework and you'll be fine

Dr. Cangelosi was a great professor, she graded homework based on participation and went over the homework every morning before getting into the lecture. Her class is pretty interactive and the only "textbook" you need is online and you can download it from course resources. She was a great professor and you can tell that she loves her job.
Good luck!

Dr. Cangelosi is a great professor that explains things really well in her lectures. CEM141 isn't that bad, the only thing that sucks is the exams. If you study a lot you should do fine on them, it's just hard when each multiple choice question is worth 4% of your exam grade. Overall though not too bad, especially with Cangelosi.

I struggled to understand concept she was teaching and felt she didn't explain well and moved on quickly. The TAs and ULAs were very helpful during lectures. I attended all lectures and recitations and still struggled and spent a lot of time studying. If you have experience in chemistry im sure you would enjoy her more.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Cangelosi is a very good professor. She clearly knows how to effectively teach this class. She is very kind and makes the class fairly accessable.

Easy A if you just show up to the lectures and study for a couple hours the day before. The tests are usually pretty straightforward. Homework is light and graded on completion, and the lectures aren't too boring. She tells you to read the textbook before every class, but in my opinion it wasn't really necessary.

This professor was very good at teaching chemistry. She was passionate about the subject and good at explaining things. So many things also get dropped at the end of the course, so you do not have to worry about missing class a few times. The exams can get a little hard, but studying and hard work will get you the A!
Dr. Cangelosi is a very nice and intelligent professor. She obviously knows her stuff and was normally very good at explaining it to her students.

For chem141 not being a super easy class I thought she did a great job. Was very informational in lectures and took her time covering the material. If you were confused it was more because the concept is hard not her teaching. Exams are majority of your grade, but if you go to help room and do learning objectives this is a very manageable class.

reviews.comment: Doctor Cangelosi is hands down the best professor I've ever had. Her lectures are super engaging, so it is almost impossible to zone out in class. If you keep up with the material, the exams are fairly easy. She is also very approachable & is always willing to answer any questions you might have. Loved this class!

CEM 141 overall is a hard class, but Cangelosi did not make it any easier. She was never very clear about what was going to be on the exams or what we should be studying. She does post all the lecture notes online, but class is mandatory to get clicker points. I missed one class because I had an exam that went over and she wouldn't give me points.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: What an inspiring Prof! I put off Chem until my senior year and this instructor made me feel as though I could pursue a masters in biochemistry! She is hands down the best professor I have ever had!
Fantastic lectures. Way better than Pollock

Professor Cangelosi taught CEM 141 very well. She went in-depth with all the concepts which were expanded on in discussion. You do not have to read the online CLUE textbook given to you (yup, that's right, they give you a textbook for free!) just show up for lectures and pay attention. Short answers on exams were graded harshly but MC was easy!
Dr Cangelosi is overall an amazing professor. She is very clear in teaching. Just go to class, read the lecture slides before exams, and you'll definitely 3.5 this class, if not 4.0.

Chemistry isn't my strongest subject but Professor Cangelosi made it a lot easier. She explained the material very well and outlined exactly what needed to be studied for the exams. Make sure to attend lecture for clicker points. Definitely would take another class with her!
Great Teacher Information was clear and concise Exams weren't bad with minimal studying Slides posted online She wants you to succeed She is cute like the girl back home cute
Great professor, really clear. I thought the class was easy, but quite a lot of other students seemed to think it was hard.
Great professor! Would recommender because of excellent lectures that really helped me understand the content well.

Uses clicker to take attendance and all the lectures can be found on D2L. I really enjoyed having her as a professor. I took AP chem in high school so much of the information was review, but she taught it in a very clear way to understand. Exams are based off of lecture notes, BeSocratic HW, and Exam reviews you can print off.

She was possibly the worst professor I've had thus far. Her voice is very dead and she has no emotion. Chemistry could either be a very fun subject, or a very boring one. She made it so bland when chemistry could be so much more fun! I four pointed the class, but it took a lot of work and I taught myself most of the material. Overall disappointed.
All of the work is easy, just stay on top of it. Prof is really nice, uses iclicker but 4 attendance drops.
Made difficult concepts in class easy to learn by his teaching style.

Great professor! You definitely need to attend lecture to keep up with the course. Very transparent about grading and how to get a good grade in his class. Wants all of his students to succeed but by actually knowing course material.

Awesome guy! I just finished my first semester at MSU, and I received a 4.0 in his class. It's tough material if you don't show up to class, so definitely make it to every lecture you can. If you study hard and pay attention in class, there shouldn't be a problem. Lab also helps give extra points and he has lots of extra credit opportunities.

Dr. Wiggins is a great professor. The material can be difficult at times, but he breaks things down and helps you understand. He answers questions clearly if you have any and seems like a very nice guy.

He truly is knowledgeable and loves what he teaches. If you pay attention, study, and ask questions, you will do well in this class. Make sure to go to the exam prep classes, very helpful. Lab is pretty easy too, never went the full time.

Dr Wiggins is a nice guy but he is just not a good professor. He reads directly from lecture slides rather than explaining the content, and the content is very difficult! I'll give him credit for giving us study guides that actually have content that is on the exams, but its hard to study bc u dont know where to start since u have to teach urself.

clearly wants everyone to succeed. it is easy to get lost in the material because it is at times hard to grasp but once you get it, you know it. be sure to look over ALL the slides on top of the study guide for exams. lab was fun and very enjoyable

Dr. Wiggins is a caring, nice guy. He wants you to get an A. Plenty of opportunity for extra credit. Exams based directly off the slides. Not sure why people are claiming it's hard, look at msu grades… the stats speak for themselves

Hilarious, caring, understanding, great guy, mid professor. Lectures are unorganized, he doesn't explain material to the degree he needs to (it's a hard class!). Undermines how hard the content is, giving you false confidence. His study guides are great, go to his exam reviews! If he taught something easier I'd recommend him, but KIN is too hard.

Dr Wiggins just reads directly off of the powerpoint slides and doent explain any concepts which is really frustrating given that the content is pretty difficult. Going to class isnt worth it since I end up teaching myself the content anyways. Exams are based off study guides which is the only good thing. Hes a nice guy, but not a good teacher.

Dr. Wiggins has been one of the better prof i've had at MSU. His lectures are organized, and study guide is helpful and follows what will be on the exam. If you go to class and study, you should be able to 4.0 the course. Overall very fair on policies and exams. Lab is usually quick and just applying concepts learned in class. He is also funny

His slide deck is clear, concise, and has everything you need to know. As long as you put in 20-30 minutes per day of studying the slide deck material and attend the labs, you will be set up for a 4.0 in the class.

Dr. Wiggins' lectures are a lovely way to start your day. He is so knowledgeable of the content and cares about his students a lot. He loves to joke and encourage others. The expectations he has for the course are quite clear, and the exams are highly dependent on lecture content, so take good notes. The study guides he provides are very helpful.

Dr. Wiggins is a great professor. Lectures and participation in class are mandatory by the use of Iclicker. Only 3 exams over the course of the semester and the material isn't too hard. If you go to class, study, and do the lab reports you should be able to get a good grade in this class.
Not incredibly engaging but his class is very reasonable and interesting. Very clear on what is expected and exams aren't too tough.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Tania is one of the best professors I have ever had. She made WRA so interesting and cares about her students so much. You have 3 essays and homework often but its not hard at all. You create a rubric for the essays with your class. The final is a group project. Peer review with your group for each essay.

Professor de Sostoa-McCue makes you feel so welcome! She defiantly cares about her students and their learning. She is amazing in giving direction and impacting your writing for the better. I honestly feel like this was the best writing/English class I have ever taken. She is also hilarious and so down to earth, amazing!

I thought that my overall experience with Dr. de Sostoa-McCue was pleasant. The only thing I wasn't fond about is that we never got rubrics until after our rough draft papers were written, which made a lot of students unprepared. She also grades very heavy and can sometimes be incorrect about her edits or advice. She can be sweet but intimidating.
Great prof
By far the best professor at MSU. If you have to take WRA101, take it with Tania.
Dr. Tania was incredible. You can tell that she really cares for her students and wants to see her succeed. I can't recommend a professor more than her.
Tania was by far the greatest professor I have had. She is one of the few professors that actually make you want to attend the class. She makes everything fun and easy to understand.

She is my favorite professor ever. She is super funny and caring. You need to complete five projects in total, but if you have good time management, then it shouldn't be a problem. Attendance isn't required, but it would be helpful to show up since the class involves group work.

Took the class my first semester, absolutely loved it. She got me back into writing after a long time and the whole class was super enjoyable from start to finish. There's a lot of writing involved, but that's to be expected, but if you take her advice and apply it, the class is easy to 4.0 and fun as well. One of my favorite professors so far!

I love Tania so much! Taking her class was a blast, she's funny and always helped out. 100% recommend her if you're looking for a chill prof that you can relate to! She always made the assignments interesting and was always flexible with grading and everything else. One of the best profs I've had! :)
Gives a lot of extra credit (but only because class average is a 25% lol)

She is a very sweet person. But I did not learn anything and it is making further classes much harder. Do not take. The next semester orgo 2 average was below 50, and most of us took Melanie for orgo 1 and do not understand the fundamentals.

Please avoid her at all cost. She taught in a way that I and many other students could not understand. Exam free response questions were absolutely terrible, too many homework problems Gives extra credit and exam redos, would've probably failed if she didn't offer it. She's a nice prof and seems genuine to students but teaching is not for her…

Would never take again. Dr. Chiu wants her students to succeed and learn the material, especially if they show interest to do so. However, she falls VERY short of actually teaching. For the Spring '25 semester, exam averages reached as low as 30%. She offered re-/pre-dos for the exams, but NEVER A NOTE SHEET FOR ANYTHING. Buckle up if you have her.

I'm sure she's a lovely lady but not a good teacher at all. Nothing makes sense I did all the work and extra credit and still got my first ever 2.5 (I'm a senior in college) bc her exams and quizzes make no sense and no feedback

Puts free response questions on exams that are virtually impossible to solve during the time given on exams. Her lectures are ok but gives out the most simplest examples which doesn't help me solve the harder problems given on exams, re-do exams, and homework. Most of my learning came from online (YouTube). Not enough extra credit is given.

Dr. Chiu, while kind at times, is not a great professor in a lecture setting. Her teaching style is very hands-off and practice based. While beneficial for some students, like me, to learn through practice and repetition; this teaching style is not the best. When considering her Exam averages as well these faults show.

Do not take this class with her. Tests would be almost impossible, the questions would be immensely harder on the test than they would be on any homework or practice problems. The average on her exams was 30 percent. Did not care about her students or their success in the class. Only provided "re-dos" for her exams to bring her averages up.

Professor Chiu cares about the students, offers extra credit to boost scores on difficult exams, and offers many opportunities to get help. Complex written exam problems were hard to prep for. 2hrs and 40mins of lecture and 1hr of recitation per week was very little instruction time for this difficult material, so you have to work for it.

Her tests, quizzes, and homework problems do NOT align with each other. She lacks empathy for her students and flies through material without any care in the world. If I had to take this class again, I would find anyone but her to take it with - even if it put me a semester behind.
Please take literally anyone else for CEM 251.
Run as fast as you can. Exams were literally impossible. 2nd exam average was a 30%. She gave us a pre-redo for the final.
the final was absolutely insane. ended with a 4.0 bc of xtra credit. not worth the stress.
This class was extremely difficult and it wasn't even the class, it was how fast the professors lectures were. Don't take her if you don't want your gpa to tank :/
This was one of the most difficult classes I've taken and it's not even

Most stressful and unfulfilling class of my life. The lectures pacing is awful, zooming through slides until a question, which are easy, like the quizzes, leaving you completely out of luck for the exam. The exams are obscenely hard, claiming to make them hard because she "believes we can do it" despite a 30% class exam average. Avoid this class.
Professor makes it hard for no reason, making the homework extremely difficult compared to lecture.

She is such a genius that she expects us to understand everything quickly where she doesn't explain concepts and talks so fast. all of our exam averages have been below 50% (around 30%). She has given extra credit but makes the problems so hard it's impossible, same with the exams. Everyone is struggling and has fallen behind, barely surviving.
She's not great at teaching. Please don't take this class with her.

A lot of people say she's nice—that's fine—but it doesn't excuse the fact she's terrible at teaching. She only knows how to teach students who already understand the material, because that means less actual teaching for her to do. Save yourself the mental exhaustion and take someone who actually knows how to keep their students from falling behind.

Terrible professor. Exams, hw, quizzes, & extra credit were way harder than what we learned in class. Class averages were always low, yet she seemed completely unaware that her teaching methods were the problem. She rushed through lecture slides without explaining them properly but still expected us to understand everything. I didn't learn a thing.

RUINED MY GPA! Not going to medical school anymore, thank you. Very difficult class, exam questions are extremely tough to understand. Not only does she make her exams hard, she gives an exam redo which is even harder. It is impossible to do good in this class.

I was extremely disappointed by CEM 251 with Dr. Chiu. Course pacing was horrific, with easy content taking forever and hard content rushed. Extra credit was a band aid on poor teaching and grades. Grading expectations were unclear, feedback on exam problems was practically nonexistent. I would recommend taking this course with another professor.

CEM251 is hell. I was recommended this class by my advisor, even though it wasn't required for my degree... Professor Chiu is nice but she does not teach well. The topics she covers in lecture are simple but she beats you down with the exams, and then covers up how awful her students are doing with EC. You won't learn anything. DONT TAKE THIS CLASS

DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS. Sign up for a different professor or take it online over the summer!!!! You will have to teach yourself everything and you will still fail her exams. Very little extra credit is given.

Professor Chiu is a nice lady however, she is not cut out for teaching at this level. She reminds me of a really bad calculus professor from a community college I took a class at. Her exams are extremely possible and she CANNOT teach in a way that is beneficial to your learning. She knows this which is why she tries to throw little bits of EC.

This sucks to say because she is actually a nice person but SHE DOES NOT KNOW HOW TO TEACH!!!! The Class average on the last exam was a 30% and offers so much extra credit just to cover the inability to teach. She knows we are going to do bad on the final and is offering us a exam pre-do to get points on our final.

CEM 251 was the hardest class I have ever taken, strictly because of this professor. Professor Chiu is the worst professor I have ever had. The exam is filled with problems that you have never seen in your life, compared to the easy lecture. This professor should be fired immediately. I hope Michigan State sees how poorly her students think of her.
