reviews.comment: Welcome to CEM251, oh I mean hell on earth. Don't ever think about taking this professor she should go back on academic probation.

PLEASE do not take cem 251 with her. She makes the exams super hard so then everyone struggles and proceeds to make 3 questions worth like 50 points alone. Our exam 2 average was a 30% average to which we had to have a "redo" for (as well as our other THREE exams.) By far the worst class I have taken at msu because she was the professor. 0/10 tbh.

Sucks because she's a nice person. If you can avoid it, DO NOT TAKE CHIU. Doing the extra credit, homework, and trying your best on quizzes will save you if you do bad on exams. Exams are impossible, even GA's say they are difficult. Go to office hours. Just because you are good at something, doesn't mean you can teach it! Never again!! :(

10/10 do not recommend. This class is tough as it is but this prof makes it 10x tougher. nearly impossible to pass the class and if you do it won't be with a good grade. averages exams around 30% and has to give out exam re-dos and a final exam pre-do just for us to get a good grade and for her to look like she is doing a good job teaching

I am genuinely shocked by this professor. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. Last exam average was a 30%. She makes everything 1000x more confusing and difficult than it already is. This class would only be improved if it was taught by a different professor.

this professor is very rude she has a average test grade of 30% and dose not care for her students, she already has a final redo out because she has no faith that her student will do well

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH THIS PROFESSOR!!!
do not take any class with this professor. She has no respect for her students and thinks it is funny to produce a 30% average on her exams. Beware before you take this class. DO NOT RECCOMEND
This professor has had maybe the worst impact on mental health I have ever seen done by anyone in the Chem department.

Worst class I've ever taken. The professor seems nice, but she is not a good teacher, and I always left her lectures feeling more confused. Exam averages were terrible (last one was 30%), and the professor didn't seem concerned and didn't change the class/exam structure to help us. Relied heavily on extra credit and exam re-dos to pass the class.

Genuinely one of the worst professors ever. Exam problems are harder than anything you were exposed to. TA said that she purposefully tries to trick students on exams. You can ask TAs for help on exam redos, but even then, they can't get the right answer sometimes. Lots of extra credit, but she makes everything more stressful than it needs to be.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Chiu is a nice person, but is genuinely the worst professor I have ever had. She does not explain anything and whenever she writes on her slides it is illegible. The test questions are unrealistic and are no where close the practice and homework that she gives us and what she teaches. Seriously do NOT take her class.

As much as I want to be compassionate and give her a chance, this class was miserable.  She did not explain anything well, gives out a ton of homework, in order to get a passing grade you have to do triple the amount of work in extra credit, and never really seemed to care for her students grades.  Avoid her at all costs.

Do NOT take with this professor. She read directly off her slides that were basic examples and would give us quizzes and exams that were extremely difficult and gave us no materials to help. We were a month behind the whole semester and she tried to cram everything into the last week. Exam averages were 30%. I learned more from youtube than her.

Professor Chiu is truly very intelligent and passionate about her field, but her class was an absolute dumpster fire in more ways than I can even write about. It is currently 8 days before our final, we have one lecture left, and we are an entire unit behind. Listen to the reviews, and take my sacrificed GPA as a warning, take anyone else's class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: please do yourself a favor and listen to these reviews. she is the worst professor I've ever had. 30% exam average. gives the most simple examples in class and then puts outrageous questions on the exam. lectures are on tophat so half the time you don't get the slides beforehand. i wish i could give a 0 rating,genuinely the worst prof I've ever had
INSANE to have a "pre-do" for the final. She knows we're all going to fail. We've had two "redo" exams for the midterms. All of these second chance points so she can hide her failure. I'm cooked. ❤️

It's almost like she wants the class to fail. She does not change the difficulty of the exams, despite low averages and the need for retakes. She gives extra credit, but I don't know my grade in the class. More homework that was released and it's due in a week. She makes things way harder than they need to be. Should not be a professor.

Worst professor I've ever had. Averages are low, retakes for every exam including the final (which we haven't taken yet), quizzes have such low averages that the last one was open book, unlimited attempts, and online. Feels like I haven't learned a thing. Rushes thru lectures bc the first ~30 min are to answer questions from select students.

This professor was very nice but cannot teach at all. The class has fallen so behind because of her lecturing style and we have been cramming content. I am going to get a good grade in this class solely because of extra credit which she uses because of our horrible exam averages. I have never felt so hopeless in a class, and her exams are brutal.

I mean, throughout the course, she tells us how hard it is, then proceeds to give trick question exams and make the course even harder. What is the point if over half the class is failing every exam? You're evidently doing something wrong. If you have the option to avoid this course, I highly recommend you do so.

Very tough exams and instead of making the exams easier and more understandable, she just gives us redo exams. I would rely more on extra credit and homework, but she doesn't even tell us our final grade so I cant even tell if im passing or not. Take her class if you want to fail! :)
never in my life....

DO NOT take this course. I would be shocked if she is allowed back next semester. she brags about have 25% on her finals and that this course is impossible. without extra credit I doubt you could get above a 50%. Do not take this course unless you love the idea of failure. You have been warned....

This may be null and void by next semester, because I have a feeling professor Chiu will not be allowed to teach this course ever again. While CEM 251 is expected to be rigorous, she found a way to make succeeding in her class an impossible feat, and hides her poor teaching with mountains of extra credit. Avoid at all costs. Last exam average = 30%

Do not take any class with her if you want to actually know what you are doing in chemistry. She gives you a lot of extra credit but doesn't actually teach you well enough to do good on the exams in the first place. The only reason she gives extra credit is because the class fails so badly she has to. I'm not gonna know a single thing for orgo 2.
I have considered dropping out of college because of this professor

The only good thing about this class is the extra credit. Our last midterm exam class average was a 30%, but since we did so poorly she allowed us to do a take home re-do to earn 80% of the points we missed back. Her lectures move too fast and there is so much material to understand. Do all the extra credit you can, do all the HW, and READ

Yeah I was pretty much cooked from the start, she made chemistry look confusing and I took intro to Organic in HIGHSCHOOL! The class average is below a 50% and the latest exam was a 30% average. The whole entire class would've been impossible without the exam redos and EC. Please do not take this course 1/4 of you could be on your way out.

DO NOT take her if you don't want to tank your gpa. Out of 350 students her class average for an exam was 30%. Grad students took the second exam before we did and struggled with the content. She told us certain content wasn't on the exam and then still included it. Intentionally makes exam questions way harder than any practice she provides us.

If you start falling behind in this class, you're basically doomed. Her exams are 50% multiple choice (where the answer could be all the choices or none of the choices) and 50% free response. Her average for the exams has been 60%, 50% and most recent one is 30%. Her lectures move reallllly fast, and the quizzes are 5 questions and 25 points.

reviews.comment: Very bad lecturer and professor overall, she is unprofessional and does not know how to teach or use the technology. Very hard grader and tests are way harder than assignments and homework. Seems like she wants to purposefully fail everyone, do not take her class.

Did not teach me a thing. 350 students averaged a 30% on one of her midterms. Studied for days to get an 18% on multiple choice. Grad assistants struggled on the exam when taking it. Doesn't respond to emails; don't know if I will pass, grades depend on extra credit she throws in when whole class fails. Made this semester a living Hell for me.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her class averages for quizzes are 50% & our last exam average was a 30%. She explicitly said that she makes the quizzes harder than homework problems, and exam questions more difficult than the quizzes. The first time seeing a complicated problem on an exam is a terrible way to teach. If you don't go to extra recitations or office hours good luck.

i never write about anything only review. but this professor does NOT know how to teach. Very nice person. But extremely bad at teaching. she skips over steps that are essential for learning and we are extremely behind. our class averaged a 30% on our last test out of 366 ppl. her exams are extremely difficult for no reason.

The first midterm average was 60% (probably lower) and the second midterm average was 30%. The quiz averages are constantly below 50%. There is a lot of extra credit but likely not enough. She's a nice person but a horrible professor. Unfortunately, she was the only one teaching CEM251 this semester. DO NOT take her. Take orgo another time.

DO NOT TAKE!!! Please find someone else to teach Orgo. She is a nice professor but doesn't actually teach anything, she talks about the general overview of the topics. We are 5 weeks behind, and on the last exam, the class averaged a 30%. Extra credit opportunities are the only thing that may help me pass the class.

Do not take this professor. Exams are a majority of your grade and the averages are around 60% or lower. The extra credit that past reviews have mentioned has been significantly reduced. It will help a bit but you cant 4.0 the class with extra credit alone. The only positive is she is a genuinely good person and means well but is a horrible teacher

If you don't find resources outside of the ones she gives you (recitation, help hours/office hours, textbooks, etc) you will fail the class. Everything she gives you is basic examples but if you actually want to learn the material you need extra help.

Lied to me,  in an email when saying the class average has been between 60 and 80 on all assignments (I have screenshots of our class averages on quizzes/exams being below 50%) and made me feel crazy. Problems in lecture are easy and then anything we get graded on is 10x harder and you get no understanding of how to do it. No answer keys!

I reached out to this professor multiple times begging for help because the class average was below 50% and she didn't even answer me for months. Mind you EVERY quiz AND exam the class average was near 40-50% which is insane to me.

Does not provide answer keys to study guides. study guides have stuff on them you haven't learned yet. Not very flexible in office hours. very test heavy compared to what we are given to practice. take general chemistry 2 if you want to be set up to succeed in this class even if your major does not require it. very little extra credit.
Melanie Chiu is an awful lecturer. If you could chose between this class and eating cement, the latter would be less arduous.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I never rate but I'm coming on here mid semester to say she is genuinely the worst professor I've ever had. Her exams are near impossible and she makes one question worth 50+ points. Gives the simplest examples in class and then puts outrageous questions on the exam. Do not take orgo 1 with her
Her teaching style really didn't work for me. made concepts seem more confusing than they were. forget the lectures, just watch youtube videos and read the book

Lectures always went great, but the quizzes and exams were way harder than necessary. There were hundreds of homework assignments each week but none of them resembled the type of questions seen on exams. Class averages for quizzes/exams were always super low. One good thing was the huge amount of extra credit that let me 4.0 the class.
Awful Just awful dont take this class

I thought that she was a nice professor but the class is extremely unfair.There were around 900 homework problems that take up way too much time and do not reflect whats on the exams. The midterm average was a 50% and the final average was 27% HOW CAN YOU FEEL CONFIDENT ABOUT A CLASS WHEN THE AVERAGE IS A 27%. Absolutely ridiculous avoid this class

I enjoyed taking organic chem with Dr. Chiu. She made the lectures interesting and had great slides, and explained most concepts very well! I found the homework very helpful to reinforce the concepts, and if you did your homework regularly it really wasn't much to do at all. The exams were tough, but if you do well on quizzes and EC you can 4.0

Dr. Chiu was a very good lecture, and was a very good lecture, and gave us a lot of practice problems through homework. She gave us a lot of extra credit, which was very generous, and she was very personable, and wanted us to succeed. My only complaint or her exams expectations were unclear.

Chiu is a very nice women but her first semester teaching resulted in a 27% exam average. There are around 900 homework questions that only count for 150 points in a 550 point class. She was very nice and provided lots of extra credit but lacks the ability to teach her students so they can retain it and covers it up with extra credit.

Dr. Chiu is one of the nicest professors you'll ever meet. Her exams are insanely difficult but there's so much extra credit for you to make up for it. I got a 30% on the final and got a 4.0. So funny to see people get an A, say she's very sweet, and still rag on her. Lost confidence in ratemyprof now.

Never take CEM251 with her. We had almost 1000 homework problems assigned for barely any class credit and almost all of the homework difficulty was wayyy past the scope of the class. The midterm and final were basically impossible, with the final having an average of around 25%. Do not take his professor if you have other options

I feel bad leaving a bad review because she genuinely was a caring person and was helpful in office hours. However, she assigned over 800 homework problems and made the exams unreasonable. On the final the class average was about a 27%. She at least offers a lot of extra credit, which is really nice.

I liked Dr. Chiu as a professor and when showing up to office hours, it was clear to see how much she cared about her students and wanted us to succeed in the class. The only thing I didn't like was how the exams were made - I feel like they were nothing like the reviews and what she had taught us and so, the class in general did very poorly.

Ochem is difficult, so be ready to study/learn. Dr Chiu's first time teaching was fall of 2023, and scores were low on exams. However, she is VERY responsive to feedback. Total class is ~500 points, but there's over 130 points of extra credit. The final exam scores were low, so she gave out a final exam re-do. Caring prof, wants students to do well

DO NOT TAKE ORGO WITH THIS PROFESSOR!!! The only reason i passed was becuase there was more extra credit points than exams. She did not explain things well at all, just read the slides. My TA was super helpful with answering questions but it did not help me on exams. Our averages for quizzes were 50%, and the final average was a 27%. Ridiculous
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Final exam scores were so bad. Class average was a 27% on the final. The highest anyone scored on the multiple choice was a 72%. Very disappointed

She doesn't deserve the rating she has. Like others have said - she's a very sweet person. It was her first semester teaching and things didn't go perfectly, but she was so adaptable and gave out a lot of extra credit. The final exam was, frankly, impossible - but the extra credit makes up for it all. One of the most caring professors I've had.

Exams are Super Hard, and do not relate to the homework. This course is homework heavy, close to 900 questions. She does offer a lot of extra credit that should boost ur grade up over 100 point. He is very lecture heavy, no technology allowed but I honestly believe it helped me focus in class. The tests are heavy but very precise to what he says in lecture, it is very easy if you just listen and take notes in class.

Lectures go off topic at times, sometimes unclear on what notes to take. Homework and readings can be lengthy but can help with understanding some of the material. Unfortunately 4 exams count for 80% of your grade, no drops. It's a bit challenging, but flashcards, quizlets, and his practice exams were good for studying. Gradebook was also unclear.

The only reason I gave Prof. Dyer anything above a 1 is because I would love him if he weren't a professor. His class is incredibly disorganized. It is so unclear what is assigned and what is optional and what needs to be done for the day. Only take this class if you're good at bio and test-taking, because 80% of your grade is exams.

Don't ever take this class the professor is terrible doesn't respond to his email and doesn't know how to use technology. Goes very off topic in class and brings up things that are not relevant to the subject or exam

reviews.comment:
bro is very senile and is not tech savvy at all, terrible at using d2l. 

otherwise hes a nice guy, just too old for this
He's really nice and very clearly cares about biology, but the tests come out of nowhere and account for a big percent of your grade.

reviews.comment: Dr. Dyer is really passionate about the subject he teaches, which is good because when you have questions because he will give you a detailed response to help you understand. His lectures go in depth but can also be boring. There is a good amount of homework and reading, which can be beneficial. He also hosts review sessions on Zoom before exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Excellent professor.  You can tell he is passionate about what he teaches and knows his stuff, giving extremely detailed/specific answers to questions outside the scope of the class.  He keeps his lectures super topical and up-to-date, and he has a great sense of humor (if a little understated).  Too much reading and not enough assignments, though.

This guy sucks fr. Avoid him at any cost. 
He clearly doesn't know how to format a course properly, and always has random reading quizzes he assigns on a Saturday making them due Monday that don't relate to anything we talk about in class until 2 weeks later. Slides are blank & he doesn't post them until 2 days before the exam, so go to class.

This was one of the easiest classes I've ever taken. Yes exams are 90% of the grade but they were straightforward and I barely studied for them. There is a no laptop policy but I found it easy to hand write good notes. He doesn't post slides until close to the exam but I never found the need to use them. I really enjoyed the lectures and the class.

reviews.comment: Dyer is extremely unorganized and unprofessional. He was extremely hard to communicate with outside of class, and even in class he would say one thing but then do another. We were often behind on material, as he would often talk about things that didn't apply to the class. Unfair grading. Please do yourself a favor and not take this class.

reviews.comment: Don't take this class PLEASE. Exams are worth 90% of your grade so if you do bad there's no going back. His D2L site sucks and he doesn't communicate/email. reviews.comment: Instructor is unprofessional and difficult to approach. Enforces a no-laptop policy without flexibility and often belittles students instead of offering reminders. Poor communication, delayed lecture uploads, and overly complex exams that seem designed to confuse rather than assess understanding.

Professor Dyer seems like a nice and intelligent person, but his class is unbearable. His D2L page is extremely unorganized. He doesn't upload his slides until a couple of days before the exam and they barely make any sense without going to class. Dyer said we would have in class worksheets, but we've only done around 3 the entire semester.

reviews.comment: I took this class thinking it would be easier than it was. The homework was very easy but sometimes it was hard to remember that it was due each Tuesday. reviews.comment: Cool dude, funny. But exams are worth 90% of the grade, and the lecture slides aren't the best. But he is really nice and very smart

This class was difficult to study for since materials were often posted late. Exams make up the entire grade. He lectured pretty fast and it was oftentimes hard to understand the connecting topic as new information was brought up. The book helped a little but was mainly unneeded info. It was difficult to display my understanding of the course.

reviews.comment: The class is graded almost entirely by three exams, but the study questions Fred releases are almost exactly like the exams so you can get really prepared, plus they're curved, and he gives lots of time for questions. The textbook is huge and not very helpful, but I found his lectures engaging and well structured, very understandable.

Dr. Dyer was a really nice man, he was funny and caring but his lectures were really boring. Lectures didnt correspond well with the weekly quizzes and the tests. 90% of grade is tests. Weekly quizzes on the readings. It is interesting stuff but sometimes hard to sit through.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dyer is a very kind professor and has a lot of passion for what he teaches. There was a lot of reading, and there are test questions on what you read, so make sure you do it. The exams are difficult but he hosts review sessions on zoom before the exams and you can ask as many questions as you need. Overall Dyer is a good professor!

Fred was such a nice and funny guy. His lectures were a bit boring but he did do his best to make the content interesting, and he explains topics very well. Super caring guy, does curve exams, and overall a great professor and a good person.

He is a nice guy but kind of boring when it comes to his lectures. This was a very hard course if you are not good at science. It can be a hard class when it comes to notetaking because I wasn't always sure what to write down.
Awful grading system

Professor Dyer knows what he's talking about but the lectures can be very boring. The slides are hard to follow as he skips through them pretty fast. The exams are pretty hard and it can be hard to achieve a good grade without studying days in advance.

Everyone is complaining about this class on this which made me nervous before taking it, although after completetion the class is not as bad as it is made out to be. if you go to class and watch the review videos before the exams you will do fine. although his lectures do cover a lot of unnecessary things.
His lectures were so boring and the exams were pretty difficult. His slides made no sense and he skipped through them very fast. Overall, I did not like this class at all.

I took six classes this semester, and this one felt the most like a class. It was challenging, but not awful, and I learned a lot about behavior. The professor's a great guy and loves class discussions. You can come to every Other lecture and be fine. Quizlet helps. Only issue is that 90% of the class is 3 exams, but they're curved! Good luck!

Course is test heavy and they are difficult, but if you try your best & put in the work, you'll likely succeed. Though he's difficult to reach outside of class, he's one of the kindest and caring profs you'll have, and is always willing to talk before & after class. Never went off topic and everything was straightforward. Interesting class overall!

I would advise studying in advance for his exams as they are based on how well you understand the material rather than just memorizing facts. It's easy if you pay attention to lectures, but you can definitely do the before-class quizzes without doing the reading. I didn't even buy the books required for the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I would not recommend Professor Dyer. His tests are some of the hardest I have had out of my classes I ever took. reviews.comment: He is a very nice person however I didn't find it very easy to do this class. It was very quiz and test heavy. The exams are difficult. The quizzes are bearable but still not easy. reviews.comment: Please pick another professor for ISB. Its mandatory so theres plenty more to pick from. Fred is a decent man, quite intelligent actually. However, to enjoy life skip this man please. He rants for 2hours monotone voice and 25% of the things he says actually matter. Save yourself.

Fred's class made me love biology so much more. This class made me more interested in evolution specifically. Sometimes the concepts were boring or hard to understand, but he was always available after class to go into further detail if needed. As long as you take good notes and attend/watch the lectures, this class is an easy A

I like biology so this class was interesting to me, but if you aren't this class won't be fun. Dyer goes into deep detail about things that won't be on the exam. The exams Themselves are difficult but nothing on them should surprise you.

The exams for this class were the hardest out of my six classes. There was a lecture twice a week and I appreciate that he knows what he's talking about but they weren't super interesting. A sweet guy but not a class I wanted to sit through.

reviews.comment: He is a kind man, but not a good professor (at least for online). Quizzes take forever, and there are a lot of them. He won't post the notes until a week before the exam. He probably won't answer any of your emails, at least not for weeks. Exams are often not worded well and the keys might be wrong. This class was much harder than needed to be.

Professor Dyer is not fit for online teaching. The only thing he was consistent with was posting quizzes late. He told us at the beginning of class that the exam would be open book but then required a lockdown browser. When asked what to do, he said, "I don't know, print it out?"

This is what you expect from a professor teaching an introduction class. Professional, requires some brain power, really interesting, though not presented in the best manor. And if you go meet him in his office, he's nice, and helpful. The exams are only slightly challenging. Explains it so even someone with no experiences can understand.
Very lecture heavy and didnt post notes on his website. Tests and quizzes are the entire grade. But very passionate about course topic.

reviews.comment: Professor Dyer is smart, don't get me wrong. He clearly understands what he's talking about, but he is awful at teaching it effectively. Once class starts, he begins talking right away and doesn't stop for an hour an a half. He goes through slides super fast so it's hard to take notes sometimes. Tests are brutal and not like the notes.
Smart, funny, knows how to hold your attention in a course that can sometimes be monotonous. Seems to actually care about how his students perform. Would highly recommend.

Dr Dyer does not seem like he wants to be teaching this class and only uses PowerPoint presentations. It is very hard to take notes because he quickly moves between slides. The slides are posted 2 days before the exam. All the test questions are specific details from the book that he may or may not have covered in class. Overall a bad professor.
This guy knows his bio, and is interesting. He looks like Steven Colbert... I wish I could take more classes with him.

Props to F.C. Dyer!  One and a half hour lectures are a bit long but this prof. knows his stuff and shares interesting experiments from around the globe.  Probably my best Biology course of all time-- Two thumbs up for Applied Org. and Env. Bio!!  Attend everyday and take some notes and a 4.0 is yours!!
Good, but boring... my advice, take your OWN notes, then study off his. otherwise you have no chance of actually retaining any info.  Tests are hard... mostly essays.
Unorganized, had a bit of a problem with fulfilling promises.  Lectures weren't always the best to understand.
Props to Princeton - this prof is smart and he knows it. He's pretty damn arrogant. Often pontificates in monotone -- you can tell when he's not talking to you anymore. Nice smile but a heartbreaker.

I havnt even finished the semester and I cannot stand this class.  He is the worst professor I have ever seen.  The class is pretty much him reading off of the powepoints and pointless tests that test for nothing that we have learned...NEVER TAKE THIS CLASS FROM THIS PROFESSOR HE IS HORRIBLE!
Hes got neat info but his attitude stinks.
No Comments
He gives good information but is arrogant to the class.
No Comments
tough teacher. all essay exams.

Dr Doherty is a wonderful professor. She cares a lot about all of her students and will do anything in her power to ensure they do well. Just make sure you come to lecture and PLEASE attend office hours! Hers are so helpful and she is so fun to talk to. The environment she creates is very welcoming and judgement-free.

Dr, Doherty does extremely well in lecture, giving time, although often not enough, for you to go over the new materials in your groups, which really helped solidify the material for me. She is a wonderful teacher, and I truly recommend taking her class!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Doherty is an amazing bio professor. She makes it clear that her top priority is your education by allowing for unlimited exam retakes and accepting late work. reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She taught the subjects clear and was very understanding if you needed support on topics. Exams were broken up perfectly to not be too content heavy. Lecture materials were easy to understand and study.

Amazing professor! Clearly cares a lot about her students' well-being and will go through the material thoroughly with you if you have any questions. Always takes the time out of her day to accommodate and help students. 10/10 would take her class again!!

I have never had a class where you learn so much quality material, and at the same time, the professor prioritizes helping you get your desired grade. She was just the best and gives you quite literally endless opportunities as long as you put some effort. The best professor at Lyman Briggs for sure.

Honestly this class is easy if you would rather just 4.0 and use a bit of effort to achieve it, but the professor is just straight rude. As for my experience, when I had trouble understanding her, she would laugh at me which made me feel very embarrassed. dr. doherty is literally amazing. everyone who says otherwise expected a class where they would not have to put effort. her approach to bio is so interesting and i've learned so much. definitely take this class with her she's so approachable and always available. just expect to actually put in effort since yknow it is college.

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved having Dr. Doherty this semester, you can really tell that she cares about her students and their learning. I would 100% recommend taking her for LB 145, you are able to retake each exam until you get the score you want overall a great approach to bio 2!

reviews.comment: I think she cares about you and wants you to learn and has very flexible office hours but the standard grading makes it difficult to get even a 3 because of how meticulously things are graded even if you go to class do the homework go to office hours and study i found this grading scheme to be stressful and a strange way to teach a college class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I loved having Dr. Doherty! She is great at keeping everyone engaged during the whole class and explaining things. You can redo anything in the class, she is funny and very easy to reach outside of class. She wants the best for her students and gives you everything you need to do well in 145. I would recommend her to everyone!

Communicating with Dr. Doherty is easy and she's accessible outside of her office hours. She drills the fundamentals of her core concepts (general models) into your brain, making her topics easily digestible. Her lecture can sometimes be confusing so do the homework. Course is out of standards instead of points/percentage but you can retake them.

Dr. Doherty is awesome, and she really wants to see her students succeed. Everything we did was figuring out connections and cause and effect. However, "gifted" kids beware; since connections are something we usually excel at, lectures can get boring because most people need much more time to think about things that come quickly to us.

Best teacher I have ever had. You are guaranteed a 4.0 as long as you try due to the grading she has which is different than others. Extremely nice and super knowledgable and flexible. I'd recommend going to office hours and the ULAs review sessions.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Doherty is one of the best professors I've ever had. She gives you great feedback and she is very flexible with the deadlines. 100% would take it again, and 100% recommend taking her!! She truly cares about you and your success!

Dr Doherty is a blessing to have. She will make sure you pass with a 4.0 no matter what and is a wonderful caring person to have for LB bio. No matter what you will learn everything and be prepared for exams. She also offered retakes on all her exams, and her labs were always so much fun. She is truly the professor to go with.

I dont know how else to say this then to say just take this class with her. You will love biology because she actually cares about you learning the material she teaches. You can retake everything and have all semester to do so.

Dr. Doherty is by far the best professor I have had in my two years at MSU so far. She is both caring and funny. There are several opportunities for students to retake exams and lab reports if they do not get the grade that they want. Lecture is both engaging and easy to understand, and lab is the same way. I highly recommend taking her Bio class.

Professor Detmers was by far my favorite professor from my time at MSU. He made me realize how much easier it is to learn and understand when classes/lectures are engaging. His lectures are fun and engaging while still being content rich.He cares about his students and their learning as well as improving the way he teaches.
I loved Justin!! He gets to know every one of his students and teaches things that are actually helpful in the classroom. He is really funny and makes the 3 hour lectures go by fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He's hilarious, caring, smart and just one of the greatest professors I have had

I had Professor Detmers during senior year and 5th yr teaching internship. He is a fantastic person, both in and out of class. He genuinely cares you and is very accessible. He makes lessons fun and engaging, filled with comedy as well as meaningful moments. I highly recommend connecting with Dr. Detmers as a mentor during your studies. Go Green!
Detmers was great. He's funny and reliable if you need to reach out to him. overall just a good guy who cares about the content he's teaching/ the students he teaches.
He's just all around great

Really nice guy! You can tell he's educated on the topics of this class and actually cares to take the time to get to know his students/ care about their well being. Lectures are engaging for the most part- There isn't an excessive amount of homework. Only one or two assignments a week but the reading does take a bit of time.

reviews.comment: He's awesome

Class is very test heavy, and the exams are super hard. The content is extremely niche and very hard to prepare for. They're all open note but the slides and pre lecture videos are very often not that helpful. She's a very nice person but do not like her teaching style, leaves much to be desired.

Very passionate and amazing lecturer! The class is very difficult where the content from the quizzes and in class dont seem to always fully line up. I would recommend reading the textbook as it has lots of useful information. Wileyplus is definitely a must even though it seems optional. The labs are very fun but dont help learn the material.

reviews.comment: Very kind and upbeat professor. I enjoyed the labs in this class as they were rather easy. TAs were very helpful as well and led you in the right direction for the lab reports and quizzes. I will say though that the exams progressively got harder and I felt as if what we learned didn't always reflect what we were tested on and were weirdly worded.

Okay so the class is hard, test averages are 60 although the content isn't hard to master. Prof. Eisenlohr is really cool tho. She is passionate about her subject and clearly wants her students to learn. She is really funny and is easy to have casual conversations with. She is also very stylish and always has her hair up in flattering hairstyles.

Eisenlohr was a good professor, she wants her students to learn and answers emails fast. However the quizzes are very difficult and they make up most of your grade, the lectures and notes are base level compared to what's on the quizzes. The labs were very interesting and attendance is mandatory or your report/quiz won't be graded.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great teacher she knows what she is talking about and knows a lot about subject. Did best to keep students engaged in online environment. Beware Exams are harder than they appear. She doesn't give study guides and lectures are base level and exams ask much more in-depth questions. Use the textbook and you'll be fine

Solid Prof. It takes work, but if you show up to class and prepare for the quizzes, you will get a decent grade. Be sure to do optional assigned problems, and review lecture slides before quizzes. Ms. Eisenlohr was very organized, held engaging labs, and clearly explained all material.

I really enjoyed this class and Prof. Eisenlohr. She is very organized and knows what she is doing. The quizzes aren't that bad as long as you actually study for them (and maybe attend office hours) the labs were very engaging and very related to the rest of the class. I also found the material very interesting. The textbook is very helpful too.

Yeah she can be helpful at times, but lectures are useless. All she does is read off the slides with barely any class engagement. Quizzes are 50% of the grade and are all free response, and grading is very strict. Final is brutal and over content that she least covers. Can be rude at times as well and treats students as kids sometimes. Get ready.

Dr Evered is a very sweet and knlowedgable guy! However the class itself was not too interesting. You pretty much have to attend lectures to have any semblence of a clue about the material in the lectures, and despite this he is very prone to off-topic boring tangents. I started off very motivated for this class, ended up skipping a lot by the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A solid professor. Shows his hand in political ideology a little much for a Geo course, but most of the time he curbs his passion before it gets to an offputting point. A really good lecture-giver, and seems to be compassionate to student needs. Definitely not a bad professor by any means, in fact I'd take him again if I wasn't graduating.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had this guy for a couple of classes, and it was a very good experience. His lectures are interesting, and his dry humor is hilarious. His lower-level classes are very easy and are only exam based, while his higher level classes expect you to write a long paper. I would highly recommend anyone take GEO 440
Very nice man who seems passionate about the subject. Class has been super easy so far and I think I'm going to end up with an A. Looking forward to taking another class with him.

GEO 214 was a pretty interesting class, but I attended 4 lectures at most. The class was fully graded off of 4 exams, and I found his lectures kind of boring despite the interesting basis of the class, personally it was because he got off-topic and I would just zone out. Got a 4.0 in the class because the exams were pretty straightforward.

Kyle is an amazing professor and I would venture to say he is one of the few professors that truly make MSU a great institution. From his lectures on Geopolitics, it was abundantly clear that he knew everything there was to know on the subject and truly delved deep into topics rather than just providing an overview of the subject.

Very easy A but wouldn't recommend going to the lectures. Only graded on 4 online quizzes with an optional final for a grade booster. Lectures don't match quiz questions but the answers are still pretty self explanatory and he curves the results. Just drones on and on about things that don't pertain to the class.

Easiest class I've had in my entire life. It was actually pretty interesting and the professor is a really nice guy.  You could hypothetically not go to class at all and still take the 4 unproctored online exams that the class grade is based off of. Not to mention the tremendous amount of extra credit he gives. It's impossible to get a B.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I got a 4.0 and only attended one actual in person class. Easiest pass ever. Based professor. Amazing class.

Graded on 4 exams and a map quiz where you can take an extra exam to drop another, can easily 4-point the class. Gives extra credit. He does go on tangents though and can have political takes that are universally not great and was wrong/invalidating on some parts of his lecture. Seems like an okay prof and was self-deprecating/funny during lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is graded solely on exams, but the exams are multiple-choice, online, super easy, and have extra points included in them. He gives extra credit opportunities too. I attended like... only 10 lectures and got a 4.0. Recommend this class and professor, he's chill and doesn't care if you even attend class.

Geography of Eurasia- very easy class, but I think he assumes his students know more about Eurasia than they actually do. I was overwhelmed from the very beginning with terms, places, people I've never heard of

Kyle was an amazing professor to have. He was so nice and caring, and wanted all of his students to learn. When doing review sessions, he literally went off the exam to help students review. Sometimes he gets off topic, but he is very passionate on what he teaches. I would take him again in a heartbeat. One of my favorite professors here at MSU.

The course was incredibly easy. Your whole grade is 5 tests with the option to drop one but they are SO EASY. He gives you exactly what is on them, no homework all you have to do is show up. His lectures are hard to follow at first cause he goes on tangents but he gives you a study guide and if you have that out you can tell what is important.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved this class bc the material was interesting to me. He's passionate abt it and extremely knowledgeable. I respect him a lot and would love to have him as a professor again. However, he talks a lot + for a long time and goes off track often. If you're not interested in material or have a hard time listening w/out visuals I would not recommend

This was his first time doing the course online, and it showed. Lectures were super long/boring and even if you watched and took notes the exams are hard. Only graded on 4 exams (5 total but he drops 1) with 25 questions and a 30 minute time limit. You can do extra credit but they are a lot of work (3 pg book report3pts, 2 page video report2pts)
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are long and boring. However, going over the slides and doing your own research is helpful! Offers extra credit and tests are not extremely hard. Seems like a good class, however, you do need at least a 94 to 4.0. Overall, he responded to emails and seemed nice!
Lectures are very heavy and hard to pay attention to because they are too long. Maybe it would be different in person but this class was WAY to difficult online.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This was online asynch. He posted lectures and review guides late, and was overall inaccessible as a professor.
