reviews.comment: Dr. Viet is a great professor and also easily accessible, she has office hours right after class. There is a lot of lectures and readings so if you take this course make sure your semester is has 4 classes including this one. You will do just fine in the course if you read the readings and watch the lectures.

Professor Veit is a great professor but the ways she structures the class is stupid. reviews.comment: Prof Veit is one of the best professors at MSU. Expectations are clear and easy to follow. Exams and quizzes are VERY easy as long as you pay attention.

reviews.comment: I adore Professor Veit! She's one of the best professors I've had. I'd 100% recommend her to anyone seeking a challenge and meaningful connections!

reviews.comment: Great professor, amazing class. She really knows how to teach a subject. Great at encouraging discussion among students, great at encouraging thoughtful engagement with the subject. Professor Veit was the worst History professor I have had at MSU. I received the worst grades in any class I have ever taken at MSU, and it's not due to my work. reviews.comment: Professor Veit is generally a great teacher she cares a lot about the things she teaches and she cares about the atmosphere of the class room as well. Taking History of Food and Alcohol with Prof Veit was great. She's very knowledgeable on it, she provides very interesting topics to discuss, and class was always enlightening. reviews.comment: Prof Veit is by far the best professor I've had at MSU. She is very knowledgeable and makes the information so interesting. Fantastic teacher

reviews.comment: She's a great professor that makes learning boring American history more exciting. I wouldn't say its an easy course, you will have to work for your A but it doesn't seem like too much work. Actually really enjoyed her and HST 202.
She is very knowledgeable and she presents information in a very interesting way.
AWESOME professor.  Not very interested in History before taking the class and she made it interesting. The best professor I had this year! Take her class, I hope to have her again!

Fantastic Professor! She was always interested in the subject matter and everything was very clear. Show up, do you work, participate and you will have the 4.0 no problem. I easily 100'd my midterm because of the study guide she provided, and I would not consider myself an exceptional student by any means. Awesome awesome awesome prof!
As long as you show up and do the assignments, you're good.

She is very clear on what will be on the tests and how they will be laid out, and she gives some freedom on how to write your papers. The only bad thing is that she goes through the lecture really fast and it can be hard to keep up. She also puts a lot of minutiae into her lectures, i think to throw you off. Good prof tho.

Great Professor! This class was so much fun and very interesting. I never got bored during one of her lectures. Very clear on what to study, she even gave out study guides. I hope to take many more of her classes in the future! Highly Recommended!

Genuinely never meet a professor that wants you to fail in my life, she not even in the profession she teaches, on top of that she teaches a technology related course and talks about africa the whole time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I am a senior and I have never had a worse professor than her. She dosnt respond to emails unless you CC her boss. She doesn't care about her students at all and completely disrespects them, shes very entitled and has a huge ego. Overall she does not care to help you if you take her class you are basically done for.
This professor was the worst grader. Does not follow rubric given and takes off points for the littlest of thing. The lectures are also very long and boring. Would not take again if I could.

this is one of the most enthusiastic professor that does  NOT do her/their? job correctly. I swear it was a yapathon and then a BS quiz with no way to prep. The assignment were graded too strictly, as this professor is not even working in this field of study that we are working on. It all was such a nuisance. big ups on the football glass design.

Professor Wyche is not a bad professor, but is slightly unorganized. She does not utilize D2L, the university platform for classes, lectures, and homework, which makes it difficult to track assignment descriptions and when they are due. The workload is reasonable for a 400-level class. She likes to lecture which makes it difficult to speak up.

The bad ratings come from people taking offense to her statements about "cis white men" in tech. She's not a terrible professor and when she brings up the problem of diversity it's relevant. She's a tough grader and her assignments can be confusing, but she's also pretty accommodating. If you show up to class and pay attention you'll be fine!

Susan Wyche is the most unprofessional and condescending professor I've had. Her huge ego makes her incapable of taking constructive criticism, unsuitable to teach a 400 level course. 0 flexibility with grading, feminist and gender biased, unorganized teaching style, and is the most nit picky professor I have worked with. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS!
Awful grader, not teaching a 400 level class, huge feminist, overall not an enjoyable professor at all and makes you hate the class because of it

reviews.comment: The most NIT PICKY professor that I've ever come across. NOT in a sense where you can learn from either, she is literally just picky to be picky & will tear your work apart with 0 regard for the amount of hours you put in. Absolutely scatterbrained with 0 sense of structure for her courses on TOP of not being able to take constructive criticism.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took GEO221L and it wasn't bad, despite the confusing instructions. Like kid you not, half of the time I was doing the lab, I was trying to decipher the instructions because they would mix up the instructions. She is a very nice person, and easy to get ahold of outside of class!

The class is pretty easy as it is online. There are weekly quizzes, two writing assignments, and a final exam. What annoyed me was the grading for the writing assignments was quite harsh for a 100 level online corse. My 300 level class was graded easier than this one. Other than that it is an easy extra course.
Took this class online - never met her in person, but she was very nice and understanding over email when I had issues with ArcGIS. A decent amount of work but you'll be okay if you budget your time.

I only took the online lab for this course, but it was fairly easy and had a decent amount of room for creativity. Dr. Fink was very encouraging and was a very easy grader in my experience. Good amount of extra credit points offered for completing evaluations. The only assignments were semi-lengthy labs every 2 weeks.
I took the GEO221L online. This class was alright although I wish it was set up differently or at least in person. Grading wasn't too bad though and only had a lab due every other week.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took the online 221 course so I never met Dr. Fink, but she seemed really encouraging and kind in all her emails. Clear grading criteria and detailed instructions. Very organized online course material. Obviously quiz heavy since it's an online class, but we had some activities to help balance it out. Easy 4.0 and learned a lot!

I took the online GEO221 lab and did not find it to be very difficult. Dr. Fink is a bit hard to reach through email (she never responded to one email I sent). As long as you put a little bit more than minimal effort then this class is pretty easy.

As others have said, she is a very kind person but, unfortunately, not the best at teaching. As wonderful of a person as she is, I stopped attending lectures mid-way through the semester because I just wasn't learning anything. I have grievances with the course itself, but I believe the GEO dept largely manages the curriculum for courses

Dr. Wisa is a solid professor and I enjoyed her class. While the final paper was a group project and the largest paper I had to write my freshman year, you had a lot of freedom to pick your topic. Textbooks were optional and free. My only complaint is that the exams were due on irregular days and times, and as a result I racked up late penalties.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The online version of her class was fine and super easy. All you had to do was read the D2L content pages (easy but long), take the quizzes, do the activities (guided by detailed instructions to follow) and pass no problem. It was entirely online, so all of the grades were based off of online quizzes and activities, so just make sure you do them.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Language barrier made following along with lectures difficult at times. Questions on tests and quizzes were sometimes incomprehensible. Be warned that a large part of your grade will come from a final group project.
There was certainly a language barrier and a good amount of the questions on the quizzes were either never mentioned in the lectures or incredibly vague.

Dr. Wisa is a very kind person, however probably the worst professor I've ever had. There is definitely a language barrier and I had issues on almost every quiz with questions that were incomprehensible. Often there were questions on the quizzes that appeared no where in lecture and I often felt lost. This class ruined my GPA.

Friday lectures are superrrr important, they give answers to lab reports that are really helpful. Labs and the reports are not too bad. The worst things were the practical exams and the final. Also, the professor can come off as pretty condescending when you ask certain questions.

Idk who said theres no lec recording lol, he records every 8am lecture, just not noon recitation. Attendance only recorded for lab. If you attend recitation and lab he literally tells u all answers for lab report. Reports take ~5h and they grade strict. Dr. Weise is very kind&patient, he just really wants you to learn and is strict for that reason.

reviews.comment: just bad. The guy's nice and so are the other professor, but the lab reports and homeworks are just ridiculous, they don't teach you how to do it, you just gotta figure it out. The gradings on the lab reports are absolutely horrid and inconsistent. You don't have any other choice but him. 8am lectures, no recordings.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Sosososo much work put into this class. Very informative, even past just grading, I really felt like I learned a lot and gained important skills. Very tough grader he takes points off for from font size, line width, and look of your report.

He was reasonable in his grading and very clear on what he expects to be in the lab report. There are lab practicals after every unit, but he provides the exact questions ahead of time so if you just put in the effort you can easily pass.
This professor was the best professor I have had for biochemistry. Anyone who rates him bad did not put in the effort needed to succeed in this class.

The lectures did not cover the material on homework or exams. He does not respond well if he believes he covered your question, very passive aggressive. The grading system is the most confusing I've ever had, it's very rarely explained why you're losing points but you lose them for every little thing.

Could be a great class but unfortunately turned out to be my worst experience in college so far. Grading feels unfair most of the time and there is no feedback on why your data is inaccurate (only points taken off). Attending class feels unrewarding when exams and notebook questions are 80% on calculations you will never be taught how to do.

Dr. Weise is passionate about biochemistry. He encourages questions but often responds harshly if he feels the question isn't valid. I've not only experienced this myself, but witnessed this toward other students. He is a nice person and can carry interesting conversations, but his responses sometimes made me feel uneasy about asking for help.

Weird structure. Lectures only dive in knowledge and none on the calculations, while homeworks and exams are extremely calculation heavy???? I'm not even bad at math but some of these homework questions are not even mentioned in the lecture or the lecture slides, like at least mentioned how to do them or something. Grading criteria varies. Badddddd
He was the worst grader I have ever had for a professor in college. Unfairly graded all my assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: BMB 370 is definitely a challenging class, but it's doable. Dr. Weise is very helpful during office hours, but participation in class is extremely important. Lectures may not require attendance on paper, but Dr. Weise won't help you if you don't go to class. Overall, it was obvious he cared that you learned biochemistry.

Dr Weise is a great professo, he's clearly very intelligent and id passionate about his work.

BMB370 on the other hand is definitely the hardest course I've enrolled in thus far. Practicals are almost impossible to study for, and the final is very difficult. 

If you take this class, you need it as a priority in order to get a 4.0! Very difficult

He is an awesome person and very nice, but BMB370 is very hard. The practical exams are one of the hardest exams I have taken, you have to go to the lab and do everything by yourself and graph the data and everything in 3 hours. the exams are based on previous labs, but are very hard still. He doesn't answer conclusion questions on office hours.

You can tell that Dr. Weise cared that you learned biochemistry, but he was kinda passive-aggressive. The 8 am Monday lecture was not a good time for anyone and he got upset when people did not show up or learned the content. The lab was a bit unorganized and the exams were unfair given the knowledge and time we had to take them.

She moves pretty quickly during lectures and doesn't do very many example problems. Workload wasn't bad, but exams were difficult. I was unavailable during her office hours for help, so I would have to email her, but she never responded, including questions about doing an honors option, the exam, and homework, even after follow ups. Dont recommend.
kind, fast talker, encourages questions and gives good answers.

She is a very kind a helpful person. She gives a ton of extra credit and is very willing to help in office hours or through email. The midterm and final were hard, but you do get a cheat sheet, so it's not that bad. Overall, I really liked her and would take the class again.

Although CEM 252 is rough and can be hard taking this class with Dr.Vasileiou is a must she is so nice and understanding. I had ran out of tries on my aktiv homework she would reset them for me and my friends and she really cares that her students are learning. She gave us a 1pg cheat sheet for the midterm and 2pgs front and back for the Final.

It is clear that this professor cares deeply about this content, while also understanding that for most people, this class is a necessary stepping stone toward other classes. I really appreciated her enthusiasm, and it helped me get through the class. Also, for exams, you get a cheat sheet.

I took this course in-person. Seems to be much tougher when taken in person vs online. Does offer a ton of extra credit though. Attendance is not mandatory. Very little homework.

Would recommend her as a professor, but take online if at all possible.

She was an solid professor. She taught fairly well, but her Greek accent sometimes was hard to understand, but it wasn't too thick. Naturally, since this is orgo 2, it wasn't really easy, but that'd apply to any professor. Only major complaint was that the midterm (and probably final) were very difficult and had poor averages.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As a professor, she is good, not bad, but not great either. Lots of extra credit makes it easy, but you can learn the topics much more quickly by just attending recitation. Many times, I found that teaching myself while doing the homework was much more efficient, and the lectures were useless besides earning extra credit points.

I took the online version of Orgo 2 (I think they are getting rid of it though). Had sooo much extra credit. Responded to emails within minutes. Was always willing to stop lecture to answer questions. Great professor.
She was a great professor, this is a very hard class though. Don't let yourself fall behind at all, or you are cooked. You need to remeber stuff from cem 251

Dr. Vasileiou is a AMAZING professor for orgo II. Lectures were twice a week, and attendance was rewarded with extra credit, which she also gave ALOT of through quizzes, homework, exams, etc. Her lectures were super easy to understand, and she was always willing to answer questions throughout the lecture or through email. Best professor for orgo!!!
So so sweet and understanding. TAKE HER FOR ORGO.

Online organic chemistry 2 with Vasileiou was significantly easier than organic chemistry 1. She is a great teacher who is always willing to answer questions during lecture, with quizzes and exams that match up well with what was taught in class. She offers a lot of extra credit, through TopHat questions during lecture and other opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Vasileiou was a great professor, I was worried about the class since I took it online, but despite the content being hard, it was taught well. There is tons of extra credit in the class so it made a high grade easy to achieve. Professor Vasileiou was super easy to reach and very accommodating if I needed to switch a quiz to another day
Made it so easy but recitations are necessary if you don't understand, lots of time that content specifically came up on quizzes
Lots of extra credit provided, so make sure to get as much as you can. Everything is online and she provides help for any homework in her office hours

TAKE THIS CLASS ONLINE WITH HER!!!!! Seriously one of the easier classes I've ever taken, extra credit for just going to the lectures online and answering the tophat questions. Weekly quizzes and 2 exams with no lockdown browser. Basically gives out extra credit for breathing. Super sweet lady and explains and teaches orgo extremely well.

Love this woman, she makes this class incredibly easy to do well. 10% extra credit, lecture is optional, recitation is optional. Only downside is it is a late zoom lecture from 6-7:20pm but she records the lecture. Exams and quizzes are very fair and based off the homework, and all exams + quizzes are online no lockdown browser.

I was nervous to take organic chemistry over the summer but Dr. Vasileiou was an amazing professor. She understood we had lives outside of lecture and often recorded it and gave extra credit to those who watch the live lectures. She was very clear in teaching and broke everything well. If I have a chemistry class I would take it if she taught it.

Organic chemistry is a difficult subject to understand, but Dr. Vasileiou makes the topic easy to understand. She offers so much extra credit so make sure to use those opportunities. Although this is a virtual course, she is EASILY accessible: easy to meet for office hours or test/quiz accommodations. Online homework is a bit tricky so ask for help

Words cant explain how grateful I am to be able to have had Dr.Vasileiou as my orgo professor. If you want to 4.0 this class, YOU CAN! She makes it easy as long as you put in the work and are willing to learn. You don't have to break your back or be a try hard. she gives lots of extra credit and should I say makes enjoying chemistry possible?

I did most of my learning from the textbook, but it goes way more in depth than what is required. Lectures are optional but have tons of extra credit as clickers. There's a good amount of other extra credit too. She is very nice and will give extensions on the quizzes if you need. Accessibility is limited but expected for a class this large.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Great teacher for ORGO . Gives many opportunities to do well in the class.  10/10

She is an amazing woman and is always available to help you out. She is quite knowledgeable and makes 252 so easy to understand. She also offers lots of extra credit, and is flexible when you have to miss a quiz. I would advise to do the cengage homework early so you aren't cramming at the last minute. Super chill.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I truly love this woman and I only wish her the best. The class is hard, but she makes it easy for her students and she truly cares about everyone. Homework is hard and most of it is not like what we do in class. She offers lots of extra credit and she cares a lot for her students. Quizzes are MCQ, exams are MCQ and short answer

Dr. V is amazing and clearly cares about the success of her students. The amount of extra credit she offers is insane, and assures students' success in the course. Homework is hard but extra credit accounts for that. Quizzes and exams are easy and also have extra credit in them. If you see her as an option for orgs II definitely choose her.

Class overall seems fine but the homework is infuriating and goes against her reasoning for it helping you learn. You get five attempts per question but the question changes with each attempt and it doesn't actually explain what you did wrong or show the correct answer making is useless and irritating. At least tests are multi choice.

Her teaching style makes topics clear and easy to understand which helps you succeed on exams/quizzes. She's very kind and gives tons of extra credit opportunities. The homework can be annoying but it is really helpful. Easy to get a good grade and to actually understand orgo.

She is fine if you want to take this class and then never think about it again, the only way you will really learn in her class is by teaching it to yourself. she doesn't really teach anything apart from reading the slides. the only way to do decent in this class is by doing the extra credit which you have to pay for. DONT take if you wish to learn

Please take her class for orgo!! She is such an amazing professor. She really wants her students to succeed and offers so much extra credit it is literally impossible to fail the class. People saying its her fault that the averages were so low but organic chemistry is an extremely hard course that I thought she taught very well. Would recommend.
best orgo professor

Dr. Vasileiou was quite literally the best teacher I have ever had for any chemistry class i've ever taken. Not only does she give lots of extra credit but explains the material perfectly. Her tests are exactly what the lecture is on and aren't too difficult. I think it would be impossible to fail this class.

Lots of extra credit offered in this class. Quizzes/ exams are very clear with what will be on them. Personally, I thought the bookwork problems were sometimes more challenging than the tests. Attendance to lecture helps grade with in class EC everyday! She walks through the practice questions which I found really helpful.

If you need an easy orgo class Dr. Vasileiou is your best bet. I do think, quality wise, she is good, but with how stale the lectures are and how easy she makes earning extra credit, actual learning is difficult. I do not recommend if you will actually need orgo in the future unless you can concentrate super well.

This professor was the fairest professor I have ever had for a chemistry class. She gave so much extra credit that if you do it all it is IMPOSSIBLE to get anything less than a B. She gave amazing practice problems for each lecture that were nearly identical to the quizzes. The midterm was a bit tough but very doable. I recommend taking orgo w/ her

She seems like a nice lady, and you will get a good grade in this class if you apply yourself. My problem is that the class is too easy and I didnt learn anything. As a premed student thats a problem. I had her class online synchronized, her zoom lectures are awful. Camera off, cant ask questions just chat, made it difficult to engage.

Great Orgo prof. Class is not overly hard. Dr. V's office hours are very good, you learn a lot when you ask her questions. By far one of my favorite profs I've had so far. I also retained a lot of what was taught in her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She was great and made it super easy to do well in the class. Everything was organized and there were no surprises when it came to quizzes and exams. Tons of extra credit to boost your grade if you need it. The homework can be a pain at times (but the TA's at office hours are extremely helpful). Super nice and accommodating if you have to email.

Loved this class. She goes slow with the content so you actually understand. Makes orgo easy and fun to learn! Her tests are not crazy hard and are simple. Definitely attend lectures and take notes tho because due to her strong accent its hard to rewatch and properly make sense of what is being said. However, she is amazing and accommodating !
She is really nice. Since it's Orgo, make sure you attend her lecture and ask if you have any confusion. The extra credits will save your life but try to score well on quizzes and exams
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Without her generous amount of extra credit I probably would have had a 3.0, but ended with a 4.0. She has moves very quick but gives direct lectures that are easy to take notes off of.

Such an amazing professor. She makes a weed out class like orgo into an easy a. So much extra credit is offered on all quizzes and exams. Focus during her lectures and it will be easy to pass. Activities even replace the lowest quiz grades. Do the practice sets she offers before each quiz, and you will be fine. Also answers emails very quickly.

She wants her students to pass, and she offers a lot of extra credit opportunities. She is understanding of health issues and let me take a quiz at a later date when I was too sick to take it on time. Textbook is required to purchase, but I never used it. As long as you attend all lectures and do the homework you will easily pass.

She is a very nice professor, she explains things thoroughly although can be a bit confusing at times. Orgo is going to be a hard class in general but I found keeping up with her pace and organization a bit difficult.

This professor makes the class so easy to understand. Some of the hardest topics of organic chem are made easy because of her teaching style. She is very fair with grading and her quizzes and exams are super easy and straightforward. She gives so much extra credit is almost impossible to fail or even end with a C for that matter. Her class is great
I absolutely adored Professor Vasileiou! She explains organic chemistry in an open way that makes it easier to understand. Definitely one of my favorite professors so far!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Vasileiou made organic chemistry manageable and enjoyable. I took her for the summer class which is accelerated, so be ware that it is fast paced. She is superb in her abilities to explain concepts and gives out practice problems that replicate her exams. Attending class is extra credit and it is super manageable to 4.0

It's orgo, it's going to be hard. Being online made it slightly easier to access notes, but there is lots of studying! All lectures were posted, so most attendance weren't mandatory except for quiz periods, but extra credit was offered DURING class. She's slightly hard to understand but she knows her stuff. Plenty of points in the class!

Good class. I was challenged but I learned a lot. She offered a lot of alternative assignments to continue our understanding yet have the chance to earn extra credit. Going into this class I thought I was going to hate it but now I actually enjoy organic chemistry

Dr. Vasileiou made Orgo 1 more than possible to 4.0, let alone pass. Her lectures are very clear and to the point -- take notes on what she taught, stay on top of homework, and do practice problems -- you will be just fine. She offers lots of extra credit which is helpful considering the difficult content. I highly recommend her as a professor!

Dr V was amazing for orgo 1. Her extra credit made the class very forgiving if you did bad on the quizzes. If you take notes based on the lectures the quizzes will be super easy for you. Def take this prof

Overall a cool prof, hard class material but nothing much you can do about it. Allows honors option, answers emails fairly quickly. Quizzes and tests are kinda hard but she doesn't try to trick you, answers every question during lecture, lots of opportunities for extra points.

She is an amazing professor. She has very clear grading criteria, and offers a lot of extra credit points. Many people complain about organic chemistry being a difficult subject, however she breaks it down so nicely. Her exams and quizzes are like her notes, and she is very flexible with grading and due dates! She wants to see students succeed!

I loved her. She cared so much if people understood what was going on in lecture and answered about every question people asked which was almost a little too much because at some points I wished we would have already moved on. Each quiz and exam has extra credit on it. Responds to emails very timely. Wish she was teaching orgo 2 in the spring!
Great professor. Lectures are very easy to follow and understand and she gives a TON of extra credit so it's very hard not to get an A.

She gives the best lectures and makes sure that you understand the concepts. All her lectures are on chalkboard so she does not post her lectures online. She provides ample practice problems which are really helpful. DO NOT FALL BEHIND, otherwise it will be very difficult to catch up. make sure to do the practice problems and mechanism practice.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: if you don't get an A in this class you should probably reconsider your major.

AMAZING teacher and the class is not too difficult given the topic is orgo which in itself is hard. Gives lots of extra credit, and explains topics very well. Definitely the best in the organic chemistry department at MSU. Do whatever you can to get in to her class vs others!!

Dr. Vasileiou is an AMAZING orgo prof. She is very clear on what she expects on all of her exams and 'pop quizzes.' They say the quizzes are random, but she will give you a heads up about them and tell you exactly what will be on there. As long as you attend the lecture and take thorough notes, there is no reason to not 4.0.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Everything on here is absolutely correct. Dr. Vasileiou is an amazing teacher and a LIFESAVER when it comes to orgo. Don't take anyone else. Extremely nice, everyone in the class LOVES her. Takes really difficult material and breaks it down methodically. Whatever they're paying her, it isn't enough!
Amazing professor who knows what she's talking about. She makes orgo understandable. Prepares you really well for every quiz and exam. Also gives you many opportunities for success and extra credit.

Organic chemistry sucks, but taking it with this professor made it better. Her accent makes it a little difficult to understand her at times, but you can expect exactly what the exam is going to be like and she is very clear with her notes

She writes all notes on the chalk board which i liked. Exams are all written with maybe 4 multiple choice questions. 3 exams and a final and 5 quizzes. one quiz and one exam gets dropped. Would recommend doing the honors option, a 10-15pg paper on a drug or a concept, really pretty simple. She's super nice and really chill.

Dr. Vasileiou is the best for orgo at MSU. She genuinely cares about her students and wants to see you succeed in her class. There is a lot of material and it's a tough class but she is very straightforward about what will be on exams and quizzes. Highly recommend going to recitation, it's really helpful! Extra points on every exam and quiz too.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Nothing from lecture gets posted online so if you dont go you wont pass. Class is fairly easy considering the challenging topics
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She writes lectures on the chalkboard so you need to go to class. Recitations were helpful too. An 85% is a 4.0 so it is do-able. She puts extra points on quizzes and exams. Graded by 4 quizzes, 2 exams, and a final. If you study and go to recitation it's not impossible. The workload is low since there's no homework, just studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She makes the exams fair and gives students every opportunity to do well in the course, she knows the material extremely well and is very good at relaying this knowledge to her students.

This lady completely sold me on organic chemistry. The exams are reasonable, and the lectures are interesting (especially when she gives you backgrounds on some of the chemicals she's talking about). She's very helpful if you have a question, and won't hesitate to give refer you to someone for research.

Only grades are exams, quizzes, and possible extra credit. No homework to cushion your grade, but less work to do overall. Exams are very hard. However, lots of partial credit is given if it shows that you tried. Hard subject but best professor to teach it.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: This class is all lecture and memorization. She is Greek and has a very heavy accent. I would recommend taking this class at a time other than 8 am. Do the practice problems or it will be nearly impossible to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's such an amazing professor and really knows what she's talking about. She's open to class discussion. She gives difficult tests, but they don't stray from the class material. She never tests on anything that she doesn't explicitly lay out in lecture. I highly recommend her for anyone taking organic chem.

Very organized professor, sets students up for success (gives EC and drops 1 exam and 1 quiz). Gives lots of practice problems. What you need to know for the exams is made very clear. She is very Greek and has an accent but I have never had a hard time understanding her. She writes very clearly on the board. I 4.0'd 251 and I'm in 252 with her now.
Great teacher. Gives lots of extra credit on each test and quiz. Also gives two chances to do extra credit assignments.

I rate the difficulty of Professor Woodbury a 2, even though I'd rate the difficulty of EC420 a 5.0. He did a great job of breaking things down. If I had one suggestion it would be for him to give practice questions more often. His multiple choice questions were quite tough but doable. Such a nice guy.

EC420 is the hardest Econ class you'll ever have to take at MSU but Professor Woodbury does a great job of meeting you in the middle. He basically gives you the exam answers and drops two quizzes. Nice guy as well.

420 is a hard course and hard concepts and he knows it. He caters as much as he can, he's a good guy, funny, relevant, etc., but the class is just supposed to be hard. He is very forgiving with things and he does his best to help you. A few quizzes, 5 homeworks, 3 exams, pretty easy to get a decent grade if you just try a little bit. Great guy tho.

If you go to class and read over the slides you'll do well. If you skip class and don't look over any of his slides you won't. The class wasn't that hard as it built off a lot of basic Econ knowledge. There were many days when only 10-15 of the 100 students would come to class. Yes his lectures drag, but it wasn't hard by any means to do well.

He's a nice guy but he doesn't know how to prepare students in today's age. In his defense, barely anyone came to class and I'm sure it's disheartening. His multiple choice questions are insanely difficult. I would get 85-90% on the short answer section of his exams but I'd get 50-55% on the multiple choice sections. It was insane...

I have him for both EC 380 and 420. Let me tell you this has been the hardest 2 econ classes I have ever taken. He doesn't help in the fact he doesn't give you much cushion unless it's quizzes. There's 2 exams: 1st is 30% and the final is 35%. This is insane because one slip up and you're done for. Quizzes he gives no practice problems. Stay away!!
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: stay away from this professor, he needs to retire.

He's a very nice guy but the quizzes are setting you up for failure. He doesn't give you practice questions so you're blindsided by the questions. The midterms are very difficult as well. He doesn't even try to help his students do well
The mid terms are rough, it's like 25-30 multiple choice questions and then 2 short answer questions with like 8 parts each. I would never even finish the exams.

His class was by far one of the most difficult to sit through. He is a really nice professor, but the class is difficult. I would recommend going to class and reading the book because it really helps. Otherwise you will be completely lost.
hardest class you will take as an econ major or even at MSU. But professor Woodbury does a great job making sure you understand the material. He gives chances for extra credit, so go to class.
I liked his class EC380, quiz's were very easy, midterms kinda hard, final was pretty tough but an easy 3.0 overall. Good class and good teacher.

Dry, uninteresting lectures. Book work was easy, yet didn't have much to do with what was done in lecture or on exams. Overall an easy course, just be careful not to fall asleep: it's really easy in this class.
Completely unable to connect with students. The work was easy, but the lectures are tedious and uninspired.

Dry class, dryer professor.  Be prepared to listen to mundane details like OSHA-specified toilet seat dimensions.  Be prepared to get no credit on homework because you didn't staple it.  Be prepared to get test questions wrong because he gave the wrong answers.
I like his class structure, especially the individual conference where I usually receive very helpful feedback.

He seems super nice but he gives minimal criteria and zero guidance. His comments when grading an essay were “good” and that's it. He's nice but he doesn't teach you anything about writing and repeats himself a lot during the lecture.
He's easygoing, but more importantly, he's a truly original professor. I really appreciate his efforts to make the class engaging and the many creative ideas he brings.

Took his writing 101 course for this semester. He's a cool and super friendly teacher! Always willing to help you when you have questions. A lot of small homework but they only counted as the participation grade. 3 essay, 1 research paper, and 1 remix Video throughout the semester but they were really easy. Easy grader.

He does not use D2L in a user-friendly way; it is nearly impossible to find materials, and he does not enter grades into the grade book, so you have no idea what the grade is for the whole class. During the two-hour lectures, he talks in circles and often will pick on someone to read because he does not want to. He is very nice but not the best.

Very easy professor, has lots of online/no classes due to one-on-one zoom conferences after each project assigned. However, he often gives unclear and bad feedback. Is a very easy grader but does NOT put grades into the grade book at all. There is no way to see your grade on d2l, and he has extremely boring lectures. Take if you want a 4. though
The class can get boring, but he's a super sweet and understanding professor. There is homework, but it is really easy, and he's a really easy grader. I would recommend him as a professor

He's pretty straightforward with the assignments, He's really nice and understanding. If you're sick or anything and miss class he's flexible with that. He does have an accent which can sometimes make it hard to understand but he's so nice and is an easy grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: You do so many assignments and it doesn't go into the grade book, only the papers go into the grade book. I think maybe it counts in the participation part of the grade but it's not a large enough portion to make it worth it. Easy grader, didn't mind having him, fun guy and really sweet.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, very understanding. Do the work and its a guaranteed 4.0
Would take again

Extremely boring lecturer. He doesn't prepare in advance, rather choosing to open up the textbook and figure it out as he goes --- often leading to several minutes of silence as he stares at the board trying to figure out a mistake. 

Email communications with him were oddly aggressive and created an unwelcome classroom environment.

Avoid.
Unorganized and very unenthusiastic lecturer. Put zero effort into preparing for lectures and often made condescending remarks.
The best geometry professor ever.
It is my first coding course. I loved it.
Best experience ever
It is fun for this introduction course. I had zero background for statistics before taking this course and I was so confident now after taking it.

The prof truly cares for his students with his primary goal being that course helps prepare for the CS/DS job environment. However, the course is very unorganized when it comes to prep for quizzes/exams. focused on statistical theory rather than implementation in code. I recommend using the stanford videos on youtube to help learning the theory.
Learn so many from the class
Love his class!

I enjoyed having Dr. Xie for CMSE 201. He is funny and good at encouraging class discussion. The course heavily emphasized being a "flipped classroom", but I think the "lectures" should have been longer, and I did not feel there was enough direct instruction from him. Sometimes I had difficulty understanding him. Also, the TAs were excellent.
If you never coding before, then Prof xie will be the best person to let to getting start. I will absolutly recommend you to choose his class!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Very caring. Enjoyed the class. You need to have required preliminary courses before taking this one. A lot of students couldn't even do integral before taking this course, which would be a disaster.
He is a great professor. Had him for Stt 441 two years ago. Really want students to succeed and is helpful in and outside of the classroom.
Great teacher

Professor Yuying Xie, XYY, Superman, Clark, or whatever you want to call him is (for me) definitely the best professor I have had at MSU. I have had him in multiple classes and each time he has been helpful, engaged, and understanding towards students. His high level courses (i.e CMSE 382) will most likely whoop you but he makes sure you'll pass.
Good experience
Enjoyed

I liked how he did multi-week labs so that we didn't have to show up every single week, however the tedious lab reports were killer depending on who your lab partner is. There were 7total labs, and 7 written lab reports. They weren't crazy challenging but definitely took time and got annoying fast.
Great lectures. Well prepared and knowledgeable

Best professor I have had for Physics at MSU. Xianglin is very enthusiastic while lecturing, easy to understand, and leaves you excited for the next lecture. Xianglin makes sure every student in his class understands the topics that are being covered. He also asks students questions about new content to further engage the class. Amazing professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Rens class was online for me, and it was probably one of my easiest classes. You are only graded on about 7-8 essays throughout the semester, thats it. I will say however, she didn't grade anything for me for about a month and a half. But overall it was a good class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Professor Xuefei Ren class. She talks a lot about urbanism and how it's related to sociology. Lot's of interesting perspectives and readings.

The entire semester is only out of 100 points so you cant miss many. The only grades were 5 short essays and 2 exams. The grading scale is really generous. The essays are easy 100%s but the exams are not.
Great prof! Class based 70% on tests, but grading scale is great! (4.0 90%, 3.5 80%, etc)

Dr. Liang is very kind and flexible when it comes to deadlines, and her lectures really help with understanding the material. The class if very easy if you have any kind of stats background, however to get a 4.0, you need to score >95 overall, so be wary since the HW is graded on accuracy.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors throughout college. She made the material easy to understand. Would highly recommend taking 808 with her.
Dr. Liang creates excellent notes that easy for us to understand.

Dr.Liang is awesome!
Her EPI 808 transformed my understanding of biostatistics and inspired me to dive deeper into the field.
While she wasn't a bad professor, she can be passive aggressive for no apparent reason on times and is very harsh at grading with no consistency.

I think she is okay. But she is not understanding. She gives so many assignments and there are so many group projects. Exams almost every week. Do your homework and make sure you understand the material and you should be okay. But she is not my favorite professor.

The lectures are pretty entertaining and help you learn and understand the language, but there is so much homework. At least 4, 10 to 30-minute assignments per week. You get a lot of time off class, but attendance matters in the end. The textbook is pretty expensive, so I would try to buy it second-hand. There are also a lot of group projects.

Professor Hao is an incredible professor. Her lectures are always fun and engaging and she always emphasizes the importance of trying instead of being afraid of getting answers wrong. Mandarin is a hard language, and you need to make a continued effort, but having a professor like Professor Hao makes the content entertaining and easy to understand.

Hao Lao Shi is an outgoing professor who gives straightforward and somewhat entertaining lectures. Getting a solid grade in the class is a little difficult and she does not have clear rubrics with grading. I would recommend giving her a try, however her teaching style does not fit me well.

Taken for PHY215. He is truly a wonderful, caring, and passionate man! Don't be scared to take this class. I barely went to class, I just read the textbook in detail and worked hard on the homework. The two exams were taken almost straight from the HW. Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I want to start this by saying CP was a very nice man - just not a great professor. He was hard to understand, went quickly through the slides, and taught stuff that was way harder than what was on the homework and tests. You could probably skip all the lectures, and just read the textbook and watch vides and get a good grade.

He is not very clear when he talks.  Will give formulas and not explain what any of the variables are.  He goes though the slides incredibly fast, and goes back and forth a lot so it's confusing. It's hard to learn anything in his lectures so you have to read the book.  The only good thing about this class is he gives a lot of extra credit points.

Not very understandable and talks fast/goes through slides too fast. Expect to buy the book an read it because it's the only way to learn the stuff. His slides are unclear and he doesn't waste time explaining them "because class is too short, so you can go online and read them".
Horrible. Spends more time explaining common sense then physics.
Terrible. Just terrible.

This class was more frustrating than difficult. The TAs and ULAs were amazing, but other than that, Dr. Yadav was very harsh when he came to visit our class. It is very hard to create your own lab procedures,  and there always seems to be a right answer even though they stress there isn't a singular right answer.

This prof isn't even involved in the course. TA's run it, they're unhelpful and rude. This class is more handwriting than chem. Projects are straightforward but little direction is given. >2 hours per session is just writing redundant details. It's run like a high school chem class. Easy to 4.0. All this extra work for no good reason.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: My software glitched and so instead of a complete PDF, only the final page was actually submitted on a team project. After realising the mistake, the professor wouldn't accept the fixed version, saying that it is an insignificant part of the grade, and that it didn't matter. the assignment was worth 15% of the grade...

For 1 credit, this class gives a hell of a workload. All work is due within 48 hours (or less) of your lab time, so it feels very condensed. How easy this class is also depends a lot on your lab group.  Rubrics are available for each assignment type, pay attention to them. The course gets a bit easier once you get the hang of each assignment type.
I love this guy
It all really depends on your lab group and the people actually instructing you, besides that hard to contact and confusing set up

The lab was super fun but it all depends on your group. If you have a bad group then you will do bad in the lab. The ULAs are hit or miss but mine were great and clear. The projects were interesting just a lot of lab reports and writing.

Really difficult to ask questions and get actual answers. Had to contact the ULA to get actual feedback. Would tell you to do one thing and then come back later and ask why you had you lab set up that way. Made no sense.

She is an incredible professor and makes every student feel heard and seen. She always makes sure each student is learning the material in a way that makes sense for them individually, and explains the content clearly. Would 100% take her courses again.

She is an incredible educator! She teaches the content well and makes sure everyone understands by asking if anyone needs a different explanation to grasp the concepts. She is one of the best professors I have ever had. She is incredibly understanding and helpful, I would take her class 100 times over if I could. She is the best!
i thought the TAs were wild. like if you didn't understand something they were just rude. The prof was nice and would help. I would just watch out for the TAs. good luck guys!
She is an amazing math teacher and makes it a very safe space to ask questions. She'll tell you about the quizzes ahead of time so if you study outside of class time you'll definitely pass.

I would recommend this professor. She makes sure everyone understrands the material and is willing to teach it a different way. She is very kind and doesn't make you feel any less for not getting it. This class is difficult in general and she does not pretty fast.
This professor is a very tough grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Test at least once or twice a week, it's quite hard to keep up at times. Attendance is mandatory and I wouldn't advise skipping any classes because you'd get lost because of how fast she moves, she goes super in depth about what topic she's teaching. Her class is usually 2 hours 2 a week and that can be bit much.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: No professor showed their true colors in the aftermath of tragedy. Not only was there a quiz the DAY OF students returning after the incident, but then said in that same lecture "It's better than canceling class" (??) Her lectures are slow-paced, her explanations were confusing for how many times she worded them, and the grading was tough.
Prof. Zimmerman really cares about the success of students. That means she has to be harsh sometimes, but thanks to her, I drastically increased my study quality and my grade.
Very enthusiastic and passionate about class content. Very easy to work with and genuinely wants students to succeed.

She loves math and is very genuine when it comes to helping other students because she wants everyone to get better at what they are learning. Professor Zimmerman will make math a little easier for you and everyone around you.

I'm not good at math and had to drop, but she is an amazing professor who goes out of her way to help you pass the class. Usually responds to emails within the day and tries to offer as much help or compromises that she can.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She was very nice, wants you to succeed. Very accessible outside of class, encourages questions, I am not the best at math but she always found ways to explain things different ways if you were confused. It wasn't supposed to be asynchronous but MSU said it was and she was very accommodating to students needing their own time to take the course.
Great Professor. Always tries her best to be available for office hours. Make sure you take the participation assignments seriously! Would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of the best math professors Ive ever had. Shes willing to work around your schedule if you need help in office hours, great explainer, has practice sheets and exams set up for you to succeed. She is a tough greater but thats the best part! It helps you get prepared for calculus. Take her!!! Highly recommended, best professor ever!!

If you can take Zimmerman! She literally designed the course, she is so sweet, and she is super helpful during her office hours. She one of the few math profs I felt comfortable asking questions to. I really loved her as my prof and if I need to take calc I'm taking it with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She was the best math teacher I've ever had! She encouraged us to ask questions and explained concepts so well. I wish I could have her for all of my math classes.

She goes through the notes in a very clear manner each lecture and is even willing to explain certain concepts multiple times to make sure that everyone understands. I can honestly say that I loved this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Zimmerman was the best prof I have ever had. I struggled in math but she really takes the time to make sure you understand the material. If I could take all of my math courses with her, I would do it in a heartbeat! She wants students to succeed!! Both in person and online, she was AMAZING!!

Ms. Z is one of the best Math teachers a student can have. She always makes sure that students are understanding the topic and if a student doesn't understand she will explain during class another way that makes sense. She is also pursuing a PhD so she is also a student at the moment, meaning she understands the current struggle. Would Recommend!!!
Great teacher! Helps with any questions you have and makes sure you understand the content.

Very great teacher, she is helpful. If you need her, all you have to do is email her and she'll either set up a face to face or video chat with you on the spot. She cares about helping you pass. Grading scale is great. She understands the struggles students have and works with you. Love her very much, if you have her you are in GOOD HANDS!

She is one of the best professors I have ever had. She explains the material so well, if you don't understand she will explain it another way. She gives you her notes from class which is really helpful. I wish that I could have her for every math class!

She is an excellent teacher, provides great examples and goes over ones people have trouble on. She runs the MLC so she is very helpful with student. She uses OneNote to do notes in class which makes it easy to read and very organized and posts a blank note sheet so you can print off as well as a completed one after the lecture. Very good teacher.
If you have to take the class take it with her.

She was awesome! She runs the MLC and pulls in examples that students have had problems on. She also used to be a high school teacher so she actually cares if you understand! She makes the calculus easy to understand and tries to relate it to things you already know so you can understand it better. She does reviews before each exam in class.

For the most part, I think this class was very well run. Aslami set her expectations, and if you followed them you were fine in this class. I personally had a difficult time engaging in the theory, but she still found a way to help you understand and make connections in class. I would definitely recommend her as a professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is an amazing English professor. Although the readings can be a bit difficult to comprehend, any motivated english student is going to adore her class. For eng 280 you delve into theory, and her teaching style was absolutely perfect for it. I would take this class again if I could, it was amazing.

Aslami is great. I had her for ENG 280 in the spring of 2023, as well as this last semester for ENG364. Grading is dependent on participation, but she also offers a notetaker job for students who feel a little overwhelmed about speaking extensively in front of the class as a way to get some credit. Her essay critique is helpful and light on grading
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I loved Professor Aslami's English 210 class. Overall, the class was engaging, and I learned a lot from her. Your grade relies heavily on class participation, but she makes it feel very easy to do so. The feedback on papers and close readings are very helpful for improving in the future. I would highly recommend her as a professor.

The class is hard to get through if you don't like the books she uses. If you don't LOVE literature and writing I'd steer clear of her classes as she can complicate things and make things more confusing. She relies on class participation and if you aren't a big talker in class I hesitate to recommend her class cause your grade relies on that a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: ENG 280 is the most boring class ever. She tries her best to spice up the class but my god the readings are the dullest things I've ever read. Prof. Aslami is a great writing teacher - my essays got a lot better over the semester - but I don't think I can overstate just how boring the class was altogether.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had Professor Aslami for Honors English 1 and had a great time. You read the texts and then come discuss them in class. She is very funny and keeps the class light-hearted but still pretty intense in terms of the analysis you do. All in all I would definitely recommend.

Amazing professor! She is very passionate/knowledgeable - and cares deeply for her students. Her classes are relatively easy, but you will still learn so much! I highly recommend taking a class with her.

She was confusing and talked with very large words that no one really understood. The lectures are very boring and very hard to understand and relate to. I would suggest getting into a different IAH class.

Although she usually teaches literature, I had professor Aslami for an IAH course. She has very little experience with teaching this course or even delivering lectures. That being said, paying close attention during "lectures" will benefit you immensely for her IAH courses. Obtaining the information needed was much more difficult than it had to be.

Great energy during lab. Very clear about the class expectations and welcoming of questions or any discussion, really. The homework wasn't always lab-related; it also included clinical or professional applications, which I really liked! Overall, the class is pretty easy if you put in the expected work.

Dr. Zubek is awesome. Unlike other labs, he is actually guiding the experiments with his TA and ULA. He is super helpful and understanding. Definitely recommend going to office hours for help or just to chat! Do your work and participate, and you will be okay.
My favorite professor at MSU! Had him for both psl 310 and psl 311L. He is always open to answer questions and offer help whether its related to class or your educational/career journey.

Prof Zubek is an amazing guy. He loves to chat with his students and is a very approachable professor. He was a great fit for this lab and quick at responding to emails. As long as you show up to the class, you will do great. The labs are really easy as long as you participate. Most everything in this class is group work.

This professor was amazing! The lab was so fun and if you did the work and showed up it was an interesting and easy 4.0. The class was very clear and easy to follow and the learning staff was very reachable!

Prof Zubek was definitely the right professor for a class like this. He was supportive and always available via email, even when he was out of town. I had a blast in this class and even though it felt like a lot of work for a 2 credit class, grading criteria was clear and they were pretty lenient. I would definitely recommend both Zubek and PSL311L
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Zubek is a super caring and passionate professor. Lab attendance is a must, and labs usually go the entire 3 hours. Not much work outside of class, and there aren't any unreasonable assignments. Super interesting and applicable class, probably my favorite I've taken so far!
super nice guy, and the class was not a ton of work. the hardest part was the midterm and it isnt worth much of your grade. attendance is important

Dr. Zubek is my favorite professor ever. He is so insanely passionate about the subject and genuinely cares and tries to connect with students. This lab was not required for my degree and I took it because I heard great things. Best decision ever. The only downfall is labs will take the full three hours, but overall, an easy class to succeed in.

This lab is geared toward pre-health professionals, and it is my favorite lab! The labs in this class all relate to a technique, device, or concept in healthcare. Dr.Zubek is kind and passionate about his work and teaching. There are pre-labs and post-labs, but they are not too long or taxing. Overall great class, I recommend taking it!

This lab is a lot of work in general. You will have 11 labs with 11 post and pre lab modules to finish. A proctored midterm, final, and mini essay assignments in between the sem. However, you learn a lot of healthcare skills like taking blood pressure, urinalysis, blood glucose testings, and more! A great professor that wants you to learn!

Zubek is a really kind & caring teacher, but he lacks understanding of student struggles in terms of exams. We had 5 exams, each 50 minutes with OVER 50 questions. I had even expressed that I had paperwork for a mental disability and asked if turning it in would grant me more time to me not being able to finish on time, he told me to study harder.

Professor Zubek is a great professor who really cares about his students. I took PSL310 over the summer with him, and he has a great organization of the course. 5 exams, and 5 activities that you really cant lose points on. You have to write notes in a pack u purchase, but exams are based off the notes and all study questions! Very manageable!

She does in-class assignments almost every class and a sign-in sheet is passed around and you'll fail if you plan on skipping class a lot. Super easy class and no exams/final, a few small and easy quizzes though. One big group project, but wasn't too bad. 20 pts of extra credit offered at the end of sem. Some guest lectures were super interesting
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is so sweet!! Lectures do drag sometimes though. We were graded by in class "pop assignments" and quizzes only. I never had to take notes and did great. Quiz days were done from your dorm which was nice. Overall an easy and interesting class if you are looking for something that doesn't take up a lot of time outside of the lectures!!

Her ISS Lifespan Development Course is her going on Pro-life tangents for almost 2 hours. You could learn the same things she teaches in her lectures by watching Fox News. This woman is unnecessarily difficult and wants you to prioritize her class above anything and everything. Has very little empathy for students and their personal lives.
So boring and the easiest information being explained over and over for hours

Dr. Yelinek is a lovely professor, and SOC 241 is such an easy course! Your grade is made up of (open-note) exams and in-class assignments, but both are super easy. She is a caring professor who facilitates interesting conversations throughout her lectures. I strongly recommend taking this course with Dr. Yelinek - it's an easy 4.0!

It's very easy to four point her class as there's only two things that the grades hinge upon: in class exercises and exams. Both are open note and pretty easy to complete. If you're not coming to class, make sure to have D2L open on your phone or computer at least twenty minutes before class ends!! Lots of discussions but they aren't enforced.

This class was really easy but mandatory attendance (in class assignments and sign in sheet). There are no tests or finals, but one group project which is a presentation. Professor Yelinek is really nice but also lowk a talker and class always goes the whole time.

Amazing professor that presents the information in a way that makes it easy to understand. In class activities are randomly at the end of class and cannot be made up, so thats kinda an attendance aspect of the class. No homework, 5 total quizzes that are open note and not in class. Honors option is a very short in-class presentation - do it!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor is very nice, and she knows what she is talking about. However, she talks for so long that time gets away from her and you will go over the end time for the class. That is really my only issue with her but this is an easy class where you do learn a lot from it.
I absolutely loved Dr. Yelinek! She is such an empathetic and warm individual, and her lectures are very engaging and thought provoking.

Dr. Yelinek was great and I really enjoyed her lectures. Just come to class as in-class quizzes are a good chunk of your grade (but they are super simple and based on the lecture you just listened to). Quizzes were online and you didn't have to come to class for them. Just go to class and you should do great.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Yelinek is extremely kind. No homework, quizzes online and not taken in class and open note. There is a book you're supposed to buy but you can pass without it. Attendance not mandatory but I would recommend coming because sometimes she has mini pop quizzes at the end of class.

Great teacher but often talks specifically about my culture (and no others usually) as highly conservative and dogmatic. As an atheist and the only person from that ethnicity in class I felt it erased my experience and made it seem like I have to represent my ethnicity/a religion i don't even believe in instead of just be a student in class.

Second class I've taken from this Professor. Quizzes are straight forward and slides were uploaded to D2L. Occasionally short, open note quizzes at the end of the class. Highly recommend if you need an easier but still interesting class.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Yelinek is very nice, but attendance is very mandatory and her rubrics and assignment guidelines were pretty unclear. Lectures sometimes got out early and were very boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Yelinek seems strict but just values attendance (don't take if you can't attend classes; expect brief in-class quizzes). All exams were online, remote, and open note, but were, in my opinion, ill-timed (very brief). Lectures were a bit repetitive, but exams reflected the slides and in-class quizzes. Free online textbook.
Started off by saying she didn't believe in race. Would mark you absent even if you were there and had proof, if you had evidence of you being sick she still wouldn't care.

Already signed up to take her course next sem. Very understanding and very caring. Topics are interesting which made me participate in class willingly (and she never calls on students who don't have their hand up). Also is considerate about poor weather conditions.

Her guidelines were very unclear, and she would post conflicting guidelines for the same assignment, making it confusing what was expected. She takes an unreasonably long time to grade assignments, making it nearly impossible to know what your grade currently is. The lectures are boring and long. There were a couple of interesting assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Super easy 4.0 class. NO EXAMS - only open note quizzes (no class on those days). No homework & no projects!

Random "in class exercises" which is a short, opennote quiz at the end of class that usually has a 10 minute timer. They can not be made up and none are dropped. Sit next to the same people since we always turn and talk.

This is okay if you're taking it as an elective. If this is something you actually care about I wouldn't recommend it with this professor. She seems nice, the lectures are just so unengaging and a bore to sit through. She shows a lot of old clips from youtube and TED talks rather than explaining material herself.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Class is easy, but lectures are painful. Constant clips of outdated TED talks and other BS. Nothing too thought-provoking if you actually want to learn something. I feel like this is what the entire SOC department at MSU has become.

personally, i loved this course. exams were online, open note and typically ?s were pulled right from her slides. she does just read off slides but we also have a lot of class discussions which i enjoyed. attendance assignments are random. i took this as an elective and it was a simple 4.0 if you show up.

She uses slides made by the textbook and just turns around and reads straight from them. No expanding or teaching. She also likes to bring up politics here and there which is off-putting for some. Overall she is a very nice person but not a great teacher.

Too easy and boring for a 300-level class. Learned nothing, and Prof Yelinek clearly doesn't want to be there. Most days, we just watched videos/ movies, and random others took over teaching. If you need an easy elective, take it I guess, but if you're a soc major, you will be bored to death and have wasted your money. DO NOT BUY THE TEXTBOOK.

Very insistent on class participation and didn't excuse the absence of students in a gas leak until people complained to higher ups about being unable to commute to class. Was very rude about her attendance policy and didn't let students do the attendance quiz while they got ready or were walking out the door. Also no sick policy without note
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I was not a fan of the way this class was formatted. If you plan on not attending-- you will not pass. I also stopped using the text after the 4/5 week... She will not excuse you (despite what the syllabus says). I know a student had to come to class with a positive covid test. It was hard to talk to her as well, it was draining. Super easy though.

I took this as an elective and loved Professor Yelinek. She is so caring and considerate. Attendance isnt mandatory, but she would do random VERY easy quizzes in class that if you missed you could not retake. She had quizzes after each topic and they were decently lengthy, but easy open-note and taken from home with no class those days (amazing.).

Attendance is VERY mandatory. Sign in sheet at every class. A good chunk of the work is done in trios You all get the same grade regardless of what portions you do and what portions your partners do. Choice of a presentation or a paper as a final. Rarely answers emails. Is mostly understanding of personal events. Rubrics could be clearer.

I did not like this professor. The quizzes were online but she got crazy about attendance. She gave multiple students 0 on the in class participation even if they were in class. Not very good professionalism. All her lecture slides were posted on d2l and in class all she did was read off the slides so it was kind of pointless to go

Dr. Yelinek is a wonderful person, but her teaching style is not my forte. Attendance is overdone; she made a student come to class with covid (even with proof) for attendance points. I didn't use the textbook after like the 4th week, class can be 4.0-ed with your eyes closed. Not a lot of work, hardest part is the attendance for sure

This class is fairly easy. Classes are lectures, but all lecture notes are online. Attendance isn't mandatory, but she does do random in class assignments that are worth points. There are 5 open note, online quizzes and no exams. She also gave us a extra credit quiz at the end of the semester for up to 70 bonus points (which is a lot).

class was easy, tests were all online. Yelinek is crazy about attendance. I showed up to every lecture and completed her attendance checks on d2L. More than once she changed my grade to 0 and claimed that I wasn't in class and wouldn't change it back unless I emailed her multiple times. She is not professional AT ALL.

Don't take this class if you genuinely want to be taught the material, every week a different group has to give you a presentation where nobody actually retains or feels interested in. Also Jodi, has lots of good and bad days, and I feel like she personally took her bad days out on her class. It made me feel like I was getting group punishment.

This class was super easy and all of the tests were online. She is also very nice. The only downside is that she is a little bit crazy when it comes to attendance. Overall though this class was very interesting and I definitely enjoyed it. I would 100% take it again.
She was just very difficult to work with when I talked with her I always ended up feeling worse.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Quizzes are easy as long as you take good notes, they are timed a minute a question though (not as bad as you think). Textbook is informative and helps as well. Sometimes the ends of lectures were rushed, but overall a good class and would definitely take it again.

All quizzes were online, taken at home, open note and open textbook (super duper easy). There was no final exam. Attendance is not mandatory, but there are in class assignments that are due during classtime on random days. Dr Yelinek is kind and very knowledgeable about her field. Her class is extremely easy!

I would have been more willing to honor the mandatory attendance policy if half of the lectures weren't student group projects. You can pass this class if you just show up, but class is deeply boring. Overall Dr. Yelinek is fine and has clear assignment criteria.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This was such a great course. No homework, only tests and puts online and easily can get over 100% with extra credit questions. NO FINAL. If you want, you can take the course completely online because she just assigns an "in-person" assignment randomly but you can easily complete it from home just watching from D2L in the quizzes section.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: she spreads so much misinformation in this class from claiming and showing us videos of people espousing the benefits of supplements to cure or treat bipolar disorder and yet as a sociology professor describing her own family, she says "low" or "high" functioning autism which is not accepted by the wider medical community; also very disorganized
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I think Dr. Yelinek needs to do some self-reflection. Regardless, if you do the work and go to all classes, you'll get a 4. Quite a few things contradict her syllabus regarding grading, but if you bring it to her attention, she will make amends. I've noticed she also likes to take off points for minuscule reasons.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Jodi is a suuuuuper kind person and you can tell how much she cares about her students and the topics at hand. I was not a big fan of SOC350, I felt like there were so many random assignment requirements amongst other things that made the class 10x harder than it needed to be. I wish I had taken a dif class with her, but I really like her!
As long as you show up to class and pay attention you'll be just fine. She asks questions about your experiences as it relates to the course and I encourage you to respond.
