reviews.comment: To fully understand the course you really need to pay attention in lectures. Seeking help from Ron helped substantially on exams and reflected on my grade. The workload is hefty and to succeed on the exams Id recommend studying at least a week ahead. Rons a good professor but just not for this course.

I honestly had no beef with Ron, he's an alright guy and his lectures were fine. The only thing that I didn't like was the fact that he purposefully made his exams really difficult and that each of the 3 were worth 25%, which is 75% of your grade. I did awesome on all the homework assignments, but that hard work is not reflected in my final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Take Bergen's class instead even if you have to rework your whole schedule.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Ron was a great instructor. Puts real life examples into lectures. If you don't put forth effort to study, you will likely struggle. Exams get easier throughout the course. (Material becomes more interesting)
Tamborini was a really good professor! He gave interesting lectures and I never had a problem paying attention. He's very straight-forward and his lectures are definitely worth knowing and relevant.
He can be entertaining, but is a tough grader, and it's only on exams and reaction papers that are random, so you better hope you're there on those 5 days.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Gives really interesting lectures, and is always engaged with the class. A really happy guy with a good outlook on life. Easy to listen to, and enjoys what he is doing. I never minded showing up to his class, since most of his lectures were worth the listen.

Possibly one of my favorite professors! Lectures are always interesting. He makes the test very easy to study for. Funny, kind, and all around great professor!!! Makes the subject fun and interesting! There are pop writing assignments, but if you always go to class you'll be fine. The research activities were very fun too.

He kinda drags on in his lectures. He doesn't post his lectures online so you have to go to class. If you only write down the yellow stuff, your golden. I would just listen to my music and write down the notes in class. Tests are easy if you study.

I don't know why he's not rated higher. His classes are fun and he's enthusiastic and full of knowledge about the subject. His lectures are organized and put together well. The tests are extremely easy if you take notes, study with flash cards and memorize a couple of mnemonic devices. I never opened the book and I dstill got an excellent grade.

This class is hard, but if you show up to every class and study it is possible to get a 4.0. I really liked Dr. Tamborini, he is funny and laid back. You have to do case studies every week but they really help you understand the concepts and help you prepare for the tests.

Ron tries really hard to be funny. He's a super nice guy and you have to appreciate the effort he puts into his lectures. You can tell he really wants you to understand, but the class is hard and the material isn't easy. Must attend lectures and study if you want to pass. READ THE BOOK

Ron tries really hard to be funny, and you've got to appreciate his efforts. As a prof I think he's good, it's just the course that's hard. Be prepared to take tons of notes, and a highlighter doesn't go amiss either.
Great professor. Very sarcastically funny and helpful when asking questions. I absolutely loved COM 275 with him!

Very challenging class. Tamborini seems like a pretty cool dude, but a terrible professor. Lots of pointless case studies and reading. Half the time he would teach the class a concept, and then tell us he taught the wrong thing. You MUST attend class in order to get a passing grade. Only good part is that there are a few hottie TAs.

Aweful! All you do is write notes off the PowerPoint screen.  Completely pointless when he could easily posts these notes online like most normal instructors.  Nearly impossible to get an A and no fun class activities, media examples (videos, etc.); we don't even get to watch a single movie in this class. Tries to trick you on his test!
Ron is a very good professor, but if you do not bother to do any work and don't study then you will have a hard time in his classes.
I spent more time writing notes so fast and furious that it was difficult to comprehend his lectures. Very challenging prof!
Great prof.  Clearly got all information across with good examples of things that relate to your lives as college kids.
Overall, he is organized and detailed. The class has a lot of notes, but most of the information is in the book. He can get off topic some, but not nearly as much as other profs. Good class.
Woah, is dr. t ever hot.  He's simply a spectacular specimen of a MAN.  Hard to focus on the course material when you've got dr. hotbottom up there shakin' his thang.
Dr. T is hottttt.  Oh, and he's smart too.  Do your work and study and you'll be fine.

Avoid this professor at all costs. Stay an extra semester at State if you have to... it will be time well spent. All my friends who took 200 with him failed. He's boring and his exams aren't reflective of your knowledge.
No Comments
interesting and pretty funny.  exams are a little tricky but you will do fine if you study!
VERY tough exams - entirely true/false.  However, he's entertaining and the class is informative.  He gives extra credit if you tell a joke at the beginning of class!
This teacher wants you to fail!! Beware!!
Very flexible and helpful professor. He is simply amazing!!
very funny, very difficult, and very imformative
Excellent teacher.  Very knowledgeable.  Write down his quirky quotes.  They were awesome.

I had the privilege of doing an independent study with him following an introductory music theory course I took as an elective.  He was awesome.  Extremely receptive to my desires.  Although, I play guitar and he is a piano player, he picked out some awesome guitar books for me to study from. I use them to this day.
No Comments
No Comments

Good prof, but doesn't teach because you use a system called Aleks that is your actual course with the exceptions of the exams. Aleks has a "pre-knowledge test", TAKE YOUR TIME AND TRY TO ANSWER EVERYTHING CORRECT!! The pretest score gives you how many objectives you have to finish for the class. So do well and you won't have to do a lot of work!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He uses Aleks for the homework. You're usually given two weeks to do it but you can get it done in about 3 days at most. Every 2-3 weeks is an easy quiz. Super helpful when I had to get my exams proctored.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took professor Powers for online math 1825 class. And let me tell you I wasn't satisfied with him as a professor. I say this because I emailed him 3 times and he never got back to my emails. but the class itself was easy, the course reminded me of things I learned in high school. And the Aleks online program for the course is very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This was an online class and math is my worst subject, If you are terrible at math do not take it with this teacher. I barely passed! I'm sure this prof would be better if i learned from an in person class but online it was really rough. TA's we're helpful and pretty much ran the class. DO THE REVIEW EXAMS AND GO TO THE REVIEW SESSIONS!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: It's an online course, so you cannot get behind. He responds generally quickly to emails, and the class isn't too difficult as long as you are on time with your work, go to review sessions before tests, and have a good mindset.
He was so awful. Tried to reach out to him 3+ times and nothing. The TA's were not very helpful either.

You are completely on your own. His emails literally say do not contact me, the TA's don't help and they cant even do half the problems. If you email them, they will take days to reply, and may not even know how to answer your question. Do your Aleks work and the practice exams are the exact exam with different #. But you're on your own.
It's online and you are teaching yourself
He's not involved in course at all besides monitoring exams, when you go talk to him about your grade he isn't helpful at all besides just giving you common sense such as "study" or "go to MLC"

He never emails back, when you try to talk to him in person he is rude and disrespectful. I had an online class with him so emailing him was my best option and I emailed him 7 times over the course o the semester and never once got an email back.

MTH 1825 was the worst class I have ever taken in my life, the fact that I come to a university and was told I had to take an online course is ridiculous in itself. ALEKS is absolutely the worst program, and the professor made the exams so much harder than anything we had to do on ALEKS. I loathed this class and despise Ron Powers

This was the worst course I ever took.  The software, ALEKS, was worse than myspace!  Ron Powers was never available and put all the work onto his TAs.  He made the last few tests really hard to purposely lower our grades.

He has got to be the worst professor ever. He goes extremely fast and doesn't even know what he is talking about himself most of the time. Don't bother asking for help because he will make you feel so small. Most definitely the most rude person.
Rude! I have never met a professor in my four years as rude as this man.  He is unavailable during office hours, and belittles you when you ask for assistance.
It is much easier to just go with the book than try to follow his lectures. And, a great deal of the time, he seems to say "told you so" rather than help you before there is a problem.

I dont know how this man ever got a job as a trig professor because he does not know anything about it. I had to substitute class with a tutoring sessiona and things went better but if you have to rely on his teaching good luck because you will need it

I'm the worst person ever at math, so the class was pretty difficult for me. But, I think that Powers is a pretty good Prof- he is very helpful and he sorta looks like Elton John. Not the worst, not the best.

MC 111 with Professor Ahlquist is amazing! The class focuses on writing about conservation and the environment. His passion makes discussions engaging, and he values participation, so speak up! If you care about the topic, you'll love it. His feedback is thoughtful, pushing you to grow as a writer. Highly recommend for anyone interested!

Ahlquist is an amazing person and very, very nice professor. He is very into expanding native rights, and is generally against the use of technology to address social issues like climate change. if you disagree with him on both those, you should think twice. As someone who disagrees with him on those though, he is still a great professor

I'm so glad I took this class. It was my favorite in my first semester of JMC. He really did a lot of work to make his classroom a community and a safe space for all his students. Discussion matters, and participation matters, but the topics are so interesting that it was easy! Lots of reading, but it's mainly online articles. HAVE to read them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: I had him for MC111 this Fall semester. Super smart and caring, will help you throughout the course. It's a hard transition going into JMC, but he brightens the whole atmosphere. He creates a good environment where you can have fun, insert your opinion, ask questions, and learn. I highly recommend him for any course you choose to take.

Professor Ahlquist is the best professor I have ever met. I took MC111 with him last semester, he has been such an inspiring and caring teacher. I would not say this class is easy, BUT, if you really put in effort, you are ready to get a good grade. Make sure to go to his office hours for extra comments! recommend this class to all JMC people!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took MC111 with Ahlquist and definitely came away a better writer! He is very understanding when it comes to personal issues and is clear with his expectations for class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors! The content and discussions are very engaging. You are graded on participating and are allowed limited absences. There are a few small writing assignments and two papers. He has high writing expectations and does not grade easy. Overall, he cares a lot about his students and will be willing to help you.

Professor Ahlquist has a way of brightening the classroom, whether in-person or online. Each day he was equal parts personable and intelligent, his anecdotes about each reading made the mountains of text legible and worth tackling each class. By the end, you'll walk out with more than a polished writing style; you'll find a friend in Ahlquist.

Professor Ahlquist is my favorite professor by far! One of the most caring and genuine people in the world. He sparks an interest for any topic we're discussing and makes you excited to come to class. He is all about establishing connections and making sure that every student feels welcomed and comfortable with him and fellow classmates. Love him!

Professor Ahlquist is the best Professor I have ever had. He genuinely cares about his students and wants them to succeed. He makes learning easy, not like an easy A (you have to work very hard) but in the way where he ignites a spark within you that you didnt know existed. His feedback is very helpful and he is always available to help.
I love Prof Ahlquist! He is an amazing guy! he's very passionate about his field of study and students! I Will take in again sometime in the future,
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This was my second time having Professor Ahmed and once again, I enjoyed him very much. Hes such a kind and generous professor with so much love for his students and his work. I really appreciate him and I hope to have more classes with him in the future. Hes an undeniable asset to the Department of Romance & Classical Studies.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Dr. Ahmed is a wonderful professor. He puts his heart and soul in his teaching and is extremely passionate about the French language. He also seems to be particularly interested in classic French literature. He is so kind, caring, flexibl. I wish that more college professors were like him. You're bery fortunate to have him.

He is insanely helpful and gives great feedback and you can definitely tell he wants you to succeed. It is a hard class for those French does not come easily to, so you'll have to put in effort. Manageable homework, short readings. Lots of quizzes/exams and a few papers. Participation is very important. You'll gain a great knowledge base in this.

Its an online course so you have to participate online. When not understanding the professor is easy to email and responds quickly. His lectures were good and the reading posted was a lot, but the course was easy to manage. The final exam was easy, I only used to DSM and the clinical cases books.

This guy is a great teacher, engaging, reasonable and empathetic.  Brian genuinely cares about the students and is sincere, but expects you to work.  He makes a difficult topic look easy.  I really may not have made it with a different professor.  Highly recommend!
He is not good at giving clear directions in class.  Read and follow the course syllabus--he treats it like a contract!

Dr. Ahmedani is a great research methods instructor. This is generally a really hard course but he made it quite a bit easier. Now having said that, it's still alot of work. Just isnt as bad as it could be. Just be warned, DO NOT CHEAT. He is vigilant and will bust you (at least thats what he says).

This professor teaches a very difficult research methods class.  The class itself is a lot of work, but Prof. Ahmedani has a great deal of experience and shares this with the class, which livens things up.  He is very funny and jokes a lot.  He's often willing to help students.  He's also (easily) the hottest professor I've ever had in college.

VERY hard subject. While it gets easier to comprehend the various topics and understand the terminology towards the end, there isn't often enough time to write everything down during the test that they are looking for. She can also be a little nit-picky on the tests when it's hard to understand what the question is asking for.

Awesome teacher! Funny and interesting--often supplements her powerpoints with videos and fun facts. Only teaches practical things you will need to know. Involves the class during her lectures with discussion and questions. A massive amount of info to learn in this class but she helps make it enjoyable and easier to remember.

She was the perfect anatomy lab professor. Provided lots of visuals and hands-on specimens. Tried to make everything as clear as possible and genuinely wanted us to succeed. As long as you study her lectures and your notes, you will do great on the tests. Only problem was that there were only 2 tests so the grade weight on each was very high.

I've never hated my life more than when I took this class. I stopped going to lectures half way through semester because it was a waste of time since my math skills were actually regressing when he taught; Instead, I taught myself the topics through Youtube videos. I paid for this class yet I'm the one teaching. Don't take if you want to live.

I've never cried or called my mom for anything this much before this. I stopped going to lectures because I learned more from someone else teaching me than the professor. I was starting to think that I was the issue but I shouldn't have to pray that I get hit by a CATA bus on the way to my exams. If you're not religious, find one & start praying.
Took confusing notes and gave us practice quizzes that had many things not on the exams. Takes attendance each class. Taught very slow though which made it easier to understand.

His handwriting is extremely sloppy, students have ask what he wrote on the slide. Lectures are confusing, on top of his extremely thick accent. Very unorganized, answers questions incorrectly, and doesn't understand the questions students ask him. He often gives no help for the question that was asked by the student due to misunderstanding them.

Could not be more confusing. Horrible hand writing, extremely thick accent, constantly gives the wrong answer and then has to be corrected by students, super unclear communication. No real explanation ever, simply fills in the notes and then tests you on said notes the NEXT class. Don't take this class unless it is literally your only option.

So confusing and disorienting. Professor has messy writing and a very thick accent. Does not keep a cohesive schedule whatsoever. You walk in class, take notes, and take a test on the notes you took the class BEFORE. No time to study whatsoever.Even told me and my entire class we had a big exam the NIGHT BEFORE. 0 out of 1,000. Could not be worse.
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO

She is really nice & upbeat during class, but this year she went back and forth between two websites. It was hard to keep up sometimes because she constantly changed it and there would be some problems (link not working, quiz not letting you see your results) but she explains things very well and the material is generally easy to understand.

This professor was not helpful at all. Her office hours were inconvenient, and she never replied to emails, which was really frustrating. She was really cheerful during classes, and seemed like a nice person, but was not the best professor. Her scheduling was confusing because she constantly changed it. the homework was easy, but exams were not.

This professor was not very prepared. She never returned any of my emails, and her exams tended to cover material that we went over in minescule amounts compared to what she actually talked about. She changes the schedule constantly. She was nice as a person, but not the best professor in my book.

Professor Cagnato was very unprofessional and was not willing to help outside of class she was always late to class and  never returned any of my emails. you have to check angel everyday because she is always posting new assignments without notice.

Overall, the class was okay. I found it incredibly hard to understand Prof. Appel because he always mumbles and slurs his words. It made watching the lecture videos difficult and imagine it would make his class difficult if it was in person, so beware of that. He is good for communication and giving students help when the need it.

Great prof! Sometimes the material gets boring, but he does a great job of encouraging class participation and getting group discussions going. He has weekly reading quizzes that are a good majority of the grade, and also does pop quizzes through the semester. His exams are very straightforward, 85% of the material comes right off of lecture slides
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I don't really understand the hate for Professor Appel. He is a cool guy and a very good prof. His lectures are interesting and he tries to engage the class and spark discussions. He gives pop quizzes (which he pretty much gives 100% to everyone on if you show up and try) and reading quizzes online with unlimited tries. 10/10 would recommend!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Appel really cares about hearing what students have to say and their opinions on different class topics. His class sessions are a mix of him teaching and other students giving their input. He does do pop quizzes, but they are a guaranteed 100%. Make sure to study the slides for the exams, and you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Appel's lectures may be boring but they are super helpful. Attendance isn't madatory but if you show up he will occasionally grant you extra credit. His study guides are essentially the entirity of the exam and even offers XC on the exams as well

I don't really understand all of the hate for Professor Appel. He seems to genuinely care about the topic he's teaching on and respects the students as long as they respect him. Like any college class, if you pay attention and participate you will pass easily and enjoy the class more.

reviews.comment: It's a three credit class and he gives us 4 hours of readings per class. Terrible professor, super unorganized. Overall terrible.

reviews.comment: his voice is awful, it's a pain to sit in class

reviews.comment: I would recommend Professor Appel to all students. Although the material can be boring at times he brings passion to his classes. The only complaint I have is he is hard to hear sometimes but overall I recommend this class.

reviews.comment: This class was god awful. Lectures are the most boring thing I have ever endured. I have moderate interest in politics and he made it unbearable. Most of the time you can't even hear him unless you sit in the front row. Most boring prof I have ever listened to.. don't take him unless you enjoy zoning out all class unintentionally.

reviews.comment: His lectures were pretty boring and were hard to make it through. There is a lot of reading for the class and he also gives 11 pop quizzes throughout the course so you can't really skip the class either. Reading is mandatory to pass the quizzes.

This is a flipped learning class meaning you have to watch pre-class lecture videos, and you do not actually learn in class. They expect you to know everything before, but the videos are super un-helpful. Class is just un-graded group busy work, making Jameel nothing more than a glorified babysitter. He is a kind person, just bad class structure

PLB106 was a very intensive class. Every class, you were tasked with a lot of busy work. You don't really take much away from the class. There is also a group project that lasts the entire semester, and you'd better hope you get a good group. Although the class sucks, if you have any questions, he is easy to approach and will answer any questions.
Very difficult 1 credit class heavy work load

Please for the love of God and your sanity do not take this class. It's only week 4 and it makes me want to die. Its unorganized, poorly structured, too much going on, and classes are overwhelming and vague. Please just don't take this class.
Good professor, cares about his field and wants to make sure you understand content

He is a very nice guy and is willing to help, but the class feels like a waste of time, its reaching the end of the semester and he still hasn't graded past the first notebook. His lectures and instructions are also pretty confusing at times overall would avoid this class if it is not required.

His criteria contradict themselves all the time, so it's hard to get a good grade because it's hard to understand what needs to be done. The class feels like a mess, and it's tough to understand the work that needs to be done. He will help you out a great deal and is very nice to talk to. Just not the best instructor.

The lectures were pre-recorded videos to be watched outside of class where Jameel read off of a powerpoint. The lectures took a few hours even on 2X speed when I took notes. There were pre-class quizzes and weekly post-class quizzes as well. Jameel is a nice person but is not great at explaining lecture content for a 2-hour long class.

This man takes absolutely forever to grade anything-- even if it is just releasing scores from a multiple choice D2L quiz. He is also very nit-picky when grading. Most of the material must be learned before the lectures, because he is going to go on ten tangents and cover maybe 25% of the material in class. If you have to take him, best of luck.

Ugh, please avoid this professor if possible. He seems like a great person and is caring about students but cannot grade things in a timely manner. Also, you have to earn a 93% or above in the class to earn a 4.0 but must earn 80% or above for a 3.0. So kinda like a curve that is helpful to nobody. Very tough grader too.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A really funny professor who is really knowledgeable and passionate about the course material +beyond. Always willing to support students with assignments and make the course fun/engaging.

Dr. Al-Haddad is one of the toughest graders I have experienced at my time at MSU. Not only is he a tough grader, but he has only graded a handful of our assignments this year and class is already over. Despite this he is actually very helpful when you ask questions in class and is good at helping students with their work.

I found professor Al-Haddad to be a great and engaging person who cares a lot for what he teaches but is very slow to grade coursework which makes it extremely hard to know what you need to do better/ different for he next assignment. We have completed 5 notebooks this semester and only one has been graded and it's the final week of classes.

It is finals week and he just started grading notebooks we did at the beginning of the semester. Even if you follow the rubric for the notebook, you'll still do poorly and you'll have no time to make improvements. I have no clue what my grade is and grades are literally due in two days. He is an incredibly boring lecturer for an almost 3-hour lab.

We only have a few days left of finals week and half of our assignments haven't been graded yet. We don't know if we are completing assignments correctly, which also makes it especially difficult to submit any final drafts for lab proposals and presentations because there is no criticism telling us what we need to fix.

Overall a hard class, Dr. Al-Haddad is a really nice guy who is open to help. But for it being a 1 credit lab, there is a lot of work. On top of that it takes him the whole semester to grade the lab notebooks, leaving you lost as to what your grade is at the moment.

Hes very nice and knows what hes talking about but is VERY unorganized. Its the last week of the semester and 1 grade has been put in. The class is a lot for a 1-credit lab and not much feedback is given at all

He's nice, but unorganized. Homework is 15% of your grade and we only had one official homework that took him the entire semester to grade. The class is group oriented, so hopefully you get a good group. The class was hybrid but the quizzes and exams were online, and they weren't to difficult. He's not a bad professor just a little unorganized.

By far my least favorite professor and class here at MSU. Himself and his lectures are a mind-numbingly boring. There is an unholy amount of work. Often takes days to respond to emails. Always unorganized, instructions rarely clear. If your group mates drop, you won't be placed into a new group. Terrible experience from getgo. Would not recommend!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: I still don't know what a notebook is. I have asked in class multiple times along with others and he just says "watch the videos." The videos do not help in the slightest. Everything seems very unorganized and I don't know what's going on half the time.
This class is an ungodly amount of work for one credit. My 5 credit math class had less work.

This professor is one of the most unorganized people I have ever met. He cannot make D2L quizzes properly, he fails to grade work, and announces significant class changes last minute. Overall, he makes the class an awful experience, despite his otherwise nice personality. I would advise not taking this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I LOVE PROFESSOR MARQUEZ! She had very interactive lectures with group work and reading and taught me things I will remember for years to come about literature in Spanish. She was very understanding when I had issues with my final, and I couldn't ask for a better professor! Would definitely take her again and reccomend!

This professor is amazing and clearly shows that she cares about teaching the content. As long as you participate and seem engaged, you'll do fine. This professor is very nice, personable, and understanding. This is my first time rating a professor ever in the 3 years I've been here, so I highly highly recommend.

This course was not very difficult, however the structure of the lecture became a little repetitive as the semester went on. Each lecture was pretty much the same format of group discussion and lecture, alternating between the two which itself is not bad, but the discussion topics were all very similar. Besides that this class was enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This prof was amazing. You don't need to read any of the works, she goes over them all in her lectures. If you do the lectures you will be fine on the quizzes (which are easy anyways). The exams are incredibly easy, open note, and she explains what is on them before. I also actually learned a lot about Spanish Literature, so that is a plus.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class is not only intellectually stimulating, it is also super fun! Be prepared to do some work - write 3 essays, 2 exams, pre-lecture assignments, etc. But Ale is such a good professor, lectures are always engaging, and she is so accommodating! Really, if for any reason you need a deadline pushed back, just let her know. She's so nice!

Professor is passionate about student learning and success. Tests were a difficult adjustment, but adequate resources are provided to improve. Content heavy, but course rhythm is predictable and becomes very manageable. Overall, learned a lot and was challenged the perfect amount.

Professor was nice and lectures engaging. Attendance was mandatory with iClicker and recitation. There was plenty of homework (worth few points), though manageable. The real issue was exams: far harder than course pack or lecture examples and together worth 60%. Even with many resources, studying effectively for them was nearly impossible.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Engaging in lecture, but exams are harder than most material described in class. Inconsistencies within how she wants you to do questions depending on platform but the wording is the same. Purposefully sneaky to students based on one discrepancy out of a whole paragraph of a question that you have to catch. Nice person, not great teaching.

She is so enthusiastic and invested in her job as a professor, I don't mind listening to the lectures at all. I'm not particularly infatuated with accounting, but she made me interested in the subject nevertheless. Very happy to have taken this class, definitely would recommend!
I felt she taught the class extremely well and made a potentially tough subject a lot more understandable. She makes you use breakout learning which I think is better than smart book

She "makes the exams much harder so doesn't reward the students that don't attend class." By doing this it still has a negative impact on the students who do attend class. First exam was easy content and she gave us a list of things we needed to study for the exam. Half of the exam was complete opposite and had different formulas. - Take it online.

literal GOAT -  class is a lot of work but if you pay attention in class it is so easy. genuinley take advantage of her teaching style and really try to learn bc the professors for acc202 genuinley dont teach and just excpect you to have learned the topics previously or through the reading. She also offers extra credit throughout the semester.

I am not a big fan of ACC but she made it manageable. She gives a lot of practice test and good homework that aligns. The exams do make or break your grade so make sure not to study last minute. But the TAS are super nice and will help you out a lot. You also get 3 recitation drops which is really nice.

Best professor i've ever had. She genuinely cares about the students and wants kids to succeed. Exams are tough but not impossible if preparation is put in. Lots of due assignments so neither one thing is gonna make or break your grade in the class. Plenty of resources available to get help in the class if needed.

The grade i got reflects the effort i put in pretty much. She teaches well and is available for students outside of class, i just don't care much for accounting. 3-4 homework assignments a week, which make up a decent chunk of your grade. Exams were tough but not impossible as long as you study and prepare.
Just do what you are supposed to do and the class really isn't that bad. Like seriously

Allison was great! I missed a 4.0 by .09% cause I bombed the final, but I wouldn't say that was her fault. HW is easy if you keep up with it and her lectures actually help you understand the material. Super nice too! Go and talk to her after class sometimes

Allison is an amazing professor. As someone who was dreading taking accounting, she made the material easy to understand and organized the course in a way that helped me so much. There is a decent amount of work but if you stay on top of it and go to lectures you'll do fine!

I don't understand why some people are giving her bad reviews and genuinely think they just want to blame her for their shortcomings. Professor Dellapelle does a great job at explaining hard-to-understand concepts and overall is a fair grader. She provides lots of material to help with exams, and she models them after the unit practice questions.

Everyone here is blaming everyone but themselves for getting a bad grade, bc she is a great professor. Great teacher, accommodating, no issues with textbooks. If you take notes in lectures and participate in recitation, the class is a breeze. The lessons and homework are directly related. She lets you use a cheat sheet on every exam.

This class is tough but fair. Some didn't take it seriously and expected it to be easy, so go cry about it. Prof. Dellapelle is a perfectionist who cares about her students. She fixed the homework structure even though only a few had issues. Yeah, we paid $90, but mistakes happen and she handled it well.

There are only 2 quizzes and 2 exams throughout the entire course. SO it is VERY important to give assessments your all. She is not very homework heavy in the course but make sure to go to every lecture since they are very material heavy and she uses Iclicker.

Allison made us buy a $90 online book just to have us not use it for more than 2 weeks. I did extremely well on all assignments, and despite studying HARD I did absolutely terrible on the exams. The exams have trick questions and the study questions she gives are nothing like the exam questions. iClicker is worth a lot of your grade also!
She is a great lecturer with a lot of energy. The quizzes and exams barley correlate with the unit practices and homework. Seemed like the quizzes/tests were designed specifically to trick you.

Lectures were very fast paced and sometimes hard to keep up with. What got me through the semester was watching her lecture videos to take notes and doing the practice questions. There were about 16 points offered for extra credit which isn't a lot but it gave me the small boost that I needed in order to get a 4.0 in the course.

Dellapelle made us buy McGraw-Hill for nearly no use, only about 9 EC points, wasting our money. The class was disorganized, vague, and sloppy, leaving students feeling set up to fail despite putting in work. Expectations were unclear, grading lacked consistency, and the materials provided failed to align with what was on the exams.
Awful experience with her. amazed by how bad she is, do yourself a favor and find another acc 201 professor

I really liked her lectures, i think they were very engaging and informative. I think the material I learned from the class will help me a lot out into the future, but the quizzes and exams are just really different from practice quizzes, homework, and other assignments. It doesn't seem necessary to make the course like this.

Professor Dellapelle is a great teacher, and you should do well in the class if you are willing to put in the work to study. She gives a refined topic list before each quiz and exam which literally give you exactly which subjects you will be tested on, so just study those concepts before the exams and you'll be fine. Very engaging lectures.

I can genuinely say that I learned close to nothing in this class. The lectures, practice quizzes, & homework WILL NOT prepare you for assessments. Allison does examples in class without writing them down, says them and expects us to follow. Ironically, she takes ZERO accountability for our terrible class average. Save yourself and take it at LCC.

Honestly I think half of these reviews are bots or Allison herself. She tells us to prepare by going through each and every units practice quiz, but half of the questions on all these practice quizzes don't pertain to the final exam and only 2-3 out of the 20-25 practice questions on each of the unit quizzes is actually on the exam.

Allison is one of the best professors I have had at MSU. She offers a bit of extra credit, but generally the material in this class is complicated, but she engages with her students and truly cares. If you prepare for the exams, you should learn how these exams work over the semester. Allison truly cares about her students and their outcomes.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Accounting sucks, but Dellapelle is amazing. She's a very engaging lecturer and sets clear expectations of what you should be doing to succeed. If you follow her advice and pay attention in class, you'll do really well. Resources like help room, office hours, and HiTA were accessible and incredibly helpful. She wants everyone to do well.

Professor is a solid teacher who explains things very well, while also being extremely organized. However, tests are pretty hard, and material is not directly covered in class. Along with that, purchased a half-cooked McGraw hill class that did not work, and then abandoned it 3 weeks into the semester.

The class is hard but Mrs.Dellapelle is amazing. She is so organized and concise. If you pay attention during lecture and follow her very clear instructions on how to succeed you will do really good in the class.

This class is very challenging. She teaches it as if we aren't beginners in accounting. It is very frustrating because the homework does not match up with the quizzes and exams at all which is very deceiving. She doesn't seem to care at all if you pass or fail the class.

I did not vibe with her, the class itself is hard without her horrible teaching. She is bad at explaining and just tells you to copy her notes and explain it at the end instead of going through the problem with you. She makes rude, sly comments throughout the lectures. The class is structured very poorly and there needs to be change.

The homework consists of overwhelming Excel worksheets and quizzes with only 3 attempts. I can fill out the worksheet but still get questions wrong on the quiz, learning nothing. Additionally, after-class quizzes only allow one attempt, and you can't see your score until the next day, preventing immediate feedback and clarity.

People writing reviews and given their opinions early in the semester of spring 25 are invalid. Professor Dellapine is an awesome professor with CPA licensing to back up her credentials. People saying the exams or quizzes don't match up to the material are wrong and are incompetent of understanding accounting is hard. Too challenging? Switch majors

all the other ratings seem like they're from the professor herself or bots trying to make her look good. She has a long way to go from being a great professor. 50% class avg on first quiz, poor preparation and guidance, rushed lectures, sits there and tries to justify a 50% avg, apologized more times to the class than any teacher ive seen. a mess.

The tests are difficult and dont match up anything on the recitations or homeworks. She purposfully underprepares students and sets them up for failure for the tests, then after the quizzes she goes over what we COULD'VE done after its already way too late.

Good professor. Explained things well in class. Recitation leads were solid, but Allison did a good job of ensuring they were not responsible for teaching course material, but were responsible with teaching the application of content. Well ran course. I'd highly recommend her as a professor.

This class is not easy by any means, however, if I wanted anyone to teach me these concepts it would be from Instructor Dellapelle. She is so knowledgeable and while the concepts can be challenging, she explains them in the best way possible. Her course pack is so organized and helpful. The exams are hard, but if you study you will do great !
Great prof gave every opportunity to succeed. Weekly HW but not too much

Her class is very well put together. The content of this class is naturally difficult but she does a great job at trying to explain things and breaking them down into smaller concepts. Lecture is mandatory with 5 drops. Homework is not bad and exams are ok, be sure to study off of the refined topic list she basically tells you all the questions.

Allison is an amazing professor. Always brings positive energy to class and is an all around great person. Accounting is not easy but she makes it bearable and is very passionate about what she teaches. As long as you come to class and do your homework, you will do fine in this class.

This class is a cakewalk if you show up. Brings in lots of industry speakers, and is very knowledgeable on the subject. Easy class for those who want to learn more about careers in accounting, and weekly quizzes are easy to do.

The class accounting 250-001 was extremely difficult, Mrs. Dellapelle made it very tough for me to pass the course. She did not seem to care about my well being in the class or helping me succeed in the class. I would not recommend this or any class with this professor, by far the worst experience I'v had. She should be excluded from her position.
She is a wonderful professor and as long as you attend lectures and complete the homework on your own, you will do fine in this course.

This class sucks. She goes wayyyy too fast when lecturing. The exam are 20 questions 50 mins so barely any time. They grade homework kinda hard as well. Also the homework is nothing like the exam so I don't understand why they give us it. Definitely a harder class as she does not dropped any exams as well.
She was amazing!!

I respect this professor, however I found her class very challenging.  The lectures were rushed and the exams were time demanding and different than the reviews.  I get it accounting is hard, but I was not able to learn the material well the way she taught the class. Hardest Broad class I have taken thus far.

Dellapelle was easily one of the best professors I have had at MSU, very knowledgeable and passionate about the content. Sometimes speeds through the lectures, but started recording them at the end. Exams are hard, definitely doable. One thing...even if you attend every recitation, to get 100% on recitation engagement you have to ask questions.
Such a good professor. The class is hard but the way she organizes it and goes through the course pack is great.

Allison was my favorite professor so far at MSU. She is super genuine and is clearly passionate about teaching. We took 3 midterm exams and 1 final which are curved. There is a mandatory course pack that she wrote herself that covers all the material for the course. Overall, the course was very organized and managed by a great professor.
Dellapelle was the best instructor I have had. She taught accounting extremely well, and the recitation leaders were amazing. If you focus during lectures and study well it is not bad.
Dellapelle teaches accounting very well, and she is a great professor. She also picked the best ULA's for recitation.
Professor Dellapelle clearly understands the material inside and out and is able to explain it in an engaging and effective manner.

Great professor, and makes an incredibly difficult class somewhat digestible. She truly wants her students to succeed and is incredibly nice. Lectures are fast but she does her best to break it down in an understanding way.

She is knowledgeable and passionate about accounting but speeds through lectures making them impossible to learn from. Exams are pretty challenging, had to learn the material all on my own. Homework assignments are nothing like what we learn in class or what is on the exams. Go to help rooms.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's actually a pretty good professor. But getting a 0 if you miss something can be too harsh. Some of the guidelines can also be vague at times. However, the extra credit opportunities can be a lifesaver though. She does care about her students, but you need to be willing to not be boring. I'll put it like that.

one of the worst graders, does not care about the students what so ever. No matter what you do to turn stuff in, she is trying to find something wrong in it. The entire course is one sided, only good thing is that there's a good amount of extra credit.

I only decided to take this because it was hybrid, 100-level class, and it's a CAS requirement. I read the reviews on here and thought, "Surely it can't be that bad". Trust me, it is that bad. She really needs to be reevaluated because this class is ridiculous. Be aware that if you miss a single thing on an assignment its an automatic 0.
Really bad class.

I really liked Professor Allen. She has a wonderful personality and seems to care about student's well-being. She also cares about the deeper meaning behind what she teaches. Class work is a lot, but if you set some time aside to do the work, read instructions, and ask questions, this class is an easy A.

reviews.comment: She treats students like children and does not care about them, uses jingles to get their attention and does pointless exercises that actually stifle creativity. Probably one of the most lackluster classes I have ever taken. I have no idea how this syllabus has been approved. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. The hw is not difficult, but it is EXTREMELY time consuming. It's only 2 hours, but it somehow manages to feel like the longest 2 hours of your life. JeanaDee Allen means well, but for a level 100 class I do more work in some of my 300/400 combine. If at all take another CAS class.

reviews.comment: Professor Allen is awesome. The assignments may take a long time, but she is incredibly understanding and wants the best for her students. lot's of workload and she played ecco2k in class

This professor was professional and responsive, making the online asynchronous CAS 110 class engaging. reviews.comment: This asynchronous course featured creative assignments, weekly quizzes, and a midterm interview that emphasized experiential learning. Perfect for students seeking a well-structured course that fosters creativity and critical thinking!

reviews.comment: allen is a nice lady but eccentric and IMO annoying. she does genuinely care though. this class is an introvert's worst nightmare; when u meet, u are forced to talk to everyone in the class. work is fairly easy and the assignments can actually be fun. no tests or reading. light work. only complaint is that her grading seems very random

A great professor and I enjoyed the class. There are a few homework assignments but nothing hard to complete. My class was hybrid so the times we met once a month in class were important because it's a big part of grading. Overall, it was a good class and easy to complete.

This honestly is the worst professor and or teacher I have ever encountered in my entire life. She constantly lies about when things will be graded and I have no clue what my final grade in the class is because she has not submitted grades after it closed on d2l. She is extremely rude and will talk for the entire class period. DO NOT TAKE HER!!!

Class was hard initially but does get better over time, plus VERY generous extra credit at end of semester which got me from a 3.5 to a 4.0. reviews.comment: Advice for this course: don't get too scared of your initial grade for your first assignments/project, trust me when I say it will improve a lot over the semester, this was the case for almost every student in my class, she also offered really generous extra credit at the end of the semester.

Highly insightful in every class. reviews.comment: Incredibly rude and demeaning towards students, inaccessible outside of class, very harsh and unclear grader, speaks flippantly about sensitive topics including rape, incest, abortion, genocide, and other various types of trauma, and I could go on. She is not a good teacher. She is very unclear about expectations and her grading is extremely tough and very unclear as well. reviews.comment: She was extremely harsh at marking, but I wouldn't mind if she gave clear instructions and followed her marking guidelines. Also, she didn't fill grades out, so I was afraid towards the end that I would fail the class. I don't recommend it.

Highly knowledgeable with equally high expectations, but often impatient and dismissive with questions. Misunderstands questions, unclear grading practices. Provides grades at the end of the semester, gets frustrated when u ask ab missing grades, claims that responses to ur weekly discussion post should be enough to gauge your grade so far.

Although professor was a very hard grader and distributed very challenging readings and complicated and rigorous homework, I gained more insight and knowledge in one semester with Aly than I have in any of my other classes combined. Aly is engaging and incredibly knowledgeable, and I would absolutely without a doubt take her class again.

Dr. Aly was one of the worst professors I have ever had. She is extremely unreachable and never responds to her emails, she won't even be in her office during her own office hours. You will never know what she wants in your assignments and you will be left feeling confused. Avoid at all costs.....
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Don't expect to ever know what you're doing in class. She has the most unclear grading guidelines that I have ever seen. She gets irrationally upset at students for trying to clarify these guidelines. You will not know when anything is due. She will never email you back. Your only chance is trying to catch her inconvenient office hours. Don't take.
Berating students puts the words in my mouth. Would not recommend, stay away from Aly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall my experience from this class was lacking. I did not feel confident going into most class periods and I felt as though I was expected to know things I was never taught. The professor herself is caring and genuinely interested in connecting with her students however when actually teaching she would teach in a deeming and harsh way.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: While Dr. Aly created a communicative and collaborative class atmosphere, she was an incredibly difficult professor to work with. She's rarely available for office hours, and berates her students in personal meetings. Her grading style does not reflect her rubric, and it doesn't accurately depict students work or capabilities.

Professor Aly was rarely available outside of class time and attending her office hours was an unpleasant experience for me. Her feedback after a poor grade was not helpful and left me more confused. The grades I've received in her class do not reflect who I am as a student and are not even close to the grades I earned in the rest of my classes.
If you answer a question, you will be wrong even though it is the right answer. Harsh grader and not understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: If you have Aly you get to sit in discomfort with your peers through the whole duration of class. If you are even slightly wrong about something she has a very condescending attitude towards you and acts as if the answer to everything is obvious, when it is very much not. Oh and she is an extremely harsh grader and will rip your papers apart.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Aly can be demanding and is an unconventional teacher, urging independent thinking, which can be stressful but fosters growth. Despite intensity, she's caring and flexible with deadlines. In a mental health crisis, her support was invaluable. While challenging, I don't regret taking her JMC class and consider future enrollment.

This professor lacks the "profession" in writing. Apparently, you can lose 50% of your grade for not having another half a page to meet the length requirement. Her accent makes it so difficult to understand to the point she's replaceable by a teacher assistant. She does NOT read her emails. Instructions are unclear. Horrible, horrible, and horrible

She didn't grade anything until the last day of term so I never knew if I was doing the work correctly. She took off points on work for no reason, I got zeros for hw that I did.  She DOESNT respond to emails.she will not fix any grades. The grade I received set me back as a student and doest not reflect me as a student.

I enjoyed Dr. Aly's class this was one of my first introductions to JMC and it made want to continue pursuing courses within the college. Your writing will definitely improve and attendance matters. She can be a bit unclear/confusing with instructions but if you ask for help she is more than happy to clear it up.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: SILENCE DOESN'T MEAN YOUR CLASS AGREES! Pls for the love of the Lord above treat your classes responses like consent: silence NEVER means yes. When people seem confused, it isn't from their lack of ability to understand, its often that they legitimately don't understand the material and NEED you to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She was very helpful when it came to late work. She was understanding if you needed to submit anything later than the due date and did not reflect any late work in your grade. However, she was often unclear about what the goal of our assignments was. Prepared to be a bit confused about what exactly she wants you to write about.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Aly for my MC111 class. This was my first semester at MSU and she was one that helped me improve my writing skills a lot. It is obvious she cares about her students and if you ever have to miss class for any reason, she is flexible and understanding. We did do discussion posts regularly but they improved my understanding of the readings.

whenever anyone would ask a question she would never give a clear answer. also when she would give us time in class to write she would still be talking so we couldn't even focus on what we had to write. she meant well as a teacher but is a very hard grader as well.
Means well, changes due dates to accommodate for students but gets confusing with so many changes. Attendance mandatory and difficult grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She helped me become better at analyzing and close reading difficult readings and pieces of work. As it is her first year teaching at James Madison I think she did an amazing job and I really hope to have her again as a teacher. I think she comes off as intimidating due to how critical she is as a thinker
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Respected

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors I've had at MSU, she really cares about her students and will accommodate their needs. There is a lot of work outside the class, but its manageable. Put the work in, listen to her feedback, and you'll get a good grade.
Can't speak English well and can't understand what she is saying or what she is explaining ever.  Always changed due dates.

Very smart teacher. She would accommodate for our class on how we're doing and decided deadlines as a class. Very nice, always asks how we're doing. Lots of work to do outside of class but overall very manageable.
I literally love this teacher, ya'll are crazy. She is very smart so I feel it comes off as intimidating, but I feel like I learned a lot in her class and gained a lot of analytical skills.

She is always changing project deadlines to the point where it gets confusing as to when work is due, so sometimes it is easy to miss an assignment. She over explains projects and when you ask questions about them she can never give you a clear answer. I will say she is easy to talk to especially if you are sick and need an assignment extension.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Terrible professor. Unprofessional, treats students like they are 10 y/o and gets worked up over minor inconveniences like typing, whispering, loud noises, etc. Overexplains things to the point where the instructions aren't clear anymore. Do not take this class if you don't need to. An unnecessary amount of reading, podcast listening, and films.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Only one time option for this class on 6-7:50 on Tues/Thurs. nights, which was a major inconvenience. Important to stay up to speed with all readings/films/discussion posts (makes this class a lot of work). Prof.a contradicts your contributions to class discussions and explains things to a point where you don't understand the assignment anymore.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I've never seen a professor more incapable of ignoring minor distractions during the class. She regularly takes time out of class to scold students over minor events such as accidentally slamming a door, whispering to a neighbor, or bumping their wheeled desk into a wall. It's wildly distracting and murders any chance of decent discussion.
SO so bad, please do not take this class it is extremely hard and she is not helpful at all
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Incompetent as a TA. Attendance and participation are a huge part of your grade, but if your grades are entered incorrectly too bad because she never responds to your emails! Made me despise this course and I will forever hate "the gothic" because of how terrible this class was. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Her feedback was not good, she contradicts herself, and I had to meet with her/email her multiple times because she put in my grades wrong. The class wasn't really hard but it was frustrating to have her as a TA and I wish I would've picked a different section.

PROS: You won't have any tests. You can get away with skimming the readings sometimes. She grades pretty easily - just do the work. Text is, for the most part, provided for you.  CONS: She can be extremely condescending - and her attendance policy is strict. Five missed classes and you fail. She loves the phrase "close reading".  Not a fan.
Lots of work   hard grader  no extra credit

Great class overall. Professional and VERY smart (intimidating at times esp. when  she asks "where do you see that in the text?" ). Liked the variety--very different readings from each other (and a documentary on drags! ) Many readings but the good thing is she is ready to push back the schedule so we'd spend more time on difficult material.

surprised at the comments that say it's unorganized. The course is well structured. we focused on one topic every week and we did readings that fit under that. There are readings and some are long, esp. at the beginning of the course but still manageable. I found her very professional.
She's doesn't like to hear other people's opinions and doesn't communicate well. I hope she reads this.

Definitely not an easy class, though well worth it. Expect to develop your writing along with doing lots of reading. The course consists of class discussions, discussion posts online, and two papers. Both papers have workshops to help you develop your ideas. Be prepared to talk about feminism and gender issues in the most professional manner.

Very unorganized, she pushes things back and is very unclear on instructions. If you ask a question be ready to get yelled at. She is extremely rude and discourages students. Will be assigned a lot of reading and discussion post along with two papers. She informs you on the requirements last minute.

If you don't wanna work or  looking for something laid-back, DON'T take that class! but if you really wanna be a better writer, she's an expert. Expect to work hard work & learn a lot. V.  gracious with her time. she'll be there when you need her help even on a weekend!

Shastri was among favorite professors from my entire time at MSU! He is extremely kind, gives great feedback, and facilitates a very open learning environment that will make you really want to be there. My only regret is that I only had a class with him once! Highly recommend.

MSU did nothing to retain him. He's the most loved professor I met at MSU--and I'm a senior. See Shastri fosters classroom communities with real care. Not easy to take over, I get it, but the profs taking over did try. Its the management's fault. They don't care we lost a gem of a prof

Such a nice and amazing person. He really cares bout his students and fosters and kind and nurturing environment. As long as you show up, participate, and do the work, you will have a wonderful time and grow so much as a writer.

He's really sweet! His grading for his Creative Fiction Writing class is just making sure you complete assignments on time, and making sure you participate in class. The class's workload is probably 3/5, so not too much or too little. He's also an enthusiastic professor, and willing to work with you to meet your needs.

Shastri is so sweet. Big fan of him. Intro to Creative Writing was very much that, an introduction where you explore different forms of creative writing. His grading scale is pretty clear and as long as you actively participate and give feedback during class, you should be fine. Feedback has a focus on positive aspects as it is an intro class.

Rojek is hands-down the best professor I have ever had at MSU. While the content of CJ 292 is boring, she somehow made it interesting. She doesn't post the lecture slides so it is important to go to class. Exams are in person, but the study guide she gives you has everything that could possibly be on the exam.

Extremely chill and lenient professor. She has a good sense of humour and lots of engaging personal stories that keep you engaged in the class. She's always full of energy and also teaches the cool side of law. Low work, 1 online quiz a week from the textbook (google the answers) Exams are baaed on what she says in the lectures. Nothing online.

Prof. Rojek was amazing! She was clear with her grading criteria and very knowledgeable about the topics discussed in class. Not many assignments and tests but they were fairly easy if you paid attention in class. would take her class again in a heartbeat.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: AMAZING professor, class lectures are actually engaging. Only downside is there are only 3 exams, to 4.0 you have to do relatively good on all three as there isn't many other assignments that can lift your grade up. Overall she makes class fun and is down to earth.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very interesting course! There is ALOT of reading that comes with this course and attending lectures is key for 4.0 as anything she says could be on the exams. Exams are fairly easy as she provides a study guide for the textbook. But you MUST attend lectures if you want to do well on the exams! Besides that she is super chill and incredibly kind!

Realitvely easy as long as you study. There are random in class assignments so showing up to class is smart, other than that attendance is not counted. Tests are fairly easy and mostly in class material.
Hot as hell

Professor Rojek is cool; great lectures. However, she has converted her Exams to paper and pencil. She also doesn't have anything else to fall back on; she has 4 Activities and 4 Exams.The textbook CJ 2022 is required; it is cheaper to do the monthly subscription rather than buying the book as a whole. There is alot of reading; Slides aren't posted
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing professor!!! Loved her and her class so so so much. Most of the grade is from the tests, though there are weekly quizzes that are easy. The only thing is that the tests can be about anything she says in lecture and the notes on lecture get to be a lot and very detailed so STUDY for the tests. They make or break your grade.

Rojek is super kind! This class specifically was my favorite I've ever taken at msu. She doesn't post lectures so you'll want to show up,  but she doesn't an awesome job of keeping you engaged and finds ways to add in humor. I had her for an 8 am and truly wanted to go to class each time, I recommend her for any CJ class she offers

Rojek is super nice and her lectures are really fun. You learn about the CJ system and she has special lectures where she  talks about specific cases that you can request at the beginning of the semester. Her lecture style is perfect, not too slow but not too fast. Weekly 10 point/question quizzes but they aren't hard at all and 4 exams.

She made this class very easy to understand and get through. I would recommend it, but note that lectures are not posted, so you will want to show up even though attendance isn't taken. Exams are based on lectures instead of reading which is nice; only the quizzes are based on reading.

Professor Rojek makes lectures very entertaining and even though attendance isn't mandatory, she always has a full class that you won't want to miss. She has many opportunities to get a good grade in the class and is very caring.
Professor Rojek is very nice and a good professor. Her class is very easy if you pay attention and she makes it entertaining with personal stories.

Pretty easy class. The lectures were interesting and she even brought in guest lecturers. Exams are online with lockdown browser. Only complaint is she doesn't post lecture slides so id you miss class you have to ask a classmate to see their notes.
I LOVE this class, it's so fun and her lectures are very interesting for an 8 am class. Exams are straight forward and writing assignments are easy. Take this class, it's been my favorite so far!
Rojek was super chill and the class was interesting.

I loved taking this course with Rojek. Study guides for every test, easy lecture material, and overall, she is a great person. If you are looking to gain some introductory knowledge into the CJ system, she is perfect for the job. Some fun added guest lectures too!

Pretty straightforward content, if you read the textbook and listen to notes. It is somewhat difficult to get lecture notes if you are absent but the study guides will list information you need to know from days you've missed which makes it pretty easy.

I loved this class. Her tests could be a bit hard but she included everything on the study guide which I appreciate, and if you took good notes you will be fine. She took time out of her day to present entire lectures of things that we were interested in learning about. She is clearly passionate in what she teaches and I loved her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I love love love Professor Rojek. By far my favorite professor, she is so interesting and teaches her lectures very clearly. Her exams are a bit tough but all of it is on the study guide so use those to your advantage. I highly recommend her and even look for her as a professor in future courses. She sucks at answering emails tho!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: As long as you attend class, you should be fine. Professor Rojek is super nice and I enjoyed her class.

Prof Rojek is awesome! Super nice and helpful/fun to talk to outside of class. Lectures are really interesting and you help pick topics. Attendance isn't required, but she doesn't post slides so it's better to go everyday and take notes and it's super interesting anyway. Exams are half book/half lecture and she provides a study guide for each one.

Such an amazing professor. While everything was lecture based, the lectures were interesting, and easy to follow along on. She allowed for group discussions and always asked for our thoughts on things in the lectures. The class was easy to pass, easy to learn, and easy to attend.
I really really loved having her as a professor. She makes her lectures super interesting and easy to follow. I would recommend her to anyone and everyone.

Best professor out there. Best lectures I will ever have. Make sure you read before class because the next day will focus on that chapter. Exams are pretty straightforward as they're made from both the lectures and the book, so please go to the classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: easy class with straight forward and interesting lectures. Only 4 exams with study guides for each. Tests were almost the same as lectures and study guides

Her lectures are interesting, so I actually liked coming to class. She doesn't post lectures so you should come to class or get them from someone else. I only used the textbook to do the exam study guides. Exams are easy if you look over the notes and do the textbook review. You do a few in class activities but they are easy. She is awesome!

Definitely one of my favorite professors. Going to class is important for the notes but her lectures are super interesting. You can pretty much skim the book for the most part. Exams are incredibly easy if you pay attention. A few in-class activities which were equally simple. Overall the class was great and very straightforward

4 Exams, not difficult. Based off book, which can be found online, and Lecture. She only did this once but its worth mentioning, she told us an activity would be next week then did it the next day. She can be difficult to get a hold of via email, however, overall the class is not hard. If you take decent notes you'll get a 90% or better every exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: Probably the easiest and best professor I've had at MSU. Explains things in a great way. The textbook was only used for online assignments and nothing from that was in the exams. The exams are purely from what she gives you on D2L and lectures so go, listen and take notes and it'll be the easiest 4.0 you'll get.

Class was async, but you had to watch the recordings of the lectures to do the quizzes. Book wasn't necessary but was definitely a big help because some of the info/questions on exams are in the book but not the lectures. Rojek is nice and you can she likes what she's teaching. Lectures were always interesting and Rojek is clear when she speaks.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: 2nd time i had this prof and i love her. Great class so fun! 4.0 just do the quizzes and assignments. Very easy
great prof and very easy 4.0 if you do the quizzes and lectures
Great professor! Gave time for work to be completed, felt like I had lots of time to really learn

She is by far the best professor I have had at MSU. Her lectures are clear, easy to understand, include the perfect amount of information. She is super helpful if you don't understand something and she is great at giving examples and explaining.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: We only had quizzes to be graded on but really enjoyed the class and as long as you stayed on top of modules you should be good
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: My favorite prof at MSU so far. She is very lively and funny and her lectures are short and not broing. I switched profs for next semester to have her because she's so awesome. Weekly quizzes but given whole week to study for them. Not hard quizzes, read the chapters and lectures. Exams are like the quizzes and come from lectures and book.

Would 100% recommend taking this online class during covid times. NO annoying mandatory classes, no homework. The only thing you have to do is take one 5 question test every week. Which can easily be done without reading the textbook. I do feel like I wasted my money buying the book because I never ever used it. Every question can easily be online.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Rojek has been the best CJ professor Ive had at MSU so far. She is extremely funny and loves to tell personal stories that relate to the material (and make it easier to remember). She only grades the four exams but she gives you a study guide and answers all the questions for you the class before the exam. Id definitely recommend her!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Rojek was great. This class consisted of speakers in the criminal justice system. Grade was consisted on less than 150 points, majority of it being in class assignments. This class allowed me to see more of my options within the criminal justice field. She is a very easy person to talk to. She is very respectful
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Rojek is an amazing professor! She is lecture heavy but its all very easy to understand and she teaches it well. There's only 4 exams in the entire class but they are very easy if you show up to class and do the study guides. The final isn't cumulative. She really loves to help out her students outside of class and is truly a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Really nice person. But she talks way too much about her family all of the time. Literally 24/7! Most of the lecture consisted of us getting out of class early and the class was only 50 minutes. Yes she was very knowledgeable but I don't feel like I would be able to say I enjoyed this class. Exams consisted of short answers; listing out things.
100% of your grade is tests, lots of weird things to memorize

I really enjoyed this class, but it isnt an easy 4. The lectures are fun, interesting, and enjoyable. The course is graded on 4 exams and the material comes from the readings and the lectures 50/50. She hands out a study guide that outlines all the material from the book. If you attend and complete the study guide you should at a minimum get a 3.5
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Rojek is one of the coolest professors, but I hate that I like her. Only graded on 4 exams 100 points each, but they exams are very specific facts from notes/book. "study guide" for exam is given a week before exam and only consists of readings from the textbook that MAY be covered on the exam. know everything from the readings as well as notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Don't go near him if you're gonna take this course. Daily 30-50 pg readings that will be on the final. Pop quizzes with a 10 min time limit. Doesnt let you see your grade until you have taken the final, meaning you have to email him to see your grade.
