Lectures are only pictures, so notes are based on what he's saying or notes on the readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a genius and very passionate about what he teaches. Not a tough grader, but you're going to have to do some research and reading. The material is pretty interesting so it's not too bad. One of my favorite professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof is very passionate, but grade is entirely based on weekly essays, participation, and a 8-10 page final that is 40% of your grade. If you miss lecture you miss all of the material, but all the essays are based on the 30+ page articles you have to read 2x a week. Class is very interesting, but very stressful and difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr Cornelius is fun, but his class is very hard. If you see him teaching this class and Jack the Ripper & Victorian England, this class is not about that. This class is on African Traditional Religion and Warfare & the final is 40% of your grade. The concepts are very abstract and hard to grasp. Fun teacher, but try your luck elsewhere
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Mr. Cornelius was the absolute BEST TA I have ever had. He is very inspirational, energetic, and cares about all of his students. I can not recommend any class/section with him enough. You will not regret it at all.

He is super nice and caring. His class is so boring, and exams are difficult. No final, but the unit exams cover so much content that it is difficult. His grading is weird in D2L, and it's hard to calculate your final grade. He is a good teacher, but be prepared to hate your life on exam days.

Course uses R-studio which is the coding portion. For exams, his coding portion will be taken at the same time frame. Other STT 231 professors allow you to take home the coding portion. He is super nice and gentle, but overall a boring professor. His lectures can be confusing due to the accent but he does offer some extra credit points.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE HIM! Actually so boring, horrible, hard to understand. In person R studio exam unlike every other STT 231 professor. I've heard take Horr, from everything I hear the class is nothing like Zeleke's was. He was really sweet just shouldn't be teaching.

Dr. Zeleke is a super caring professor who will do what he can to help you succeed. Although attendance isn't mandatory, it's vital to attend lectures as he works on a chalkboard & doesn't post his notes/lectures online. He offers lots of practice problems & extra credit, & his exams are fairly similar to the practice offered. I highly recommend!

Dr. Zeleke is an incredibly kind and enthusiastic professor. However, in my opinion he is not the best teacher and studying for exams can be increasingly difficult and stressful. There is lots of homework too. There are many opportunities for extra credit too. My advice: Go to every class you can, do the homework, and go to office hours.

I enjoyed this class especially trying to refine my statistics skills. I took a stats class in the summer at OCC and I found that some stuff was the same, but the formulas were slightly different. In this class, I would personally say that I struggled with the R-studio part because I would always get error message when I was typing in command.

He seems like a nice guy, but I could not grasp this class well. I am a good student and I enjoy math but he made a lot of the concepts quite confusing. There is extra credit, but doesn't help your grade a ton. His lectures are boring, I was warned of this prof and was told not to take him. I thought I would be fine but I was wrong.

I like Professor Zeleke as a person, but lectures can be kind of boring. There are peer writing assignments which aren't fun if you have a bad group, but they aren't hard. 3 lecture attendances, 1 recitation, 1 PW, and 1 HW are dropped at the end of the semester. 3 tests which aren't too hard-- the final isn't cumulative, and there's lots of EC.

Zeleke is a nice guy, but he just can't really grasp teaching very well. He is quite confusing in lectures. Catch him quite a bit seeming like even he doesn't know what he's talking about. You have so much hw in this class, individual and group hw. The individual hw usually lengths within the 30's for questions. Gives out a lot of extra credit.
Professor Zeleke followed a course-pack and shared many resources to help students succeed in his class.

Professor Zeleke is such a kind man but he cannot teach well during lectures. Asking him questions about homework may lead to more confusion. The homework is difficult and there are so many questions. Moreover, no feedback is provided for homework. Coding section is not hard. Extra credit is provided, so make sure to do all of them when possible.

Very nice professor but his class was awful. Struggled to reach a 3.0 while other students in other professors recieve over 100% on their tests. This class ruined my 4.0 gpa. Do not listen to the reviews saying he is a good professor. I don't know a single person in this class who wasn't struggling.

This Professor is very articulate on most concepts in Calc III. He is very accessible for office hours and study groups outside of class. Exams are very similar to material learned so if you give effort you will do very well. Very interesting class and very simple for those who are interested in the course.

I loved Dr. Zeleke. I am historically terrible at stats, but he got me through this course with a 4.0. He can be difficult to understand, but he wants you to do well and will always try his best to help. Great teacher, do the homework/practice problems/mock exams and you will do well. Attendance is mandatory but he is understanding. Very kind prof.

Professor Zeleke was a ver kind professor. He truly wants his students to do well. I, however, am not very math brained and some of the harder concepts were not explained well leaving me to have to re-teach myself. I ended up pulling a 3.5, but if you understand stats it would be an easy 4.0. homework every week and group essays every other week.

Zeleke is a dawg. By far the best class of my semester. Attendance is mandatory, but class gets done early, and participation isn't normally necessary. There is a "mandatory" textbook, but he provides the same information during class time or alternatively on D2L.

Okay (normal) lectures, but very nice guy & knowledgeable. Always happy to help outside of class, has a good attitude, flexible, offers extra credit. Do the homework, look at the mock exams (just like the real exams). Easiest 4.0 of my life. Excellent mentor for UURAF/Honors Opt if you're a more motivated student. Wants you to do well!

Dr. Zeleke is one the best professor at MSU. I had him last fall for my calculus I and he is always helpful with my questions. His office hours was one of the best thing. Moreover, he is a linear grader with lots of extra credit. Just practice the homework and sample exam paper to get a straight A in the Final.
He is an awesome professor! This isnt high school anymore. You gotta keep up and be responsible for yourself!

Nice guy, talks slow, really goes through material thoroughly & office hours were helpful. But tests were nearly impossible and he teaches calc like you took AP calc already & even those kids had a hard time. for example he taught us 2nd derivative test, but asked us to do 4th derivative on exam? had lots of extra credit but take a different prof
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: tests are kind of challenging he puts true and false questions that are conceptual not a fan, but he gives extra credit on each test and the homework isn't much and it is easy

Class is very very challenging because everything is multiple choice even though stats is very up to interpretation. As a professor, he does a really great job and is very caring. He makes him self available to help and wants all of his students to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Test are incredibly hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He's amazingly clear and willing to go out of his way to help you as long as you show that you are willing to put in the effort.
I LOVEEEEEE HIM AS A PROFESSOR!
Harsh accent, horrible lecture

The class is taught as if the student took AP Calculus in high school, so it was pretty challenging. He was really helpful if you took advantage of his office hours. Meeting one-on-one made things make a lot more sense.
Good professor, for stats. does a decent job of explaining the material that is pretty easy to begin with.
He teaches his calculus class like you took AP Calc in high school. Doesn't explain anything. Had to retake the class with a different professor the next semester.
Very nice and helpful. He really explains everything well and you never feel rushed.
I am a math major and thought his class was definitely good. My friends who were not math majors like him as a prof but have trouble understanding the material.
Tests are tricky, loved calculus before I had him for calc III.
I felt that he thought we all knew everything already so he expected us all to do fine when we gave him blank looks. Not a very good class.

Literally an awful professor. Never knew the answers to any question I asked. The assignments were so confusing because he never explained them. He also didn't know how to work the online D2L system. 0/10 DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASSES.
He was very bad and didn't know how to use D2L to put assignments in. Never responds to emails and doesn't have office hours. Good luck if you get stuck with him.
Doesn't know how to work D2L. Won't email you back at all. Sucks at communicating about literally anything.

ASIANLAN426 (Advanced Spoken Japanese), Imamura is the only teacher of the class and it is organized very poorly. The homework has an insane amount of typos and when it comes to preparing speeches, there are no examples and explanations are not clear. Her "feedback" is extremely blunt and rude, and sometimes just downright hurtful.

Imamura sensei is a wonderful teacher! She really cares about how you're doing in class and helps you as much as she can. Even though the class is a lot of work, if you're able to attend everyday and keep up with the content, it will be pretty easy.

Imamura Sensei was a great professor, definitely recommend taking her class! She rly cares abt her students. You have hw and class every day, so make sure that your other classes aren't too time-consuming- languages requires consistency and time. However, it was such a rewarding & fun class, I also loved getting to know my classmates.

She does give a lot of homework, but that's expected of a class with a language as difficult as Japanese. If you do have mistakes, she will ask you to resubmit a new corrected version of the assignment, but it's all for your own benefit. She's a great teacher and everyone in the class really seemed to enjoy having her as a teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Overall great teacher that does everything you can ask for from a uni level language professor. Very clear with her expectation and grading, takes her time and fully explains everything very well. Clear deadlines, goals, and instructions the entire course. 100% would recommend

GEO221 online. He was great! Very responsive outside of class (online course) via email, and the labs were very easy to follow. Some may say there's a lot of labs/assignments (I personally didn't think so), but there's no exams, and as long as you set a decent amount of time between beginning the assignment and the deadline, you'll be alright.
His class is a lot of work, but he makes the instructions very clear and you will receive a good grade as long as you follow them. Not a difficult grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Inaccessible in terms of help and assigns loads of assignments.

He is super sweet and checks in with us to make sure we are all okay and to remind us of due dates in our GroupMe. There are about four papers that we had to do (not very long), and there is about 20 pages of reading per week with a weekly quiz. Overall, a great professor who cares about his students and the information at hand.
Honor section is more difficult compared to other sections.
You have to study lectures before class. Useful material.
dont take.
Would give a 0 if possible. Avoid this TA if you can help it.

literally the worst teacher I've ever had. the dude has existential crises in class and doesn't teach anything helpful, and didn't even know when our midterm was. there's maybe two people in the class that actually know what's going on. DO NOT TAKE A CLASS WITH HIM.

She is really good at lecturing, and explains concepts in good detail. She is also very approachable, and provides students with internship opportunities. The final for her class is optional, and won't count if it harms your grade. Her class does involve exams with only written response questions and very challenging projects for a 100 level class.

Dr. Peters is a kind and helpful professor, and her TAs are supportive. Class uses lecture slides with Google Forms completed during class. Workload is light, mainly two group projects. Exams are fairly easy if you pay attention or study. Attendance isn't graded beyond the Google Forms. Research projects are spread over a few weeks.
She left for 5 weeks mid semester for a trip and had 2 TA's running class and barely knew how.
Professor never answers email and disappears for weeks at a time.

To be honest her class is pretty easy. There are in class questions you must answer for attendance/grade, but class material is pretty easy. Exams are half multiple choice half written but again not hard. She is gone doing research a lot so will have canceled classes/ TA ran classes which is nice. My downfall was not paying attention in class

Dr. Peters is super nice! She taught half of the lectures, and Dr. Peacor taught the other half. I think that she had simpler topics, so it was easier to understand her. The rest of the class was quite difficult outside of her lectures. Something that made things a bit difficult was her lack of study materials for exams.
I love Dr. Peters. She genuinely cares about her students, and I love the way she teaches her classes. I recommend every student take her class.

I loved Dr. Peters! I enjoyed taking her Great Lakes Bio class. It wasn't a ton of work and the quizzes felt fair. This semester, she offered that if you had over a 90% in the class you didn't have to take the final exam so make sure you attend class! There were no attendance drops but a few chances for extra credit.

Dr. Peters is a great professor! She obviously knows what she's talking about and welcomes any questions or comments on the material. She makes an effort to get to know the class and lectures are engaging and interesting. Attendance is not required but participation matters! Exams are written response but easy if you go to class and participate.

Dr. Peters is a good professor and she is obviously very knowledgeable in her field. However, her grading is weird sometimes and her quizzes/tests are all short answer. I would take her class again, but be prepared for it to be slightly unorganized and for her to be gone several lectures.

Dr. Peters cares a lot about her students and works hard to know everyones name. She makes a fairly large class feel close knit. The assignments are varying and cater to many different types of learners. She is readily available to help whenever. I hope I can go with her on the study abroad this summer! She's overall just a great person.
Good teacher easy course
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great prof, super nice, forgiving on missing pts on assignments/exams. Just show up to class, and if u can't email them and u can get points back. Not too much homework, exams were very fair, and lectures were engaging that helped prepare for the exams. Need more profs like her

Dr. Peters is a funny person and makes lectures fun. She rarely assigns homework (BS162) and grades very forgivingly on exams. The ONLY downside of taking her/BS162 is attendance is mandatory and if you miss one day, it takes your participation grade down about 3%, which is annoying but other than that I would recommend her to anyone who asked!

Peters is a great professor. The main reason I liked her class was because the practice exams matched up to the actual exams very well. You never had to worry about not knowing what was going to be on the exam. The amount of homework was very fair and when we did have homework it was not very difficult or time consuming at all.

BS 162 was a lot easier than BS 161. Everything you need to know for the exams Dr. Peters goes over in class. All tests are free response but they are really similar to the practice tests. Attendance is not mandatory technically but there is a google form you have to fill out each class. If you attend most lectures you will get a good grade.

absolutely NO amber slander.  science does not come easy to me. but ive gained SO much confidence in this class. Amber is approachable, shes funny, and shes inspiring. class material is easy to digest yet difficult too. but if you pay attention, ask questions, and do the practice exams  common homework, you'll be fine.

I loved Dr. Peters! She tries her hardest to make the class easy for her students. 35% of our final grade was based on homework (most of them being in-class activities), so make sure you do those. The exams are spaced out well and they are not too hard as long as you pay attention the lectures and do the Common Homeworks.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Honestly, I thought this class was so annoying. The class material is boring, not sure why any pre-med would want to learn it. Tests are all short answers which is so annoying, make it multiple choice like any normal class come on. Also, they take 3 weeks to grade your exams which is absolutely ridiculous. Should consider changing class format.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Peters is great! Her lectures make a lot of sense and her in-class questions really help the material "stick." Peppy and approachable, making the best of online classes. Her tests and homework are fair, just pay attention in class and you'll do fine. Stuff takes a while to get graded though.

One major problem I had with this class was how LONG it took to find out grades for exams, like a good 3 weeks even though theres 5 TAs and lecture is only about 150 people so that bothers me. Other than that, her exams are very easy and Amber relates a lot of her lectures to everyday life and her own life and was a great teacher and person.
Very cool teacher. She was super straight forward and the tests were exactly what we learned in class. However, all tests included short answer!

she is so unorganized and the pickiest grader ever on exams its so ridiculous. exams are all free response. the material isnt hard but shes so picky on grading that in the end she has to curve the class. shes a really nice lady and the final is group which is nice. but still, shes just so freaking picky on grading
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Amber Peter's class. You form a group to work with at the beginning of the year. The final is taken with your group. She gives a lot of study materials for the class. One thing I would complain about is that she posts homework and other useful documents very last minute. Overall great class and much better than BS161.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Amber is super nice! There is homework every week and it is posted over weekend, kinda inconvenient but the homework was usually really easy, I usually did Btwn classes. Exams are straight to the point with great study guides. The group work is nothing to worry about, its mostly discussion with each other in class 4 particp, no agonizing projects.

Lectures are kind of long, the class was a bit disorganized, and in-class group assignments got a bit tedious, but the work was fairly simple and the exams/tests/quizzes were near mirrored to practices.

To begin with, Amber has an extremely annoying voice and her voice makes it hard to sit through a 2 hour lecture. She is also very disorganized. If we have a homework assignment due on Tuesday, don't expect it to be posted before Sunday. Everyday in class there is an in class assignment and it can get a little annoying.

For better or for worse, there's not much that I can go into detail about Amber. This course, like most ISP courses, was one I, speaking on behalf of most of the students in the class, was not eager about taking. With all negative remarks and low expectations aside, she elaborated fairly succinctly on the causes and effects of climate change.

This is the most ridiculous class I've ever had the displeasure of taking.  Prof and TAs are rampantly disorganized, the material covered belongs in a high school classroom, and there is a ridiculous amount of busywork assigned.  I become physically ill during labs due to the utter stupidity of the tasks we are told to undertake.  Avoid.
She is an effective, helpful instructor. Her class format was quite good. She's very/too nice. Note to other students: SHUT UP while she is lecturing. No one is paying to listen to you!
Easy class
Very chill class, exams match the lecture notes!

Study guides for every exam which clearly outlined what would be on them. Exams were very straight forward. Offered many extra credit opportunities throughout the semester. Super sweet and caring and available outside of class to discuss grades. Attendance was not mandatory either. Take her for PSY 101!
Great professor. Easy class if you go to lecture and use the study guides. Pay attention to the times that things are due though. Will screw you over

I took ap psych in high school and didn't do good but this class was amazing. Her lectures are well thought out and there are extra credit opportunities. I ended up getting 90s on all exams because her study guides are very straightforward on what was expected. I definitely learned from her class and she was super sweet.
Amazing professor! She is very sweet. Tons of extra credit opportunities and the study guides are very close to the exams which she makes pretty straightforward.

She is a very kind professor. There was a textbook, but I never read it. She would sometimes give extra points on exams and provides plenty of extra credit. The study guides that she provided were very useful. Make sure to do them because that is how I aced all of her exams. You are allowed to drop one exam, and this includes the final exam.
she completely messed up my grade i shouldve gotten a 3.5 and she put me down as a 2.0

Dr. Drahota is a sweetheart. Super caring and always very excited to teach. She's a great professor. Exams were easy if you studied and paid attention in class. Read the textbook and take notes on it, I took notes for the chapter of the week on Sundays and then went to lectures MW. Her lectures solidified what I had learned and added more depth.
Quiz at the end of every class, it was easy. 5 questions based on the lecture. All exams were online and open note!
She was really nice. Her lectures were really long and had a quiz at the end of every one, but other than that, she seemed really caring and passionate about her students and work.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very nice professor who is considerate of students needs, will often give extra points on tests if too many people get questions wrong. A lot of self-teaching if you do hybrid, but the exams are online and open book so it would be hard to do bad.

Drahota is a very understander professor, when the students were going through tec issues from the ebook she quickly took action pushing back the due dates and calling to fix the problem. Overall as a hybrid course, it was fairly easy. For attendance, she will do it by handing out in-person quizzes at the end of class that are very short.
Love dr Drahota, although lectures can be long. Would take again.
Very straight forward and is always there for help.
Never posts notes, exams, etc. when she says she will

Her lectures are a bit all over the place which is why I had to force myself to sit all the way up from and really lock down into what she was saying. Very nice and bubbly but can at times draw away from the subject. Exams basically every other week but provided great opportunities for extra credit.

The professor herself is not super amazing at teaching. Half of the class got distracted during her lectures. Study guides are specific and the exams do follow those study guides. Many chances to get extra credit. Attendance is not mandatory but you get points for the tophat quiz. Read the book and you can achieve an easy 4.0. Drops the lowest exam
She's a sweetheart and does a very good job providing her students with the necessary tools to succeed in her class. You have to actually try to do badly.

She is such a caring a passionate professor. You can tell she really loves her job and is very passionate about psychology. She gives a study guide for each chapter and if you study it, you will ace all the exams no doubt. She also gives a lot of extra credit opportunities. You can tell she truly cares that everyone is successful in her class.

Sweetest professor ever, her exams are basically the learning objectives so as long as you do them youre fine. Attendance is graded but you get 9 absences and attendance is on TopHat so you can do it at home too. She actually wants to see her students succeed and offers a lot of extra credit.

Dr. Drahota is amazing! She is very passionate about what she teaches and keeps class interesting. The study guides are exactly like the exams and she doesn't try to trick you at all. I haven't used the textbook this whole semester and I still have a 4pt. This class is super easy, highly recommend considering it's 4 credits!
Just attend lectures and do the study guides and youll ace it. Shes very enthusiastic.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Easy class and reattaching style. Doesn't try to trick you on exams

She's really funny because she is all over the place and she is really passionate about psychology. The top hat participation can be done without being in class and there's one easy homework per week. Super easy class for the amount of credits

this yr so far is absolutely aweful. she made us pay for 2 educational programmes (tophat &packback)  $40+!! they arent even useful or conducive to learning yet she makes us to use them &all it is is a bunch of busy work. she is exciting as a teacher but she does not do a great job of teaching material & doesnt really make sure students understand
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Drahota is a bit clumsy and scattered as she teaches but that's okay! As someone who loves psychology I can truthfully admit that I was not too inspired by this class, but I was assuredly not bored. She knows how to make a lecture interesting, but I feel like she missed some opportunities to excite her students about the material. Easy class!

There was a lot of homework assignments, but they are very easy and she often would provide templates so you would know exactly what she wanted. I appreciate how sweet and kind she is, and you can tell she really cares about her students. There were also a few powerpoint presentations, but overall she made sure to not overwork us.

I adored her. She was always super considerate of her student's other classes and wanted us all to do our best. Her grading scale was honestly a little confusing, but if you had any questions she was always super good about answering them. I loved taking this class and would definitely take another with her.

The class wasn't bad if you studied, but it was hard having our grade be made up of only pop quizzes and tests. The lectures were not great because Dr. Arguello read word-for-word off the slides. It was also difficult to get into contact with her. The class wasn't bad if you put in the work, but it wasn't my favorite. She did offer extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She reads off the slides word for word, and when someone asks a question she never seems knowledgable enough to give a good answer. She gives random extra credit on days where not a lot of people showed up, even though attendance isn't mandatory. Also there's only 5 pop quizzes, 4 exams, and no homework so make sure to study for hours
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She will literally read off the slides every class, not explain concepts any further than basic bullet points, and the exams (which have some topics we barely cover) are worth 90% of your grade. No Notes, In Person, Confusing exams. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is actually for PSY493, but the course isn't listed here. The first half of the semester is extremely easy. You're just graded on attendance and some paper summaries. In the second half, you're graded on like three things which is fine, but she only releases the rubrics for these things After you turn them in. It's frustrating :/

I emailed Arguello & asked her to Zoom to discuss where I needed to improve in my paper. She told me I was disrespectful, unprofessional, and harassed her in my email, & wouldn't talk about my paper the whole 45 min call. I asked her what I said that was bad & she said she wouldn't talk to me. She is not nice & I have no clue why this happened.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Overall Prof Arguello is good and her classes aren't overwhelming with the amount of work assigned. She's kind of a tough grader, but she's great about giving feedback on written assignments so that you can succeed and still do well on the assignment. She cares about her students and is willing to work with them so they succeed in her class.

PSY410 was definitely harder than PSY209, but that makes sense since this is a senior level course. The rubrics for exams are unclear, and the exams are like three questions each, but other than that, the lectures are good, and I learned a lot! There's a group project too, but it's a fun one. I would take this professor again for sure.
Class was supposed to be in person, but she made it almost completely on zoom and then had issues figuring out technology. Lectures were boring since she basically just read off the slides.

Arguello is a pretty good professor. We only had quizzes and exams so there's no homework which is both a good and bad thing. There were a lot of PowerPoint slides during lectures so be prepared to write down a lot of notes. The textbook was optional. The only complaint I have is it focused too much on memorization instead of application.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very good professor! Love her. Her lectures copy the textbook almost exactly, so attendance isn't very important, but she has a good lecture voice and has the right energy for eight in the morning. Four exams plus an optional cumulative one makes up the course, and those exams make up 90 percent of your grade.

She is a good professor! Lectures are PowerPoints and she basically just goes over those but the information for exams are pretty much on them, the book is a good resource because it is more in depth and not too hard of a read. I really do like this class. It truly isn't too difficult. She is easy to contact as well.

Easy 4.0, her class is somewhat interesting. I learned some new things, and I had some previous knowledge so it was redundent sometimes. But overall an easy 4.0, the tests are online and no lockdown browser.
She's a great professor, and this is an easy elective course to take in order to get some credits in without it being too time consuming.

I could say the class is easy, or I could say that the material was explained so well and so well understood that the class seemed easy. Isn't that the goal as a good teacher to ensure students are learning all the material? Mission accomplished.

Clearly passionate about her lectures and it shows, they were all super easy to follow and interesting. The 2 Homework assignments are fun and don't take much time. In class participation assignments create interesting discussions, and students go to the MSU bug house at the end of the semester!

I adored Professor Lorenz! She was incredibly gracious with RCPD extensions, and provided stress-free assignments. Every quiz and test was open resource, with plenty of time to complete the task. Lectures were engaging and interesting. She felicitated a calming learning environment while also sharing her passions. I cannot recommend enough!

LOVEDDD Dr. Lorenz! She is very sweet and funny. This is an online class held over zoom so you'll have daily in class participation and pre-class readings, 3 home work, and 4 exams (all of which are open note). Genuinely enjoyed this class as her lectures are interesting and you can tell she is passionate about her work. Could not recommend enough!

The class is good, it is pretty easy and she is clear on student expectations. Dr. Lorenz is kind and very passionate about what she teaches. The only thing I struggled with is the way she talked about politics and was pretty divisive

Prof Lorenz is super friendly and clearly loves teaching her class. All you have is 3 exams which are open note, 2 homework assignments, 3 question preclass quizzes, and in class participation. She teaches well so all the information is easy to understand and you visit the bug house at the end of the semester. 10/10 prof

Super fun and interesting class. Next to no homework, and what we had was super easy. Exams were open note. Lectures were collaborative and not just her speaking to us. Very good professor, really fun class. Would definitely recommend taking this class.

Dr. Lorenz has a clear system of operation for her class, but it is easy, fun, and engaging! She has a lot of love for the material she teaches and it shows. Her lectures are very clear and informative and the in-class participation that she requires is good review of topics discussed. Pay attention in lecture and you will do well :)
This class made me enjoy exploring the outdoors once again and I had so much fun admiring all the bugs she brought to class to shows us. 10/10 Professor
Amazing professor. Very obviously passionate about her work and the subject being taught and will always answer questions if asked.
Dr. Lorenz is a great professor. This class was an easy A, just attend the zoom meetings and do the participation. Slightly boring but you can tell Dr. Lorenz is very passionate about what she does.

Awesome prof and person. Super kind and receptive to questions. You can tell she's very passionate about entomology and that directly translates into her teachings. I wish grades were updated more frequently, but besides that, she's amazing.
Dr. Lorenz is a very kind professor and cares for her students. She let us take our exams at any time of the day and only had two homework assignments. She gives many points for attendance.

I have struggled in every high school science class I have ever taken and this teacher truly turned that around for me! She breaksdown concepts Into digestible material. if you really care about how you do, so will she. If you put in the work, you will do great. Definitely an easier science for those of you who are not chemists. Sweetest professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Seriously one of the best teachers I had. For being an online class, this teacher truly cares so much about her students. She is responsive on email an always accessible out of class. Science is not a strong subject of mine and I was nervous to take this class. I can seriously say I have learned so much and enjoyed it all because of this teacher!
I learned a lot of things about bugs in Dr. Lorenz's class both interesting and things that will be useful to know for my future career! The bug house visit was especially enjoyable!

Dr. Lorenz was great!! Her lectures are easy to follow, assignments are few and far between, and exams are short, usually multiple choice, and open note. You can tell she is very passionate about what she teaches, and is genuinely excited each day to teach her students. Would 100% take a class of hers again.

Before every class there is a reading quiz that is 3 questions based on a short article you have to read. In class there are in-class participation questions you have to answer in zoom chat. Every class is worth 5 points, and you get 3 drops, exams are online and open note, you have the entire day to complete it. Take this class for ISB requirement

Dr. Lorenz was by far one of the best professors I've had a Michigan State. She is very personable and her lectures are entertaining and engaging. Her passion about the material really shows and makes lectures really fun.

great professor. i took this biology course as an easy A, and i got that easy A. she's very laid back and relaxed and her teaching style reflects that as well. the material and the course is easy, and she's very caring and understanding. ellie was also a wonderful guest to see from time to time.

Great professor and cares about students doing well. You can trust that she has the best interest for everyone and the class is pretty easy. Weekly reading assignments that take less than 5 minutes, and a few exams that are online.

Amanda was so sweet and I loved listening to other lectures. Super short quiz with articles before each class, 2 homework assignments, and open note tests throughout the semester. My favorite part of the lectures was getting to see her dog Ellie. If you have the chance to take a class with Amanda, do it!

She is a great professor and I loved her lectures. The course is very easy and simple, but I still learned a lot. My only complaint is I do think she's a bit hard to reach which can be quite annoying as it was an async class. Though, nothing that was make or break with my grade.

Sooo nice and caring, clearly loves her students/teaching/this class, super fun lectures. Much of the class is completion/participation based, and the tests are very easy. The 2 major homework assignments are fun or at least not difficult. At the end of the semester you get to visit the MSU bug house during class hours which is so much fun.

Very lenient and caring, she asked what topics were difficult before the final exam and adjusted the exam accordingly. There's like 2 homework assignments, open-note tests, and participation grades. Took it online and she showed lots of enthusiasm for the material!
This class was interesting and would be hard to fail. Prof. Lorenz is awesome, funny, and a compelling lecturer. Visit the bug house!

She never answers emails. Like hellooo what's ur job. she takes forever to grade. not mean or difficult but she annoying for never answering my emails or anyone elses. like your not the president of the united states. andwer emails
Very good lectures, not much homework but the homework that you do have is honestly pretty interesting.

Prof Lorenz is the sweetest! She teaches clearly and answers any and all questions. She loves to discuss with students, and keeps lecture interesting. Attendance is needed because a lot of your grade is in class participation. There are extra credit opportunities, but you might not even need them! This class is fun and easy to pass.
Absolute gem, and her dog is adorable. Class is an easy A.

I loved her!! This class was somewhat interesting because she is so much fun and wants everyone to learn. She makes every class fun and she is also so funny so that makes it more fun. There are 3 exams which include the final. There are 2 homework assignments and before every class, you have to do an easy reading quiz. Super easy and she is so nice
Exams were easy and open note, Lorenz is a good lecturer and I never had a problem hearing back from her.
Class is extremely easy and she's lenient with her grading on the homework's. Class should be an easy 4.0

Took this class online for Fall 2021, one of the easiest class I had so far, there are 3 unit exams and 1 cumulative final exam in which are all open book test with multiple choice questions; theres one or two assignments, the assignments are easy to complete, took me about 20 minutes. Dont really require much memorization, just general concept.

She is a very good professor and easy grader. I had technical difficulties and emailed her and let me turn in the assignment late without grade deductions. Highly recommend taking her for ENT205 for the bioscience credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Prof. Lorenz is truly the most caring professor I have ever had! She truly cares about her students and their success. Very easy class- easy 4.0. Exams were open note/open resource. She is very willing to help students outside of class. Would take her class again!
I don't even really rate professors but she was so good I wanted to go on here and give a good rating :) Really easy class as long as you participate
Assignments are easy (at least online they are). Professor is so nice and understanding.

Lorenz is an amazing professor. Had her for ent205 and the class was very easy and I learned a lot. Never thought I would be interested in bugs but she makes it interesting and fun to learn. Most of the grade is determined on in class participation, so if you show up you're in good shape. She's very well educated and kind.

She is very caring and demonstrates her enthusiasm during her lectures. Combines videos along with her powerpoints to make the lecture more fun. Exams are easy as long as you study. She does not try to trick you on the exams they are quite simple. Easy 4.0 as long as you do the work.

Easiest ISB 201 class if you are willing to show up to class. She does in class papers for attendance (so easy you barely have to pay attention) basically your entire grade is attendance, a few 1 page papers & exams. The exams are very very easy. Super kind prof! Highly recommend her but dont get stuck in the 8:30am you wont make it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I had Professor Stanton for Intro to PR Writing. I really liked the way she taught the class. We didn't have a text, but she made slides available with the information we needed. We spent a lot of time in class doing writing exercises and proofreading each other's work. She isn't always organized, but she is a caring professor. I'd take her again.

I had Professor Stanton for the 2025 Fall Semester PR 225 Writing class. I thought I took a lot away about the basics of writing in the PR world and found it to be a very helpful introductory course. Professor Stanton gave great feedback, cared about how her students did, and was not a harsh grader. I would definitely recommend taking this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I had Professor Stanton for the 2025 Fall Semester PR 225 Writing class. I took a lot away from the class and was a really good introduction to writing in the PR world. Professor Stanton gave great feedback throughout the semester, was not a harsh grader, and showed a lot of care for her students work.

The class required a lot of writing assignments, and she was slow getting our assignments back to us. But she really cared about the class and about helping us build a PR writing portfolio. She wanted us to participate. We did a lot of partner exercises in class that made the class more interesting. I liked that she walked around the room so much.

Don't be discouraged from her class. She's attentive and engages, so anticipate her walking around n asking questions. Workload is manageable. She goes out her way to help best she can. Stay after class if u have questions; she addresses them transparently and guides u step by step. There's a textbook & subscription, but u can pass w/o if u engage.

Great professor! She's very transparent, approachable & sets clear expectations while still being supportive. She encourages participation, stays after class to help & ensures everyone feels heard. I loved how she taught us to use AI ethically and modeled project expectations. You will get from this course what you put into it, so show up & engage.

Lectures were long, not really her fault,(6pm-9pm) class. Feedback takes a while to get back. I thought she did her best. You could tell she cared about preparing us for the workforce and reflected that through the assignment she gave us (you build a portfolio throughout the semester. Final is improving the work you already did from her feedback.

Just don't take her courses. Waste of time literally. Got quite an attitude with me multiple times when I would ask questions. Rambles about NOTHING. Uses chatgpt to grade and give feedback. My group never showed up and she didn't care. Just doesn't care about her students honestly. Hope she does some reflection after this semester.

Lectures are impossible to follow- class material is unclear in how it correlates to assignments (and there are a lot of them). Assignments are time consuming, and feedback is fully AI generated. Also spoke condescendingly to students often. Nice enough, just extremely frustrating to work with.

Lectures are extremely boring and hard to follow. Used the required textbook one time at the beginning of the semester. She also requires you to get chat gtp premium and i think she uses AI to grade. Sweet lady that definitely means well, but so so disorganized and scattered.

I loved having Professor Flaim as my professor for MC 201. She can be a difficult grader and rarely gives "perfect" scores, but she will help you improve your work if you're struggling. Note: Her office hours can be busy. She's passionate about the topics she teaches, make sure to participate in class!!

Flaim is nice, and passionate. She cares for her students and her cause. However, she frequently goes off topic, which stops you from getting answers to your questions. She also grades harder than the other professors so you will probably have to work harder than your fellow classmates.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: felt incredibly babied and micromanaged. Specifically, rubrics had word counts for specific paragraphs, and she would walk around the lecture to make sure you were paying attention and didn't have your laptop out were some things that really pissed me off. She brought valuable information to class but I felt  like I was in 6th grade
Changed my mind, avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Respected

reviews.comment: Tough grader, all readings are similar and not interesting. The class is tailored for specific people. It is unorganized and good luck getting a 4.0 on a paper. Her grading makes absolutely no sense. Would not wish this on my worst enemy
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Flaim is perhaps the greatest professor I have ever had the privilege of taking. She understands that students have a life outside of her class, and adjusts due dates accordingly.  There are a TON of readings , but it is JMC so it's not surprising, and she takes a while to answer emails but she is very busy so also not surprising!

Her classes are hard, I wont lie, but she cares for her students and will hold your hand throughout the whole process. If you are really trying, it is never too late to try again. I once did poorly on a paper and because I went to office hours to ask for help she just offered to let me rewrite it. I didn't even ask. Take her classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Flaim is one of the most helpful and respected professors at James Madison. Yes, her grading can be difficult. However, every JMC class holds its students to high standards. The difference with Flaim is you will receive the grade that you earn. If she sees you're putting effort in and show interest to learn she will make sure you succeed.
Best start to JMC at state I've had!! Tough grading for sure, but she'll help you through it!
Very very caring and will work with you if you happen to miss a big assignment, I missed a midterm and she let me write a paper to make it up even though I missed it for a dumb reason.

class was extremely disorganized. she changed the syllabus multiple times during the semester and your grade is based only on weekly quizzes and exams. she goes extremely fast in lecture so there is basically no point of taking notes. quizzes and exams are not hard but they take weeks to get in
This class had 5 tests with your lowest getting dropped. tests are 75% of your grade and difficult. She curves them sometimes but still fairly hard. No extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very kind and wanted students to do well. Was willing to adjust class to improve students scores. Class is only tests in-person and online quizzes (3 drops). Class is flexible and her lectures were good. Only complaint was exams took FOREVER to get graded but I don't think she rly had much control over that (scoring office stuff i think).
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Borcila is very kind and caring. She's a tough grader, but gives very detailed feedback and agendas before each class. She gave us very interesting materials to study and read and encouraged us to think deeper about what they mean and what they could later depict. Thoroughly enjoyed this class and am taking this prof again!

Borcila is a great professor. She is a hard grader, but gives insightful feedback. Additionally, she cares about the improvement of her students writing. Her class is extremely difficult, but worth the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Borcila assigns dense, lengthy readings that often require hours of preparation. Participation is heavily weighted, and speaking once or twice per class is not enough. Essay instructions are vague, with no rubric. While the class may improve your analytical skills, the workload may feel disproportionate to the growth gained.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: For MC111, which is a freshman-level course, I am now a junior and still have not taken a class that was so work-heavy with such vague instructions. Professor Borcila is a very nice person to get to know outside of class; however, I found this course to be very difficult, and her teaching style is very intimidating for freshmen.
other professors recommended.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Borcila is both detailed oriented and verbose. She gives thorough agendas which act as guidelines for assignments, but I would still heavily recommend attending office hours for clarity. Most corrections are focused on the content of your papers and not the style or format. It was a critical race theory class, not a writing class. CCP

This professor is very nice as a person, as a professor I have never seen someone who is more disorganized or requires more reading. she will have you turn in annotated notes from every reading and will grade, participation and attendance harshly, she will not give clear guidelines, does not lecture, will not clarify, will not excuse any absences.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: She was very unclear in both her assignments and her grades and when people asked her for help she would be none. She would either just repeat her grade comment of tell you you can't write. She also was not a fan of people who disagreed with her opinion and would be rude to them. If you can take any other 111 I would, she should be a last resort.

Professor Borcila is fantastic. Yes, she's a tough grader; yes, she is strict & intimidating. However, she teaches you how to approach texts with a critical eye and apply real-world concepts. It takes a while to adjust to her grading style, but once you do, communication is key. Participate vigorously & don't be afraid of being wrong. Great class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I would avoid this course under P. Borcila. This professor has high expectations. Her criticisms, while generally constructive, often came off as misplaced and, frankly, rude. I felt anxious in this classroom most days. I have nothing against her personally, but the class was stressful for reasons other than difficult content.

AWFUL!! AVOID AT ALL COSTS! Will interrogate you about your personal life if you miss even one class. Rambles and wastes class time talking but saying nothing of substance. Essay prompts are vague and make no sense. Expects you to read everything and contribute every day, which is very unrealistic to have everybody talk every class. Condescending.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Borcila is by far the best educator I encountered in my 11 years of post-secondary education. She is a tough grader and an intimidating presence, but she will make you a better thinker, writer, and person. Even if you do not do well in her course, she will give you the tools to be successful throughout your academic career. Take her course.

If you have any right winged or even independent middle ground political views be very careful what you say. Very hard to determine what she wants. Be ready for about 20 hours of hw a week, at minimum. But nice lady.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Great teacher and class. TOUGH grader. You must complete all readings without just skimming them. Highest grade that she gave out in my class was a 3.3. She will give you lots of feedback if you go to office hours, but going does not promise a higher grade. Great readings and content but you must participate. She WILL make you a better writer.
Intimidating
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Class participation and thoughtful discussion is mandatory. Think before you speak in this class. Analyze every reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Amazing person, hard teacher. You will learn a lot

She is one of the best teachers I've ever had. Sure, she is a tough grader but you will learn a lot if you put in the effort. You HAVE to participate in discussion or she will probably grade your papers harder.

She is one of the best teachers I've ever had. She is a tough grader but pretty much the only thing she grades on are papers. She always gives you clear guidelines for the papers and it is never unclear what she wants from you. I became a much better reader and writer in her class and highly recommend her despite her notoriously tough grading.

Professor Borcila is the best professor that I've had at MSU. The class is not easy, but it has improved my writing as well as my understanding of the world. She does grade harshly, but my writing has improved as a result.

very interesting professor. I enjoyed the class a lot, it really opened me up to new perspectives, however you do focus on racism for the majority of the time... a helpful little tip, if you smoke go outside with her on the smoke break she takes in the middle of class.. you get to talk one on one and you will generally do better cuz she knows you.

She was a very interesting professor. The class is all about uncovering the concept of racism. You HAVE to participate if you want a decent grade in her class. She is a very nice woman but she is a very tough grader. She doesnt really explain what she is looking for. The class is interesting but I did not learn much about how to improve my writing.
She is a pretty interesting professor in class, but she is a harsh grader that it is almost impossible to predict what she is looking for.

Really passinate about her class, tends to force opinions, if your republican, don't count on doing good. Make sure to talk alot (in discusion), show up to class and don't be late, or she won't let you in. Lots of reading. Its all about racism. Overall good profesor
I loved Professor Borcilla.  As long as you make an effor in the class and participate during discussion, you can pull off a 3.5.  She isn't as hard as everyone says.
I loved Professor Borcilla.  As long as you make an effor in the class and participate during discussion, you can pull off a 3.5.  She isn't as hard as everyone says.
I really liked her class and she's always there to help when you need her.  Attendance policy is strict though.
best prof ive ever had but i got a 2.0 cause of attendence... if you want to skip class, dont take hers
Ummm yeah...if it's not 12 pt and 1.5 spacing WITH 1 inch margins...then 2.0!
This was my favorite class and teacher ever!!

Dr. Krause is the GOAT! He is so amazing, incredibly helpful, understanding, and caring. He will help his students in anyway he can, you just have to ask. This class might seem really easy, but it can trip you up sometimes so make sure to ask questions
One of the best professors I've had at MSU! They're incredibly understanding and always willing to help with class material, homework, and quizzes. I highly recommend taking a course with them.

He was an amazing professor, he was very helpful in class. I also had an amazing TA, but I would say that he does most of the teaching you need during lecture. Tests do count for a lot of the grade, but the final is not cumulative and only another unit exam. There are also quizzes every week, but you only need to complete the homework to do well.

Dr. Krause is a great and understanding teacher that wants everyone to pass. Was always willing to answer questions after class and often let us leave ~15 minutes early if it fit with the schedule. Highly recommend.

Super nice, cares about his students, and is very organized. Attendance isn't mandatory and notes are posted online, but definitely go to recitation. Very easy to 4.0 the class and extra credit is offered.
He's a very good professor but tends to take a fast pace, and you can get lost very easily during the lectures. Outside of class he's very available, and cares about his students.

Andy is fantastic. Not only does he understand and relay the topics well, you can tell he genuinely cares about the success of his students. Pre Calc is definitely not an easy class, he does a great job simplifying it. I would retake a class with Andy 10/10 times.

Dr. Krause was an amazing math professor. He was always happy and nice during lectures and gave many resources for extra help. I was never shocked by having homework or a quiz/exam because he always gave a heads up. I am not the best with math all the time but I 4.0 this class because he was so good at teaching. Would definitely take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor. The class has itself a lot of homework and quizzes, but they do a great job of balancing out the exam grades. Andy is very detailed but goes very quickly through lectures, but don't be afraid to ask questions during the lecture he will usually provide another example to help you get it. I would 100% take Andy for any class you ca

Andy is super sweet and very funny. He does a lot to help you prepare for the exams and it honestly helps a lot. You are given homework assignments after each lecture and a quiz every week leading up to the exams. This may seem like a lot but if you actually try on everything, the exams are very easy. The class is based mostly on exams and quizzes.

Attendence isn't mandatory but showing up helps a lot, the class isn't too difficult as long as you pay attention. The extra credit webwork is a must do at the beginning of the semester, but great professor
Goes really fast when filling in notes but overall helps students when they need and gets the point across nicely
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is such a caring and wonderful human being. He knows how to teach and helps you understand things. Although the lectures are just filling in notes, he walks you through every step and explains why which is really helpful. Theres a quiz almost every week but only about 5 questions.

I really like Professor Krause, he is one of my favorite mathematics instructors I have ever had. His lectures are concise and easy to understand, and he answers questions well in and out of lecture. He made Calculus simple to understand and succeed with. I highly recommend anyone to take his class.

i dont know how he did it but he made calc 1 easy. rn im averaging like 90% on the exams because of it. the lectures for example leave no room for questions because everything is explained so well. even if you miss the lectures, the intro videos are also great. my only criticism is i wish the quizes had 1 hour time limits instead of 30 minutes
Amazing professor. Provides a lot of help during office hours. Makes everything extremely easy to understand. Quizzes and Exams are online.
You have to be ready to move at a fast pace. Lots of time must be put into this class. He drops a lot of exams/assignments to help out.
So much homework. But, the professor does a great job of grading. It's a tough class but definitely the best professor if you have to take it.

DO NOT take this class over the summer especially if you are taking another class at the same time. This class will take up all of your time. Andrew is super nice and helpful and the extra credit opportunities saved me in this class. I've never gotten a 3.5 before so that was tough information to swallow.

DO NOT take this course online in the summer. Work load it extremely heavy, 20 hours of work a week at a minimum, and lots of homework. Expect at least one whole chapter a week if not more. The course is also supposed to be 8 weeks long but is actually less. Plus classes tend to run longer then they are supposed to.

Andrew was one of the best professors I've had in my life. He has a very good understanding of Calculus and he's an excellent teacher, he truly cares about students learning and he always makes himself accessible. I didn't even have his class but I would watch his lectures just because of how much I preferred him to my actual professor.

At first I struggled in this class but I later started getting the hang of the course schedule. There are weekly quizzes but are simple if you do the homework. This professor is considerate and cares about students' success. If you have any concerns, he is willing to meet with you outside of class. There are many dropped assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Krause was definitely the best Calc 1 professor. I know students who had different professors who attended his lectures because of how goo the was. He tells you what types of questions are on the quizzes (if you ask him only).

Be prepared for lots of work outside of class time to prep for lessons. Quiz almost every Friday but lots of drops available. Lectures arent required but Krause does a really nice job explaining the concepts and answering questions, so I recommend going.

Professor Krause is THE best math professor I have ever had in my life. His lectures are well structured and he makes sure to explain concepts thoroughly in order to help you understand the material. He is always there and willing to help during his office hours. His exams and quizzes are very reflective of the material in class. Take it with him.

Professor Krause is amazing. His lectures are clear and concise. Piazza is a HUGE help for homework and he tends to answer pretty quick on this site. The homework is a bit challenging (typically more than the tests) but it prepares you for the quizzes and exams. If you are taking calc at MSU, I highly recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Krause is by far one of the best mth professors. His lectures are really good and help you understand the content no matter how difficult it is. He also answers questions that you may have during the lecture. His notes correlate to the homework and the quizzes/exams, so you will be prepared to get good grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: MTH124 is a really tough course. He was definitely one of the better profs I've had for math but could talk really fast making it hard to keep up. I needed some extra help understanding the material outside of class, I used the Wize videos for this course and they really helped me to understand!

Andy might be the best math prof ever. He's always available for questions, helping with homework, and flexible. He had some easy extra credit things and was fun. If you're ready to learn calc, he's ready to make sure that happens.
Such a great professor. Really cares about students doing well and available to meet whenever. Makes Calc a lot easier to learn. 100% would take a class with him again, I wish i Could.

Seriously one of the best professors I have ever had. Great at explaining things and actually makes calculus enjoyable. He's always willing to help you out individually and going to office hours was a game changer for me. Definitely recommend him, he's a great guy!
Great at explaining the material and is willing to help. Makes learning calculus enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Math 124 is hard stuff, especially when you're like me and can't get a good grasp on calculus. With that being said, he was the first teacher that ever made me remotely understand calc. He sometimes moves super fast, but he's very thorough and answers any questions. He posts his completed lecture notes, but I still recommend attending.

He's a great professor, he has a clear grading system, will meet with you outside of class and really cares about his students. I liked having the videos outside of class and would recommend watching them before class. Overall amazing professor.

Professor Krause is an amazingly patient and personable professor. On the first day I had a scheduling conflict involving his class and he worked with me to get it resolved. You have to watch videos before class lectures but he goes over everything and works really hard to make sure everyone understands the material. Best calc prof. by far!

I had like a mixed type of learning, so you watched the notes online, and a small class of us, like 20-30, sat while he did examples and went over the notes. Quiz every Friday, but Krause is a great guy and he taught me a lot. Just stay on top of webwork and quizzes and you should be alright.
Explains things but gives out a lot of homework and does not have good examples in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She made this class very easy, there is a checklist for every module so you knew what do with clear due dates. Her wording can be a little tricky, but she is a easy grader. Be ready for busy work, but she never gives over an hour of homework a week. You also have to hope you get a good group, though she does make changes if you tell her an issue.
This was a hybrid class and very heavy with group projects. This class was definitely easy; just lots of busy work. You just have to hope to get a good group! There are no exams/quizzes. Very easy!

She's caring and stuff but she explains things so confusingly. It could be the most straight forward assignment and somehow everyone is confused because she used 10 pages to explain it. Even the syllabus is SEVENTY THREE pages long. She literally confuses everyone. Even though I got a good grade I felt like I was going insane reading instructions

She's a good professor, but for being a half-online class, it is the most work I have ever done. It's just busy work, but it gets annoying doing it every week. It's all group work, so it's not that difficult in class. If you miss class, you have to do alternative work, which is much harder than the in-person work, so you should just show up.

She is decent. I personally never had a love for the topic so I didn't find the class that enteraining.
Its all group work so being in class is a must you get 3 skips for the semester
The group work isnt bad its just sometimes annoying to do when you have alot of other schoolwork to do
Mostly it is in class work though, final needs is done outside

Professor Bierema is a very nice lady, but I genuinely would not recommend taking this class in person if it is a requirement. Her D2L is terribly organized and the instructions for assignments are overwhelming. No examples are given, and she generally gives overly detailed explanations that make understanding worse. Not content.

Bierema is kind and clearly cares about the wellbeing of her students. She's easy to reach out to and gives lots of reminders about due dates and homework. D2L-wise, this is the most organized class I've ever had. There is a lot of work in this class, but it's super easy and Bierema is an easy grader.  Show up to class, look at the checklist, easy.

She's a really nice professor. The class I took was only once a week, and you definitely had to go to receive credit for the in class assignments. But the in class assignments were so easy and you got to do them with ur table ur assigned. I never felt like the class was too difficult or stressful.

She is the kindest professor I've ever had. She cares about her students and not deadlines & grades. The second I told her I was have a mental health episode, she immediately created a plan with me to get back on my feet and didnt question or shame me in any way. If I could take her course again I would. The class is easy just a lot, stay organized
She's a nice lady but the workload is CRAZY for a gen Ed class. It's like she wants you to fail with how confusing her assignments are.

Dr. Bierema is a really personable professor. My class was hybrid, once a week. She had lots of Packbacks each week but the structure was really simple in her class. One presentation for the whole semester with a group. Seems super caring and biomed was scaring me but her course was really simple. Would take her again. Easy 4.0 if u stay on task.

Professor Bierema was very nice, but the course material was extremely confusing. The book you have to read has little to nothing to do with what you learn or do in the class and is only relevant to some of the homework. If you don't like working in randomly assigned groups, this class is not for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: If you want to take a class where you use 4 different sites to do things that can be accomplished on D2L here you go. Grading criteria ranges from clear for the final project to impressively vague. It really seems like she does the least possible work while giving her students a massive amount. The textbook is extremely odd and uncomfortable.

She's a nice person, but she gives so much unnecessary "busy work". It's a big class, but she doesn't lecture much, the class is heavily based on group work and there is not much individual work. She makes the content understandable, but at times it is uncomfortable and weird. Overall, she's very understanding but I would not take the class again.
She's nice, big classroom

Please please please if you have her as an option to take, do it. This was the easiest class I've taken and she was super super nice and an easy 4.0. She barely gives homework maybe two things a week and there's never a test or quiz. The majority of your grade is graded based off completion and not even correctness.

Mrs. Bierema was literally the sweetest. She is an amazing professor and the class isn't difficult at all. Highly suggest taking it if you need credit. There are quizzes and class activities so make sure you go to class but usually its only one day a week.

Professor Bierema was the easiest professor Ive had this semester. Isb 204 is a hybrid course but once you get the hang of the weekly routine its nothing. I HIGHLY recommend you take advantage of all the extra credit she offers cuz it helps boost your grade. But overall, easy 4.0
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I wish I didn't have him as a professor. He said, “You guys are doing too well, so we need to average a 70,” which makes it seem like he wants students to do worse. He often speaks down to students for asking questions, forgets what is on his own slides, seems confused by the material, and assigns homework that takes 2 to 5 hours.

Fun prof who cares about what he is teaching. Weekly homework and reading are posted, and the schedule stays the exact same throughout the entire semester. Can get hard/tedious with frequent hws, projects, and quizzes, but he's willing to extend deadlines/work with students.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He designed the course so he understands the material the best and dumbed it down so anyone can learn. Just like anything you need to put in the work.

Overall, Dr. Mason is a good professor. The amount of time given for the projects wasn't ideal, but it seems like Mason is adjusting the course to account for this. The lectures covered a lot of the same stuff from the textbook, which was a little strange. The homework was fair and the grading comments were always helpful in understanding mistakes.

Dr. Mason was an all-around great professor. The homework and design projects were a bit of a workload, but he gave you all of the material needed to excel in this course. While some people didn't find the required online textbook helpful, I believed that it was a great resource to have before starting a new chapter each week.

HWs were graded by a few things. Sometimes the structure of his courses can be confusing. He is highly caring and the HWs are super well built to enhance your reading. He is a tough grader and his exams are very challenging, however, you build very good study habits from his classes as his structures promotes that. I'd also say he is inspirational.

Your grade truly depends on how much you try. If you show up, learn the content, and study, you will do just fine. He doesn't deal with BS and if you never show up to class, don't expect much help from him (rightfully so). His classes are clearly laid out and lots of content is available. It's actually pretty hard to fail 230 unless you're lazy.

He was ok I guess. He was replacement professor for this class. However, he's stricter and give us even more homework compared to the previous one. This was supposed to be a easy class, and he could make this fun and easy but sadly he wouldn't. There's way too much hw at the end of semester and his lectures are plain as he just goes through slides.

The class is set up poorly. There is lots of busy work like readings that are never brought up on exams. Projects are unnecessarily complex. There are no study guides or practice tests. The only real material is long lecture slides with pictures and charts.
Super work heavy and no in class time to work on group project. Tough grader and very picky about short answer questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Burrow is a kind professor and clearly cares that her students succeed. She allowed us to earn points back on our first exam when the average was low and pushed back deadlines to accommodate us. Her course is tough and does have a lot of textbook readings, assignments, and exams, but that is expected considering its a 400 level course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class was project heavy, but they helped me learn the material and were good grade bumps as often extra credit was offered. The exams were not incredibly difficult, as long as you studied and attended class. Dr. Burrow is a fantastic professor, and I would recommend her to anyone. She is easy to learn from and is obviously very knowledgable.

Angela Burrow is extremely excited to teach this class, she comes to class with a passion to teach her students about conservation biology. I do agree with other reviews that this class is a lot of work at times. But people complaining just don't go to class, GO TO CLASS! Exams are meh but require no studying if you attend class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The content was easy, but with the amount of assignments, the class was so hard. If this class is not required for you, please do not take it. I felt like I was always swimming in work. She is also a really tough and picky grader. Run if you can.
this class made me stop wearing my seatbelt while driving.

One project after another. Had no idea what we were truly learning the entire semester. Asked for clarification on projects, and minimal help was given. The concepts are rudimentary, but how you're tested/scored is brutal. The only redeemable aspect of this class is that the final exam grade replaced your lowest exam grade if it was higher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Soooooooooooo many assignments, like 3 massive projects jammed in on top of reading and an exam in the same week type assignments. Content isn't hard but the workload is equivalent to all your other classes combined.
