If you're not far-left in political ideology (coming from a Dem), you'll have a very hard time
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!! You'll be graded by a handful of things---I'm not exaggerating---three tests and two assignments. You'll receive the most subjective grading you'll ever see, especially if you don't parrot what he says. Will only call on people he knows won't ask questions. Out of respect to your tuition money and time; don't take this.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Best lecturer I've ever had. The exams weren't too difficult, they were taken as timed essays you completed with a partner. Reading-heavy but the books he chose were very digestible and made the readings not too troublesome.

Professor Marley is a very nice guy, but although he doesn't take attendance, he will do quizzes after each topic and three exams after a few (no final), and you need to go to class to get the slides because he will not post them. This class was not really a topic of passion for me, but it was a decently easy 4.0, just repetitive and lowkey boring.
this guy is the goat and whoever gave him a 1 or a two just cant handle losing a political argument

Class was sorta interesting but his lectures dragged on and slides weren't posted so you needed to show up. But if you took good notes the class was easy- all tests were online and few, easy assignments. Missing a day kinda sets you back though

Unique guy. Exams and quizzes were always online, which was great. He also had extra credit, but the lectures were him talking and getting off track half the time + very long. He was a nice guy, don't get me wrong, but I had no interest in neoliberalism.

This is a good class to take if you actually care about sociology. Professor Marley is very knowledgeable on the material, but discussions are longwinded and boring if you aren't engaged. Heavy on readings, quizzes twice a week, and weird partner essay exams. Overall pretty easy

I enjoyed having him as a professor, he's super funny and the lectures are very engaging. Attendance isn't mandatory but if you miss a few lectures you can get completely thrown off. Participation also helps in this class a ton.

Professor Marley is so passionate about sociology to the point that it gets in the way of learning anything of importance. Every class is lecture-based on 30+ page readings. The grade is mainly based on small quizzes that tank your grade if you get 1+ question wrong. Do not expect him to help you actually learn significant topics.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Genuinely wants to see his students succeed and learn, goes to great lengths to ensure this and lets his students grow and find their own individual path to understanding our world.

If you plan on taking this class, beware of endless discussions regarding anti-capitalism. The entire purpose of this class is to complain about climate change and how screwed our political agenda is. Majority of classes he didn't even lecture in. He expected students to take notes of what other students said. Thankfully tests were online though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Do not take SOC161, unless you are willing to glaze every word this man says. As a political moderate, I felt horribly singled out (not being called on when my hand was the only one up, being graded down based on vague technical stuff, refusal to define concepts that were new to the class). Revoked all extra credit opportunities last minute.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Will refuse to define concepts vital to the understanding of Sociology (like you should be able to define Liberalism). Spent most of the time ranting about capitalism. Will lower your grade based on subjective things if your ideology doesn't match with his, trust me. I'm a political moderate (left leaning) and this class was horrid.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very easy professor, canceled the final. I personally loved how he challenged our existing beliefs but that can rub some people the wrong way. Very lecture heavy, no recorded lectures and gave extra credit for participation. Can be very test heavy so if you do badly on one exam it might be very hard to recover.

Abysmal professor. Don't expect to be able to debate this guy in ANY way. Will constantly say "there's statistics to support this" and then never bring anything forward. Three of the videos shown to us were taken off YouTube for literal misinformation. Unless you have GPA to spare or are willing to nod to whatever this guy says, don't take this.

Do NOT take SOC 161. It's an opportunity for this walking fallacy of a professor to peddle his own political agenda. Spent the whole semester complaining about neoliberalism and capitalism, with little on the actual development of society. Only take if looking for a headache.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Marley is by far the best professor I have ever had. He is extremely engaged and truly wants his students to learn about how the world works. He is a very fair grader and explains everything in depth so that students do well on the tests. If you come to lectures, do most of the readings, and are engaged you will do great in this class!

Very lecture heavy, but it's a sociology class so what did you expect? Attend every class. Get ready to take notes. Loved him as a person. Very caring and passionate about his teaching, and very smart in general. If you miss a class, make sure to get the notes for sure. He's very understanding and didn't take attendance ever, but make sure to go.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Please avoid this class, if not the professor. This man's ideology bleeds through anything he says, unabashedly. He turned a class meant to be about how we socially developed as humans into half a hundred lectures going after capitalism within a 50 year span. If you are a political moderate of either party; AVOID THIS CLASS. You will be picked on.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Workload was super light. Five critical reflections that were three paragraphs, three quizzes, three exams (he cancelled our final). The exams are partner exams with two essay questions that were based on readings. He had an author on one of the books we read as a guest speaker and if you asked him a question you would get extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Will try to explain your own point to you, as if you don't understand what you're saying. Lectures fraught with fallacies, to a distressing degree. Has a very narrow scope of how certain things affect society (there are hundreds of factors that influence us as humans, especially in large groups). Nice enough dude, but an unbearable professor.

Professor Marley is deeply passionate about sociology and wants his students to learn. He loves participation. He is very anti-capitalism, so be prepared to be open minded. Tests are with partners, and the class is mostly essay writing. There is a LOT of reading and the lectures are closely related to them. Overall though, a very interesting class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great professor to gain new perspectives, he is kind of a Marxist, but presents real data and evidence for what is taught. The workload is very light, the only assignments were four discussion questions. The exams were online and open-book so they were very easy and low-stress. Participation in class is heavily encouraged but never forced!

no stress class, good lectures, content is interesting, there is practically no homework except two to three essays, with a few 5 question quizzes and essay-question exams. None of the content is really difficult or hard to wrap your head around. If you dont like reading all the texts just attend class as he reviews all the content from readings

As an introverted student, Prof. Marley's class definitely pushed me out of my comfort zone. He puts a lot of emphasis on participation, so be ready to share your thoughts throughout the course. Nonetheless, I felt as though he was a fair grader and his work was very manageable, though there was often a lot of reading.

Prof. Marley was an amazing instructor. He explains content very well and makes sure you have an understanding of all the material. Attendance is not "mandatory" however, the lectures are where you get most of the information that you will be tested on. Take good notes!
He is a fair professor, he respects your time and gives you opportunities to make up assignments should you miss them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The lectures can feel long and tedious, however as long as you're taking good notes, paying attention, and doing most of the readings you'll get an easy A+.  He loves when people participate in lectures, so the more people raise their hands the more fun the class will be.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Ben Marley is the absolute goat. Even though ISS220 was a lecture heavy class, all you have to do is pay a little bit of attention, do the reading and the other homework assignments and you will get a 4.0 no problem. Even if you omit some of the reading but pay attention in class, you will still most likely get a 4.0. It is important to not skip.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He was my most favorite professor I had this semester. Completely changed my viewpoint on the world and taught us all how to critically think. He lets you take quizzes and exams at home and even gave us all 100% on our final for being such a great class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Best professor I've had so far and by far the best class of my first semester! He really cares about his students and is passionate about what he teaches, which shows in his lectures. You are guaranteed a good grade if you complete the readings and attend lectures. Completely changed my perspective on the world and improved my writing.

Professor Marley was by far my favorite professor this semester. The class was very lecture heavy about the book we were reading in class but Professor Marley does a good job interacting with the class leading to many class discussions.

Prof. Marley is one of the best teachers I have ever had. My perception of the world has been completely flipped upside down since taking his class, and he has so much knowledge on how the world works that it is so eye-opening. There is lots of reading, but it's so worth it. I came into his class knowing nothing, and now I feel 100x smarter!!
Super chill dude, as long as you show up, give half of your attention, moderately pay attention to the lecture, and read the book you'll get a 4.0. Very understanding, and relaxed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took this course in the summer. It's pretty easy and only one assignment each week. Either it's a quiz or a short paper. Easy grader and gives some extra credit, and the quizzes and assignments are easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Prof. Marley was great! There was not a moment when I didn't love his teaching style. He genuinely opened my eyes to see the world in a different way, and I will always remember. He is very understanding of students and the pressure that they are under. He is also very helpful and a fair grader. I would take a class just to have him as a professor.
Really cool guy, I had his async. class so I never got to interact in person but he was a great prof. He was a fair grader and gives good heads up about exams/assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Marley is definitely a more chill & "go-with-the-flow" kinda guy! He keeps all his students in check and has expectations that he only slightly budges away from. Personally, I didn't enjoy the class topic (capitalism/environment) but Professor Marley always had good discussions. The only con would be the 5 min breaks for our 2 hr. class

I really enjoyed taking this class and the professor! While the professor is very accessible and open to any questions, he was also very hands off. If you do not mind a lot of reading this is a good class to consider taking!

I loved this class, in fact, I feel spoiled that I got it my freshman year. This is what a college class should be. It completely changed my worldview and made me think more deeply about everything. he pushes his students to really develop their own views. I cannot stress enough that you should take this class. You will not regret it.

Dr. Marley is honestly super nice, the class my come off as difficult but don't worry because he breaks it down and is super generous with extra credit. There's partner exams and many extra opportunities to get points. Exams were not as bad if you are somewhat prepared. There are alot of articles and reading outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof. Marley is a really nice guy who cares for his students. By the end of this semester I think he was feeling burnt out because he def starts to grade harder. If you do the readings you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Marley is the best professor I've had at MSU. You do have to read or you won't understand the lectures. The readings are hard, but he comes to class and really clears things up so you feel like you didn't waste your time.

Loved this class! Marley is a great guy who is super knowledgeable and wants students to be engaged. Participation/attendance is important but I really enjoyed the lectures, they were very well put together and he always answered questions thoroughly. Sometimes the reading was heavy but after coming to class it all came together/made sense.

Prof Marley was great. Tbh I didn't love the class for the first two months bc I am not into class discussion or readings due every class. but I came to love the class. Marley is a very relaxed guy and respects everyone's opinions. You have to come to class tho, he posts slides but main discussion you need to be in class for.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I took this class as an elective and I regret. Do not take this course if you don't like reading or writing. His way of writing is difficult, but I will admit that they help you develop skill. His tests are partnered and he grades hard I am just not a fan of his teaching style.

LOTS of reading and reading questions and in class assignments. Very easy class though: Tests are taken in groups and the only project in the class is done with a partner. Class is very heavily interactive and discussion based with some powerpoint slide info. Challenging content, but made easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Lorch is one of those professors who you'll remember forever. He cares about his students so much and it shows- he truly only wants everyone to succeed. He makes subject matter that some would find boring, incredibly interesting. Prof. Lorch is the reason why I decided to stay in JMC.
I loved Professor Lorch's recitation. He made sure everyone understood the topics at hand and was great to talk to!!

Professor Lorch is hands down one of the best professors I've ever had. He is very understanding and approachable for students in and out of class. All the readings in his class were relevant and very reasonable in length and difficulty. He also facilitates discussion better than almost any professor I've had. If you can take a class with him, do.

absolutely brilliant professor. probably one of if not the best jmc professor i have had. classes were very discussion-based, his lectures were extremely easy to digest and comprehend. as long as you do the readings and pay attention in class you can easily 4.0 this course. if i could take this class again i would. 10/10 highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lorch was so sweet! He was always insightful and helped students think deeper about the questions raised in class.

Professor Lorch kept the MC 201 recitation and discussion sections very interesting. Even when his area of expertise was not at focus, he provided great context to the course materials and helped significantly with breaking down the essays for clarity. Let's just say, don't be surprised if he answers your question with another question.
NUMBER ONE LORCH GLAZER! He is literally the best professor tbh really hard but go to office hours and he really helps.

Lorch was a great professor who obviously wants his students to succeed. He is extremely interesting and does not make participation intimidating. Facilitates great discussions in class, and is a good grader, albeit a bit demanding at first.

By far one of my favorite classes I've taken so far at MSU. Professor Lorch made an almost two hour class feel short, because he is able to make course material very interesting and engaging. He has a great range of office hour times, and is willing to make appointments beyond those hours. You can tell he wants his students to succeed. 10/10 class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: While Lorch grades fairly & provides helpful feedback, he dismisses opposing viewpoints, fails to present other perspectives, & steers discussions to imply that only his views are valid. He has made troubling comments, such as being okay with the existence of the KKK when talking about hate speech. If you're a progressive, DON'T take his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lorch was great! He was always patient & happy to discuss anything asked, both in class and office hours (which he provided very, very frequently). His class was always both entertaining and engaging, and he'll always challenge you to think and reason harder. Thorough & helpful feedback on papers was always given. I cannot recommend him more!!
His lectures are great very caring and accessible.

Amazing Professor, he was absolutely meant to be a teacher. His attitude makes you want to get up for that 8am. He is a tad but tough on grading but I had a professor who was much worse. His lectures are very informative and he guides you on how think for yourself. His expectations are very reasonable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Really great professor, his questions really push you to really think but he won't tease you as much on your essay. He gives good feedback and highyl recommend him
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I can honestly say that Professor Lorch is the best professor I've ever had, and it isn't close. Prof. Lorch loves to talk to his students, he constantly has office hours, and he responds quickly to emails. For any essay you turn in, he provides a page of feedback that both compliments your work and gives detailed constructive criticism. 10/10.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Whatever class you are looking at taking with Professor Lorch, TAKE IT! While he is a tough grader and it's hard to get a 4.0, he makes his classes worth your time. I took both MC201 and MC202 with Lorch and LOVED both courses. One of the most universally respected Professors at MSU, his classes are top-tier in both education AND enjoyability!

Despite the amount of reading and work, the class is worth it. Lorch has a unique ability to take things most people would find boring and put a fun spin on them. He is super understanding and always willing to help. Can't recommend him enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: My second time taking Professor Lorch was better than the first. If you ever get the opportunity to take a senior seminar with Lorch, do it. I've never been more interested in Aristotle, and he is to blame for that. Take him at any opportunity you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Excellent. Interesting, kind, and reasonable. Continues to help me out in office hours even though I am not a current student of his.
Could not say enough great things about this man. Please take his 201 and 202 classes.
Lorch is amazing; the only gripe I have is that he does not like technology and tries to avoid its use. It isnt that big a deal though. Take lorch if possible

One of the best professors you will ever have. He will challenge you and help you meet the high expectations that he has for you. Lectures are clear and understandable if you pay attention. Go To Office Hours, he will explain to you what he wants you to talk about if you just go. If you can, take a class with Prof. Lorch.

Professor Lorch is easy to access outside of class and encourages students to come to office hours. For recitation, he did an excellent job guiding the conversation with prompts/questions and he did not dominate the conversation. His feedback was helpful on every assignment and occasionally he brings treats to class. I recommend taking his class!

Professor Lorch is a typical PTCD professor who grades extremely fair and makes his readings and papers pretty interesting. He is always really helpful during office hours, and his no electronics policy actually helped me focus on his lectures a lot more than I would have with a laptop in front of me.

Absolutely love Lorch. While classes and assignments can be tough, he is incredibly accessible and gives amazing feedback. His office hours are so so helpful. He is very well-respected by all of his students and vice-versa. He also brings in treats!

Professor Lorch was super understanding this semester and adapted the whole course to better fit his students needs. Lots of reading, with occasional quizzes to make sure you do them, but it's interesting topics and well worth the time. 100% use his office hours, he has a lot and they are magical for assignments. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lorch is a wonderful professor. His lectures can get a little boring, but he doesn't lecture for all of class. It is largely discussion based (you are graded on participation). Sometimes he responds to comments pointing out the flaws in what you said, but it is to provoke thought and reflection instead of embarrassment.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took Lorch two semesters in a row. He can assign a lot of work - but is fairly understanding and gives enough relevant feedback that it is not too overwhelming. He also brought us snacks! And seems like an all around interesting prof/person.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Respected

reviews.comment: THE GOAT. Lorch clearly cares about what he teaches and makes sure to ask interesting questions in class. If you're willing to put in the time to do the readings, you'll find yourself confronting a lot of thought-provoking concepts during class discussions. His grading on essays can be a bit vague but he is helpful during office hours

Professor Lorch is one of the best teachers I have ever had. He cares a great deal about his students and takes lots of precautions to ensure every student has opportunities for a good grade. He also adapts his class to be best for everyone, and is an entertaining lecturer

Professor Lorch is such an amazing Professor! He cares so much about his students and really wants you to succeed. I would definitely take his class is given the opportunity. You will learn a lot in his classes and get an amazing lecture for every class. He is wonderful!

He's an extremely tough grader and isn't super clear on parameters for essays. He's really kind and his office hours are helpful. Gives a lot of feedback on papers which is nice but obviously, there's no makeup. Overall he's alright.

Love, love, LOVE Professor Lorch! His office hours were super helpful and he leads interesting discussions. He's understanding and flexible, but will make sure you don't slack off! Class participation is a big thing and he provides helpful feedback on papers. I highly recommend him!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Lorch is a great professor. His classes are discussion based, so if this is your thing, you should definitely take a class with him. He's a tough grader and questions everyone in class. But, he gives great feedback and appreciates when you come to him for help. He's very intelligent, fair, and well-respected. *Do the reading before class*

I had him for MC201 which is a difficult class regardless of Professor. Reading is heavy no matter what but Lorch required 1-2 page reflection papers (graded on completion) at the end of each week, whereas other instructors assigned discussion posts. These were helpful for test review. In class discussions were not helpful unless you had questions.
He's amazing. Kind, flexible. An honor to have
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Lorch is a great professor especially if you take time to go to his office hours. The more he gets to know you the easier the class becomes.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Hes a great guy and I loved his class, but its a ton of work he gets off topic sometimes but is very passionate about what he teaches and engages you!

Lorch's lectures were amazing and I loved having recitation with him. He grades fairly and perhaps easier than the other 201 professors, but sometimes he can be a bit vague (in, say, office hours or class) about what he's really looking for. It's also very obvious where he lies politically, and that affects some of the recitation discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Very interesting and nice guy. Most students receive around a 3.5, which is high compared to other professors. You must be ready to back up with your participation with the readings, as he tends to ask follow up questions intended to pin you into a corner. Gives great feedback on assignments. Signed up to take 202 with him about halfway through.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Would take again

reviews.comment: Lorch is a very interesting man who really makes you think during his lectures. He grades fairly (and maybe a bit easily) and is more than willing to help you if you feel lost. He is a friendly face and can both deliver content well and explain what he expects you to do in his assignments specifically.
She's really nice and wants to see you succeed. Very helpful and had a relaxed classroom environment while also making sure we improved in Spanish.

Dr. Berrios-Campos is so nice and good at teaching the material in a way that is digestible and prepares you well for exams. It's very exam-heavy, with only 2 exams the entire semester that cover 6-7 weeks' of material, but it is doable. I also appreciate is you can speak to her in English, because I know some Spanish teachers only do Spanish.

Dra. Berrios-Campos goes into great details about film portrayal of recent and modern day issues in Latin America and Spain. There are a lot of short papers in this course, but she is very helpful and will make sure you do well if you try.
She is super sweet, and the class was super easy. She explains everything very well. Lots of writting, but it helped me a lot improve

Dr.Berrios-Campos is amazing! She's so understanding and willing to help with whatever problem you may have. Enjoyed the course and everything taught in it about Hispanic culture and film. Learned so much. Lots of essays and writing - but easy enough to enjoy.

It's asynchronous which is nice to be able to take the class at your own pace but you should know the professor will be taking the class at her own pace too. There are three total essays that you will write during this class in which she will not grade them until finals week. The final film review essay is a 4.5 page research paper, not film review

This professor is so unclear with what she wants within her papers that no matter how many times you attend writing or Zoom sessions with her you will never understand what will meet her criteria. She will tell you what she wants at the moment to get you out of her face and then turn around and say that's not what she wanted. Overall, terrible.
I had her for SPN 201 and she was super easy-going and knowledgeable. Very helpful and could always answer questions, just do the preclasses and you will 4.0, easy grader.
I took Spanish 310 with her. She's so sweet, literally the nicest person ever. A very easy going class. Lecture notes are a bit too much but nothing bad!

Berrios-Campos is great! She is passionate, knowledgeable, shares personal anecdotes to strengthen class concepts, and provides a PDF of the textbook instead of requiring that you buy it. She values participation, attendance, and group work, and gives great feedback on writing assignments. Show up and participate :)

Great teacher with a lot of enthusiasm for what shes teaching. Easy-going. Group presentations and papers (the majority of the work in this class) are not graded hard. Come to lecture and participate as well as put in a little bit of effort into the the presentations and papers and its an easy A.
Take physics online with this guy and study the take home activities for the exams as they're near identical. Great guy just keep up with the homework!
hardest part about the class is remembering your enrolled in it

The class is an easy 4.0, but he is a not a great professor. If this class was hard everyone would probably hate him. He does not really teach: the video lectures, homework questions and exam questions are by a third party. The only time I ever saw him teach was the EHW explanations + he is horrible at answering discussion board questions in time.

All the exams are exactly like the extended homework and he gives lots of extra credit on the exams. He does not have lectures, you just learn from the textbook and supplemental videos. Easy 4.0 if you study the extended homework.
I was very worried about taking physics but this was so much easier than I expected. Tests were exactly like the homework so if you know how to do that you'll be set.
Lab is run by TAs, as long as you do the reports in the format they want it should be easy to 4.0
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. Easy 4.0. Such little work. HIGHLY recommend!

Online asynchronous class. Very easy to pass if you keep up with the weekly LON-CAPA work and study the extended homework solutions, because they are literally just like the exam, which is in person, but again, very easy if you study the homework solutions. Caring professor who honestly doesn't want to make physics too hard for us.

Lot of students complained about response time, but I never had an issue. Homework sets were the same Q's as the exams, and he let you have one note sheet. He said this would NOT happen next semester. Expect either one of those things (homework = exam, or a note sheet), but not both. Most of the content was through an edited online textbook.
Physics at MSU is very difficult, but Saul was one of the best professors I've had! He makes the homework assignments align with the exams, and he helps anyone struggling that reaches out.

Professor Novo is that professor that you know is gonna be good. He started the 1st class saying we didn't need to have our cameras (on Zoom) on and expected us to be in bed still because it was "early", it was at 10:20. I don't think he ever lectured for the whole time either. He was such a sweetie, please take his class, it is so easy.

He is the sweetest prof ever! This was an online class, but he was a very a accessible. We had 3 midterms, but there weren't many questions. Homework was easy and if you needed help with a question you could stay after class and he'll show you step by step. I would take this class and prof again!
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Online class with zoom calls twice a week. I really enjoyed this class it seemed like he really cared about his students. I would've gotten an A+ had I not missed a couple homework assignments. This class is a physics class which I didn't know beforehand but ended up being fine. I would take again.

This was a great class I really enjoyed his positive attitude. He is very nice and provides a safe space to ask questions and seek help. At times it homework is confusing to know when it is due, but he will give you opportunities to go back and do it if you missed it. Exams are easy and there is a retake for each. Would definitely recommend.

Such a good guy, however, he often canceled lectures but never said anything. He understands that this is a university requirement class, so he kept it simple and didn't expect too much from those who have never taken a physics class. Overall great due and was readily available outside of class.
The book that was used for this class was amazing. The content in d2L was clear and easy to navigate.

One of the most caring professors I've ever had. He's very passionate about physics, but makes the class understandable for us only taking it for an ISP credit. As someone who doesn't enjoy physics, I enjoyed his lectures. Easy amount of HW, you can always ask a question on Discord or in the help room to figure it out. Exams were open-note.

During the class, he gives out clicker questions throughout the zoom to count towards your participation points, so you need to make sure you are paying attention. Typically the lectures do not take up the whole scheduled time for the class. Homework can sometimes be difficult, but the exams are exactly like the reviews (which are open note).

The sweetest and best professor I have had since I started college. The homework we had were a little confusing, but he was more than happy to help. The exams were easy to do as well since some of the questions were on our homework and our exam review were the exact questions with different numbers.

The best professor I have ever had!! Extremely kind, caring, and understanding. I took his course online and he would stay after every class to explain questions people had on homework. He was also very understanding when people missed assignments. Overall, great class and great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Always available to help with homework or exam questions very kind and understanding. Posts lectures so that you can rewatch if you missed anything. He acts like a real person who has a life.

Professor Saul is easily one of the best professors I've ever had. I had never taken a single physics class before this, nor did a lot of my peers since this is a gen-ed course at MSU. Saul made this course enjoyable, easier, and impactful. He genuinely cares about his students, and will listen to their advice and opinions. HIGHLY recommend him.

Great Professor. He made a tough class way more enjoyable and always pushed for things in favor of his students when the physics department would make decisions about the course. He has a great sense of humor and kept class interesting. He always seemed excited to help his students both during and after class.

Great Prof. Our last exam some people forgot to take it so he extended it another day. Physics is not my thing but he made a required course painless. He gives you the course textbook and reviews exams before you take them. If I couldnt figure out a hw problem I asked a TA, they always either gave it to me or helped me find it.

This class is a very difficult class considering the teaching style, however he made this section so much more enjoyable. He is by far the best professor I have had in college, wants all his students to succeed and does not sugar coat things. If I could take him for every class I would.

If you just finish your homework on time you will ace this class. He has review sessions where he literally just changes the numbers from the test problems and does it step-by-step, then posts those questions and answers online in D2L. Very easy A+.

Great prof. I told him I worked a lot throughout the semester and he was able to work with me to allow me to continue. He also does the whole exam with you and gives you the answers before. Super good!

Saul is a proffessor who genuinely cares about the well being of each of his students. The format of his lectures and notes were made in a way that a student can go through and learn in depth, as he didnt try to 'fool' us on any questions. Plus, you get extra credit just for showing up to class. You can tell he loves his job, and I appreciated that
An awesome teacher! Only cares about his students doing well, wish I could take this class every semester. So easy and nice. Attendance is online and for extra credit, how awesome?
A professor who really wants his students to succeed! There are weekly homework questions that aren't too difficult. As for the exams, he gives very clear reviews.

I loved Saul! He did a great job using participation questions and group work to keep you engaged with the lectures. He also is quite funny and really cares about his students. He listens to what the class has to say and is very conscious of students' workloads. I would highly recommend taking a class with Saul, he's great!
Saul wants everyone in his class to do well and is very caring. He is so far one of my favorite professors at MSU

Saul was absolutely great! His lectures were sometimes very loaded but he cares about his students and wants everyone to get an A+! I enjoyed his class and hearing about his pets. I I would take another class with him!

This lab was a breeze. It didn't use lots of physics but was more focused on scientific communication and methods. Most of the grading is based on group work, so be sure to get a good group and communicate with them. You do rank your group members and if they don't participate, their grade will be affected. There is little HW outside of class.
Hes the greatest. He easily accessible if you needed help and was more the willing to do so.
I was so nervous to take college-level physics, but Prof. Saul made it so enjoyable! He was incredibly helpful, kind, adaptable and understanding. Physics is hard, but Prof. Saul was AMAZING
Best Prof I have had and super understanding. Very easy 4.0 if you do your work!

Saul is the funniest professor I have ever had and probably one of my favorites. It is almost impossible not to 4.0 his classes by the way he really tries to make sure his class is successful. If you show up and do the homework, a 4.0 is almost guaranteed

He wants every student to pass the class. Cheat sheets are allowed on every exam and the exams are comprised completely of HW questions. Do the homework and copy the problems down on to your cheat sheets and you will do fine!

He is a great guy, very funny. You won't understand what is going on half the time, but you will probably 4.0 anyways. I recommend coming the day before tests, and that's about it. He is funny, with very easy grading, and there are weekly assignments but they are just pass/no pass. Do it.

He was awesome! His lectures were amazing and he is very entertaining and wants his students to learn. Attendance is not mandatory per se but he uses clicker questions and those are extra credit towards your grade. Attend his office hours before quizzes and exams, they are super helpful and he usually gives you hints to help you on the test.
Saul is the best professor I have ever had, makes learning physics fun and enjoyable. No professor is as personable, and funny as he. If you're taking 183 I would recommend him to everyone.
He is one of the best professors, he really cares about his students.

There is a daily (1-5 question) and a weekly (20-30 question) online homework assignment. You are required to buy the book to access the website but you will never use it. The homework can be googled/chegged if you get it wrong. The quizzes can get challenging but he gives out extra credit for the hard ones. Great guy and a good teacher.
best professor ever! So dope
Difficult material, but tries hard to facilitate good grades for students with extra credit and exam retakes. He also goes over every exam the class period before and allows a cheat sheet.
The lab was supereasy. Instructor was nice and helpful

I took 313 and 315. Nice professor but has a lot of confusing slides that don't cover content on tests and grades by only a few things. He reads off powerpoint slides for classes, not very helpful for learning. The quizzes and tests are worded difficult and confusing so even looking at the textbook (they're open note) did not help much for 313
This is a great class and Professor Cooke is super knowledgeable.

Professor Cooke is very kind and knowledgeable overall, but beware of the grading structure. The only grades that go in are 5-question quizzes and lengthy exams, so one wrong is an automatic 80%. Seemed manageable at first, but often the questions are worded very specifically to details that might've been glazed over or missed in lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very nice Professor! All slides were posted to D2L, which was really nice. Tests and mini quiz questions were a little more difficult, but were manageable.
Great professor and the class was very interesting. This was my favorite class.
Great and interesting class where everyone respects the professors times.
Despite my grade, I feel like Mr. Biddle was not at fault. His class was fun and we had great discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great teacher and great person. Took his USEM at ND.
Great teacher and Mentor. Took his class at Notre Dame.

Professor Biddle, now at the University of Notre Dame teaching a seminar class as well as others, led one of the best classes I have taken. Not only was the class fun, but also interesting, and Professor Biddle was able to guide the class to great insights. I hope to take another class of his in the future.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Jeff Biddle was probably my best professor Freshman year. Clear teaching and balances fun with learning perfectly. I took his University Seminar(Social Sciences: Economics) at the UNiversity of Notre Dame.

This may be one of the worst classes i've ever taken at MSU. Graded by 7 quizzes and 3 exams with the questions not being relevant to any of the material learned. When most the class is failing to a point he curves your final grades to an average of a 2.0 that's a problem. Nice guy but not worth the pain brought on by this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: he doesn't really care

Really engaging lectures and I actually felt like I learned a lot. Really funny in class as well which makes them one of the better parts of the day. Only downside is fairly tough grader with some rigorous midterms.
Professor gave a pop quiz on the third day over stuff that was not even taught yet. Wants to watch students fail, brags about how few people pass his class. Awful professor
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very nice professor, I enjoyed his teaching style of lecturing during the week with quizzes on Fridays. Could get off topic some times but it helped me to catch up on my notes. Making a connection with him goes a long way and it felt like he wanted me to succeed. Willing to admit when he makes a mistake and works to make it right.

While Dr. Bell was extremely caring and attentive if you reach out during office hours, I found his lectures to be quite misguided and confusing. I watched videos online to teach me most concepts, and recitations were also extremely hard and theory-based. I was just able to manage a 3.5; if he sees you putting in effort, he will recognize it!

Couldn't stay on topic during lecture. Often went off on a tangent about things not related to the course. Very homework heavy. Weekly quizzes written by the professor. Hard to read feedback given on tests, takes off points for small things even if the answer is correct.
Genuinely one of the best professors here at msu. Extremely kind and caring, worked closely with him to ensure the A. Much respect for professor Bell.

do not take this class.I only took this class because I was unable to get into the online version of lb118. if you are unable to get into the online calc class seriously hold off on taking calculus. take it in the summer or the next semester. he is nice and that is the only good thing about him. hard tests, will probably be ending with a 2.0 or 1.5

He lectures poorly and goes off on tangents many times. He does not have an interactive way of teaching, just writing away at his chalkboard aimlessly. Lots of self studying needed bc he doesn't prepare you enough for unit exams.

It was so bad I would give it a zero, but that's not possible so I give it a 1. Don't take his class unless u already took calc 1. The tests and quizzes are 80% of ur grade and they're super difficult. He's is very nice I will say but teaching wise he's terrible. Absolutely 0/5 would not recommend if you want to pass calc.

Bell is a great guy but his class is extremely difficult. You need a strong foundation of calc before coming into this class because he doesn't explain stuff. His lectures are a waste of time because he often goes into tangents about difficult and unrelated concepts. However, if you meet with him outside of class, he is helpful. Hard grader too.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you have never taken Calculus or have a strong foundation, I do not recommend taking it with Bell. He can be very confusing during lectures and often goes off on tangents. He focuses on the why instead of how. He is a very kind professor but again without former knowledge, I do not recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Prof. Bell is an amazing lecturer; however this requires participation on the students end. He will do examples and usually will go over topics IF you reach out and before on the online forums for class. The heavy work load combined with the lectures are the best study material for the class. The exams are definitely possible with enough prep.

Basically had to teach this class to yourself, absolutely do not take this class with him if you haven't taken AP Calc of some kind. Class is set up where all of the teaching is done out of a textbook and some basic problem sets, class is wasted by going over problems that are overly complicated and barely related to the material we are tested on.

Do not recommend taking a class with him. He teaches the class by having you read the textbook before lecture, and in lecture he does less than three really complicated practice problems. It's basically a self taught class, and it's weighted harshly. The problems he writes are hard. Nice guy, but you have to be able to teach yourself calc.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He seems like a good and nice person but he isn't the greatest teacher. Lectures can be confusing to follow as he uses confusing coding problems to explain simple topics. Assignments aren't hard but there is a lot of them.  Tests are pretty hard so expect a lot of studying. Would recommend taking a different teacher for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Very smart professor but can be boring. Lots of online assignments. No way to check grade unless you calculate it yourself but theres so many assignments to keep track of. VERY late in grading. Textbook and course is ran online and is expensive.
Lots of practice problems, which can take time but ultimately helped me learn the material.
teaches by having students read a math textbook and take quizzes on it. lectures are composed of five or less practice problems that are more complex than the test questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: As others have said, Dr. Bell is a very friendly and passionate professor but his teaching style is not the best and his version of LB 118 seems to be much more difficult then the other ones offered at LBC. I personally find office hours not very helpful if you have a lot of questions.

Do not take this class if you can. Lectures are extremely confusing and his exams are very difficult. I already took calc BC in high school and I still don't know what he's talking about most of the time. My advice if you end up in this class is to read the book and take notes and do lots of practice problems from there. Office hours are unhelpful.

Do not take. So unorganized, can barely hear him, and expects you to know everything before class. Talked about why we shouldn't take calculus and take computer science in the first class (keep in mind briggs is a college for premeds). Just switch out if you can, you'll regret taking his class.

Dr. Bell is a very nice and passionate person. The lectures can sometimes be difficult to understand since they are typically very conceptual but writing notes is very helpful. The tests are difficult but doing lots of example problems makes them very doable and there are opportunities for test corrections. Dr. Bell made the class enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Bell is a very caring and understand professor. Lots of WebAssign homework that usually doesn't match what is taught in class. Outside of class time is when you have to learn how to solve the problems on your own, in class is more conceptual topics. Exams are difficult. Office hours are usually helpful.
Definitely cares about his students and always helps you if you need it. Tons of opportunities for corrections on exams.

Unlike all other calc classes at Lyman, you are not allowed to use a calculator. Web-assign due every day and we also a reading quiz due every class . Does not grade reading quiz on attempt, rather only if you are right or wrong. The tests have really low average scores, due to how hard they & no answer key. I do not recommend taking him for calc.

DO NOT TAKE A CLASS WITH HIM! He is a very sweet guy, but he is horrible at lecturing. He will want you to do a bunch of reading and come to class with a full understanding of the material. The exams are extremely difficult! BEWARE! He is horrible at explaining things.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Bell was a great pre-calc professor. He had lectures 3 days a week on zoom, but he recorded these if you missed class. He does his best to help with any questions you ask and is also very understanding about extensions.

He's a really nice guy but he's also your typical "math professor". He has a monotone voice and is not very engaging. He expects you to already know the information and is not really helpful at teaching the concepts either. Exams were really hard but there was always helpful feedback. I did well in all my other classes 3.5 but I got a 2.5 with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This was a very difficult class for me. Dr. Bell has a flipped classroom, which means you work in a team of 3-4 kids to solve problems during class, which he doesnt lecture on how to do until the last 5-10 minutes, leaving us all frustrated and the lecture rushed. Tests hardly correlate to what was on the learning objectives. Switch out if you can

Dr. Bell is a very sweet guy, he tries to help as much as possible and genuinely WANTS you to do well. Despite this, he's not the best teacher- that is, if you're not much of a math whiz. I struggle with math and because of this, I really struggled to follow him. He's not very good at simplifying difficult topics for kids who struggle with math.
Dr. Bell is a great professor, he is so caring and puts a lot into his class. He is a great prof, and a great person.
He can ramble sometimes when explaining topics, but always helps when you need assistance and his office hours were incredibly useful.

I struggled with AP Calc in hs but did well in his class. Seeing the information again made things much more clear for me. He is a calculus whiz and really should be teaching grad-level math. He assigns a worksheet every week that are usually tough so GO TO OFFICE HOURS. HE WILL WORK YOU THROUGH THE CONCEPT AND ANSWERS. Had a 4.0 until the final.

First off great guy, TERRIBLE professor. As a person who took calculus in high school I really struggled. Topics he taught really confused me even though I already learned them. He goes really fast in class so if you get confused for even one second stop him. Also homework is so confusing LA's who were in calculus 3 couldn't even help me.

It's definitely hard not to admire his knowledge, but it's hard for him to share it when it comes to students who have no background in the subject. I have him for calculus and I've never done any calculus before. As a result, I live in his office hours and in tutoring sessions-- even the tutors and LAs get confused by homework assignments.

Terrible professor, very monotone. After the first exam, he straight up said if you got less than a 40, then you should drop out because there's no hope for you! after that, 23 of the class dropped. Switch out while you can!
Doesn't teach, expects you to read out of the bookalready know the material.

He assumes you have a strong foundation in math, and if you don't you are screwed. He doesn't really teach the material, he expects you to read the textbook and understand everything from that.  He isn't very approachable.

Although the class was difficult, and Professor Bell is strict on what he expects from coursework, he is a fantastic teacher and will go to any length to help you in or out of class. He is incredibly knowledgable, and can relate almost anything to a practical application. Highly suggest any of his courses.
So-so.  I think he knows his stuff, but can't get it across to those that don't already know the material.

He is not a very good teacher. I had him for college algebra and thought maybe it was just this class, but a friend has him for Calc 3 and also says he is horrible. I will never take a math class through him again. My only 2.5 of the semester

Dr. Bell is a genius, but for an easy class like College Algebra he just can't "dumb down" the material and explain it. He, in a way, expects you to already know what you're doing. For a higher level class I would recommend him, but for College Algebra I would tell you to look elsewhere.

He is very helpful in Office Hours, and has good lectures. I recommend attending all of the classes, and recommend him as a teacher. As long as you pay attention, study, and ask for help when you need it, you'll do well!
Extremely helpful, always works to give office hours, exams are hard, but corrections were given for points back

Professor Bell is extremely helpful if you attend his office hours.  Even though he uses abstract thinking, the class is not too hard if you are determined and disciplined as a student.  I enjoy Professor Bell's class.
Professor Bell's class is difficult, but if you attend office hours and ask specifically for help, he is very helpful.  If you are dedicated, you can do well in this course.  I enjoy it.

Exams are extremely difficult, practice problems are not relatable to the exam, and attending class doesn't even help you understand the material.  I've taken AP Calc, and what I learned there has actually confused me even more with what Bell lectures on.  Transfer if possible!

He is really unhelpful and he always goes off on tangents. He only spends the last five minutes of class teaching new material. When  he does end up teaching something new he doesnt know to to teach it in a way that students can understand.

Bell does not give directions on how to solve problems, but rather talks about concepts and ideas much more abstractly. This increases need to use the textbook. Bell is a very nice, intelligent teacher, and expects students to work to understand the content of the class.

Bell is a really nice guy but way too brilliant to communicate.  Going to his office hours helps a bit more than just attending class but it doesn't help that much. It was difficult but if you make friends, he will help you out in the end.

If you have Bell transfer immediately.  All his examples are way out in left field.  He assigns homework that has nothing to do with quizzes or exams, and all the exams are really difficult and hard to finish in the time given. He doesn't explain concepts so a beginner in Calc would understand them.  He might be better for like Calc 2 or 3.

I LOVE Professor Morseau! She's genuinely one of the sweetest people ever! We had a lot of in class activities which we worked with the people around us on, but they were fairly easy. She also drops the lowest two of those so if you miss class then you're good. A discussion lead, three quizzes, and the final exam as well.

I loved Professor Moreseau. She truly cared about the content she was teaching and knew how to make it interesting. Discussion lead was super collaborative which made it less nerve wracking. 10/10 recommend this class!

Super nice and caring. Very laid back class. Class is graded on a few quizzes that are easy if you simply show up and pay attention,  4 in class assignments that are graded on completion (this is her form of attendance grade), a final exam and a discussion lead (not as scary as it sounds).

LOVED PROFESSOR MORSEAU! Had her for AIIS201 and was funny, understanding, and I looked forward to going to the class every week. We had different readings each class, and then went over it and had lecture. Extremely fun and would take it again!

Very easy class, and very chill prof, it's almost impossible not to get a 4.0 in this class. I enjoyed the content, and even though you don't HAVE to read the book essentially I found it interesting in general. Lots of online platforms but you get the hang of it. Def take this class for an easy gpa boost.

This is a very easy course. Before taking this class I read that there are too many platforms we are required to do work on like packback, d2L, textbook, dr. Tatiana, etc. I think this was easy to grasp and every two weeks is a module that follows the same criteria, just diff topics. I held an 100% basically through the entire course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Incredibly easy class. It is literally less than 20 mins of homework a week, and there are no exams. If you do all the easy participation, it is nearly impossible to not have a 4.0

Very easy class overall. Work is easy and you're also with a group. The quizzes we had to do were super easy you can directly get the answers and get a 100. The project that we had to do was fun and easy to do. The only thing is that the packback was a bit annoying and the book is cringe.

She is a great professor. Makes it clear what is due and when. Many resources are available for help. You do need to buy a book that is used for a discussion board. No exams, just a course semester project due at the end of the semester which isn't the hardest thing ever. Group work, but have same group whole semester. Overall I'd take again.

the easiest class I've ever taken. Material isn't boring, grading is clear and uploaded into d2L, accepted late work for most assignments. Not that you'll need it, bc every assignment is pretty simple. If you get anything less than a 4.0 in this class and don't have extenuating circumstances consider dropping out of college

Literally got 100% in the class. So insanely easy, and you just show up once a week. I tell everyone to take this course for an easy 4.0. There's a lot of navigating on D2L and other websites, but the same stuff is basically due every week. Probably the best prof/class for a gpa boost.
Super easy class

Nice teacher but it took me forever to understand the layout of the class because we have SO many different websites relating to the class. But it's pretty easy once you understand how to use it. The whole class was based on this animal sex book, overall an easy class if you read the book. Attendance is only once a week and mandatory for a grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: I hated her class, it basically had nothing to do with the title of the course, it took I believe 9 weeks to reach the first mention of topics related to the course. Only redeeming factor was that 80% of the grade is participation and graded by computer for 0 or 100%.

Great teacher if you love having the WORST class organization I've ever dealt with. I haven't finished the class yet, so I really can't say what my grade is. Taking ISB 204. Teacher will tell you to 'go somewhere' in the class website, and good luck to you finding it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: ISB 202 is an easy prerequisite. There are a few assignments that are teambased, but nothing this semester was difficult. Class structure makes it so that even with a bad group, you are still able to 4.0, since there are plenty of assignments and categories to be successful in.

Prides herself on being an online learning wiz? Worst online class I've ever had the displeasure of taking. Sure her D2l setup is pretty-- it's smoke and mirrors. Unhelpful prof, overcomplicated course, unnecessary and annoying group work, all busy work. If she ever reads these: Hi, It's summer gen-ed bio. No one wants to be here. Simplify things.

seems like a lot of work because of discussion posts and responses but overall super easy. group projects that build on each other and combine them for the final instead of an exam and drops one assignment in each "category." easy 4.0 as long as you do the work
This was an asynchronous class and the workload was a lot, but not necessarily difficult. Be sure to do the homework right away
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Overall, this class wasnt bad. In general, Prof Bierema was a relatively easy grader and assignments werent too hard. However, there are a TON of assignments. You will be bust every day of the week with this class. Also, a large part of your grade is dependent on group projects. These are pretty challenging and not an easy feat. However easyish A

was good at keeping me busy. lots of assignments due on different days of the week. had to post two discussion board posts each week (took about 2 hours to do both) before wed., and had to posts 3 responses, 3 different days of the week. group projects every week- not helpful at all. wasnt an option to work alone. she was organized and no exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very helpful, responded quickly to any questions. Discussion board each week, easy quiz every week online, content was very enjoyable and intriguing. 4 assessments total, easy projects. Met once a week, work in groups every class. Highly recommend, very nice and caring professor, easy A, and pretty interesting no matter what you major in.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Her class was decent. I feel like I didnt learn anything but it was an easy A. She is a great prof. and is very caring and understanding.

Great ISB class! This class only meets for an hour each week and the rest of the work is done on D2L. We had an online quiz and discussion board post due each week, as well as three responses to the discussion boards, but it was a reasonable amount of work. Bierma is super nice and helpful as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Class only meets once a week so youre expected to attend every lecture. you work with the same group, so if you dont like who youre put with, say something immediately. Class is crazy easy but youre required to do online stuff beforehand that doesnt even correlate to what we talk about in class. theres 20 pts worth of extra credit!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: She is a very nice person, its a pretty easy class. You get put into groups for daily work, and you get participation every day for the group work. Try to be in a group that will write your name down for participation when you aren't there. Easy 4.0. Barely ever studied.

This class was very interesting and an easy A! You work in groups every class period and get credit for the work you complete. There are also modules before every class, but they are super easy. There are four total exams that are easy if you use your course pack to study. Dr. Bierema is very organized and clear about what she expects from you.

I had her for both LB144 and LB 145, and she was by far my favorite professor at MSU. She's super nice and really wants everyone to do well, the workload was extremely manageable, and the tests we're very similar to in class work. Would highly recommend!

You have an assigned group for the semester for in-class activities that cover biology principles, and you are scored for your participation in those activities. There are also modules (hw) you must complete for points before every class. The exams follow the content very well and are not difficult if you prepare. Professor Bierema is super nice!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: If you need to get you ISB credit, take it with her. She is very clear with what she expects on projects and is more than willing to help you understand. Worked in groups the whole semester, so going to class is necessary to get credit but she does give you plenty of skips. Pretty fair grader on tests and final project.
This class is super manageable. Work in groups for the whole semester. Homework is easy and not super complicated.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Would take again

reviews.comment: In class you work in groups on case studies and video responses. Quick homework online after every class. Easy tests, I recommend this class.
AMAZING PROFESSOR. IF YOU GET A CHANCE TO TAKE HER, DO IT. YOU WILL THANK ME.

Probably the most chill professor I've had at MSU so far. She understands that Uni is to let people learn new things and not just for a grade and it's reflected through class. She has a lot of professional experience in the field so she has lots of personal stories she can tell in class. Tests are very easy if you come to class.
Very easy class. i would take her fro every pysch class. pop quizzes but they're just completion based. homework is so easy and you have one a week. no exams only quizzes

one of the best professors I have had here. you can tell she cares so much about what she is teaching and makes it very interesting. lots of drops. it is very interesting and a very easy class. I definitely found myself actually wanting to go. Theres one homework assignment a week and pop quizzes but it is not hard at all. definitely recommend

genuinely one of the best psych classes ive taken. dr. burnette is fantastic and the lectures are really well done and make class very interesting. i always looked forward to her class. all you have is weekly homework (which is straightforward and very manegabkle) and few exams. would highly reccomend!

I lowkey think she might be my favorite or second favorite professor. she actually makes me want to go to her class because she's makes it interesting and interactive. she actually cares about her students.

Dr. Burnette is very knowledgeable, and her class was extremely interesting; I would actually look forward to attending lecture. She does do iClicker and pop quizzes so attendance is sort of mandatory. Her exams are weighted heavily, but she does offer one exam drop, along with a drop for a pop quiz and attendance drops. Easy 4.0!

reviews.comment: This class was so easy, and genuinely so fun and interesting. Attendance is not required, but I still looked forward to going because the class is amazing. I would 10/10 recommend Dr. Burnette. She does use IClicker, Pop quizzes, and online assignments, but overall this class is an EXTREMELY EASY 4.0.

Dr. Burnette is AWESOME and would recommend her class to everyone. She is very knowledgeable and is super interested in hearing students' responses to class material. Lectures were very engaging, and there are only a few assignments even graded for accuracy- the other ones are just graded for completion. You get 1 drop each assignment as well.

I would take every single psychology class with Dr. Burnette if I could. She is genuinely the best professor I've ever had. She is so knowledgeable and encourages class discussion and is open to all questions. Every assignment gets at least 1 drop, goes for quizzes as well. Class material is so interesting as well.

Dr. Burnette is amazing. Simple assignments throughout the semester, and you get drops for everything. 5 pop quizzes but besides that attendance is not mandatory. Her lectures were always entertaining and she had guest speakers for every topic. So much extra credit! She is one of the nicest profs I had and this was an easy, informative class.

Easiest class I've ever been in. Homework is graded on completion. Quizzes are free. Extra credit opportunities. Professor is so sweet and genuinely wants to make you enjoy the class. Please Take this class.

She was very caring and def wanted us to know the material rather than memorize. Everything is open note, ton of extra credit, ton of drops. She does pop quizzes so choose your attendance wisely but she is caring and understandable

she is the best. I would take all of my classes with her if I could. all quizzes are open note, and the classes are so engaging. I'm a serial skipper and I actually WANT to go to her lectures. she brings in a guest speaker for each topic we cover too. Amazing professor, easy 4.0 and you actually learn

Professor Burnette was amazing, she is so kind and caring about her students. She offers guest lectures from professionals in each field we cover, and she is extremely knowledgeable and understanding.
Very easy 4.0. Nice prof who gives clear lectures.

Blair is incredibly kind and you can tell she cares about each student. The homework and quizzes are incredibly easy if you pay attention and know the stuff. There's extra credit opportunities, some of which being to send a picture of a pet if you read her announcement. Such a fun & interesting class if you're interested in mental health and psych!

Professor Burnette cares about her students and gives out stress management tips. She is fascinating to listen to, and gives many examples for each concept. Homework and tests aren't hard, and it's easy to miss class if needed. She specializes in eating disorders, so she will often bring this in as an example in her lectures.

Rick is the greatest college professor I ever had the pleasure of meeting. He is just an absolute wealth of knowledge- not just about the industry but about so many things. He's someone who you want to learn absolutely everything you can from. One of the greatest resources not just in the MSU film program, but at MSU as a whole.

Once a week during class, you will watch a film. The discussions and analysis of the films is very interesting, but you do need to go to class, because there are weekly essays, along with the fact that attendance is graded harshly the more you miss. The professor is very nice and interesting.
I love movies, he made me love them more.
Professor Rick, goes above and beyond for both his students and lectures. I learned so much in this class, not only about film, but life in general. One of the best professors I've ever had.

The most insane class I have taken at MSU. Easy class, you watch a movie once a week and have a couple of one-pagers about the readings, but Prof. Blackwood is the highlight of the class. Not only are his lectures unhinged but he shares lots of stories from his past. While attendance is mandatory, you always want to show up to see what he says.

reviews.comment: Take this professor. I was legit excited to go to every one of his classes. He is very smart and knows what he's talking about, and he really for his students to learn.

Professor Blackwood was the most interesting professor I have had yet. Yes, the class was long, but we mainly watched movies and heard the professor's stories and insights on life.  I felt this class was an amazing opportunity to reflect on my life and goals. Homework was easy and engaging.

If you are looking for someone that will give you something meaningful for your time this is the man. Professor Blackwood, and those who work within his classes, really care about the material, and greatly encourage curiosity. While attendance is mandatory you're not wasting your time going. Read the material it seriously teaching good life lessons

Rick is an amazing professor who really cares about what and how we learned. Yes, class was early, but you were watching amazing movies all the time. Don't miss class because you'll miss out on great lectures and analyses that Rick provides throughout class. Would take it again just to have Rick as a professor again.

He was one of the most inspiring professors I've had at MSU. I found his IAH course deeply engaging and meaningful. He made complex topics feel approachable, encouraged open discussion, and always connected the material to real-world relevance. His passion for teaching and genuine care for students really stood out.

Prof Blackwood is very interesting, and the class itself isn't stressful at all despite all the content. Weekly readings, and biweekly one page papers that are graded on whether or not you did the reading. Lectures were long and sometimes droned on, but usually his extensive knowledge is fascinating enough to keep you awake and paying attention.

I enjoyed having Professor Blackwood, he has a lot of real-world experience to share from his days working in Hollywood. Lectures are very long, but they contain lots of wisdom, and I feel like I learned a lot from his class.

I enjoyed my time in this class. It was very interesting and we watched movies every Wednesday. We only had 2 papers and 3 one-pagers which were really only participation. The papers aren't even graded that harshly. Come to class every day and he will literally cancel your final and midterm. Wish he taught other classes so I could take them.

Showing up to these lectures was always the highlight of my week. He really cares about expanding your perspective and making you smarter. Movies in IAH 241G were triggering so be cautious of that. We had two papers and three one pagers which were easy if you did the readings and watched movies outside of class.
Professor Blackwood is an amazing professor. He really cares about his students and you will learn a lot.

Professor Blackwood is an interesting guy lots of life experiences. Fair grader and only assigned 2 longer-papers and a 3 short 1-2 page papers. Rarely gave quizzes and midterms as long as everyone showed up to class and was engaged in the material.Easy to get along with and enjoys what he's doing. The class was very worth it. Make sure to show up!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Absolutely amazing class! He gives such good lectures you forget you're in class. He shows you movies and explains how they created them. He has amazing experiences in the real world, that he is more than willing to share with you! Highly recommend, you will not be disappointed with this class at all. I learned so much from this class!
Loved the class, great coursework, readings, and films. Enjoyed just about every lecture. Great class even greater professor.

This class was the one I looked forward to every week: Prof. Blackwood's stories and lectures were engaging and interesting, and I left each one feeling like I learned something. His screenwriting and filmmaking industry experience offered invaluable context to the class content. Class was discussion based and there was ample time to ask questions.
Seems paranoid around male students. Clearly writes her own reviews and has written her own Wikipedia page (lol).
