Great guy, getting tired of the same stories.  Hard tests, but worth it

Great professor! Clearly cares a lot about his job, is extremely helpful, and the class is interesting. The class becomes a little overwhelming in the last few weeks because you have a group presentation, 12 page research paper, and an open-ended final but prof Hambrick is helpful and understanding of his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Hambrick is amazing and I'm so glad I decided to take to take his class. He's such a good professor! There will be 2 quizzes, a group presentation, a paper and a final. Attendance matters a lot so you must go to class—That is why I didn't get an A. He's also very welcoming and likes when you participate and ask questions in lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor. Clearly very knowledgable and passionate, plus he's funny and very kind. He wrote the main book for the class and provides it for free. A couple assignments had somewhat unclear grading criteria but he's happy to expand on anything and answer questions. Would take a class with him again!
Class is lots of reading however was expected. Dr.Hambrick is such a great and caring professor. Very much recommend his course he is awesome!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I wish I could take a hundred more classes with Prof. Hambrick. format of his class is concisely laid out in 1-page syllabus, he opens the room for discussion, anybody who actually listens and comes to class to learn will get a 4.0. funny, kind, thoughtful, and knows how to teach a class, unlike many young Psych profs who read off their slides.
if i could have him for every class, i would. he really cares and values your opinion like a peer of his own. ridiculously funny and receptive. extremely flexible. easy

I really enjoyed this class. You were encouraged to do your own work the way you wanted to. The class was just 2 quizzes, 1 presentation, a paper, and a final exam. The workload is very doable. The professor is very cool too. The second day of class was pet introductions. He knows how to make his students smile and is just a cool guy.

You're graded on a paper, two quizzes, and a group project so attendance is mandatory. Professor Hambrick is one of the most approachable and understanding professors I've ever had. He's passionate about what he does and it seems as if he has a story for each topic covered in class. Books are mandatory, you'll need them for the paper/group project.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: I think this is a good class just depends on the person. If you are not a good test taker do not take this class. Scored very low the first quiz and was very hard to bring my grade u. if you are looking for easy A do not take it . He is great teacher but having only 3 exams for a grade can take a toll on ur grade. If ur like me and are bad at test

This class was ridiculously easy, there are 3 exams and thats your grade. His lectures are fun and he is very funny and entertaining. I wish I couldve had him for all my psych classes. really an amazing guy all around highly highly recommend.

Professor Hambrick is a great teacher and I would definitely recommend taking his classes. His PSY101 class consists of 2 hour lectures, but he manages to make them interesting and is super funny and engaging. Your grade is pretty much completely tests, but they're easy and consist of material directly from the lectures with a few book questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's a great professor and he's really funny. The only grade you get in his class are the exam grades so if you don't do good on them then you're screwed. He does exam reviews but they don't do much. He also puts questions on the exam from the book so if you don't read you may find it hard. Overall, he makes class really interesting and funny.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hambrick is amazing. His lectures are really easy and interesting to sit through. Hes very funny.

Prof Hambrick is so amazing! His psych class is mainly lecture and reading the chapter on your own. His grading scale is pretty stringent and it makes up for a lot! He also has extra credit so you know he cares!!  Really did love the guy. Also- hes freaking hilarious.

I really enjoyed PSY101 with Dr. Hambrick. He is such a sweet and funny guy, and his lectures were always meaningful. The material was very understandable, and he posted the slides after a couple weeks. You can tell this guy loves what he does. Great professor!

literally only showed up to class on exam days. got a 85 on first test, 94 on second, and 89 on final. gives extra credit for research. i took ap psych in HS, so studying took me maybe an hour total the night before the test. I never went to class, but i hear hes a great professor and tries to make it interesting. easy GPA boost if you need it.
Great lecturer. 95% of your grade is tests tho

I had Hambrick for psych 101 and I loved him. I barely showed up to class and got a 90% on the first exam. He posts the lecture slides a week before the exam. Make sure you do the research studies EARLY!!!

I got a 2.0 in this class but he was the easiest of the 101 professors from what I heard. He's a funny guy, and if you show up everything in lecture is from the book and you should do way better than I did.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I loved taking Psych with Hambrick. Very genuine guy who truly enjoys teaching. His lectures are enjoyable and he provides excellent media / real-life examples for specific terms. The tests cover exactly what is referenced in PowerPoints and sometimes the textbook as well, but they are very easy if you put in study time.

Hambrick was awesome for psych. I would suggest going to class and listening to the lectures and stories he tells, but if you are someone that can teach yourself the material, then he does post all of his powerpoints the week before each exam. You have to participate in a few hours of research studies but you can get EC from them if you do extra!
He's a great guy and wants you do well in the class. It's an easy A as long as you review the notes

Heres the whole class in a nutshell.... u dont need to go because he teaches from a powerpoint which he gives you 1 week before the tests. The class is an easy 4 because literally every test question comes from the powerpoints. With that being said the powerpoints are long so lots of memorizing,
Long lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher and a great person to get to know. Highly recommend him because he truly loves his job and he offers you 3% extra credit if you an extra 6 hours of research. He is really funny and a down to earth guy who really, really, loves dogs.

I went to every class, put in numerous hours of studying, and even attended his office hours multiple times, yet I still ended up with a C in the class. Got a 95 on the final and was a point away from a higher grade but he would not change it. His class solely is based off 4 exams and a few hours in research labs.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The class is just exam grades which can be difficult, but if you pay attention to the lectures, take good notes, and make sure you study at least a bit you'll be okay.  Hambrick gives interesting lectures and he kind of sounds like Bill Clinton which is a plus.  I really enjoyed the class!
Very charming and funny individual. Lectures were given with care and charisma. Tests only. No homework. No "mandatory" reading but I recommend you do the reading if you want a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: A great teacher and made me excited to go to every class. I would love to take one of his courses again or shadow him in his work.
cool guy
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: best professor at msu
Such a great professor! Goes over everything in detail and as long as you review all of the terms, you'll do fine on the tests. He's hilarious and a really nice guy.

As long as you go to lecture, you shouldn't have to do much reading outside of class besides the 2-3 pages he tells you to read before an exam. Lectures are very information heavy and provide a lot of examples that are extremely helpful. Also funny and entertaining which makes lectures go by faster. Grade is all exams with the exception of 3%
Really great teacher, makes sure you know the material and makes the lectures interesting.
Very long lectures, but you get one break, and sometimes he'll even let the class go early. Very nice and funny professor.
Hambrick is extremely helpful and funny. He makes the class interesting, even though it's very long. He wants students to do well. I would recommend taking the class with him if possible.
Goes over everything you need and reiterates material from book so you don't have to read it. Doesn't drone on and makes sure you have access to materials before tests.

He was a cool teacher. For me, it was an easy A, even though I skipped class a lot and barely studied. I do not recommend skipping class if you are not a naturally smart person! He explains the material great, and he is easy to listen to. Do what you need to do to get that A and you will be fine. Good luck!!
Amazing teacher Makes learning psychology interesting
the class is long and lots of reading.

Hambrick is one of the better profs I've had. Attendance was not required, but his lectures were very helpful for the exams. Very knowledgeable, had a lot of additional media (YouTube videos) to go along with his PowerPoint slides to keep the class entertained. Overall, he was a pretty easy-going guy
the class was really easy and prof. hambrick was very funny. he really knows his stuff! the lecture slides are online too, so it was easy to pass without attending.
Class is super easy. There is no need for you to go to class. He sends you all of  the lectures so just read them. He is also funny.

Great professor. You don't need to attend classes to pass, but its helpful. He put's all his lectures up online before the test. Go to review sessions before test and the book is not necessary. Tests are easy
Very funny and interesting lectures. Tests were very easy. Attendance is not necessary but helpful. Review sessions before every test.
Great class is very easy, test are big but so simple, you just review the material he has on the powerpoints and it is an easy A

Fun teacher, interesting lectures... but they are kinda long. You can skip his lectures, but you have to be sure to read the book to get caught up. His powerpoints are easy and he gives enough time for you to take notes on each slide. Tests are kinda hard though, but he does give review sheets before tests.

He's absolutely hilarious. Though you don't have to attend his 101 lecture, I highly recommend it. The exams are based on what is said in class and he is an extremely engaging speaker. If for nothing else, attend for the jokes.

Hambrick is the best professor there is.  No matter what anyone says, you must take this class for psych 101.  I never read the book, and studied for an hour the night before a test and 4.0ed it easily.  He's super nice, hilarious, and interesting.  i love him

His exams are pretty difficult! This class is all about studying, especially from the power point lecture notes! Most of the test questions are from those notes!! And you can only get the notes if you go to class. But I do recommend him b/c he does a good job teaching psych. I should barely pull a 3.5 GPA! Definitely a nice guy with goofy hair :)
His tests were much harder than I had expected. They were more application questions than definition. He gives big curves though.
tests were crazy!
Not a hard class if you go to the lectures, but you have to go to them all to do well.  You have to read the book too.
easy if you read the book.  easier said than done. if you miss even one or 2 lectures you are screwed
expert in this subject, friendly and teaches well
Wonderful prof, helps you to understand everything clearly&wants u to understand
great prof, very clear, class isn't overwhelming
Dr. Seligman was plane amazing, he took the time to get to know everyone's names and always explained everything very clearly.

Professor Seligman is really passionate for astronomy and he treats students as equals. Attendance isn't mandatory but there is learning catalytics that will go toward your attendance; it isn't worth much. I'm not really interested in astronomy but he made it interesting. Also the class was in a netflix documentary which is pretty sick
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, told us it was his first year, but still did an amazing job in teaching the material. Very knowledgeable about what he is teaching and is always looking for feedback on his lectures, which shows that he cares.

Dr. Seligman was fantastic! His lectures were engaging, he made an effort to connect with students, he was a very fair grader, and frequently asked for feedback on his lectures. I'm not science smart at all whatsoever, so my poor grade was not due to the professor; he explained the material extremely well! I would totally recommend Dr. Seligman!

Amazing professor. Great lectures, very engaging with students, super knowledgeable. This guy is the real deal, he's a leading researcher for interstellar objects. But he still makes the content easy to understand and interesting for non-science majors. Young guy, good with tech, good grader. Homework and exams are manageable, very possible to 4.0

He is an amazing professor who clearly cares about his students and the work that they create. This is a writing class and he allows for a lot of creative freedom which is really nice. He holds regular office hours and is very personable.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was amazing! Professor David clearly cares about all of his students. The homework is very light, but attendance is mandatory; that is not an issue, as he makes class super interactive and enjoyable! I loved this class and would take it again if I could :)
Great guy. Really cares about what we learn and take away from the class. You have to show up every day but that's as hard as it gets.

Heavy participation-based class, but all you have to do is show up, and if you do all the readings, you'll get a 4.0. Prof. Medei makes an effort to talk to and get to know all the students in the class, and genuinely cares about your success. He's great at responding to emails and super accommodating.

Caring about students and all-around great professor. Homework about 1-2 times a week (which is short paragraphs responding to prompt of reading) and couple bigger projects: one being a group presentation and a research paper/infographic. Tries to know everyone by name and talk with them. If you miss anything, there are drops, but you can email him

If you miss a class he will call you out for it next time he sees you. You have to ask questions and talk in class or your grade goes down, It's a decently sized class and somehow he knows everyones names so no getting past him. He's a nice guy and has a lot of personality but if you can choose a different IAH I wish I would've.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Prof. Medei was one of the best professors I have had so far. He cares about all of his students and gives amazing feedback. I recommend this class 100%!!!

The professor does not offer a complete syllabus when the class begins and will change things as the course continues. If you are unable to attend a class session, you will be emailed afterward and indirectly shamed for your missed attendance. Assignments are not made clear and are often given with only 2 days' notice.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Medei is amazing. His class was a comfortable and safe place for everyone. He took the time to meet with everyone one on one to make sure they were okay in the class. He reads all the papers and provides amazing feedback. He was the sweetest soul and best teacher I have had at MSU! I definitely recommend him!
This class was easily my favorite class of the semester. He cared about each student and made class enjoyable to come to. Easy grader, definitely recommend him for WRA 101.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mr. Medei is the best teacher I have had during my first year. He is very interactive with the class and doesn't make you feel wrong for asking a question. Considering I have him for my 8 am class, he makes coming to class worth it. Homework is not too much since we complete most assignments in class. Group work is encouraged. 10/10 recommend!
Very kind professor. Easy grader and very understanding. You can tell he is passionate about his job and cares about his students and wants them to succeed.
He was a really good professor who genuinely cared. Do the projects on time and put in at least 80% effort and engage with him and its an easy 4.0

Prof. Medei is an awesome teacher who genuinely cares for his students and always checks in on how projects are going. The semester consists of 4 projects usually split into homework assignments due before next class. Overall a fun class and would take again.

Professor Medei was one of my favorites. I was somewhat nervous for WRA101 because I never felt extremely confident in my writing skills and expected a college writing course to be a challenge. I loved the structure of his class and how helpful he was. He pushes you to do YOUR best not that of other students. Highly recommend his class.
Prof Medei truly cares about his students and will give you helpful feedback. He'll meet you halfway and is an easy grader. If you're taking WRA 101 definitely take it with him.

Great professor and truly cares about his students and how they are doing. I really loved this class as it doesn't feel like your average boring english class. You write about your personal experience with things and he make it very fun to do so.
Great Professor!
Medei was a great prof. Cares about his students, will give you extensions if needed as well as absences. Attendance is mandatory and he values it. Easy class with 5 essays and no actual final exam.

Dr. Medei is such a nice man! You can tell that he loves his job. There's obviously a good amount of writing--it is a writing class--but you very rarely have homework or feel stressed. I would 100% recommend him for WRA 101. The class has been incredibly enjoyable.
Medei is the literal goat. So enthusiastic and uplifting. A real gem for sure. If you are taking WRA101 do yourself a favor and pick professor Medei.

Dr. Medei is easy to reach outside of class and very understanding. He prioritizes feedback which made writing the papers easier. Definitely show up to class because most of the work is done during class time and he will answer any questions you have. Overall, a great professor and made a mandatory class a lot better.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very enthusiastic and uplifting, probably the best professor Ive had at MSU so far.

He is such an awesome professor his classes are really fun and beneficial. If you ever had a chance to sign up for his class do it ! he is really helpful and wants you to improve as a student. Moreover, he always wants you to turn a well written paper that way he always gives you chances to meet up with him and find ways for you to improve !!

David was a phenomenal professor. My writing has improved, and David has made the mandatory class fun, and active. The two hour class period never felt as long as it truly is. David is easy to talk to, and he gives back great advice and feedback about your work. He will respond to emails within a day, and makes Eli Review and D2L easy to access.

I had Medei for my WRA 115 and he was great! He made the 2 hour class manageable. He was easily accessible through D2L/email and had flexible office hours. The syllabus and directions for the papers were easy and straightforward. He spent a lot of time grading papers, and you could tell that he really cared about our writing. Highly recommend!

Dr. Medei was an absolutely phenomenal professor. He believes that proactive feedback is far more helpful than retroactive feedback and because of this most students did incredibly well in this class. He uses his office hours to provide specific development feedback on your papers and they truly do help. If you put in work you'll do well.

Professor Medei is an all around great guy. Barely assigns any reading and gives you so much time to write and edit your essays in class. He's not a tough grader and is ALWAYS willing to help out. Take him if you can! You don't need to buy the book either we used it 2 times and it wasn't even necessary. Just come to class

He keeps the atmosphere active so you're not falling asleep during the 2 hour class period. He takes attendance but it's not a part of your grade. Pretty informative and did help me improve my writing a bit. He canceled class twice and half the time we left early. The class barely had anything to do with law and justice.
Decent professor. He was very helpful and  helped improve my writing skills. However the 2 hour class was fairly dull and boring, and he took about 2-3+ weeks to grade our essays.

GREAT professor! very helpful when it comes to revising papers and always gives you adequate time for assignments. it's not totally focused on law and justice so don't let that scare you off, it's well incorporated but not shoved down your throat. you can only miss 3 classes but that's university WRA policy. overall a great class to take.

I had him for my 8am.  Even though it felt SUPER early, he was always energetic in class and after we all had time to wake up, we had some really good discussions that made you think... great teacher, very enthusiastic!!
good teacher, kinda weird. cancelled class atleast three times so that was a plus. kind of a hard grader

Had him for Evolution (IBIO 445) too and honestly he's great. His tests are always fair and he is very willing to curve tests or give extra credit when he sees that it's needed. For genetics, we got to drop an exam and for evolution he made your better exam get weighted more and rounded final grades. I enjoy his slides too, made it easy to study.

I am not a fan of bio classes. But Professor Filice was a great teacher. I learned so much and actually understand the information. The homework was not hard, and the exam was easy if you paid attention in class. The class was fun and an overall great class to take.
The class is so pointless genuinely could not tell you anything I learned and I love zoology. Pre class lectures that were so boring just to do individual assignments in class

Very nice, is really eager to chat with students and help them figure stuff out. If you're coming to MSU for Zoology or FW, this class is not necessary. It is more focused on getting you involved with your major than learning about animal biodiversity.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Lots of helpful practice problems during the class, homework assignments were very relevant to exams, professor took feedback well and was willing to adjust class to make sure all assignments felt useful for students.  Would take again.

This professor is nice, and will answer emails quickly. But, there were several times throughout the semester that he would (in the middle of class) change his slides and change the answers. This was confusing. He also doesn't post the annotated slides online which can be hard to catch up on if you missed class.
A wonderful professor for a class that I was dreading. Explained all concepts clearly and in depth, and spent a lot of time going through practice problems that are very similar to what are on exams.

I have no critiques about the professor himself. However, this class was structured and organized terribly. There are preclass lecture videos which should be what is taught in class instead of doing that weeks assignment. It is almost pointless to show up. The class could be fully online and have the same effect.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Lucinda is AWESOME! But her tests were so HARD. I would go in and nail the review and then I would bomb the tests. The lectures are your classmates teaching you through their presentations. Attendance is not taken but the reflections at the end of the class are graded so if you miss you get a zero, and when those add up it will tank your grade.

I really loved Prof Davenport in the beginning of the semester. Unfortunately, she turned out to be really harsh on me at the end of the semester. Her tests are also really hard and lots of memorization and I found it hard to memorize content when half of it was student-based presentations. She does a nice job on making class interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Davenport was very nice. The class subject is pretty dull; she tries her best to make it fun and interesting. The tests are also very tough, and you have to memorize a lot.

Professor Davenport did a great job making the subject of Journalism history interesting. Every class, she would bring and hand out old books/articles or tools used by journalists and pass them to the students. She provided educational videos and simple but informative lectures that showed just how much passion she has for the subject.

Dr. Davenport is amazing beyond words. SO kind and funny, and always brought in the coolest historical artifacts to share with the class. You have to study a lot, but she is so engaging and charming. Every day we would do a quick reflection for attendance credit. There is one group project, and a couple multiple choice exams.

Professor Davenport was very informative and interesting to listen to, for a class that topics could be dull she did a great job on giving a enthusiastic lecture on the topic. She had a easy course load and reviewed with the exams the class before and the few minutes prior to taking the exam.
She was just there, didn't really help out much. ULAs carried lab hardcore. On occasion, she helped with things and was decent at explaining things.
Overall she was an okay professor. Even when my group was finished early she sometimes made us stay until the end of class which wasn't the greatest.

She was nice and helpful when needed, but overall a poor teacher and grader. Instructions for lab write-ups were inconsistent and scattered, making them hard to follow. She graded everything at the end, so I didn't know I was doing things wrong and got low scores. Group work grading was unfair since everyone shared the same grade.

She was great. She was there to help whenever and was easy to acess during office hours and email! The ULA's do a lot but she is always there making sure they are correct and help out whenever needed. My only complaint is the grades came in very late and sudden at the end of the semester.
Dr. Davis was very kind and she is good at explain where mistakes were made and how to fix them.

Your experience will vary greatly depending on your ULA's and lab partners, but Dr. Davis herself was accessible inside and outside of class which was helpful. Assignments are fairly easy as long as you follow the rubric exactly and communicate with ULA about the exact expectations and what they specifically want to see.

Professor Davis is one of the best lab professors I have had at MSU. She's okay at explaining things and may take a moment to articulate her thoughts but she makes sure you understand what's happening and is willing to help at any point during the lab. Overall, I would highly recommend her to anyone taking this class!

Course is a lab so it will be ran by ULAs. Be hopeful that you have amazing ULAs that you can ask for help with. Dr. Davis would have multiple sections at once & rarely appeared in my section. When she did appear, she asked questions but would make it more confusing. She is such a nice and kind professor although her teaching is another story.

Dr. Davis was a good lab instructor! From what I've heard, most labs are ran by LAs. Although Dr. Davis is present, most instruction will come from the LAs. She always has very accessible office hours and is there to answer questions.

Dr. Davis was not present sometimes but when she was she repeated the same things the LAs went over with us for so long and would cold call students. She wastes time and slows you down a little. I found the lab to overall be fine but due to the LAs for the most part. Wouldn't suggest her unless you have to.

Just like in my previous semester, Dr. Davis was rarely active in the lab. When she was there, my interactions with her were neutral. The difficulty of the lab is based solely on your group and ULA's.

LB155 lab and she was awful! My ULA's were great and led the lab. she was rarely in lab, when she was there she created mass confusion and chaos. The ULA's would tell us how to do something then we would do it, then Davis would come around and tell us it was wrong, but it would be right. Was told by ULA "she doesn't know what shes doing"

It is a lab so it is run by ULA's. As long as you have good ULA's you should be fine. Dr. Davis is barely present as she is in between multiple labs simultaneously. She will pop in randomly and ask tricky questions and get irritated if you don't know the answer. Most of the time Dr. Davis and the ULA's aren't on the same page so its confusing.

It is a lab, so it was mainly up to the ULAs. Mine were fine, but I know plenty people with differing experiences. Dr. Davis likes to sneak up on you while you work, but once you get past that, she's fine. She's helpful where it counts, in my opinion. That said, I probably wouldn't choose her as a lab prof again.

Dr Davis was rarely in the classroom. The ULA's and her did not communicate well between material and what is happening in the class. The lab did not contain a lot of actual experiments. Sometimes when asked what to do Dr Davis and the ULA's gave different answers to what we had to do.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class was pretty awful. My ULA Mithil Penta was just straight up mean, and did not help whatsoever. The ULA's grade and run everything, and they are harsh with it. There is VERY little support from the teaching team let along Dr. Davis herself. It was pretty confusing and overall lots could be done to make the course better.

Beware to never know what you are doing in lab at all times. Me and my group met for our final project that was never explained to us and was due tomorrow. Terrible course and a waste of time and money. If you are being placed into College Algebra or a MTH 103, please just go into trig with chem 1 and lab so can skip whatever this is.

Absolutely terrible prof, taught two sections at once but never came in our secfion. TAs ran the course but told us the wrong information or Dr. Davis would come in and tell us something completely different from what the TAs

This professor is by far the worst professor I think I will ever have, and I am only a first year student. She does not give clear instructions at all, gives students assignments with no clear due date. Do not take this prof. even if you have to, if the class is required you are better off waiting for her to retire. Also she burped in my face.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I rarely see Dr. Davis, but my experiences with her have been average. The problem with this lab is that it all depends on the ULAs you get. Also, the lab feels like you are being dropped into a situation without much help or preparation.

She's really not bad. Doesn't do much, but I think that's true of all chem lab profs. It's really all down to your ULAs. Davis wasn't the most helpful, but she wasn't actively bad, and she was pretty nice.

Chem lab is a disorganized mess no matter who your professor is - I think Saraha gets much better reviews but my friends with Saraha had the same confusing assignments. What really matters is who your ULAs are. Class itself isn't hard, just disorganized.

Professor isn't involved in a lot of the labs, the ULA's mostly run them. The ULA's and professor can sometimes give confusing answers/feedback. Prepare to spend a lot of time outside of class with your lab group to work on assignments. Assignments and content aren't too hard though.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Davis didn't involve herself often. LAs didn't seem to understand Davis's expectations but tried their best regardless. Assignments were sometimes confusing and very hard to find in D2L. Course is organized poorly. Davis answers questions with more questions and is not helpful. Lots of group work, so your group is large factor in your grade.

Barely saw her the whole semester. I got lucky with good LAs and a great group but it's clear that this class would've been much harder without those. Grades and points for the semester are clearly spelled out in the syllabus which I did like. I don't recommend her even though it wasn't bad for me as it's clearly a gamble on other factors.
Get ready to teach yourself literally every thing you need to know to pass.

In this lab, she was not present much, as the ULAs run the labs with her assisting as needed. The lab is just a hard class overall, so she did not necessarily make it more difficult. She always had good input during labs and made sure we were on the right track even though she was not there very often because she was going between the two labs.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Here's the deal, when you take chemistry lab through Lyman Briggs, you will not interact heavily with the professor. Your learning assistants are the people grading your assignments, so you really just want to make a good impression on them. Dr Davis is very nice, but not heavily reachable. Do your work in this class and you will 4.0

Do not take any classes! She is extremely disorganized, doesn't respond to emails, and she will only make you more confused. My entire experience in this class has been terrible the only good thing where the LA's since they were the only helpful part of this class. If you take lab with Davis get prepared  to be stressed out and permanently clueless
She made my day:)

I do not recommend taking this course with her. Everything and I mean EVERYTHING was disorganized. From homework not being posted in time, to typos on tests, to errors on the lectures, you name it. If you email her, you probably will not get a response, just keep that in mind. Several grading mistakes. Hardest class I have taken at LBC.
Dr. Davis is almost always late for class, she hardly gives any instruction for anything, and she is very disorganized.

She was one of the worst professors I've ever had. She didn't update any of the worksheets and so the flash didn't work; the pacing was too fast; she basically didn't teach at all; you are your own teacher, which should never happen in a lab; and to put the nail in the coffin your TAs are your only hope, so pray that you get a good one.

This online lab was awful. You do more work trying to figure out what lab assignments are asking (because of poor wording and various mistakes) than completing the lab itself. Dr. Davis herself is uninterested in the welfare of her students. She provided no instruction the entire semester. Take the normal chemistry lab.

She does care about the students and their grades and stuff, you just have to reach out. A very sweet professor and I think she made the best of the fully online lab. Some modules were hard but if you asked, the prof and the LA's are willing to help however they can.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: You teach yourself everything in this class. EVERYTHING. You want to do well? Get used to putting in 7-10 hours in a one credit class on a weekly basis. And depending on how poorly she paces the course each week, you may find yourself with an upwards of 12+ hours of busywork to do. So yeah, you're in for a treat if you end up with her.

Dr. Davis has good intentions, but failed to deliver on them in any of the time I spent in her class. She is very vague with her instruction and expectations. She has not taught a single thing herself and the entire class is led and taught by the LAs. Do not take LB171 L with her unless you are ready to teach yourself entirely.

Kind person, but she handled this course terribly. The workload is ridiculous, and the instructions on how to complete assignments are vague. To make things worse, none of the material covered in this class will benefit you in LB171 / Chemistry. Expect a lot of situations that make you want to rip your hair out. Pray that you don't get her.

Dr. Davis is a pretty good lab prof. I will say that 171L can be a little overwhelming at first and the profs throw you into it. However, Dr. Davis does care about her students. Be ready to work hard in this class, it is not the easiest. Really make sure you know what you are doing with labs, this gets a better chance for a 4.0.

Dr. Davis herself was a very nice lady, but the class was not up to par. The directions that were given weren't very clear and I had to rely on LAs for help most of time, but even then they too would be confused on what was going on.

Her lectures can be confusing/hard to follow as her english is not amazing. However, she is very kind and wants everyone to do well. Is very helpful in office hours and her exams are fair (and comparatively easy to other briggs exams). If you study, do the homework, and occasionally read the textbook you should be able to handle the class fine.

I do not know how to grade Dr. Davis because she had never stepped foot in the classroom the entire semester. I've met her and she is very kind. The class itself is more work than all of my classes combined. It is very unorganized and the teachers and LA's are very vague on what they expect. A pro is that there is an enormous curve at the end.

This lab was taught by TA's who didn't know what was going on (and the class being at 8am didn't help at all) The few times Dr. Davis did walk in, everyone would go rigid and pretend to do something because she's so intimidating. But if you get to know her, she's super sweet, just really intimidating and never there to help.

The class is taught totally by LAs and the labs are like group projects. I hated lab more than anything and I had a 4.0 in AP Chemistry in high school. The class is a bit of a necessary evil, and Professor Davis responds to emails really quickly if you have questions, but the class is trouble.

Class is taught by LAs. This makes it confusing, because others taking your class, but not in your section will confuse you as to what you need for each class period, lab report, etc. Generally, it was very difficult to figure out what we needed to bring to lab, though the LA and TA worked very hard to try and help us.

Class is taught by LA's instead of professor, which complicates the entire process. Overall, lab reports are daunting and brutal, so is the class. In hindsight, I should have avoided this class, for many reasons.

I urge you not to take this class if you have had difficulty with chemistry in H.S., the understanding partI got an 4.0 in chem. in H.S., and I loved science (I have 2.0 in her class now, maybe I can getr a 2.5..ruined my GPA). I just urge you LBS students to just take the university chemistry class and lab..the labs in 171L are 8-13pages.BE WARNED

The course content is fine he just goes on long lectures that you can barely hear him talk about and is the pickiest grader I have ever had. There will be pop quizzes and the essays are difficult as they are not prompt based. Go to office hours if you can as that helped me. But if you can take the class with someone else. I do not recommend.

Profes

Prof. McAuley was great, and he really worked to make the class material accessible without having to use the textbook (though it was still a useful tool). The TAs were very helpful as well, and if your attendance is consistent, you should do well. Lots of grades based on completion.

He really helped everyone in the class to understand the material as best he could and tried to make the class entertaining. Go to class though because he explains things a lot better than the book does. Great teacher and I loved the hike metaphor!

I liked Professor McAuley! He has a few corny jokes but he really cares about everyone learning the material and succeeding. very fast-paced, 2/3 of ur grade is exams, weekly group problem sets cover short-answer questions - good for understanding the material, but u NEED to practice multiple choice before exams (90% of the points for an exam, answer choices are all the same with one-two words swapped out). textbook not needed but good if u dont like the video lectures

This class was very difficult and the professor did not make it easy to pass, the exams were very heavy material and there was not enough time to study everything in time for an exam, about 200+ vocab and lectures that are about 3 hours long for each week, the lecture videos are pre recorded from 2016 and the professor overall had a negative tone

He focuses way too much on the essay questions; you HAVE to answer it exactly as he formats it and even if you miss the smallest detail you get points off. It makes it hard to learn the actual microbio content. If I wanted to take a writing class I would've.

This class is difficult, Delekta does not really care about student success. The class is structured to be ~60% of the grade for 3 difficult exams that they do not properly prepare you for. They stress CER type responses heavily, but only 10/106 points of the exams are CER. There is way too much information covered in this course.

MMG 301 is a hybrid course and I only saw Dr. Delekta once a week at section meetings. MMG 301 is a tough course, but if you spend time studying you can definitely 4.0 this class. There are a few extra credit opportunities.

Was not very helpful when asking questions. Uses very outdated videos and even mentioned to students that asked that some of the things I these videos were irrelevant to the material on the exams. Most of the lecture videos were not done by delekta, and are VERY outdated. He was kind of rude tbh, even when I asked about exam details like location.

Dr. Delekta's MMG 301 Microbiology course at MSU is fantastic! His lectures are engaging and clear, making complex topics easy to grasp. He's highly supportive and always available for help. The classes are practical and informative. Highly recommend Dr. Delekta for an enriching microbiology experience!

While MMG301 can be challenging, I HIGHLY recommend attending office hours. Dr. Delekta does an exceptional job making sure students understand the material and re-emphasizes important information during office hours, which was the main reason I was able to 4.0 the course.

The first day of class the other professor who ran the course, along with the ULAs and TA, told us that Phillip Delekta makes it borderline impossible to get a 4.0 in the class. The content itself if easy, but he makes it difficult to get anything above a 3.5 on the exams. Very strict professor, so don't expect any leniency. Class average is 3.0.

Dr. Delekta was a great professor for micro. While I will admit I didn't do the best in the class the opportunity to do great is there. Tests and in class work are graded super fairly, with chances to get regrades and partial credit. He is a super caring guy and would even come up to groups such as mine after every exam taken to ask how it was.

The class is easy but Dr. Delekta is not approachable in the slightest and rude towards many students. Seems like he thinks his class is the most important and should be held higher than all others. Many of my friends have had issues with him, and do not ask him to reschedule your exam if it interferes with another- ask the other professor.

I thought Dr. Downs was easy to reach, knowledgeable, and fair. The lectures can be long, but I thought the content was interesting. Attendance matters!

The lectures are very material heavy and not at all interesting. Around 50% of the grade (2 exams and a big group project) was due in the last 3 weeks. He did not evenly spread out the work, and for a 3 credit course, this is too much work. He doesn't give an option to drop the final and demands too much of his students.

To sum this professor up, it is finals week, I have no idea my grade in the class and I can't calculate it because he has around 200 of my points not yet in the grade book and I take his final tomorrow morning. So I could potentially fail the class, but I have no idea because I don't have all my grades in (Theres only 12 assignments all semester.)

reviews.comment: I would strongly think about not taking this professor. Your whole grade is based on how good of a group you got placed in and how well you performed on two quizzes and an exam. It's all case studies and business memos. He will lecture all class but talk in circles. I would not take him.

reviews.comment: This professor is good at explaining content and is always trying to engage with students. Also he did load a lot of work onto students during Thanksgiving

I strongly advise against taking this professor's classes. hands down the nicest professor ive ever had

One of my favorite professors of all time. This was for Com304 and it was super easy. No exams, just short weekly quizzes. He cares so deeply for each of his students. Dr. D is a great guy. Obviously super passionate about what he does and cares deeply about his class. His lectures are pretty entertaining. All of the assignments and papers are extremely easy. The quizzes are based strictly off the textbook which was slightly annoying but whatever. Best Prof Ive ever had by far.

Dr. D was one of the most amazing professors that I have ever had. He cared for all of us so deeply, and gave us lessons far beyond the classroom that will help us succeed in life. I wish I could have him for every class. Just do the work and you'll pass, super easy.
This professor is the GOAT, one of the best in the COM department. Amazing man and great prof.
One of the best professors here at state, he is so caring and such amazing person to speak to on any regard.
most amazing professor ever. He truly cared about each of us and was very accommodating to our schedules and with class work.

He's a very pleasant man who tries to understand the culture of college students to make his lectures relevant. His exams were close-ish to the study guides he gave, but some questions just came out of nowhere. I didn't touch the textbook the whole semester and I did fine.

The assignments are super easy. The tests can be a little weird but if you study you should be fine. You can't skip class, there's no textbook and he doesn't post his lecture slides. The material is also impossible to look up, I'm mildly convinced he just makes up vocab words.

reviews.comment: Hilarious and caring professor. Makes lectures entertaining. Easy assignments every class period for easy points, but if you skip you won't get credit. If you show up to lectures its an easy A. Speeches are all done online through a webcam with 14 other classmates. Speech topics are easy. I recommend this class and professor.

Dr. Donelson is a nice, funny person. Despite her personality, I felt she did not care much about teaching or even holding class. I learned nothing new about content strategy that I hadn't already learning in the core P2W courses. There were several weeks where she didn't hold class to work on our "projects" (simple, highschool level powerpoints).

Dr. Donelson was an amazing teacher for WRA 101. She made the class enjoyable and very obtainable to achieve a 4.0. She made the lectures fun, gave lots of time to do work, and gave good feedback and ability to improve. She's always willing to stay after class and help even for other classes. Outfits were on point, always.
She is a very kind and funny individual who makes class better

Dr. Donelson is an amazing professor. If you stay on top of the work and follow her instructions, you will pass. She makes a real effort to connect with her students and gives honest, helpful feedback that actually helps you improve. She's also super relatable; she talks about her love of hip hop, and her outfits are always on point.

The only good thing about this class was that attendance wasn't mandatory. She was never clear on instructions, and assignment dates. Honestly, this class should've just been an online class because she canceled class so much.
Aggravatingly taught class

Dr. Donelson is a very good professor. I loved her not only did she have an outstanding personality but she taught her class very well. I was surprised now thinking about her rate my professor beforehand but now that i've been through her class she is amazing. She knows holiday's are important so she is very lenient with those days. Very engaging!

Professor Donelson was an outstanding professor who not only helped me become a better writer but also encouraged me to think critically about the world around me. Her clear teaching, constructive feedback, and engaging classroom environment made this course a truly valuable experience.

Dr. Donelson is a great teacher. She sets instructions for spreading out the work load, and is easy to get into contact with after class or in class if you have any questions. She is very caring and has an amazing sense of humor. She cancels classes during the holidays and important week days. I would recommend her to anyone wanting to take WRA101.

Dr. Donelson is a very good professor. She is very easy to get in contact with outside of class, and she lets you know what you have to do to get a good grade, and gives lots of examples on projects, essays, etc. I would definitely recommend her to other people looking to take WRA 101.

reviews.comment: Changed the rules for the essays and assignments throughout the semester. Dr. Donelson is truly a great professor. I am very confused on why so many people do not like her. She makes all the assignments/papers very clear and she is very approachable if you have a question. This professor seems to have clear expectations during class, however when you leave you end up feeling like you have no clue what's going on. This is the worst and most difficult Professor I have ever had. Her directions were extremely vague and confusing, and whenever we asked her questions, she would either not respond or assume we didn't read the directions thoroughly enough. Also, the class is riddled with leftist bias.
Dont take her

she's a really cool person and the recitation were actually fun if you like your TA. assignments were super easy and easy points, and exams were light work as long as you study and go to class/recitaion.

Had her for IAH206 but that isn't an option. She was a great professor, but if you aren't a science major and are just taking her class for a general requirement, you may struggle a bit to keep up. Besides that, her lectures were really entertaining.
She makes the class content digestible for students who are new to the material. Her lectures are always interesting and she has an inspiring passion of caring for the environment
Was not good and was the definition of arrogant

Great professor, wants you to succeed and give you the materials to help you.
Great professor, cares about his students
The Second half of the semester is much heavier than the first. His expectations only get higher as the course continues. He is very kind though and gives helpful feedback.

The group project course is extremely valuable. Professor DeVeaux is always accessible outside of class for extra help. He expects top work but helps you get there. Great professor, truly cares about his students! Learned a lot from him!

reviews.comment: Amazing prof!! genuinely cares about his students
The most genuine professor I have ever had!

MKT 891 Elective Project Course Professor DeVeaux is by far the best professor I have ever had. He has made me a better researcher and better student. Professor DeVeaux is one of the best professors in the MSMR program! Its clear that he is passionate about helping students succeed in MKT 805 and beyond. Easy but she's mean
professor knows the material well, but the course felt more difficult than necessary. I wouldn't choose to take them again.
PR 300, very caring and wants to set up her students for a successful career!
I really enjoyed this class! The professor was incredibly nice, kind, and knowledgeable.

Don't worry about the time slot for the lecture, it's only for half a semester (ends when spring break starts). Bessette actually cares about you and is so funny to listen to. The chillest professor ever.

Dr. Douglas Bessette has been an excellent instructor who brings a wealth of knowledge and passion to his classes, especially in the field of clean energy and sustainability. Hilarious, knowledgeable, approachable, entertaining.

reviews.comment: Super great guy to learn from, and really relaxed class setting. Definitely a higher level class, just in structure and content

Dr Bessette is the best professor I have ever taken a class with here at MSU. Dr Bessette has a clear passion for what he teaches and he really does not care about your grades, only that you engage with the material and try. His lectures are fun and I enjoyed going to his class each week. Plus, he gives you a cheat sheet for the exams.

He was such a great prof! Material was relatively easy to get through, the assignments were easy as well. Wasn't too harsh of a grader as long as you did the assignments correctly. I really enjoyed the topic of this class, partially because Professor Bessette made it interesting, and I know other students in the course feel the same.

Real cool teacher. Lots of papers due on Friday nights. Grading is weird, not very clear on certain aspects of writing them. Otherwise a cool guy, makes class as interesting as possible. I would take another one of his classes.

reviews.comment: I have never felt such hatred for a professor like I do him.

Even though Steve draggo wasn't a bad professor due to teaching the material exceptionally well and showing his good attitude and leniency of extending the deadlines for the webwork problems he gave me an ADR because of policy violations in calc 3 final not in midterm exams, even when he tries to be lenient

He has a kind attitude, and his lectures are easy to follow. He records the lectures too, which is a plus. As for the course itself, it's easy as long as you put in a decent amount of effort and manage your time well. For the webwork, make sure to use your achievement items!!

Prof.Draggoo is like one of the best professor i ever had in college. His teaching style made calc really easy to understand. Webworks are kinda difficult. But exams are easier. If you study base on exam review, it will be fine.

I normally hate math, but Professor Draggoo made it so much more accessible and fun. It seems like he genuinely cares about his students and is willing to go the extra mile to help you learn the material. He's an easy grader and lets you know exactly what is going to be on quizzes and tests. If you can get him for a class, do it.

Very sweet, and a silly personality, I really needed a professor like this. I appreciate how his personality helped motivate me to come to class, if anyone takes any class with him, try matching his energy with the course and take in mind how he explains his applications of the math to real world calculations.
He's funny and sweet, he motivated me to come to class, I appreciate him a lot.

Prof. Draggoo is a very funny and caring professor. I was initially nervous about the class since I hadn't taken Calc 3 before and knew it had a reputation for being very difficult. But the way he taught simplified complicated math concepts helped me actually understand calculus. I highly recommend going to his office hours—they're a huge help!
Steve was great and funny! Very chill and helpful; he wants you to do well in the class. He goes through the notes kinda fast sometimes. Can drop 2 quizzes and 1 test, and some may be open note.
very good professor he is so funny and nice and he is very clear on what we are going to be tested on so it's really easy to prepare. He gives lots of resources and ample opportunity to succeed.

He is soooooooo nice!! Very understanding and kind, his class was not very hard and everything was explained well in lecture and if you missed lecture you could join on zoom. If you can, take this goy steve is epic
Steve is a great teacher—he's funny, cares about his students, and always takes the time to help anyone who asks.

Steve Draggoo is a awesome Professor, I always struggled in math but he was the first professor that i was able to learn easily from and feel stress free throughout the course, He offers a online lecture so you dont have to worry about being in person or missing class and is hilarious and caring to all his students.
Very caring professor with great lecture videos. If it wasn't for the great videos I wouldn't have gotten an A. I think the exams were very fair.

He is so funny and nice, and he is very clear on what we are going to be tested on so it's really easy to prepare. He gives lots of resources and ample opportunity to succeed. You can tell he genuinely cares and wants to see you do well.

Steve is an American hero, if you have to take a math class and he teaches that specific class, take him. Best Prof I have ever had, if you pay attention in class you will get an easy 4.0. Is willing to help you out with grade as well, bro is the LeBron of Professors.

PLS TAKE DRAGGOO'S CLASS - best mth103 experience ever. so beyond easy and lots of extra credit, extra homework attempts, and dropped quizzes/exams. he is the best and my favorite professor i've ever had.
Take Steve he is the best teacher he is very chill and wants students to succeed.

He's a great person, you can tell he enjoys his job. I've always struggled with math and maybe it was just me but his class was very fast-paced and the only grades are webwork and quizzes weekly + exams.

Online MTH 234 was such a pain. In lectures, the most basic fundamentals of each topic are explained. However, this leaves the student at a complete loss for the homework as they include difficult questions that the student could never begin to know how to do without exterior knowledge.The quizzes are hard and limited time (initially 10 min now 20)

Steve was really laidback and is overall really sweet. If anyone was unsure of how he got to a certain part of a problem, he always explained it with no judgment. Overall, I would recommend him to anyone. His teaching style is to go through example problems and explain what he is doing at each step.

I really liked him. His class was much easier for me than any math class I've taken in the past and he's very understanding. When I took the class, you didn't have to show up to either lecture or recitation, but you could always get two points extra for taking the quiz during recitation. He was always giving extra credit and I really liked him.

I took online, the lectures were a bit hard to follow at some points so I often would look up the topics on youtube to get a better understanding. Other than that, Prof Draggoo is a great professor who keeps a positive vibe in class and cares for his students. Exams always were way easier than I thought (I got an A on almost all of them)!

I had Prof Draggoo for MTH 234. He did an awesome job. He does a great job of teaching the material, gets back to students quickly, is lenient/understanding but also fair. Multivariable calculus is difficult to some extent but he gives you everything you need to pass the class. If I had been more disciplined with my webwork I easily would have 4.0

reviews.comment: Quizzes and tests are pretty lenient which is nice. The worst part is the lectures, a lot of the videos have very roundabout or cryptic explanations which waste a lot of time. Many webwork problems are not covered in the lectures which make doing the HW very, VERY frustrating. They arent think outside the box problems, it just wasn't taught at all.

Dr. Draggoo is great! I had him asynchronous so I barely even saw his face and I never contacted him. He wanted to make this class as laid back as possible and it really was. Coming out of mth 103 with another professor to mth 114 with him was a breath for fresh air. TAKE A CLASS WITH DR. DRAGGOO!!!

He is a really nice guy and tries to make the class enjoyable, but his teaching style isn't the best if you aren't familiar with a lot of the stuff. The one shining beacon out of the dumpster fire that was the team behind the MTH 234 course. I stopped attending my online lectures and just used his videos which were ten times better, this is the name that got me through Calc 3.

I was in the online async class so we had pre recorded lecture videos. These videos usually werent too long and Draggoo made them very straightforward and informative. There were a few times the lecture videos didnt cover all the homework but Draggoo was easy to access on Piazza.

I had Steve for math 103 last semester and he was a great teacher. I will say sometimes, he skips steps in problems, but if you mention it he will go back.

He takes a lot of time making his colorful videos and I don't think a lot of students appreciated that. A few times the homework would be on a related topic but he never showed how to solve a problem of its likeness, but this is a good thing. Steve carried all of the MTH234 sections, even though he only taught some of them. He's super smart, good at answering questions with thorough explanations, and even funny sometimes.

reviews.comment: Recorded online lectures for asynchronous. Helped whenever I needed it, and makes great review videos.

Hes a good professor. He pre recorded all his lectures, during the pandemic at least, and you didnt have to go to the scheduled time to meet. If you went to the class times you could ask him any questions from homework or from notes and he would go over the question for you I essentially give you the answer.

I took MTH 114 Trigonometry with Professor Draggo this semester online and the class was great. honestly he's a very laid back professor. the class has a very manageable work load that doesn't become overwhelming. sometimes he does skip steps while teaching so if you're not the best at math and need a in depth explanation it could be confusing .
Great professor who made a manageable schedule during COVID. Would definitely recommend Draggoo!

Probably the worst math professor I've ever had. Our quizzes were due and graded before homework for the same quiz were due. In his lectures he goes over very little of the work and leaves you with little to learn. He speaks on the work like you're suppose to have already mastered the subject, so if you don't everything you're screwed.

Steve is a great prof. I had him for MTH103 and 114 during my freshman year and received and A in both courses. Draggoo has no participation whatsoever. Does not thoroughly explain problems, just simply does them on the board. He is often corrected by his own students. This class should not be as hard as it is. All he does is solve problems from his notes on the board. There is no participation in class which makes it really hard to know how to do the work. TA is the worst. Asked her a Q & she said she didn't want to help bc she didn't want to say something wrong. Doesnt know what shes doing but makes the tests.

Very kind, responsive, and accommodating with late work. Assignment directions are very unclelar. His class is very confusing.I dont reccomend.

I would try to get out of this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I did bad on a lot of his quizzes because the questions and answers are highly subjective rather than factual. The final assignment is a 20 minute presentation or a 2000 word essay. This is not honors college. No hate to the teacher; I can tell he put a lot into making the class what it is, but we're undergrads, not experts in this field like him.

He seems like a nice guy who cares about his students. It is just an impressive amount of work for a general elective class that most people take to check off a box. Lots of readings and quizzes that are hard to understand wording, he is very critical with feedback as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: His course is way too much work for a pointless elective class. Can be a smart aleck when leaving comments on your work and is very belittling.

I am sure he is a nice guy but for a basic IAH class I was taking as an elective it was an unnecessary amount of work. He also leaves comments on work that are very unsupportive and it seems like unless you put insane amounts of effort into this course you are doomed to fail.

There is a fairly heavy amount of workload and reading expected each week but he will grade most of your assignments based on effort, so if you do the reading and your work you will do fine. However, the reading quizzes are unnecessarily difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor McCullough was my favorite professor this semester, while it was a requirement for my degree I learned a lot of useful information I will use as an adult.  Yor are graded by effort, so all these people who gave him negative reviews probably didn't do all the reading outside of class....which is a lot but college is literally all reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Tough grader, along with a tough final project and pointless readings.

Do not take his IAH 209 class unless you like reading pointless information that is very difficult to understand, enjoy getting feedback that makes your self-esteem tank into the ground, and love being graded like you are in medical school trying to become a doctor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This was my favorite class this semester. While you have a lot of reading, the assignments are easy. You can email at any hour of the day, and have a response in a short amount of time. Always willing to help, give feedback, and is super understanding. Due dates are not a suggestion, but there is wiggle room for them.

The professor is a really engaging and thoughtful instructor who makes cultural heritage interesting and easy to understand. He explains concepts clearly and encourages open discussion, which makes it easier to connect with the material. Overall, he is approachable, supportive, and genuinely invested in his students' learning.
Prof. Draper could take on a pure blooded viltrumite easily

Great teacher, it starts off easy like every essay class and then snowballs near the end.  I learned a lot and he asked questions which makes you think critically.  The class is relevant today and allows you to learn about something in-depth.

I personally didn't like him. At first I thought that he was going to be good, but after a while if he doesn't agree with what you're writing about, or your personal beliefs, he will give you an awful grade. But overall, if you're not aiming for a 4.0, he'd be a good teacher.
He is easy to understand and keeps everyone stress free. He is an organic teacher and goes with the needs of the class. :) I enjoyed the class
LOVE HIM!!!!!!!!
Amazing Man

Amazing teacher! Very down to earth and funny. All the writing assignments were about topics we could make our own. He encourages you to write in your own style. Great feedback on papers. Somehow got our class to interact and have actual discussions. Final project was an amazing experience. By far the best teacher I've had yet.
very very easy 4.0. I took him for my ISB and ISP. Just have to attend class to write your name on the sheets and turn in homework. Very easy grader and cancelled class often
The class is extremely easy taken with him, and he is a very nice guy.

This class was only one day in person, and we had a short assignment due once a week to make up for the second class day. All of the work in this class was very easy, and exams were as well. Prof was very friendly and helpful, easy 4.0

This class is very easy to follow. Don't skip because you need to do the group work each week and get the points. Homework is very easy while I learned about climate change and planets. He's a very nice Prof, and  interacts with the class! Would take again! Easy 4.0!

Absolutely loved Dr. Bob. He was very interested in what he was teaching which made the class more engaging. You have a group assignment at the end of every class that counts for your attendance. Couple of big milestones which are easy and all exams are online. Def take Dr. Bob for your ISP.

Very easy class, the assignments are not hard if you just put in a little effort. The d2l page can be a little confusing to navigate and there's not really any communication about what the asynchronous assignments are but just make sure you stay on top of stuff and look ahead and you'll be fine.
Easiest class I have ever taken! Like easy assignments and easy test. If you put in any effort you will get a 4.0.

this prof knows that the class is almost all freshman/sophomores fulfilling their isp. you don't have to do anything in class, which was hybrid for me. all u had to do was the online assignment (took 5 min) on monday and the exams were all online. he didn't answer emails but that's understandable for this class. good class to fulfill ur credit

He's a super easygoing teacher, and the class is easy too. In class, you just do a few questions with your table group, write them down, and turn them in for attendance points. There's one easy async assignment each week, one simple project, and online exams.

He deserves this high rating. Lectures are easy. Your attendance is based on a quick group work assignment, which normally takes about 10-15 minutes. You have a couple big assignments but nothing I lost sleep over, very easy.
The nicest professor at MSU. I've never seen someone ranked so high but he deserves it he's amazing.

Excellent professor. Very flexible if you communicate well, offers ample extra credit, and gives leeway for unforeseen circumstances. If you put in the bare minimum effort, you will 4 point this class. Highly recommend taking him, and will definitely be looking at more classes I can take with him in the future.

Excellent professor. Gives a lot of leeway if you communicate effectively, offers ample extra credit, and shows a lot of understanding for unforeseen circumstances. If you put in the bare minimum effort, you will 4 point this class. Highly recommend taking him, and I definitely will be looking into classes to take with him in the future.

This class was mostly hybrid, but it was super easy to get a 4.0. This class was absolutely the easiest class at MSU. Dr. Bob was great, not only was the material pretty interesting, your graded basically on completion. The in class assignments are super fun and the exams are open note and super easy. Overall, this class is a very easy gen-ed!
love love love dr bob, so sweet and the workload is so light and exams are easy. take him easy A
Dr. Bob is an awesome professor. He's a super nice guy and I would recommend taking this class if you are required too.

If you want to finish the uni requirements without stress TAKE THIS CLASS. Professor's awesome, not only does he teach well, his homework assignments aren't overwhelming. We did small in group assignments in class. There were also essay-like writing assignments that had clear instructions. Easy A trusttttt

Great class, every assignment is easy and i'm so happy I took this class. The only con was the fact that he doesn't respond to emails and some of the assignments on d2l aren't accurate as he does not do some of them anymore... BUT still a great and easy class.

Probably the best class ive taken so far at msu. He clearly cares about teaching and makes it very easy to pass. Class is once a week and barley mandatory, but there's short in class group participation assignments so you will miss out on those points if you skip. Lots of extra credit opportunities to make them up. Easiest final ever

Literally the best professor I have ever had in my entire life, he is so chill and nice and responds to emails super fast. Cares for his students and has the easiest class I have ever taken. Easier than a middle school class, little work load and all exams online. The best class ever, highly reccomend.

I also took ISB 200 with him; the main assignments were the same. TA put additional assignments up but most didn't end up being required. He's a very easy grader, plus exams are online and very easy. He's a great prof and ideal if you need basic ISB/ISP credits but will still learn. Lectures are technically required but not super necessary.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easiest class i have ever taken. You do need to go to class because of participation, but the class is usually under 30 minutes and tests are ridiculously easy. He knows this is a Gen Ed so it is a very easy class. One thing is that you need to check your email on D2L, as that's how he communicates.

Don't expect assignment due dates to be accurate in D2L, we didn't know when we were in person/online or what was due when. Not to mention his and his TA's inability to communicate. Assignments are easy, exams are beyond easy. Just don't count on ever knowing what is due that week until he finally decides to communicate. Easy but frustrating A.
Dr. Bob was epic, and a very easy grader. He knows this is a Gen Ed, and wants his students to succeed so he actually helps you out. Would take again.

Emailed Dr. Drost in a panic because I unwillingly had to drop one of my other classes, making me a part-time student and at risk for losing thousands of dollars in scholarships. Dr. Drost let me into the class a month after it started and made sure to help me catch up. That alone makes him the most caring professor I've ever had. Easy class too.

Had him for both ISB200 and ISP203B, easiest classes I've taken at MSU ever. Do keep in mind that TAs are the ones grading the work + attendance matters (missing few attendances can drop your grades easily). Besides that, the classes end early and half the time it's zoom classes. Would highly recommend.

Dr.Bob is very chill, makes an easy class. Have to show up for lectures for group work and attendance/participation credit, but if you do, you will pass no problem. The quizzes are online and easy if you have the slides and pay attention. Assignments are cumulative over the semester to one big final project but are easy and graded very nicely.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Such a nice guy and understands that everyone is taking this class because it's a requirement, not because they want to. Each class has one group assignment that is used for points and attendance so go to class but it's supposed to be over an hour and I was never there for longer than 25 minutes. Exams are all online and no lockdown browser...

Prof. Drost made this prereq class very easy to pass, and kept the homework (if any) very minimal and to the point. Attendance wasn't required, but points were taken if you attended class. No textbook either. Hands down best professor I've had this year!

Dr. Bob was literally the easiest professor and class ever. There is usually some sort of group assignment that needs to be completed for a grade every class so attendance is really important. It claims to be an hour and 20 minute class, but on average we were never in there longer than 40 minutes.

Dr. Bob was one of the best professors I have ever taken at MSU. He makes a prereq that isn't meant to be difficult but incredibly easy but still fun and informational. If you ever get the chance to take him for your ISP or ISB I would highly recommend.

If you need a super easy ISB class, this is the one! Dr. Bob is a super great professor and doesnt make the material difficult at all! Very easy to understand and a 4.0 is VERY attainable! Majority of grading is the individual milestone projects which take up to 2 hours to complete at most. Loved this class!

If you are looking for an ISB credit, take this class. He is an amazing professor, he makes the class so easy for students. His exams are so easy you are basically guaranteed 100%, most assignments are super short and so easy you get 100%, you also often don't meet on Mondays despite it being a class time + multiple extra credit opportunities.

Dr. Bob is amazing, his lectures are fun and class activities are not unusual when he holds in-person classes. Lots of extra credit opportunities and the TAs were super chill. Super recommended if you need to take an ISP for class/major credit.
If you go to class, you will get an A. Vey nice guy, he makes things easy to understand and assessments are a cake-walk.

Quite literally the easiest class you will ever take. Prof Drost was the most laid back guy ever, the exams are all common knowledge (and online), ULAs are very helpful, I highly recommend this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Love Dr.Bob! Such a chill guy, he understands the people in class are not science majors so he is much more relaxed than other "university required" profs. We never went over 20 minutes, whether that be on the zooms or in person. And the exams are super easy as well.

easy 4.0 definitely take him for any class that you possibly can. The Zoom class was often canceled and in person never lasted past half an hour. gradin was clear and assignments were easy. exams were all found online

Easy. Class is scheduled for an 1hr 20m but only goes for about 20 minutes each day. Zoom on Mondays so makes the week easy. He understands that the people taking this course are not science majors so the material is nothing crazy and his assignments are very easy, only take about 10 minutes, projects took me 30.
