There is iClicker and a quiz every week, you must go to class and take notes. All quizzes are lecture based, and exams will have textbook questions too. The questions can be confusing, and in class he can ramble, so try to pay attention, but overall he is a very good teacher.

Hussain is passionate and tells great stories, but his quizzes and exams can be confusing, with repeated or random questions. Some content on quizzes and exams aren't covered in lectures or assignments, making prep difficult. Reading the textbook is highly recommended (quizzes don't test textbook chapters but exams do)

The class was structured in a way where it was easy to succeed. Lots of note taking but he uploads the slides to D2L. All quizzes (usually every other week) and exams are open note open book. He doesn't hesitate to crack a joke or a tell a good story! Highly recommend for your ISS credit and would take a class of his again.
The class is easy ash but so boring
he's a nice guy but his lectures are so monotonous and repetitive. everything is on quizlet too

Hussain was great overall. The lectures, while long and a bit boring, were engaging. The class includes weekly quizzes and four exams. Hussain does have a thick accent, which can sometimes make him difficult to understand. 
Advice: Take detailed notes on everything, even things that seem insignificant—they often come up again later.

This class was very lecture and quiz/test heavy. If you attend the lectures and go to the study sessions this class will be easy. It is unnecessary to buy the textbooks. This class was super informative though.

Nice, funny professor who is clearly passionate about his job. Hard to pay attention because you're sitting in the same spot for two hours straight. Relatively easy assessments and easy to understand concepts. Class is heavily graded on assessments, so if you do bad on quizzes your grade goes down pretty badly.

I absolutely LOVED Dr. Hussain! You have to take notes on his stories, but they are relevant to what we are covering and they are entertaining. You have to take a lot of notes, but only the quizzes we do once a week are graded. The only reason I didn't get an A in his class was because I got sick and missed some of his lectures.

Professor Hussain loves what he teaches and you can clearly tell. All exams and quizzes are open note and done in class(pretty easy if you take notes). There are textbook questions of exams but he does a textbook review lecture and gives the answers essentially. The class is almost 2 hours but he gives a half way break and most days he ends early.

I loved this class. Very interesting topics discussed, and it's clear that the professor loves his job. Quizzes and tests were open note, but some questions were on Dr. Hussain's personal stories, so make sure to write those down. Although the books are required, I just went to the study sessions offered by one of the TAs instead.

if u use quizlet, this class requires 0 work. every quiz/exam open note with almost every question on quizlet. if u actually try, all of the info u need is in his lectures. pay attention to his stories, they will be on the tests. i never read a page of the textbook. the class is boring but he's a very engaging speaker with interesting stories.

Fairly difficult class, but the professor gives great insight on various global topics and has very nuanced views on complex subjects that he explains pretty well. This class is definitely worth taking for anyone who wants to be more knowledgeable about the world around them.

A LOT OF MATERIAL. Went over 2 textbooks and roughly 20 chapters of content. Engaging and humorous personality despite the long lectures. Lots of quizzes for attendance, Chapters, and exams. Content focused class.

Professor Hussain's class is engaging, with weekly quizzes and helpful study sessions. While the lectures can drag at times, he keeps things interesting with his stories. unstuck study was a lifesaver for exam prep.
LOVE HIM! he yaps alot which is okay but the only annoying thing is he uses personal stories in his quizzes/exams but overall hes chill.
The class is pretty easy but superrrrr boring bro is a certified yapper. The quizzes are pretty easy since he includes his personally stories so make sure you're paying attention.

I felt like he always enjoyed teaching!  The course is very lecture heavy, so taking detailed notes is best. He uses a lot of examples and stories in his exams/quizzes, so make sure you're always paying attention bc it may not be in the slides!!! very funny guy very passionate about the subjects, awesome 10/10

super long and boring lectures. his lectures are based on his life examples. other than that u can always reach out, he doesnt take long to respond. no assignments or hw for credit. just quizzes attendance and exams. a 4.0 is easily achieveable

This is the most boring class I have ever taken. He'll be talking about the lecture slide, and then all of a sudden he's on a 30 minute tangent about whatever, and then that story he took 30 minutes to explain will be on the quiz/exam. The only good thing is the no lockdown browser from quizzes or exams. But this class is so boring

Hussein is a great professor. The lectures can be pretty long and boring, but that's not his fault that's just the way ISS classes are structured. You can 3.0-3.5 the class with quizlet, but sometimes quizlet is wrong and can f you over. So pay attention a little in lectures so you know at least a little about the material and go to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Pretty easy class everything on quizlet.  Professor is a raging liberal and spends the each lecture shitting on America.  Very painful to sit through everything you learn is complete bs and just his opinion that he forces on his students.

He was great! If you get a 4.0 there is an opportunity to work for him if it is open, thats what I've been doing for the past three semesters. Really cool. He's funny and most of what you need to know are in the lectures. Quizzes every week and four exams but one of them gets dropped. Make use of the PAL study sessions they're helpful.

Extremely easy class. There are weekly quizzes, but all the answers are on quizlet. Exams are super easy too and he dosent use any lockdown browser. His lectures are a little boring at times, but he tries to keep everyone engaged and he tells some pretty interesting stories. He's also one of the funniest and nicest professors.

While this class had a lot of reading, it wasn't necessarily difficult. Lots of bad grades I heard in this class resulted from lack of participation. Professor Hussain is a good guy with at times funny points in his lectures. Regardless of the lots of reading, he made the class very enjoyable. There also isn't a lot of homework!

Open notes on all quizzes and exams. This professor offers .5 extra credit, so if you had a 3.5, your GPA could go to a 4.0. The extra credit is volunteering, which was very easy and I did not need it anyway, but it was nice to have in case I did. Lectures can feel long sometimes, but go as he tells stories that are on the quizzes and exams.
Amazingly passionate professor! Learned alot, and be sure to start reading both textbooks early.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class ruined my 4.0 GPA. I do better in classes that are exceptionally harder in content and I think this is because I very much dislike the way this class is set up. I bombed the first quiz because I focused on conceptual aspects of the content but he gives questions that are extremely specific to personal stories he tells. No quiz drops

final exam is cumulative=30%, first three exams=20%, you're able to drop one of the first three exams. Throughout this class I had an A, up until the final exam which you are unable to drop, this class is very quiz and exam-heavy. The professor is very snappy, and responds to any type of questioning as if you're threatening his authority.
Very nice man, lectures you on everything you need to know, without tricks. As long as you go to the class you will easily pass with an A
Lectures are very interesting and apply to the world around us
Awesome class. Easy and a lot of the content is accessible on quizlet, etc. As long as you study a little you should be fine.

Absolutely terrible. Lectures are extremely boring and he rambles about things barely related to the lesson for the entire 2 hour class. On a good day we're lucky to make it through 5 slides. I feel that I could easily teach the class and provide a far more insightful lecture in 30 minutes than he does in 2 hours.

He was funny at times, but overall this class is insanely boring and lecture heavy. He was difficult to understand, and the quizzes and exams had weirdly worded questions. Pay attention to the videos and personal stories, and take detailed notes.
Good Orator and makes the class laugh a few times per lecutre but it is a lot of lecutring.

Everything you're graded on (besides iClicker) is quizzes and exams. All of the tests featured questions that were misspelled or kind of unclear which made it hard to know what the answers were especially since you couldn't see the test problems afterwards. Funny lectures but bad tests and he said future classes won't have take home tests

Really funny guy, tests aren't overly hard. Lectures can be unbearable at times, they can also be entertaining. Pay attention to his personal stories. My biggest issue with this prof is that there are several things he taught that had no reliable source. Things that seem interesting, google in class to cross check validity and they often are false.

Hussain was a nice enough guy but this class was borderline unbearable. The lectures were so long and incredibly boring. Quizzes often tested how well you were paying attention, instead of how well you know the content. Everything was open book, though, so if you take good notes the class is extremely easy.

Hussain was very knowledgable about what he taught as well as a funny prof making the lectures more interesting. Attendance is mandatory and important. Quizzes weekly and 4 exams over the course of the entire semester. There was a bunch of content, definitely wouldn't say it's the the easiest class. If you pay attention you should slide by.

Dr. Hussain is so funny and can always make me laugh during his lectures. Taking notes at his lectures are a must! Quizzes once a week but online and can be taken any time of the day just like the exams. He does have questions based on his personal stories so definitely take notes during those.

Was not a fan of Prof. Hussain. His lectures were long and quite boring and he very often injected his own biases (albeit admittedly). My biggest pet peeve however, was his quizzes and exams often featured questions that were not covered in class or the textbooks. Easy class, lacking prof
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: To succeed in this class you must attend lectures and take detailed notes.  But as long as you have good notes and pay attention, quizzes and exams are open note and straight forward.  He is very passionate about his work and shares many interesting stories.  The lectures are long but you get a break and he keeps you engaged.

I will always remember Dr. Hussain. I was always super excited to go to his class. His lectures are amazing and he is so inspirational. All quizzes and tests are online and you can find a million quizlets for this specific course. The grading and everything is super clear and he is very flexible on due dates and stuff if you just talk to him.

If you are looking for somewhat-easy class with occasional entertaining lectures, I recommend taking his class. He checks up on us after our breaks in between the lecture and has interesting stories to tell. He has open note online quizzes and exams which aren't horrible. Make sure you attend every lecture and do the reading and assignments

Such a fun professor! All of the content and his stories were very interesting. Took his course last year and genuinely enjoyed it. All of the quizzes are online and you can take them at any time. Pay attention to the readings and his stories, but the lectures are interesting!!

The lectures are incredibly long and boring. The professor often talks too fast for me to get all my notes down and I end up missing information because of it. The workload in this class is very small but your grades depend only on your tests and quizzes which can be difficult because he tends to phrase questions weirdly.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Hussain is so sweet! The class is very easy as he posts all the lectures online, and there is one quiz a week. There is no homework for the class besides one (non graded) assignment per test. As long as you watch the lectures, the class is an easy 4.0

I personally found this course to be a time waster. The lectures were almost two hours long, twice a week, and they would just drag on and you didn't get much out of them, especially since everything was posted online anyways. There was basically no point in attending lecture. The class itself is easy, but I wouldn't recommend going to the lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: If he tells you to buy a book, don't. He is a super nice guy and all you had to do was watch an online lecture and take a quiz. There were about 4 exams that were all super easy and the lowest gets dropped. Very easy class and I recommend if you are just trying to get your ISS credits out of the way.

I love Professor Hussain. He is so sweet and his lectures are really interesting. His quizzes and exams are fairly easy but make sure you read the books because there are several questions on the exams regarding book questions. I'm taking ISS315 with him over the summer and I'm very excited to have him again!
Not perfect, but I really liked him. Quizzes and exams are open note  although sometimes the questions are a bit confusing. You can get a lot of extra credit if you volunteer.

Fayyaz is the best professor at MSU. If you have to take ISS freshman year, do anything you can to take it with him. He actually makes the lectures interesting and has a good sense of humor. He also takes time every lectures to give the class a break and asks how everyone is doing. This is one of few professors that actually wants you to succeed.

Dr. Hussain does a good job of keeping lectures fun and engaging. The only downside is he lets his political bias affect the class. As long as you show up to class and pay some attention to the basics it is very easy to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: I love this man. He is so fun to listen to and his course work is really easy. If you ever have questions, his TA's as well as him are always willing to help. My one advice is to take notes in this class as he does tell stories that are mentioned in his quizzes. Again, 15/10 teacher. Lotsa love for daddy Fayyaz

I loved him. I took his class online, so I dont know him in the classroom but basically we just had a lecture and quiz each week. He gave all the questions before each quiz and the class was overall easy. Theres a book but its easy to get a 4.0 without reading. Would highly recommend doing the service learning for extra credit, I learned a lot.

Prof. Hussain is literally the most iconic professor! He is so funny with his sassy remarks he doesn't like it when you have your phone out (like any professor), but he's incredibly kind when he tells you to put it away. This class was interesting, and I'm not usually a "school person" but I loved this class! use color pens to take notes, it helps!

Awful class, do not recommend. Lectures were 2 hours long twice a week due to his constant rambling. Course material was heavily swayed by his political views and he often said very offensive things. No homework points, only quizzes once a week and exams which made my grade suffer.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Fayyaz Hussain is hilarious, though his lectures are long and just general information he's so funny that I like the class. You can get away with not reading the textbook but it definitely helps! No HW just quizzes and exams which are usually straight forward.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Hussain is one of the best profs I have ever had. He truly goes above and beyond for his students and always checks in on how we are doing. He mentioned during the very first lecture that he wanted to do everything in his power to ensure that we all got good grades, and he delivered! The class was super easy and lectures were optional but fun!

It is very easy to see where he stands on the issues presented in class and that is how he teaches unfortunately. Lectures are often 3 hours long and you have to download the power points and when you do not have the best wifi that often takes as long as the lectures. The exam review session are a waste of time, and he does not answer questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr Hussain seemed like a really good teacher, but his covid classes weren't it. The lectures are 1 - 3 hours long (usually around 2:15) and you can't skim as you are tested on his life stories and his examples. The class itself isn't too difficult but the test and quizzes were. If you take this class be ready for lots of notes and listening.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This may have been the absolute hardest class and prof ever
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very nice, stopped during his lectures to ask us how we were doing.

Dr. Hussain is a great professor. Yeah, he can yell at people but that's only if you are late to class and walk in or have airpods in during lecture. During COVID-19, he expressed his love for us and has great lectures overall. He DOES have a thick accent but just listen carefully and attend every class. I ended up witha 4.0, do the extra credit!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Hussain's class is lecture-heavy but he does a very good job of getting the point across. Quizzes are often but if you pay attention and take notes then you will be fine. He really does care for and set his students up for success but if you don't respect him (like being on your phone or sleeping) then he'll call you out and tell you to leave.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: This is the first class I legit cried in. It was so hard. There are tests every week, attendance daily, and so much stuff gets covered. You can definitely pass as long as you put in the work and go to the TA's study sessions. But you may cry. Hussain has a sense of humor so at least there's that.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Genuinely cares for each student as the class is designed for everyone to 4.0. Weekly iClicker quizzes that are based off previous lectures. He goes over exact topics on what to study for exams and lowest exam grade is dropped. Final exam questions compiled from previous ones. Highly recommend taking him. Stories are inspirational and he's funny.

I love this class!!! He talks about important topics and really opens your eyes to different issues going on around you. His lectures are really interesting and he uses stories to connect them to his points. As long as you pay attention in class and remember the stories, you'll pass the class. He can be strict about sleeping and being on your phone

I LOVE THIS GUY!! His lectures are very interesting and fun! I also love his signature phrases like "oh my gahhhd" and "literally speaking" Also makes my day when I see him at the Brody caf like every day! Such a nice professor, but do not fall asleep in his class, he'll call u out personally

Hes great. If you arent mature enough for the lectures he has then simply dont take this ISS. Take the one about being a happy person all the time or whatever it is. It may seem like a depressing class, but hes here to tell you the truth and to burst your bubble. If you cant handle that, then thats your own problem.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Respected

reviews.comment: lectures are extremely boring and sometimes it is hard to understand what he is saying. most lectures he says the same stories over and over again.

I really enjoyed this class. I learned a lot. I know a lot of people complain about him but honestly if you do your work you should be fine. I did as much as the reading as I could and looked through his lectures and was able to get a 4.0 without too much trouble. If you try, youll be fine.
All you do is sit through lecture three days a week, BUT Hussain's stories are absolutely amazing.

he should have a higher rating. one of the best teachers ive had so far. the lectures are boring but makes them fun w jokes. quizzes weekly & attendance daily. exams are exactly the questions from his weekly quizzes. study & youll be fine. clear questions. will call you out if sleeping or on phone. id take this class again. taking him for 315!

This is a lecture class, so he lectures the entire time which actually isn't terrible because he makes the lectures easy to follow and they aren't too terribly boring. Just make sure you go to class, take notes, and definitely listen carefully to his stories. As long as you're present and attentive for his classes you shouldn't have an issue.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hussain thinks he is some type of messiah who is enlightening everyone in the class with stats and news that the average person already knew about years ago. He's also one of the most long winded professors I've ever had, and his lectures can get SO boring because he talks about the same points over and over again. This class needs to revamped asap
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: It is clear what his perspectives are on the political spectrum and he teaches based off fact and bias. It is hard to listen to a biased lecture for an hour and 20 minutes and not fact check everything he says. He gives very common knowledge and statistics and very rarely goes into interesting detail or unknown examples. Professor could learn more.

He is a great and funny professor but you have to go to class and actually pay attention because he gives out a good amount of quizzes and he also will have questions on his tests about the stories he tells in class. I did not buy the book or read because if you go to lecture you and pretty much already know/guess what the answer is.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dont need the books at all, quizzes or attendance taken every class
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Hussain is not the nicest person, but the class was fine. I ended up with a 3.0 and did not mind going to the class. Attendance is mandatory. Quizzes are easy but tests are much harder. Had a 3.5 going into the final and ended up with a 3.0. Overall, not a bad class.

Seems strict at the beginning but is actually a pretty cool professor. Most of the questions are very straightforward and he gives you everything you need to know before the exam. The iClicker exams are almost every week but are very easy if you attend the lecture. If you pay attention in class and listen to his stories carefully it's an easy 4.0
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is very sarcastic and some may think he's rude, but he's just trying to help you succeed. you have to go to class to do good, but class isn't that bad. reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Prof Hussain is the classic stern lecturer that will tell you everything you need to know for the exams. He gives quizzes through an iclicker roughly every other day, however these are free points if you pay attention in class. The exams are online and super straightforward to what is discussed in class. Standard lecture class with a solid prof
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Honestly you don't have to buy the textbooks he requires. I didn't and I'm ending with a 4.0 but I really wish I did the extra credit he offered in the beginning. His lectures sometimes are boring but everything you need for notes you can find on quizlet like I did. Best teacher ever I loved his class, if you have to take an ISS take this one!!
Long lectures... and make sure you remember the stories he tells. Most of the exam questions are taken from his stories.

You have to show up to pass his bi-weekly quizzes, BUT it is seriously so easy. He is the funniest and easiest professor ever. I would take any of his classes. Just don't fall asleep, or be caught on your phone or listening to music. His lectures are pretty boring but very straight forward. His exams are common sense.
Do the extra credit opportunity!! Make sure to do well on in-class quizzes. It'll save your grade!
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class can be an EASY 4.0 if you do the extra credit. It may seem like a lot of work, but it bumps your class GPA by 0.5 and helps your resume. The lectures are super boring and you dont have to pay attention for the most part. He will usually tell you if something is important. 50 multiple choice on three exams and he drops the lowest.

His lectures are long and can be somewhat boring, but he knows what he is talking about and makes the information fairly interesting. For the tests most of the questions from lecture are based off of examples he uses and not just from the slides. It isn't bad if you go to class and read the material.

Would not recommend one of his classes to anyone. Out of all the classes I have taken, he is by far the rudest and least caring to students. Students only have five seconds to answer iclicker questions, lectures are heavy, and Hussain goes out of his way to make this class very difficult.

Hussain can be extremely rude to students and is not afraid to call people out for sleeping or being on your phone. Overall, class isnt too terrible & information can be interesting. Just BE PRESENT during lectures or he will call you out, & NOT nicely.
reviews.rating_tags: LECTURE HEAVY--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: His tests were ab it challenging but this class is worth the work. Very insightful.
SOOOO Boring and rude to students. Is not understanding at all.

I went to every lecture and read the assigned reading and barely 3.5. His lectures are long and boring. He is extremely rude to students and does not like answering questions. ISS should be an easy 4.0

He has an accent so he is a little harder to understand and tells so many stories that it is hard to keep up on them. The TA sessions on Fridays were the one thing that helped me pass. Overall a neat class but sometimes hard to pay attention
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is not very nice. Will yell at you if you sleep. You don't need to buy the books. Material is on the test but you go over it in class. Past exams are on koofers, use those to study. Not too difficult

He always makes sure to tell students that they don't have to agree with some of his lecture topics/opinions.  DON'T HAVE TECH OUT/SLEEP IN CLASS. He will call you out on it, it will happen every class. His lectures are amazing though - they will really make you think about life. He's even got super cool stories to relate to them,clear grading,too!

Professor Hussain takes a little to get used to, he is strict but only if you are on your phone in lecture or sleeping. Other than that he is pretty funny and keeps his lectures very structured and understandable. I would definitely pay attention in class because your exams are mostly on lecture notes.

Professor Hussain's class is relatively easy to pass as long as you show up to lecture and pay attention. His lectures contain a lot of stories which are interesting and it causes you to think about things differently.

There are clicker quizzes after every chapter (weekly) but they're very easy as long as you pay attention.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Hussain is absolutely one of my favorite teachers here at MSU. Yes, his lectures may be 2 hours long but he really tried his best to engage everyone in on what he is teaching. reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Hussain seemed decent at first even though at times he was hard to understand. Overall the class isn't difficult but Hussain ruined it for me.  PS: Koofers will save your butt
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: It seems as if he goes out of his way to make this course as difficult as possible. You will have only 5 seconds to answer questions on quizzes. I do not think this is fair at all, and only enhances the anxiety that some students face during assessments. He is also very rude to his students and acts like he is a dictator rather than a professor.

This dude is an jerk. His accent is pretty thick, but he's usually okay to understand. He does ramble quite a bit though. Class is pretty much only mandatory because he puts his stories in the quizzes. Oh, and the quizzes.. there's one a week usually. You get like ten seconds to answer a question, if you're lucky. I wouldnt take his class again.
Hes kind of boring, but have very interesting stories.
He is very passionate about his lectures and overall, a great professor.
He's very passionate about his lectures.

By far the best professor I have ever had the honor to take a class from. Really funny guy, cares a lot about his students, has had many first hand experiences, and is very passionate. Would recommend, would take again, would love to grab lunch with the guy. Don't shy away because he is foreign, his class was my favorite. Makes it so interesting.

Hussain has to be one of my favorite professors. So helpful and funny during class. Kind of has his office hours at night at Biggby which is pretty nice. Very nice guy, I would recommend going up and talking to him and getting to know him if you get the chance. He really likes to know his students.

Going into my senior year and Fayyaz is still one of the best professors I've ever had. I had him for 215 and I went out of my way to build my schedule around his section of 315 because I had to have him again. Funny, caring, and extremely passionate about his work. Take his class!
He was funny, insightful, helpful and very smart. The class was my favorite of the year, and I would definitely take it again.

Exams are exactly like lectures and the stories he uses to go along with them. He is funny just make sure you pay attention and stay awake so you don't get in trouble. Class is interesting because you're actually learning relevant information.

This teacher has a bit of a heavy accent but after the first class you'll get used to it. He is very clear on what will be on the tests and makes sure to go over all important information multiple times. He has lots of great stories to go along with his lectures since he has traveled all over and is very interesting. I would definitely take it.

I was a bit skeptical coming into the semester seeing that I had a foreign professor. I thought I might not understand him but Dr. Hussain is very easy to understand. Also the exams are exactly as the lectures and Iclicker quizzes. They drop your lowest exam grade and through the extra credit you can get a .5 boost!  great class!

Absolutely LOVED Hussain. One of my favorite professors so far. Gives a chance for a .5 GPA boost, super funny in class (tells lots of stories). Can get sort of boring in the 2 hour lecture, but as long as you go to class the iClicker quizzes are identical to the exams.
He was good, kind of hard
Seriously the funniest, most caring man ever! He has great stories to share that go along with the material - definitely makes his class interesting. I would reccommend him to anybody!
Cares about his students and that they learn. Such a great professor
Hussain was definitely my favorite professor at MSU so far. Very intelligent man with hilarious stories and conversation. Great class.
Really interesting professor. Enjoyed his class.

Quite possibly the best professor I've ever had. so incredibly knowledgeable its unbelievable and made a subject i was pretty uninterested in something i now love. what a prof should be. kudos to him!

By far the the best professor ive ever had. He's really funny, his class is easy, uses old tests, and he actually cares about how you do. He likes to call people out when he catches them sleeping in class too, but he makes it funny
great professor overall! very funny, tells stories related to text/lecture, and is genuinely interested in what he's teaching!
He is awesome...very funny and a great prof. Juss study the slides and be sure to take side notes, because he does test from what he says...all in all great prof!

I took his course over the summer, and it was the easiest course I have ever taken. I did not read a single page of the book and did not do a single assignment. All I did is take the online quiz once a week for 6 weeks  and got a 4.0. There was no homework and there were no videos to watch. Easiest class @ MSU hands down.
This teacher was a delight.  He made me laugh and the material was pretty interesting.  The tests were super easy and I want to take every class with him! GO FAYAZZ!
Uses all old tests and tells you exactly what will be on all exams. Extremely easy class and Fayyaz is very passionate about what he teaches which makes it to be an interesting course
awesomeness
Professor Hussain was very interested in what he was teaching, therefore he made the class interesting. He was always approachable after class and had a lot of great extra credit opportunities
Great teacher and challenges many of the things you have learned in your past. He is foreign, but he speaks very clearly. Overall a great teacher and I hope to take his 315 class next Spring.
Amazing...I want to take all his classes!
hes awesome!! i love his accent and the material he teaches is easy to understand. his tests arent too bad and the final is just like the three previous exams taken. take him!!
Dr. Fayyaz Hussain is amazing.                               "Push the lever longer and enjoy your life of poverty!"
Fayyaz is a wonderful prof.  He's very intelligent and clear and is pretty damn funny.

the material could have been completely boring, but he keeps the class pretty engaging, tells lots of anecdotes, uses lots of recent examples, and breaks the theories down so they're pretty easy to understand. the tests aren't bad if you skim the readings and put some time in studying lecture notes.

One of the best professors I've had at MSU. Very interesting material, he cares a lot about what he is teaching. Great stories. Pay attention in class or he will point you out. Make sure you GO to class and that you take good notes. Take any class with this guy.

The material in this class is very dry.  But Fayyaz makes it interesting by telling stories, relating current data, and using humor to express his points.  He even picks on people in the class who dont pay any attention or sleep.
No Comments

His class opened my eyes to things going on in the entire world. I thought his lectures were, for the most part, VERY interesting and his stories are great. His tests were straight-forward but a little difficult because some answers seem the same. Overall,

Boring class with too much reading but the tests were very easy, I managaed to get a 4.0 with out much trying....however his final was a ****.  He made ridiculously hard questions that were much worse than his regular tests, but i still diid alright.  Goo

Fayaz is the nicest man.  He cracks me up.  I loved the class because the material wasnt boring.  His tests arent too bad, nothing that you cant study for.  He is the best prof. I have had since I have been in college.

The Apu comparision was accurate - hard to understand sometimes.  Be VERY discreet if you're gonna daydream, he's got radar for that and is constantly yelling at people.  Easy class, boring though.  If you're going to pay attention, go for it, but if you want to sleep through 215 pick someone else.  I wouldn't take him again.

EASY CLASS!!! very interesting material covered. DON"T FALL ASLEEP IN CLASS!! drops your lowest exam grade. u get extra credit if you are there on all they days he takes attendance. then there's the volunteer thing that gives you more ec. he's a nice guy, sarcastic funny. just make sure you're there for the lectures, take very good notes. u'll pass
Very good professor.
Definitely one of the better ISS teachers out there.  My only gripe is that he assigns quite a bit of reading, but oh well.  The tests are pretty easy...try to see if someone has some past exams.
Haha, he just talks like Apu from the Simpsons, and that's all that mattered.  "And dees are dee tings dat make de world good.  Tank you, come again!"

His lectures are interesting.  He stops class a lot to yell at people who aren't paying attention, and reminds them they're paying for this (but it doesn't matter to him that the other 349 of us are paying attention.)
No Comments
No Comments
Very cool Professor, if you go to MSU and you have to take an ISS class take ISS 215 with Hussain. He is funny, and really cares about the students.  He also teaches ISS 315.
he's really nice but the class is boring.  the tests are difficult but the final is pretty easy if you study you're past exams.  he's very big on attendance

Dr. Field was a very good professor. He is very good at explaining things, and you get to watch videos in his class almost every day. You also get to write several fun essays in his class. He and his TA mostly grade for completion and not accuracy.

If you like music, you would like this class. All you do in this class is watch documentary about a musical composer or listen to musics. He always let us go 30 min early. Attendance is mandatory-ish. You get 3 free absences, but if the TA isn't there you don't even fill out the attendance sheet so... The Assignments are super easy too.

This professor is such a fantastic, knowledgeable lecturer who has a deep passion for the topic. He explains these topics so well and with such excitement, it gets me excited to learn. I learned so much from this class without it being difficult.
Very nice guy that seems to care a lot about his students. Easy and fun class to take, good elective.
Cool teacher with easy class

He made the classroom a fun environment, and was very understanding near the end of the semester. His grading is very relaxed and the weekly assignment was a paragraph on whatever I wanted. I really enjoyed understanding music i'm gonna miss that guy
He seems to actually care about what he is teaching and that makes the class so much better.

Very nice professor, you can tell he likes teaching about music and he's also very passionate. One of my favorite professors I've had at MSU. Makes essays fun because you write about almost anything you want related to music. Great choice for an elective.

It wouldn't let me choose the correct course but I took IAH 241a with Professor Fields, which was Music and Society in the Modern World. I loved this class, especially for an IAH. Prof Fields has such a caring, kind demeanor about him which made me want to participate even more. Easy workload as well. This was the way an IAH course SHOULD be.

I took this class very last minute not knowing anything at all about music. One of the best professors I have ever had so far at MSU. He is really engaging and cares that you pass. Not even a music major! I am business but was my favorite class this semester.
Loved him he was really nice and always eager to talk to you!
He does a very good job of including work in his day to day lectures in order to understand material. He really cares about his students as well.

Mr. Filosa was okay at teaching. My biggest grip was how slow he moved through the material. He was constantly behind and regularly had us stay late. Additionally, we did not finish the final chapter of material. If you want an easy grade take this teacher but if you actually care about learning the content, I recommend taking a different teacher.
Extremely good at teaching and explains everything so well! Definitely recommend taking his class.
Cared for us, we learned and even it was a hard class he did a very good job teaching.

Class is based on 2 midterms and problem sets. We have problem sets about once a week due on Friday at 5. Allows a cheat sheet one sided handwritten which is really helpful. First midterm average was around a 64% but the tests itself are very easy if you read over your notes and do the practice midterm.

He was truly an amazing teacher, as this was his first-ever lecture in a big class. The class was pretty hard, but he tried to explain again and again so that people would understand. Definitely go for his class if you have an option.

Neil Filosa has made a difficult to understand class extremely engaging. He is high energy, starts every lecture with a song, and would bring in cold water for us when the room was 97 degrees. He gives excellent advice. It was his first ever lecture and he did great. The exams are graded in a timely matter with explanations and partial credit.

Nature of the class is difficult, but Filosa was super understanding and did a good job going over the necessary material in class. Do the homework and his lecture and his class is pretty easy. One downside was he was very inexperienced, but this was his first big lecture so it was understandable. Definitely recommend his class.

Listen to the advice given by Dr. Foley in the beginning of the semester, and don't fall behind! If you stay on top of the material and ask questions when unclear, you can ace it.
She was a good professor, her lectures were clear and she cares if the students understand the material.

Ridiculously hard exams (Options A-J, no chance for process of elimination). Disorganized and monotonous lectures. Grading scale was okay, 85 was a 4.0. Final exam was optional, but could replace your lowest exam score. Also, if your score on the final was greater than your grade in the class, it replaced it. However, it was cumulative & VERY hard.

Dr. Frilingos was by far my favorite professor that I have taken a non-animal science class with. He is extremely caring and respectful and truly wants to know what's going on with his students so he can help and support them along the way. I truly cannot sing his praises enough!

This class was the best class I've taken, Professor Frilingos is caring and understanding, truly cares about his students and really loves what he's teaching. He's very open to other ideas that people may bring up in class and he leaves room for in class discussion. The best professor I've had!
This is a professor who loves what he's teaching and you can tell, it makes the class so fun and engaging. Truly a caring professor and the best professor I've had at Michigan State by far!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Frilingos is such a nice and knowledgeable man. He learned everyone's names (I've never had another professor do that before) and seems to genuinely care about his students and their success in the class. Although the class was a bit demanding at times (mostly with memorization), I ended up passing with an A.

Frilingos created a phenomenal work enviorment for everyone in the class and anyone who does not rate him a 5 is trippin. Class was not mandatory but mostly all information was in class or online. The class was interesting on its own but if you can go to class a decent amount then you can easily 4.0, He will make you want to go to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Frilingos is one of the most kind, compassionate professors I have ever had and he TRULY cares about your education! He will meet with you during office hours and make accommodations within reason for you to learn the best that you can. If you pay attention in class you should have no problem getting an A. Great guy all around.

One of my favorite classes I have ever taken. Professor Frilingos is exceptional and really cares about is students and is very accommodating about late work. He is very straightforward about the content on exams and does not try to trick you in anyway. If you show up to class you are bound to 4.0.
Excellent professor topics were not very hard.

Dr. Frilingos is absolutely wonderful! He is clearly passionate about the material and very caring towards students. There is a required book in the first half of the class, but it is interesting and easy to read. Good lectures and great organization. Challenging, but not HARD. I loved this class!

Chris is genuinely one of the best profs I've had at MSU. He is so caring about students and make the expectations of the class very clear. Not only was he a good prof, but his class creates amazing discussions and things that you've never thought about or noticed before. He can make boring text from the book so interesting. I highly recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great class, attendance is not mandatory, but just show up to class and your bound to get a 4.0
Dr. Frilingos is passionate about what he teaches, and you will be too. I look forward to taking more non-major classes with him in the future.

Professor Frilingos is an amazing professor. He is so caring towards his students and he is so knowledgeable on what he teaches that it makes lectures so interesting and he allows you to see things in a new perspective. Overall, loved this class.

Professor Frilingos is my all time favorite professor. Professor Frilingos makes MSU a better place. He tells you exactly what is expected of you and I look forward to his class everyday. Participation is important but just to keep class rolling and entertaining for everyone. He sees you as a person and a student, not just a student.
Protect this man at all costs. Homework was not a heavy workload. Explained content and assignments clearly and thoroughly.

I had a ton of fun in this course and he was part of the reason why. Fun elective course, led by easily my favorite professor I've had as a student. Actually cares about his students, doesn't just say it, but shows it. He is the GOAT

Amazing professor. Genuinely cares about his students. One of the easiest classes I have taken, but was still able to learn a lot. I would recommend him to everyone. Most grades are participation, so it is very easy to do well in his class.

He was a very nice dude and I would recommend him. There were a lot of readings to do, assigned on Fridays, and due Mondays. I didn't love his papers, they weren't extremely difficult but I had to do a lot of deeper thinking for them. Overall, great class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Frilingos was fantastic! This was one of the best classes I have taken at MSU. He truly cares about his students and cares about feedback. I highly recommend this class!

He's a genuinely nice person. Definitely cares about students and the material in class was well rounded and interesting. Was unbiased and seemed like he just wanted us to dive into the material and get our own perspective.

Great teacher, but he was somewhat monotoned so it was easy to get distracted. Readings are not that important as long as you pay attention during class. Homework is graded really easily as long as you put in a little effort. Nice guy and kinda funny.

Graded on midterm, final, 3 papers (pretty easy), and 7 homework assignments. This is my 2nd class I have taken with him and he is my favorite professor! Class is a lot of fun! Lots of small group discussion. Exams are almost all written but he tells you exactly what is going to be included. 3 books required but you can find them used for cheap.

This professor is an absolute gem. He starts every class with a deep breath and maybe even a subtle joke or two, which is helpful for me and my class anxiety. He explains things really well and uses timelines all the time to ensure we understand the importance of the time that we are studying. Even though his class is hard, he is an awesome person.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Frilingos is very educated and passionate. His lectures were clear and enjoyable. I found this class to be very interesting and I thoroughly enjoyed going. There isn't a lot of homework and if you study/take good notes, you can do well on the exams. I would gladly take one of his classes again.

Chris Frilingos is the greatest professor I've ever had. Do not take the class if you want to validate or disprove Christianity. Do take the class if you want to see the Bible from an academic perspective and/or want to take a class with a professor who asks how you're doing and actually cares about the answer.

Frilingos is a certified OG.   He genuinely cares that he learns everyone's name and that you do the readings.  His exams are somewhat difficult but not bad by any standards.  You have to identify dates during the first section of exams, then define ID terms, then identify biblical passages.  The identification of passages is difficult so read

The course was interesting and Frilingos is really nice and helpful. The exams were difficult and all of them were "blue book". There is also a lot of reading in the course. You don't need to have all the reading done for the class it's due on, but you will end up needing to read most of it to study for exams.
Best Class Ever. He is such a nice, helpful teacher. I never wanted to miss a day of class. Pretty easy, as long as you pay attention and do your reading.

Fantastic guy. He has an interesting personality and sense of humor. He makes an effort to learn names and things about you. The class itself is very interesting and he makes it very easy to understand. GREAT PROFESSOR, GREAT CLASS

He's a nice guy and knows his stuff but he just goes so slow and talks so much its hard to actually pay attention. Half of what he says he's just repeating himself unnecessarily. It may have been because it was an introductory class, but I felt really talked down to in general, not academically but emotionally like we're all high schoolers.

Super nice guy. Class was mainly just lingco and participation, as long as you did those you were good. We had three talkabroad conversations but Francisco was an easy grader. It would be difficult not to get a 4.0, but just put in the effort if you want to actually learn the language. I think I learned about as much as expected from a 101 class.

Francisco is funny, caring, and kind. You can absolutely tell that he cares for each and every one of his students. I feel he could honestly be a bit more 'strict' with his teaching, meaning making us speak Spanish more, but I loved him! Would highly recommend taking his class; he made me love Spanish again!
He is so funny and understanding, gives help during assignments

He is good at teaching for this class and you will get a good grade. As for learning Spanish, he may not be the best professor if you are hoping to be proficient. He will often answer question with essentially, 'that's just the way you say it.' He's super nice and class is always a lot of fun!
I loved this class, no tests
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Francisco is absolutely one of my favorite professors at MSU so far. He is both a great dude and a great professor. The class was pretty easy for me- although I technically tested into this level of Spanish coming into my freshman year, it was essentially a review of what I had previously learned. Dude even gave me his shark hat. Take his classes!

Francisco is an amazing professor that cares greatly about his students. Not only did he make a 3:00pm lecture fun and worth going too, but he made sure to check in on how all of us were doing at the beginning of every class. As long as you show up and don't miss assignments you will do great in his class.

This class was "Que Fancy," as Francisco says. After not taking Spanish for years, it was so easy to hop right back into it with his help. His expectations of students are very clear, as he'll remind you multiple times about assignments coming up in order for you to better prepare. The class overall is pretty easy, just try your best and have fun!

Francisco is the best college professor I have ever had! He is seriously the kindest / most caring person on the planet and will make sure that all of his students succeed. His classes were so much fun and he will make you laugh the entire time. I have never seen a happier or sweeter person in my life, his classes will make your day 1000x better!

Fransisco is one of the best professors at MSU. He builds such genuine relationships with his students that he feels more like a friend than a professor. He's really funny and easy-going and made this class one that I was excited to go to. I really can't say enough good things about him. Definitely take a class with him if you have the opportunity.

So fun actually! The class covers some challenging material but the lectures are so helpful for moving into understanding what you read in the textbook. Attendance is annoyingly mandatory but honestly it's not that bad. He's funny and makes the class engaging, when linguistics has the potential to be a drag, so I appreciate it a lot.

Such a fun professor and he really cares about how we do in the class and how we are doing as students in general! Attendance is mandatory for points, but Francisco makes sure class is never feels boring or stale.

Franciso is one of the best Spanish profs I've ever had! He really cares about our understanding of the language and that we're having a fun time. Because it's a language class, attendance is required (you can only miss 3 classes without a penalty) and participation goes toward your final grade. Overall taking Spanish with Franciso is the best.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Super funny guy. My favorite Spanish class so far and he made it really fun. The TalkAbroads were kind if annoying but theyre out of his control. 11/10 would recommend.
Professor Morales is super caring and funny. Attendance is somewhat needed in order to get attendance points but the written projects are very easy. He is an easy grader as well.

Prof Fujita is very sweet and caring. There are 6 quizzes and they are all online. Very easy to 4.0 as long as you do the readings from her lecture slides or take notes in class. Personally the best and easiest ISB/ISP honors substitution class.

Such a genuine and nice lady. Grade is based on 2 group projects and 3 exams. Don't have to show up to class except to present and review others' presentations. There is a lot of reading, and you'll want to at least skim most of it to get you through the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Fujita is so sweet and is really passionate about what she teaches, and her tests are online and quite simple! However, do not get the textbook, everything in the textbook is covered by her lecture and her slides, which is shared regardless if you go to class or not. You can definitely 4.0 this class easily!
Lecture slides are posted and attendance is not mandatory. There are only quiz grades for this class but if you do the required reading they should not be too difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy to do well in this class. The only grades are 6 quizzes and the lowest drops at the end of the semester. Class is super easy in general but especially if you have any biology knowledge as the topics covered are similar to those in a biology class, only simplified

Super sweet professor and cares about how her students are doing. Not a very time consuming class, there was no homework and our grade was only based on 6 quizzes, open note, and you get one drop. Also provided extra credit. Easy A+.

The only thing I didn't like about the course is that your grade depends on only exams. There is no homework given in this class which makes it somewhat more difficult. The prof is really sweet and accommodating though even though, because of her accent, sometimes it can be hard to understand her.

Super sweet woman who gives clear guidelines and gave no midterm or final. Seems really understanding of students during the pandemic and doesn't give an overwhelming amount of work. Also drops many things at the end of the semester. You better have the textbook but once you do, everything comes directly from there so it's not hard to understand.

Prof Fujita is such a sweetheart. Her class is pretty easy- only three exams are graded, but there is a potential for 10% of your grade to be extra-credit based. Lectures are long and sometimes not the most exciting, but this class is definitely one to take if you need a 4.0. She says you need the book, but you definitely don't need it to succeed.

I took this class for honors credit. I really appreciate Dr. Fujita. She was super helpful and very approachable. No homework assignments, just tests. If you attend class (not mandatory but helps solidify information) and study the textbook you will do fine. I would definitely take her again if I actually liked anthropology.

did not attend class often, but she posts her lecture slides online and they are very easy to understand. the book is necessary, but the class is not. the professor was very sweet and wanted everyone to pass.
Very hopeful teacher, willing to go above and beyond to accommodate you and answer all questions. Also a very wonderful lady, I highly recommend taking one of her courses!
Cute teacher. Very enthusiastic and willing to go at whatever pace the class wants. Easy enough class, but you do have to study. Offers a LOT of extra credit.

A great professor, who genuinely cares about his students. He is flexible and willing to help any student struggling to grasp concepts in his class. However, I wouldn't recommend taking HA101 unless you are an art major.

Really good professor and knows what he is talking about. The class has a lot of reading and is very dependent on you completing your readings in order to do well in assessments. Other than that, the class is super chill and the professor is too.

Lots of readings, but the workload is pretty manageable if you schedule your reading. His lectures are interesting and funny. He clearly cares about this class. If you read the works, show up to class, and participate, you will do amazing on the exams and have fun in the process. Loved this class! One of the best and understanding profs I've had.
He was kind of a weird guy, chill, but a bit odd and lets you do your homework in class if your in the background but I found him to be slightly insufferable.

Jon Frey is probably one of my favorite professors at MSU. Amazing guy who you can tell knows his stuff, and is able to make his lectures so interesting. Work consisted of 2 papers, 3 exams, and 2 online discussions, and he is very flexible with conflicts and making sure you're able to turn in your work. Highly recommend taking any of his classes!
Took HA 101 and overall an amazing class

Frey was great! Very kind and smart about his content. Learned a lot and he made it interesting. 1 multi-step project, three exams, two online discussions. Cares about students and is available if you need help.

Dr. Frey is amazing! Very passionate about what he teaches, and his lectures are very interesting and hilarious. I really enjoyed this course. There's also not a huge amount of work, and the exams are a breeze if you study. Highly recommend anything he teaches.
He was amazing 10/10

Prof.Frey is awesome, he does cover a lot of information so be ready to take notes. Exams are multiple choice but if you go to class and pay attention you should be okay. One of my favorite professors ever and he made lecture interesting. A genuinely nice person, 1000% would take his class again.

My favorite professor ever. Very passionate about his teachings, makes you really interested in the material and he is pretty funny as well. Very good at helping students understand the material, and makes it known that the class is A LOT of reading. As long as you at least skim all of the reading material and go to every class you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: ACTUALLY IAH-207!!!!Really cared about the students, weekly assignment that are too hard. Put in effort and you will get a 4.0.

Professor Frey is one of the few professors that actually cares about his students well being and if they pass or not. He is very understanding and has many resources available to make sure you succeed in his class. I am very appreciative that there are professors like him

His class always kept me interested in things that I normally wouldn't be interested in. He's very upbeat and you can tell how passionate he is about his class. Take in every once of information he gives you, you're going to need it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Jon does a good job of making lectures as interesting as possible because he is genuinely enthusiastic and passionate about what he does. Best of all, he is super flexible and understanding if you need extra time or help. He understands that students and busy and things come up and he treats those situations with respect. He is also pretty funny.
Prof. Frey is a great professor. He definitely cares about what he is teaching and is really flexible. He wants to see you succeed and will do a lot to help.

Jon is awesome. Super understanding if you need another day or two on an assignment. Everything is very clearly laid out at the beginning of the class. Two papers (one formal analysis and one annotated bib), 3 exams, and 11 discussion posts (only 4 are necessary). Lectures are interesting and he will always answer your ridiculous questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Really great professor! I thoroughly enjoyed taking his class. No one scored below an 85 on the first exam. If you do the reading and attend class, you should have no problem passing.

Jon's the man. His exam's are harder than most but he's dedicated to making sure you understand all the material and his passion for the topics covered draw you into his lectures. His personality and knowledge make any of his classes exciting to attend. Definitely one of my favorite professors.

Jon is AMAZING!  He bends over backwards to help you, and he's such a down to earth guy.  His exams are harder than most, like mentioned, because he expects you to KNOW the material.  If you pay attention, come to class, do the readings, you will do fine.  He's very fair.  My favorite professor so far at MSU!
Very fun teacher, very enthusiastic! Covers a wide range of ancient art, not just focusing on one area or time period.

Jon is an excellent professor. His exams are a little more difficult than other art history professors, mostly because he doesn't give a list of required images, but he is always willing to help, and will work his schedule to accommodate yours. Probably my favorite art history professor.

His exams are very difficult. The average grade for his exams are around a 60% over years of classes. He is disorganized and all assignments are turned in by hand, meaning he loses some assignments. He is accessible and is willing to meet outside of office hours, but his lectures are dry and ANYTHING he has said in class is "fair game" on exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Don't do this to yourself. Unless eat, sleep, and breath earthquakes don't take him. Spent countless hours studying, went to class, took notes, still only got a 3.0

He was really enthusiastic about the subject, but I never knew what information was important because he talked at length about things that weren't on the exam. It was a challenging class for me. If you don't have to take this class, then avoid it.
Most difficult and boring class I've ever taken. Switch if you can. Don't waste hours studying only to get a 70% like I did. Never again.

His class is hard, don't get me wrong, but it had more to due with the complex nature of the topic than the professor. (Plate tectonics isn't your average geo class.)He was very accommodating and more than willing to spend whatever time was needed to help a student understand the concepts beyond just getting a good grade.

As an ISP professor, he moved a little faster than I anticipated. A lot of the exam material also comes from the book, which he did not mention in class. It's a difficult class, but the in-class activities hopefully made up for my exam grades.
Hardest GLG class I took at MSU.  He knows his stuff and expects you to as well.  Essay tests.  Studying is mandatory.
Easy class but this crazy little asian is hard to understand
Very tough but overall a good prof.  Very willing to help if you ask.  Take the class seriously and you will learn!
Interesting to begin with, but always very tough

I've Dr. Hoppenstand's IAH 207 and IAH 211 as part of my business program, but they turned out to be far more meaningful than just required courses. His personality, passion, and ability to connect material to real life made every class engaging and impactful. I have a great deal of respect for him and am truly thankful to have learned from him.
This guy is the best, super entertaining and super easy A.

He did not actually teach anything. During class he would put on a movie and that is it. The course consisted of reading 3 books and watching half a dozen movies. The only grades for the class were 3 exams, two of which were made by his TA's and asked ridiculously pedantic questions.
He ended up curving it, I stand corrected. Ended up being manageable.

If this class does not get curved I am going to be very angry. When I saw 100% on the syllabus to get a 4, I thought he would be offering EC. Do not get your hopes up because there was nothing. The exams are online, but absolutely impossible. I would like to see what the TA's and the professor would get on them. I know it would not be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Hoppenstand chooses fun topics, however, the TAs do most of the work. If you have a bad TA good luck. The entire course grade was calculated by weighing 3 poorly written exams created by TAs for 90% (30% per exam), and recitation attendance/participation for 10%. A 4.0 is 100%, 3.5 92%, 3.0 87%, 2.5 82%, 2.0 77%, 1.5 72%, which really sucks.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: We read 8 YA books, and had to write a 2 page MLA paper on each of them, which may be a lot quantitatively, but really it was a fair and reasonable amount of work. Each person will be in a group to do a long form presentation on one book. Each class period was light, fun, and somewhat informational. He is a very pleasant and understanding guy.

Professor Hoppenstand is a truly phenomenal professor. I took his ENG 142 course over the summer semester, and found it to be enjoyable but not too demanding. We were required to write a 750 word reading summary each week, and as long as you put some effort into your writing, he will give you a good grade and kind, encouraging feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Hoppenstand is not only a great professor but a kind man. We mainly watched films, read a few short novels, & discussed them. When he did lecture, it was interesting & he always had a fun personal story. Grading consisted of 4 exams that you will ace if you paid attention & content from your TA's recitation. Super interesting guy, great class

Loved Professor Hoppenstand. He's just a sweet old guy and he really wants to see you succeed in this class. If you need an IAH class I would recommend taking this class. You watch a lot of movies and there's some reading for class; assignments and tests are relatively easy. Pretty easy class overall and I would probably take the class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Hoppenstand is easily one of the best professors I have ever had. He has such a positive, kindhearted, and humorous spirit that makes you want to come to class every day. He made it very clear that his number one goal is for everyone to earn a 4.0, so he does not make any of the group assignments or exams difficult.

Professor Hoppenstand is the best! He really wants his students to do well. In this class, you watch a lot of movies with a little bit of reading. I absolutely recommend this professor and this class. There are also some extra credit opportunities.

Professor Hoppenstand has by far been my favorite professor at MSU. He is so interested in his students and cares about them and what they are learning. He is willing to work with students if they have questions. He is very knowledgeable about what he is teaching. He kept the class very interesting.

Absolutely loved him. Sweetest guy ever. Very understanding, assignments were really easy. Usually a group assignment of writing about 250 words. The quizzes were 10 questions, and if you've read the book or you find a good summary you'll pass. I do recommend attending the lectures. Overall, super caring and passionate. Take him if you can.

He is very caring and considerate towards students, he wants everyone to get a 4.0. However you do have to do the work in his class to do well this semester we had to read 5 novels on roman history and take a quiz on each of them and write a book review in a group. The midterm was worth 30% and the final is 40% of your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: The best teacher I have ever had in my college career so far. So caring and funny and has even nominated for a bunch of awards. If you take his class please go to class even if its not mandatory because he puts a lot of energy into it. Highly recommend, one of those classes you genuinely enjoy.

An amazing and sweet professor who cares about his students. The class was heavy on reading but it also incorporated in movies which were interesting at times. After each book, we received quizzes on them. I stopped reading the books halfway into the semester, read summaries, worked with some friends, and did fine. Study for the midterm and final.

He was one of the best professors I've ever had. His class was SO easy, all you have to do is read the books & you'll easily pass with a 4.0. He assigns a quiz after every book, and everyone always got 100's on them! He also tries to grade really easily, and makes the exams easy too!
He made class fun and interesting. The assigned readings were not hard and the quizzes were easy.

This class was pretty easy! If you read the books assigned, you will pass the quizzes. The lectures were pretty interesting too. I enjoyed the class. Also, you watch a lot of movies so that's a plus :)

He's cool, in my class we read books and watched movies with similar themes and plots, and then write essays on them. At first he's intimidating but if you work hard you'll do fine, even though it's honors its not that bad.

He must be the BEST professor in the whole world. His classes are very fun and I have really really enjoyed having him as a professor. I will take any class with him even if it's not required for my major. Highly recommended--take any of his class at any costs. You will really love it!
The coolest, nicest and most real guy out there.  Changed my life!  Brilliant, funny and interesting!
No Comments
Literally, the most interesting professor EVER. Take anything with Prof Hop in it.

Overall his class is easy as long as you pay attention and do the work. He gives a ton of extra credit opportunities and the exams aren't weighted heavily, so even if you don't do awesome on an exam it's still easy to 4.0. He does talk slowly and lectures are boring, but the assignments aren't hard and you get a notecard for the exams.

Make sure you read the rules on the assignments he posts, got every question correct but because he doesn't want to go through and actually read the answers I wrote he marks them incorrect. He also does these super awkward pauses in between every sentence he says, makes the class unbearable. PLEASE take any other professor.

He does speak slowly and has a monotone voice, but he includes funny clips in his lecture slides and occasionally cracks jokes, so he does make an effort to keep the class fun. I didn't have any issues with his grading, if you pay attention and complete the work, it's an easy class to ace. He was also very helpful whenever I needed help.

Yes he does talk slower, but id rather only 8 slides a class then 100+. He offers a decent amount of extra credit throughout the course and overall is extremely caring and helpful towards his students. His class is only super hard if you don't pay attention or study for exams. We only had two in person exams and got 4x6 notecards for both.

he was the definition of fine. he did not make the class interesting, talked in a monotone voice, and showed up late to the exam. two of the exams were online, then he made the final exam in person with a little cheat sheet. make sure you do good on everything, so you don't stress on the final exam

This class is painfully slow. It takes 1.5 hours to get through 10 slides, with long silent pauses where he just stares at us. The tests don't match anything we learn, and random in class assignments punish anyone not there that day. Completely disorganized and exhausting. Harsh Grader, takes weeks to get our test back STAY AWAY FROM THIS PROFESSOR
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He was late to the final. He allowed us to have notecards, but there was very little from the study guide that was actually reflected on the exam. He did have a few extra credit points, but they were about sports and other irrelevant things. Things are still not graded and the semester ends in two days, so I have no clue what I have. Don't take him
Late to our final exam

Additionally, the way he speaks makes no sense, and it takes him 50 years to go through two lecture slides, one of which is the title page. He also refuses to put grades in, so I have no clue what I have in this class, even though it ends in two days. His lack of effort in both teaching and grading makes this professor annoying and hard to stand.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He sucks. The lectures, though posted, are all poorly worded and difficult to comprehend, and he doesn't elaborate on them just reads off them verbatim. He has the most monotone voice ever, and shows little care for students and their learning. His grading makes no sense and changes on a whim. Terrible experience, don't take him unless you have to.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lecture HEAVY. If you don't go to class, good luck. His slides have little information on them so unless you're there and paying attention, it's hard to refer back to anything. Hasn't graded anything since the end of September and our final is tomorrow so I don't even know what my grade is currently.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Galasso is a nice guy, but his exams/lectures are so confusing and worded in the strangest way ever. He takes 45 minutes to go through 2 slides with 50 pauses. Decided our final would be in person after having 2 online (open note) exams, which I don't find fair. Decent guy but not a great professor.

reviews.comment: You can tell he really cares about you. Consistently asks how you're doing and if the course is going well. Stays after class to help. Super kind. GOAT professor.

Dr Grambell genuinely cares about all of his students so much. I've never had a professor like him here at Michigan State. I had this professor for STT 180, and he is one of the best professors that I've ever had. He makes learning R very easy to learn and he creates an elite classroom atmosphere. Dr. Gambrell is easily one of the best professors I have ever had. He is incredibly helpful, and if there is something wrong, he would continuously update us on what is going on. Even his teaching staff included some of the most helpful TAs I have had and I highly recommend Dr. Gambrell
Very easy to talk to and cares about his students.

Mr. Gambrell was one of the best professors I've had at MSU. He brought energy to every class and always had a warm smile on his face. Will probably be the best professor I've ever had. He connected with students and often went above and beyond to foster a positive environment in the classroom.

Professor Gambrell is very helpful and comes up to you individually to make sure you are comfortable with the class. The class itself is a lot of work in terms of assignments but as long as you do them for completion/the best of your ability, you can easily 4.0 this class especially when professor Gambrell is around since he lightens up the mood!

Dr. Gambrell is an extremely understanding and helpful professor. He makes an effort to recognize every student in his class and truly cares about their performance and growth in his class. Kind professor, while he is new you can tell he cares about teaching and cares about his students. This class is a breeze with Dr. Gambrell as long as you do all the preclass assignments and push yourself a little.

After having him for 320 and 325, Dr. Ganguly is my favorite professor in the cse department. I guarantee that you will laugh at least once in one of his lectures.
