I gave Dr. Ganguly the lowest rating for the own good because he wasn't really a good lecturer who does not explain the material properly based on whatever content was covered in CSE 320 for exam 1, exam 2, and exam 3 so I received a bad grade and had to retake this same course with a different professor who is lecturing pretty well

Best professor in CSE. He is great!

Ritam is my favorite professor. I don't know what type of experiences the lower ratings had, but he is the most attentive and caring professor I've ever had. He is extremely focused on the well being and learning of his students, constantly asking for feedback. If you put in effort, you will be just fine. If you see his name, take the course.

Even though Dr. Ganguly sometimes lose his temper during the lectures asking why most of the students did not often seek clarification and class being difficult, he is still an overall wonderful professor who grades fairly in every assignment. Ritam is amazing! The class is super clearly laid out, lectures and homework mostly. Though Dr. Ganguly is an amazing professor, he still made this class very difficult because I had to learn hardware techniques instead of software even when I did not show interest in hardware including assembly and circuits
CSE 320's course topic is very difficult, but Prof. Ganguly tries his hardest to make it digestible. His exams are difficult, but he gives you so much to prepare for them that they seem much easier.

This class is very difficult, however Ritam is extremely passionate about us learning. He was never content with just giving us the information, he was always ensuring we were actually learning from his lectures, and able to apply that material If things didn't go as planned he would be ready to adapt and accept feedback to improve the course.

I had Ganguly for three separate classes (CSE 260, 320, and 325). One of the best and most personable professors in the program. Is always eager and willing to assist students. Can be ruthless but in a great way. You can tell he genuinely cares about the CSE program and is always trying to find ways to make it better. Go to his office hours to chat

He's tough but also caring. He will push you to the edge of your comfort zone but also will give you enough resources to help you. I just got off a zoom call with him at 12.45am, because I was facing difficulty solving a homework question. He was patient and caring, made sure I understood what I was doing. Grateful!

Dr. Ganguly is a pretty good professor since he thoroughly explains all concepts during lectures but in case any of the concepts are unclear to me he was able to give me proper clarification before exams despite the course being very difficult. Very approachable in his office hours if I could visit him often!
If you really want to get to know him and the amount of effort he puts into his classes, go to his office hours and talk with him about anything! Super approachable!
He genuinely care for his students both inside and outside the class. Constantly talking with students, getting feedback and improving the course. He's one of the best faculty in CSE.

I've had Prof. Ganguly for three different CSE classes, and he has been single-handedly breathing new life into MSU's comp sci program. His lectures are great and he will happily answer questions provided you actually bother to engage. Some of his classes are unfortunately weighed down by old practices, but they are gradually being reformed.

This is a hard class but if you put in the effort, you can do well. The practice exams are a good expectation. If you dont understand a concept go learn it otherwise you will fall behind. The professor wants you to be engaged and participate and he will answer your questions. He's making good changes to the class

Class is pretty hard and there's a lot of content you cover within the class, along with the flipping back between the two types of content it can get very confusing. An improvement over josh nahum but so is being taught by a sock. Just another example of a professor being chosen because of skill in coding and not teaching. Don't go to MSU for computer science. Ganguly is by no means a bad or a terrible teacher, he is relatively new as well. He is always looking to improve his courses.

Dr. Geske is the best! This is a challenging lab but completely manageable if you put time into it. She explained concepts very well and it is evident she genuinely wants every student to succeed. I would highly recommend this lab to anyone considering it.

Amazing class. Learning anatomy on specimen is extremely different from textbook drawing, and Dr. Geske is there to help every step of the way. Tests are pretty hard as they are all fill in the blank, so definitely practice free recall to study for the exams. 100% would take again

She is an amazing professor who will make herself available to help students. She cares a lot about your success and is very knowledgeable in her field. One of the best professors I have had at MSU. She is a wonderful professor, a great person, and also inspiring to learn from.
She seems very nice

Will overload you with work then grade tuffffff

Although I had an early class that was long, he didn't bore you and waste your time. Most time in class was brainstorming and helping you with your essay. I wish I could've finished the semester with him.

I do need to start off and say that English is kinda my thing, so automatically I would like a class like this. I really don't know why some of the others said Professor Johns is terrible, though. He's really funny, and I had this class at 8am- he kept it going and kept us awake. The material is pretty different than anything I had ever done, but I
George is the best teacher I have had at msu. He is a great guy.
Very engaging professor.
The most understanding and personalble professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The GOAT. 1of1 professor.

Love this guy! The class was very easy, and there were only 4 assignments the whole time. Guys, please laugh at his joke of the day it makes me sad when people don't! Kinda quirky, but a very passionate teacher and someone who would help you in the future in a heartbeat.
Such an amazing professor! Genuinely made every lecture so engaging and enjoyable. He is so funny and goes out of his way to accommodate and help students, could not recommend him enough!!
He is the best. He is so nice and funny. He genuinely cared about each student. The class was so easy too.
He is so kind! This was such a fun class and I would definitely take it again

My favorite professor by far! He truly cares, adds humor to keep lectures engaging, makes students comfortable asking questions, and is always responsive to emails, even if you're a former student. He truly helped me love the class and want to be there and engaged. You have to write your name on a piece of paper when you go, but it's not mandatory.
George is AWESOME!! So helpful and truly just wants the best for everyone

George is one of my absolute favorite professors. Super engaging with the students and genuinely cares about his students' learning. You'll have to study for his exams but nothing too difficult. Also a little bit of homework but totally managable
Very respectful and has your best interest in mind. 190 is extremely easy.

I took this class only because Professor Harnick was teaching it, he is the best professor Ive had at MSU! He is so passionate, entertaining, and funny. All the content is super useful and he makes it easy to learn. If he makes a joke, LAUGH!!!
GEORGE IS MY GOAT. BEST KIN PROFESSOR IN THE DEPARTMENT.

When I say George is the best professor you will ever have that is an understatement. He is super nice and is really excited to teach his students. His work does require a bit of work but everything he assigned was pretty easy. If you have a question he will gladly answer it and help you if you don't understand something. George you are amazing.
I fking love George Harnick.

THE BEST PERSON EVER. he genuinely cares about every student, and he knew everyone in my class by name. though I only showed up to like 5 of the lectures, I still managed to 4.0 the class. most of the material is common knowledge. he is really passionate about kin and make the class interesting. I would go out of my way to have him again.

George made the class fun. He is very caring and respectful. He is also a good source for any information, KIN related or not. The class is half a semester long so a rather fast-paced class, but you learn a lot. It is also a pass/no pass grade. Attendance isn't mandatory but highly encouraged to get all the information and they are also fun.

George is awesome. Teaches you so much about the world of disabilities in the lab, and he is extremely patient and caring about both the participants and the students. Top three profs I've had at MSU.

Very passionate about his job and kinesiology in general, which makes it easy to pay attention in class and makes you actually want to go to class and learn. He is also a great source of information if you have questions about anything kin related, he's a huge help and always willing to answer questions.

George is THE best, if he makes jokes just laugh. The class is kind of annoying because you lecture for almost 2 hours once a week and then have a gym class for 50 minutes twice a week but it's a requirement so just do it. The exams are a mixture of easy and hard.

He is one of my favorite professors here at MSU. You can tell that he loves what he does and is very accommodating to students. The class is easy and the labs are super fun! It is not hard to do very well. The only thing i wish was different was better feedback on assignments especially our presentations from the labs!

Super amazing professor. He truly cares about his students and is genuinely a great guy. The class is the easiest I have taken ever. I studied one hour before the exam and scored above average. TAKE THIS COURSE WITH HIM!!!!

This class is a bit annoying because the recitations are basically a PE class, but the lectures are good and the material is interesting. Professor Harnick is a great and passionate lecturer who cares about us learning the materials. The class has three exams but he gives study guides that outline what it is on. Grades are very attendance based.

Prof. Harnick is an awesome guy. He has a great personality and is always happy during lectures. He is always open to asking questions, and loves engaging with students. Lectures are important, but the textbook will help you if you missed anything. The lab for this class was also super fun, literally just a high school gym class. Fun class overall!

Prof. Harnick was by far one of my favorite professors so far. I never missed a single lecture and he always knew when to give breaks. You can definitely tell he is passionate about what he does and knows how to teach the content. Notes are the most important part of the whole class and before an exam always study the exam review!
He was one of the best professors I've had at MSU. He really enjoys teaching and is very clear when teaching material. He's also super understanding and is super nice.
He is a professor that genuinely wants you to be successful!

Professor Harnick is one of the best professors I have ever had. He is super funny and I enjoyed going to class. It is a note heavy class, but he makes it easy to follow along and understand. Professor Harnick is super easy to reach outside of class and usually responds super fast. Overall, one of the best professors I've ever had

This class is a joke at MSU. I can confidently say everything in this class is made up and means nothing. I have never read the power points, watched the lectures, and read the cases given, yet I still achieve a 100% on the cases. You can make up anything that sounds correct and receive a good grade. This class is easier than many 100 level classes

NOTE TO ALL FUTURE STUDENTS: at his final lecture (2025 Spring) he mentioned that a lot of the class will probably change so there might not be as many group projects, or they might be individual, attendance might be mandatory or not, idk. Either way, he's not a great lecturer and if everything stays the same, pray you get a good group to work with

Take any other professor if available. Very rude and loves to hear his own voice 24/7, and will cut you off mid sentence to talk over you. Attendance is mandatory and he will change his rules mid semester, from his syllabus. If you are sick, you must have a doctors note or will lose points. He does not care about his students, just his ego.

The minute things don't go his way he attempted to instate new rules that weren't on the syllabus, causing confusion for many students. There are many group projects, and if you get a bad teammate or two like I did, ur in for a rough sem. Attendance is mandatory, be prepared to show a doctors note if u miss. Really good guy but not the best prof.

He may come across as intense initially, but he is genuinely kind and deeply invested in his students' success. With his guidance, most students achieve grades above 3.5. I highly recommend taking Management 409 with him over other professors—there's no final exam, and his teaching style is simply outstanding!

He changed the way he is doing class halfway through the semester due to quiz 1 avg. being 80%. Cannot understand him during lecture. Cannot miss class under any circumstance. Quizzes are on his lecture specifically not the slides. Gives multiple right answers on the quiz but you have to choose 'the most fit' answer. Try to take w anyone else.

The course material is often not updated at all.  The directions for things were often so vague and harmfully wrong that students would fail assignments with zero help at all. This class has the potential to be so good - but Dr. Ghassemi's character as a professor and a student leader makes me wish I saved myself the headache of taking this class.

Do not take 477; you WILL regret it. Like others have said, his grading is "all-or-nothing" and he'll take off points for miniscule things that aren't specified. The GitHub has many documented instances of his submission system breaking; students get zeroes despite having perfect assignments and he just goes "Sorry, you should've started sooner"
should be arrested for terrible grading system

Grading provides an inaccurate representation of work completed, and allows inconsistencies and subjectiveness. Although the all or nothing grading is transparent at the start, the unfairness and discrepancies his requirements presented were not. No student should have to avoid classes due to clear issues in a grading scale that can be improved.

Has a horrible all-or-nothing grading approach that's supposed to be rooted in "objectivity." Got a full 10 pts taken off solely because the background color of my site footer wasn't distinct from the body of the page (req nowhere in the rubric btw). Ironically, someone who didn't style their site at all would've gotten the same grade as me.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Had him for ISP-205.  Did appreciate dropping an exam and curving to 75% despite flaws.  Lectures were robotic and verbatim to slides, no real point in going.  Flipped exam to online two days before it was scheduled.  Limited exam ?'s to 1 at a time and no going back.  Acts offended when asked about accommodating different test taking strategies.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class was easy, but the professor is the most frustrating part. He never seemed to care when students were having technical difficulties and once said "I guess you won't be able to get the credit for this today." It was never made clear when assignments were posted. They're spread out over two websites so you have to regularly check yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He is a grad student that is required to teach a class and this is painfully obvious. He does not care about you or your grade and will essentially waste your time for every lecture all the exams are online. All lectures are him mumbling through slides in a monotone voice. Overall a terrible professor that you should avoid if possible.

Lectures are very monotone and boring, however, very easy online exams and attendance only somewhat required. If you have an attendance rate of 70% you get full credit. Very good for an easy 4.0. Weekly homework but nothing too complicated. Ideal workload for a pre-req class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: ISP 205 is perhaps the easiest yet also most frustrating course you'll ever take- the entire curriculum already exists WORD-FOR-WORD on Quizlet. Absolute disaster of a class- completely disorganized. You'll take an identical quiz twice every week, prof lectures like an actual robot, reads word for word off slides. Take a different ISP if you can

I lovingly refer to him as "walking melatonin" because he sounds like he woke up 30 seconds ago, someone pushed him into a classroom against his will, and he's forced to improvise a lecture. He clears his throat more than he speaks actual words. And I'm not being salty, I got an A, but this man made me lose my sanity, avoid him at all costs.

Professor Ali is a nice guy but his lectures are a lot of rambling and its not clear what he's talking about a lot of the time. There is an expensive course software that most of your work is done on, plan to use that for most of your learning. Everything is super disorganized. Quizzes on the software happen before he's even lectured about it.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. I had the misfortune of taking ISP 205 and even though it is a astronomy class, its basically physics. -100000/10 do not recommend. Had to pay $60 for a online subscription since he doesn't really use D2L. There is a expensive textbook you have to buy, but I found an online one. Only sign up if your hyper fixated on space;(

Visions of the universe: worst class of my life. He lectures till the last minute, rambling on and on. Be prepared to read the textbook on your own. The amount of work was exponentially higher than any other gen eds I've taken. Avoid at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Not very good at explaining anything

This course is awful, avoid LB physics like the plague, especially with this instructor. This course somehow managed to be both mind numbingly boring, extremely frustrating, and also insultingly easy at the same time. The entire instructional team was very disorganized and assigned homework seemingly at random without announcement.

Had him during FS21. Due dates constantly shifted, group projects were taxing and incessant, and our weekly homework assignments were riddled with errors. Scheduled a one on one meeting with him in person, but my grievances with the course fell on deaf ears. All of my peers dreaded coming to class. Take uni physics and save yourself the trouble.

Physics is not an easy subject to learn, but Ali definitely did not ease this process. His lectures are minimal and confusing, but it's the disorganization of the course that makes it so frustrating. The TAs are the only way you will learn, but the course is manageable to learn yourself. They are lenient with due dates. Try and get a different prof

Professor Ali is a nice guy but isnt the best instructor. The class was easy enough to do good on your own and you will work through examples in class to help but the professor does not do much in terms of teaching.
She was a really great professor. Material was a bit heavy (both in workload and that we had to read some triggering content), but she was very kind and caring to her students.
Great professor. She deserved more respect from my classmates and was pleasant to work with. Very sweet and is always willing to compromise.

Madiha was a wonderful professor. She is very knowledgeable about the subjects. She's very caring about her students and is always willing to work something out with you. She understands that life happens sometimes. My classmates gave her a hard time but I thought she was great to learn from.
One module a week with associated videos and short homeworks. Exams are relatively straightforward and open-note. Lectures are well-done, very kind professor, I dig the Bitmoji. Would take again.

The assignments are easy if you pay attention to the lecture videos. But the exams are hard, the questions are not studied in the course, and the assignments don't prepare you for them. Reading the chapters and closely paying attention to the lecture videos helps but the exams are still difficult. The learning guides also don't help much.

If you pay attention to the lecture videos and read the chapters in the textbook that helps, but the exams are difficult. The questions aren't studied in the course, and the assignments don't help to prepare for the exams. The assignments themselves are easy if you pay attention to the lecture videos.

Took this course for the business minor. Pretty straight forward, one module per week with three exams throughout the year. The exams are lockdown with a webcam so keep that in mind but overall pretty breezy.
Highly recommend this professor, easy A if you do your work which isn't hard at all

This class is so easy, his lectures are great, and the homework reflects the textbook. There's lots of extra credit so take advantage of that because you will almost 100% get an A if you do mid on the exams. But the textbook is a lot of money so beware
This class is very well organized and there are plenty of extra credit opportunities.

He is so kind and overall a great professor.  The class in formatted with in-class lectures, 5 team competitions, 3 exams, online extra credit, and weekly online assignments.  Not a super hard class but the exams do require studying and you will miss content if you skip class.  Lots of in-class participation and group discussions.
He is nice and caring. He offers a lot of extra credit opportunities. The class has a lot of fill in notes and 3 exams but they are pretty easy. Online class and its chill.
The professor went out of his way to make sure I could find a time to make up a missed exam. Great professor and person, 10/10

This class was pretty easy as it consisted of watching a video or two a week, then doing minimal homework. The videos were simple and matched the lecture guides which were helpful when not knowing questions on the exams. He offers a considerable amount of EC as well. Overall, the Professor is very helpful, knowledgeable, and wants you to succeed.

I would highly recommend taking Professor Harold in MKT 327 online. His lecture videos were very interesting and kept you engaged with the information. 3 Competitions a year over Zoom where you are put into groups and must create a marketing pitch for a certain company of your choice in a group of 5. Assignments can be completed in less than 40min
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You have to buy his textbook but his class was not hard if you even googled the terms he was using in the exams. I would definitely be ready to watch all the lectures and do the reading though. Highly recommend doing all of the extra credit. Easy class if you do that.

He's a funny dude that really cares about his students! Very open to feedback and makes the content easy to understand. He does sell his textbook for the class, but you can do just fine on the exams without it. There are lots of extra credit opportunities, but you really need to take good notes in order to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class is hard- the exams are best solely on what he says in his lecture videos so if you don't remember everything he said then you're screwed. He isn't a bad professor he is nice and helpful the exams just did me in everything else was pretty normal. but the READING so much reading- at least the quizzes are easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment:
This professor sells his own book on his class, and you have to buy it in order to do the HW. So on top of getting his salary he makes students pay 155 dollars so they can take his class.
A professor selling his own book for a class and making it mandatory should be against policies in MSU.

Prof Harrell is a great professor for online work. He's not only well respected but really cares about his students. He, as well as the mkt327 team, is very responsive to emails. Class is an easy 3.0-4.0 if you watch the lectures attentively. There are usually 3 20 minute videos and 3 short assignments per week with 4 exams overall.

I genuinely found this class interesting because of how much he cares. There's 3 lecture videos/week no more than 60 mins long, activities due on Friday's but you can do them as many times as you want to get a better score. I recommend watching the lectures more than once, take notes from the course pack to succeed. Overall, great prof and class!

One of the most impactful professors I have had at MSU. He's been teaching a long time and really knows what he's doing and cares about his students. I liked attending his class and found it engaging. Try to get him for an in person class if you can. Wouldn't call it a blow off class but its pretty easy if you pay attention and do some studying.

MK 327 with Harrell is pretty good! Weekly work consists of a few lecture videos (60ish mins) and 3 easy quizzes every week, if it's an exam week, you only have the exam to do! His lectures are pretty fun and engaging and I never found myself too bored with the content. It's important to watch the lectures and take notes to do well on the exams!

The notes and three assignments a week were easy and took like 30 minutes total a week. A big chunk of your grade is 3 exams who were kind of tough as they covered a lot of material. Just make sure to go to all three extra credit competitions and you should have no problem getting a 4.0 or 3.5. The professor is also very nice!

He is nice and gives lots of extra credit opportunities through optional zoom group projects marking PowerPoints. The weekly work is easy as all the questions for the quizzes (and exams) come from the online book and you just have to make a post on Packback about something youre curious about from the chapter. Highly recommend for an easy class.
Professor did a great job covering all the material in the lecture videos. Assignments and exams were straight-forward.

Great prof, lectures are pretty interesting and not too long. Homework only takes about ten minutes once a week and you get to check your answers before submitting, on top of that you get to drop like a third of them.

Dr. Gilstrap had great lectures and the class was very simple if you were willing to put in the work. Only took roughly an hour or two per week, mostly lecture quizzes and exams. Easy online asynch course for 2 credits. Recommend if you need an easy elective. Content was interesting at times also.
I mean it is world of turf. Not as easy as some make it out to be, but overall you should be ashamed of yourself if you don't earn a 4.0.

I took World of Turf because it is often referred to as "the easy online class" at msu. However, it is quite the opposite. Your grade is based heavily on exams & quizzes that you can rarely find the answers to online. Also people create quizlets with the wrong answers so dont trust those either. The prof is strict with grading and doesnt round.
Very easy elective to take. Loved the class. Lots of quizzes and discussion questions but they are easy and the quizzes you can take as many times to receive an A. Very hard to get below a 4.0.

He does an excellent job selling the subject to you and getting the students interested. The class is extremely easy; you can retake quizzes as many times as you want to get full credit and the exams are online and open note. I genuinely don't understand how anyone can get below a 4.0 in this class.

I LOVED watching his videos even if they were "boring" he is really sweet and caring. He's so interested in what he does which is inspirational. Easy class and actually very interesting. :) He smile at the end of each video is the best part btw!

This CSS course was by far the easiest course I have ever taken at MSU. Completely online, 1-2 10-question quizzes per week that are easily on Quizlet. Just one peer response and post. The structure is so simple and it is literally about the upkeep of keeping your turfgrass healthy. Such an easy class and you can easily get all your work done.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Be prepared for a ridiculous and somewhat confusing course structure. Pretty easy class. Not tech savvy teacher, but cant speak on him otherwise.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: What a wonderful guy, Learned a ton about lawncare. If you cant get an A+ in this class you need to apply yourself more.

Easy, but boring A. Weekly video lectures and slides, weekly quizzes, and 6 discussion forums (I doubt they actually read). It's true that the syllabus and calendar can be a little confusing, but it's honestly not that hard to follow. Just pay attention to the calendar that says when quizzes, forums, and exams open and close so you can keep up.
Would not add one point to final grade for a 4.0
This professor is not organized at all. He just posts a bunch of quizzes and forums and the due dates are not structured at all. This class is easy but pointless.

One of the easiest classes at MSU if you need the elective credit. It's all asynchronous so you work based on the recommended plan he provides. He also gives a lot of time for assignments and tests as well as a clear grading criteria for each grade cutoff. Theres nothing negative to say about him, 10/10 recommend.

This is probably the easiest course at msu. All you do is watch the videos or lecture slides, and do quizzes and exams which are based on that. You're basically teaching yourself. Also there are 6 forums that ask what you learned, I don't even think he reads the answers. Beware of missing deadlines, that's probably the only way to fail the class.
The class is really easy just keep up with everything. Each week maybe has 30 minutes of work outside of exams

Avoid this "professor" at all costs. He makes everything ridiculously more complicated than it needs to be. Everything in D2L requires some long explanation because of how he has it set up. It is evident that he has ignored student feedback because of his need to over-solicit the IT helpdesk on every assignment and post.

Class is highly standardized with substantial insulation between professor and student. The first lesson in this class is to not contact the instructor under any circumstances, with very few exceptions. He explicitly repeats this point in his many lengthy syllabus-like reqd. readings. Lecture heavy. Uncaring and intentionally impersonal. Absurd.
Never interacted with the prof. Class was set up to be pretty much automatic. Hands down the easiest course I have ever taken at MSU. Most days I completed my "coursework" in 10-20 mins.

Let me start saying that his course wasn't difficult. Extremely lecture heavy, outstandingly dull, and lead primarily through reading power point slides further increasing my boredom. The assignments are reasonable but be warned, a 4 question exam with an expectation of a paragraph answer to each prompt in under 15min time crunch is unreasonable.

I took this one credit class because I needed extra credit to graduate. This class seemed to be an easy option, but it was not. He makes you listen to him record grass for 2 hours each week and then gives super specific questions about his videos. When I did the extra credit, he didn't give full points, even after I emailed him I needed help. Awful

Ok let me start by saying that this class is easy and I got a 4.0. But what is the point!! Did I learn anything? The answer is no. The class is so Lecture heavy and you will be so bored. So, if you are not interested in grass DONT TAKE THE CLASS ITS A WASTE OF TIME. Take something else that interest you.

The professor is not helpful at all, but this class is so easy that in a sense you really don't need much help. The assignments are super easy, and 10 question quizzes after every lecture. Overall it's a good GPA booster, but very boring.

This has been my least favorite class at MSU. This teacher grades based on her opinions instead of the assignment criteria and it's obvious. Her class is so confusing because she does not explain anything. It is honestly the most dreadful hour and a half.

Prof Gibbons held a decently structured course. She is a bubbly person and humble. I found Project 3 to be poorly planned because of the little time and guidence we got for the workload. The guidlines for all of her projects are specific, yet hard to find in the D2L and sometimes confusing. If you ask questions and pay attention you will pass!

She is as loud and annoying as she wants, yet somehow still so boring. You can't stop her; she chooses your grade, it's best just to smile. She doesn't grade until the last week. I didn't know my grade until it was too late. This class ruined my 4.0. I thought I had an A up until the last week. I could've done better, but Gibbons needs to improve.

Professor Gibbons is very sweet and understanding, class is flexible to each student. You will do work in class, but if you just show up you will be fine. The class is project based but the way Professor Gibbons breaks it up makes them all easy! Honestly love her and I am not a writing major.
Very nice lady, cares about her students. Material can be unnecessarily excessive and confusing. Assignments homework about once a week. She is easy to talk to and accessible outside of class.

This course has been incredibly frustrating due to its confusing structure and excessive busy work. The assignments are unclear, making it difficult to grasp what's truly important. It needs a serious overhaul to focus on meaningful learning rather than just keeping students busy.

Worst prof I had at msu, this was more busy work than any other class i had. no syllabus, some assingments arent even on the calender on d2l. the worst is total bs busy work and its like shes trying to make every assignment confusing.

no syallbus, just some text posts about the course. she is terrible at organizing the d2l and so much of the assignments lack good instructions. its like she tries to make it as difficult and confusing as possible. worst teacher ive had at msu
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very sweet lady. I took 195 H and it was very fun. She is passionate and makes class entertaining.

Whilst there plenty of reading to do in the class, if you make a schedule, you won't be behind. She adapted the course schedule if we needed more time on projects and would let us submit things due before class, in class. She only graded the projects on an objective rubric and didn't let her own opinion get in the way of us getting good grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: My section was hybrid, so attendance was extra credit. She allowed revisions for 2 of the 3 projects, and she moved deadlines when the class needed it. She also gave 2 late passes. She's a really nice professor and super understanding. The only thing is that it took a while for my papers to get graded, but the feedback she gave was really helpful.

Shes a tough grader on papers. Its hard to get 100% on the papers but she grades fairly. She also gives out extra credit. She moves around deadlines by a day or two if the class is struggling with a topic because she wants everyone to succeed.
Great professor, but takes a really long time to grade papers.

Prof Gibbons is literally so nice and helpful when you reach out - you can tell she really cares about how you're doing and will provide accommodations for you if you need. It's really project-heavy and was pretty hard to stay motivated bc of online schooling but her zoom calls were very discussion-based rather than lectures so they were helpful!
Professor Gibbons is a great time. You have to go to this class though. She makes class fun and gives great feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Gibbons is awesome! We only had 3 major papers throughout the semester. The class is hybrid so we had discussion forums every week. You have to go to class though or your grade will suffer.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Awesome professor, very lenient with due dates and lets students make their own decisions on picking projects. Course was really easy as long as you keep up with the projects/due dates. Gives you a lot of time to revise your work, and offers second chance points. Easy 4.0 for WRA if you put in the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, she was very easy to access through emails and office hours. She assigned fun projects and gave lots of class time to work and edit papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment:
Professor MacDonald is one of the most engaging professors I've had the opportunity to learn from. Her expertise in the subject, particularly around AI concerns and digital methodologies, is evident in lectures as well as conversations. Her enthusiasm encourages a positive learning space.
10/10- I would absolutely take another course with her!

Prof seems genuinely nice and cares about students. No attendance policy but participation matters so make sure you talk. Exams are handwritten which sucks but all comes from lecture. Podcast was fun but took all semester

the midterm/final exam for this class were horrible, all questions were essay questions and you had to respond with at least three paragraphs for each, the final exam also had a argumentative essay question that had to be at least five paragraphs. I don't recommend taking this class to fulfill your ISS 300 level credit.
Professor MacDonald is a g

Not a bad professor but the final was a ridiculous test to take. 5 short answers, 2 medium answers and 1 argumentive essay all by hand. The lectures where engaging but the recitations are hard to sit through. Wouldn't recommend this class if you arnt up for a decently sized workload through the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I loved Gillian's lectures, attendance not mandatory but the tests are based on them. Tests weren't too hard, notecard allowed. The recitation however was awful and useless, and attendance mandatory. I also didn't enjoy the group project. But the lectures and professor were great.

Decent professor, Terrible Class. The professor has zero information on her slides, so to take notes, you have to keep up with what she says, which is impossible. Recitations are easy but pointless. THE EXAMS ARE SHORT ANSWERS, AND BY HAND THEY ARE TERRIBLE AND TAKE FOREVER. There is also a podcasting group project that takes the entire semester.
Great class, one of my favorites. Very little homework but lots of participation.

Wonderful prof who gives witty and engaging lectures.  Clearly cares about the material and did not grade harshly.  Assignments were light and easy.  Material was very interesting with lots of reading.

Professor Macdonald was extremely passionate about history and wanted us to do the best we could in her class. She admitted the lowest grade she would give was a 3.5 and offered opportunities to redo essays we did poorly on. She was very funny and engaged, wanting us to participate in discussions and lead class. Make sure to talk! She keeps track.
Not sure what others are on about. Engaging lectures, incredibly easy class. My grade never dipped below an A and I am not a particularly hard worker lol

Took this class for a ISS credit and regret it immensely, please listen to me and take a different ISS! Professor seems like a nice person but layout of class is very poor, it is basically impossible to get a 4.0, and lectures are just her talking...no powerpoint or anything, TA's also grade very hard, for example 93% is the cutoff for a 4.0.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I disliked this class, my worst yet. It was an ISS credit, and I regret taking it. The lectures lacked visual aids and were boring. Using analogies and images could have helped connect and visualize the content, aiding learning. While the teacher was enthusiastic, the lectures felt like reading a 5-page paper, making it hard to stay engaged.

Not the worst ISS course to take, most of the stuff you'll learn is from the lectures where the professor will just speak, no slides but did write key terms. 3 mini papers, 3 discussion leaders, storymap project, and a bluebook final is all required. Ok class if you can focus and show up every day, but the recitation is hard to sit through.

Hillery is an absolute gem. No student's opinion is ignored, and everyone is cared for. Hillery is flexible and understanding of things that come up, and has frequent and engaging class discussions. If you have the chance to take a class with them, do not hesitate to. Just make sure to speak up, or you won't get everything out of the class.

Students are penalized severely for “minor infractions,” such as being absent or missing a homework assignment. Three minor infractions automatically lower a student's grade by 0.5 without any warning. This creates unnecessary stress and makes it feel as though students must be perfect to succeed, rather than being encouraged to learn and grow.
Hillery Glasby was such an amazing professor, she was so caring and understanding and I would take her class again.

It was an easy class but Hillery would get so mad at us if no one would answer the question she said. I liked her but she seemed so passive aggressive most of the time. The assignments were really easy though.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hillery is quite flexible with the course schedule and adapts it based on the circumstances. There's a lot of readings, but they're for in-class discussions, so you don't have to read them. I would recommend reading them though to help guide your writer memos. The only thing I didn't love was the way she graded- with checkmarks instead of numbers.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I thought she is a good person. But, at times she lead discussions about cultural topics, but it was often hard topics that could make students uncomfortable. Also she didn't teach how to use certain applications necessary for assignments, which made it very difficult when the student didn't have a background in said application.

I enjoyed taking Professor Glasby's class. She pays attention to students and advocates for inclusivity. She thinks outside of the box and her projects reflect that. This course is project-heavy, with 4 projects to do during the semester. She allowed us to be creative with them so I didn't mind.

I was really, really excited for this course. Projects and assignments were fun. However, a classmate threatened me and when I reported it to Professor Glasby, she didn't do anything, even when I told her I felt unsafe. I didn't participate at all in class after this, just did the work. Still got a 4.0.

Prof. Glasby's courses are an easy set, but if you have any interest in Women's or LGBTQ studies, she's wonderful. Her classes are easy and don't have a ton of workload, but she's simultaneously very good at condensing complex ideas from different disciplines into digestible lectures.

Hillery made my first year at MSU great! The class size is pretty small so expect to participate/ be held accountable for missing work. She gives very meaningful lectures and leads students to question ideas in order to grow as individuals. We only wrote two essays and the rest were projects: which was different but fun in writing class.

Prof Hillery is very well respected and is very personable and engaging. Class size is a bit smaller so participation really matters. You really learn and understand a lot just by showing up and actively participating. A lot of peer reviews and working in groups. Gives great feedback and is always there to help

Hillary is an amazing professor! She goes out of her way to work with each and every student on all of the projects. She has a grading contract so if you try your guaranteed a 3.0, as long as you put effort into her course you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: All in all Hillery is actually a good professor. I would have loved her class if I had the same viewpoint as her, but since I do not some of the assignments were a bit more difficult. She has a grading contract, which is pretty confusing, and without real grades and clear criteria for assignments I don't really know how I'm doing in the class.

Hillery is a very caring professor. She is very focused on the success of her students. A lot of the projects are kind of vague in what exactly you need to do. With that said, I do appreciate how she put an emphasis on multimodal platforms instead of the usual essay writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Hillery Glasby really made my first semester at MSU great. Her projects were easy and I really looked forward going to class. She is SO accepting and understands if you are not the best writer. She really just wants her students to have fun while doing projects. If you are looking for a more creative WRA class, take it with her.
She cared a lot about her students. You can do acceptable work and still get a 3.0 lol. Fun projects to do.

I really like this professor. She cares A LOT about her students and their opinions. She spends most of the time in-class discussing and really enjoys it when people speak up to share their thoughts. She'll make you read articles and do a bit of homework and essays, though. If you try at least and show progression, it's a very easy class to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The kindest man I have ever met in my life. He fosters a safe, caring environment and enables us to talk about such heavy topics revolving school violence such as bullying, suicide, and school shootings. Best teacher ever.

He was a great professor and cared for his students. All of the assignments were very easy, he made a zoom for students who would miss class. I got a 100% in the class and thought it was very easy to read the book and do the 3 homework questions a week.
Glenn was a very nice guy and a good lecturer. The class was not set up super well, but he was encouraging and always had very informative things to say.

Dr. Stutzky is without a doubt the best professor I have had at MSU. He truly cares about every one of his students and his lectures and assignments reflect that. Lectures are a combination of casual notes/lecturing, class discussions, and personal stories from his experiences as a social worker. Assignments are all about listening to your thoughts

I love him! 10/10 would recommend him to anyone. Easy grader (literally gives 100% on every assignment) 
 and does not have a late penalty.
Literally my favorite professor! So nice and tells amazing stories. Such a easy grader and a amazing person.

Honestly, I did not like this class at all. It was an asynchronous format, and all of the assignments and exams came out of the textbook. Professor Stutzky did not record any lectures, and would rarely respond to emails. Though I took this class for credit, I couldn't help but feel like I wasted my money on it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: SW 200 with Stutzky was very easy. Exams were free response, open textbook, and asynchronous. Not a hard class at all. Stutzky was also very understanding and caring. He would often move the exams back if there were students having a hard time with their other classes. Homework was also really easy. They were textbook free response questions.

Stutzke was by far one of the best prof I've had at MSU so far. It was asynchronous for me, but you could still tell how much he loved what he was teaching and genuinely cared about his students and their wellbeing. It was a very easy layout, and extremely easy to pass. Really great guy who if you ask for help, he was more than willing to give it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: He is a wonderful professor. You can tell he loves what he does, and is truly passionate about social work. His expectations are clear,and as long as you complete the assignments you will do good. You have to take your own notes,so make sure you get the textbook! That part of the class sucked, but just split up the reading weekly and you'll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Stutzky truly cares about his students and if you have any issues or just want to talk he is willing to hear you out. The class is definitely based on tests and if you don't study you are going to do poorly on them and get a bad grade. Pretty lecture heavy, daily attendance, and a few one-page papers here and there. Pretty decent class, sweet guy.
Nice man but horrible prof, he goes off on tangents that aren't relevant to material and plays around too much. Get ready to teach yourself everything you need to know.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A very sweet guy who brings real life into lecture. When the hurricane hit Puerto Rico, he dedicated the whole class period to how the course and the event are interrelated which brought the class views into perspective.

He is very passionate about social justice. Some of what he lectures on is on the exams but you'll have to read on your own to get the info and charts. Participate and go to class, do the extra credit(its easy).

The class had one big, major paper as an assignment split up into smaller papers. Each paper built upon the preceding paper. Glenn NEVER gave feedback on a paper prior to the next one being due, so you never knew if you were on the right track. He was out of state and even country through much of the class. He never responded to emails.

Glenn is SUPER sweet. He clearly loves what he does and he is always happy to help you out. His lecture class is huge but I went to his office hours once and he took the time to remember my name. He gets very into his teaching and becomes very passionate in the middle of his lectures.

Glenn is an amazing professor! Really fun and easy going guy. He understands that life gets in the way. You have to go to class to pass but it's easy to pass his class. It's a really enjoyable class. Btw he likes zombies and walking dead!
Glenn is the reason I switched into the social work program at msu, he is a wonderful teacher and is very accessible to his students. 10/10, Glenn!

Glen is a great prof. He loves what he does and wants others to feel the same for the subject. He tends to go off topic a lot and his way of taking notes is different. As long as you read the chapters and go to class you will do fine. Super nice guy and makes his class interesting and fun. Im taking another class with Glen.

If you have to take this class with him, make sure to buy the book it's the only way you can learn the material. He writes down like three words from one paragraph that he says. It's easy to pass this class but you have to do it ALL on your own. He talks a lot about stuff that has nothing to do with the class.

The class was set up for us to read a couple chapters each week on our own and discuss everything during class time which was twice a week. The discussions were really interesting. Dr. Chambers does a great job at making history interesting and relevant. There is no homework other than the readings and exams.

Professor was not very good at getting back to you through emails. The "textbooks" are actually books that you read chapters from and then write essays based on the books. I felt like this was much more of a history class that the culture class it was suppose to be. Professor was very funny and relatable though and made lecture fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Basically your only grades are the exams which are 8 page papers, doesn't post any grades so you don't know how you're doing, and there is absolutely no structure to the lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Chambers is a good professor. He is very relaxed and seems to have a genuine passion for the course content. However, it seems like he puts all of the grading and class work on his TAs. Mine was a horrible grader and I wish he could've been the one to have input on his students' work. Other than that, fine teacher. I liked him!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--SO MANY PAPERS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr.Stutsky was kind! Attendance isn't required. We only used our book for the Time to Think assignments. He really enjoys students participating so please do if you can! He took a while to grade and respond to emails but that's understandable because he didn't have a TA this semester. Take the class! Super easy!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Insanely easy class with all assignments and exam questions pulled directly from the textbook. Great course for those in majors other than social work in the college of social science
This professor is awesome!  One of the best I've ever had!  He is extremely knowledgeable, quirky, fair, approachable and so kind.  I truly enjoyed this course.
This man is adorable, kind, and quirky. Class is easy but attendance is 1 point per class which is annoying when you're like me and have a tendency to sleep through your alarm
He is a great professor who really cares about his students and is passionate about this topic. He always tried to make class interesting. He was my favorite professor this semester.
Great Teacher who cares about his students!
No Comments
He rocked.... seriously one of the best prof's Ive had at MSU...
Very easy to listen to, easy class. Tries to make lectures interesting.
Terrible lectures.  Another cog in a social work program where students don't count.

Dr. Glew is the BEST! She cares so, so much about her students and about what she teaches, and it pours out in every lesson. She is so understanding and very attentive to the needs of her students. I would recommend her a thousand times to any TE student. I dont have enough good things to say about her.
She's literally is one of the best professors I've ever had. Really eye opening stuff.

Margo is so amazing! There is a lot of reading in the homework assignments but most of it is pretty interesting so it's not too bad. She's pretty easygoing with late work (within reason)Her zoom calls were by far my favorite and she did a great job of making the class feel as much like in-person as possible. I 100% recommend her for your TE class!!

One of my favorite professors! She is honestly very sweet and understanding. There is some reading involved but she does a good job of not overworking you. Nothing but positive things to say about her. If you're looking for an amazing professor she's the one. Be sure to read what she assigns since she will be talking about them in class.

Margo is an amazing professor! Her lectures typically always follow the assigned reading, so the reading is very important.  All the work I had to do in her class never seemed pointless and everything connected back to the overall theme of the class or topic being discussed. Her grading is not very harsh either.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is a great professor.  However, if you want to be spoon fed, then select a different class.  This class is for people who want to be successful in the real world
She isn't the greatest all around teacher but it is an easy A and she is a good person.
She doesn't teach, she sits there while we "talk" in groups.  She is awful and very unhelpful.
Ditto to the first comments. AWFUL AWFUL AWFUL!!!
This was the most pointless class ever!

I had her for MC 231. Professor Goett is very knowledgeable and detail oriented. She talks a lot in her lectures though and is a very tough grader on her essays. She is understanding, but as a professor is tough. She's always looking for us to think deeper and go into more detail, which isn't bad just harder. Overall, great!
I took her for MC 331. she will leave you completely unprepared and is unpredictable with grading. Very tough grader no matter how hard you try.

Lectures were super engaging. She knows her stuff, but she actually explains it in a way that makes sense (which is hard to come by for JMC). If you're a CCP major you need to take a class with her. For non-CCP majors, her course material is heavily CCP so you may be missing some background knowledge to fully succeed.

Professor Goett was an absolutely amazing professor to have. She's extremely accessible outside of class and her office hours are IMMENSELY helpful. The readings she selected for her class were digestible and interesting. She is very understanding when it comes to absences and will do what she can to help you not fall behind if you miss class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is set up exactly like a jmc Senior Seminar. I would recommend avoiding this class if possible. Professor Goett wasn't understanding and offered little support on assignments.

This class was mandatory. I did not love her or the class; however, the class part wasn't her fault. She was the leader of all MC 201 and she didn't really know many answers to a lot of the questions. Professors my friends had were way easier graders.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Prof Goett Is a great Professor! She's very knowledgeable and passionate about her work. She is a hard grader but will help you improve over the course of the semester!

Professor Goett shows great interest in the subjects that we study and is very charismatic. However, the feedback that she provides on papers are minimal and is unclear regarding her expectations for assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Goett is a professor who is intimidating in intellect but approachable in personality. It is clear to see how passionate she is about what she teaches and it makes it that much more enjoyable to learn from her. She knows what she is looking for grading wise and is firm, but is reasonable in what she expects from students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: There is a great sense of agency in her lectures: when it comes to Latin American studies, nobody in the 201 crowd is more qualified to teach. Our case study in Bolivia was particularly one of the shining moments of the Semester. As a section leader, the class is doable. Do the reading posts and read a fair amount of the text and you'll do well.

I love Professor Goett! She is seriously one of the most intelligent people I have ever met. Her feedback on papers is good, but she's even more helpful in office hours where she willingly reads over parts of your papers to give more feedback. It's very obvious that she cares about each student's success a lot, too. Totally recommend!

She's really good, and she helps clarify the reading that we did for lecture. She's one of the professors who helps you understand instead of just making you ask questions and figure it out on your own. I really really like her. And she's super nice.

Goett is definitely someone you want in your corner. Her classes are very well organized, but she does not hold your hand through anything. If you put in the work, you will see fair grading and positive results. She has a very good sense of humor and is definitely qualified to teach anthro related topics. Be prepared to participate.

Saulo Gouveia was a really great professor. Every week there was a reading then a discussion post. Really straight forward IAH id take if you can. At the end there was an essay that was a little bit confusing...
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I LOVED Professor Gouveia! For an IAH class, it was extremely easy, and you can really tell he enjoys and cares about this topic a lot. He gives incredible feedback on each discussion post, given he writes PARAGRAPHS for his responses. No complaints. Literally got a 100% in the class. It seems like he truly loves what he's doing.

This is an online asynchronous class. Dr. Gouveia seemed very knowledgeable about the subject, and even though I am not usually interested in IAH material, the readings for this class were enjoyable. Dr. Gouveia was also very understanding when I went through a period of grief and helped me get back on track.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: IAH207 was a fun class but had a lot of reading. Professor Gouveia was a great teacher and very interactive for teaching an asynchronous class. Good prof and does a lot of work for the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Honestly a super chill and easy fun class to take!

Overall, an easy course; the reading is fairly intense, but that is the nature of IAHs. His grading is arbitrary and not consistent among students. However, when/if he marks you down, bring it to his office hours 1-on-1 and you'll "correct it" in front of him, in person, and he'll update your grade. He gave an average 3.388 GPA for 260 students.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This was an easy A or I thought until the last two weeks of the class-the professor did not know his own grading rubric, super disorganized and everything is based off of a super unspecific essay. Boring class mostly him talking at the class and the rest of the class is old Portuguese films-DONT TAKE

i've had two online classes with her and both times she's been an extremely difficult prof to work with. will not answer any emails, even if you follow up. if your assignment is even one minute late you're getting graded at 50%. puts the least amount of work into her job as possible then expects us to do the most. class is 5 assignments all online

i mean its a 1 credit class. all online. if u dont go to the zoom nothing happens. i would turn it on and go back to sleep. assignments took 15 mins. prof was nice but kind of annoying. if u go to every zoom u get extra credit.
She's a good professor. The class is really easy. It's important to show up to receive in class assignments. Group project went smoothly and was fun. There are no quizzes.

The content itself is fine. However, Dr. Grace is disorganized and does not prepare you as well for her exams I'd like. She gives a few practice problems but they are often not what's actually on the exam. That said, she is willing to give you extra help if you ask for it and genuinely cares about her students. Put in extra time outside of class.

This class was honestly pretty easy. She covered everything very clearly in lecture that would be on exams, homework wasn't hard, and there was a good amount of extra credit. Gave us a sheet of notes for every exam, would have died without those though.
Hands down the best professor I have ever had. She cares a lot about her students and their success in the course.

Dr. Grace is a wonderful genetics professor. She is super kind and goes out of her way to make sure you have every opportunity to succeed and understand course material. I have only had great interactions with Dr. Grace, and would highly highly recommend taking classes with her.

I am in her genetics class right now (spring 2025) and she is by far my favorite professor I've had so far for science classes. Her lectures are easy to follow and the assignments/partner quizzes are so helpful in learning the material. She is also very understanding and if a topic is confusing she gives extra help instead of just moving on.

Very fair professor, content itself is easier compared to other courses I've taken at MSU but covered very well. Mainly graded by exams/tests around 14% from homework so little room to mess around with exams. Has the Lazarus method option as well where she replaces all your previous exam scores with your final score. Extra credit offered as well.

The tests are weighted a lot but professor uses Lazurs grading so last exam can replace the first 2. Really caring professor with a clear syllabus and guidelines. Easy to follow along and offers practice for exams that are similar to questions being asked during the exam. I would 100% recommend her.

This class was the most challening of my course requirements however, professor Grace was amazing. I retook this class and she was infinitely better than the previous professor I had. She goes over problems with you, provides a lot of practice, was communicative outside of class, and she made the hard stuff seem doable. I really appreciated her!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Really nice prof, felt extremely comfortable in class. Only 2 exams, and like 4 assignments. Really great class. There is some group work.

I really liked this professor. He knew what he was talking about and could explain it really well. The class was easy as long as you put in the work of paying attention during class. Assignments were not hard, and the exams were easy.

Great class. It was hybrid so we only had one day in person, you get two attendance drops in person and one for online assignments. The online assignments are easy and graded based on completion. Make sure you check over breaks though like spring break because he did assign stuff. Overall easy 4.0 and interesting.
beast. take this class. he wants you to succeed.

Steven's class was pretty easy overall, and the exams were manageable to study for and do well on. However, he's very strict about deadlines—I turned in one assignment late and lost 50%. He also joked about students' excuses early on, which was disappointing, though he's otherwise funny and engaging.

Very chill and funny professor. Class was once a week and usually involved him teaching and encouraging class discussion. Homework and midterm/final are very easy to study for and do well on. He is very kind and likable.

He was super laid back and easy going. Exams (only a midterm and final) were based off of online homework material which was taken for completion. He was super engaging and his goal was for us to do well. He was also super into what he was talking about which made it a lot easier to pay attention
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Is there a chapter of a textbook due along with three quizzes each week? Yes. Was this class also my favorite one to date? Also yes. He does his best to make sure that the lectures are entertaining, and makes the information easily digestable. Participation doesn't matter but it helps make the lecture more engaging. Accessible outside of class too.

He was a great professor, very honest, funny, and had a good class structure. the HW was easy, the assignments were easy and the exams were easy. The only bad thing was that I think he should have used a microphone because It was hard to hear him sometimes. other than that it was a great class.

Professor Gray was extremely kind and his lectures were always informative and to the point. Attendance was mandatory but you had two skips if you needed. The tests were also straightforward and he prepared you for them a lot the week before. Overall the class was a light workload and worth taking!

very easy. The only assignments were weekly quizzes, which were open-note. Dr. Grandy is a very sweet lady and builds the curriculum around what the class wants to learn about. One thing I will mention, she is pretty soft spoken and monotone, so it is fairly easy to get distracted and not pay attention in lecture. But overall, shes a good professor

The kindest professor I have ever had the privilege of having at msu - had her for GEO 235 last semester and GEO 435 this recent semester. Beyond genuine and caring, with assignments that make sense. I'd recommend her to anyone!!

super caring and understanding of life! class can be taken on top of other classes and still succeed. lectures are so boring but you just gotta get that attendance point and youre good. exams in person but two hours of studying before and youre golden. provides study guide that is almost the exam. very easy and very nice professor. easy 4.0

She is a very sweet woman, lectures can be very boring, however attendance is required and based on participation this is for 50 points of your grade. Her midterm and final are in person, do the study guide and you will be fine. If you can't attend the lecture join her zoom link or email her she's understanding! The 3 assignments are easy.

Professor Grady's class was pretty good. The material is very easy to understand, but the lectures are extremely boring in my opinion. She also switched the 2 exams to in person this semester, however the quizes are still online. Overall this class was good.

She is a great professor and the material is structured in a way that makes it easy to understand and get a good grade in the course. Attendance is part of the grade, but she provides a zoom link for days when you're sick or can't get to class for whatever reason.

Dr. Grady is truly one of the best professors at MSU. She cares about all of her students and she makes that clear. When you take her for an elective, she knows it's just an elective so the workload is light. She's really passionate about what she's teaching so her lectures are always very interesting. I strongly recommend taking a class with her!

dr. grady is really nice and i wish all my professors were like her! she's super caring and you can tell she's passionate about what she's teaching. although attendance wasn't mandatory, i still went because she genuinely made it interesting and made me want to go to class. she's accessible both in class and outside of class.

Sue is the sweetest professor I have had. She cares a lot about the success of her students but also about their wellbeing. When you have her for an elective course she understands it is simply an elective course so the workload is incredibly light and easy. I highly recommend that everybody take at least one class with her. She brightens your day.

Very simple class, there's 2 exams, 4 homework assignments, and participation. Class always goes the full time and lectures can be boring, but she is super nice, caring, and a clear/easy grader. As long as you study an hour for each exam, it should be an easy A. Highly recommend this class.

I didn't think I would be interested in learning about health geography until I took Dr. Grady's class! She gives constructive feedback on assignments, and if you have a question, she is always willing to help and answers in a timely manner. She also values all students' POVs and encourages sharing them. If this class fills a requirement, take it!

She is amazingly sweet, and the class has some pretty interesting material. Great class to take if you want an introduction to medical geography. Attendance is mandatory but flexible. I would advice to participate in class to make the lectures more interesting because she has a lot of geography knowledge just waiting to share.

Overall, great professor. There were 4 assignments and 2 exams. The assignments were simple and she provides a study guide for the exams that were very helpful. Attendance was mandatory, but if you emailed in advance you would be excused. I did use the book, but you could get by without it. Class was lecture heavy. There was lots of extra credit.

She was an amazing teacher and extremely sweet! She really wants all of her students to pass her classes and is helpful if you reach out. Very fair with grading assignments and allow you to resubmit work if you correct errors!

(GEO 235 not 435) She is so incredibly sweet. She cares so so much about her students and is honest about the work she teaches. Opens discussions in class, and really wants to get to know you. Lecture heavy but the assignments were interesting. Such an amazing lady.

Dr. Grady is such a sweet professor. She is very understanding and kind, and will work with you to accommodate you. She wants all her students to succeed. I took her for GEO235, and haven't regretted it at all. If you have the chance to take her class, do it. She really cares about her students mental health and wellbeing.

Professor Grady is the sweetest person! She really cares about her students and what she is teaching. She used to be a nurse so she has real experience in the medical field. She gives you a lot of chances for extra credit and is super understanding with late work! Her GEO 235 class is hard at times, being a freshman, but she is a great teacher!

You have to love her! Shes absolutely amazing and the way she structures her tests, assignments, and class make you actually excited to learn! She is so understanding with literally anything and will help and accommodate all your questions and needs. Loved this class!

She is the sweetest lady. I absolutely loved her. She tends to ramble sometimes but it is just because she is so passionate. If you pay attention or go through lecture slides on your own the material is easy to understand. Lots of opportunities for extra credit. Also very understanding and accommodating with current events, replied to emails! 10/10
Prof. Child clearly cares about his students and his subject matter. I didn't personally enjoy his lectures or teaching style but he was flexible and communicative.

Greg is a super kind person but lectures can feel like they drag on. If this class wasn't with Greg I don't think I would be as motivated to do my work, however I don't know if I would want to take another class with him. He has great insight and cares about the content but holds you until the final seconds of class (not that they have to end early
Greg has been great in both 341 and 342! Show up to class with some knowledge of the readings and you're fine!
If you participate and ask questions, you'll succeed!

Dr. Child's lectures are amazing. It's clear he's passionate about the subjects he teaches and he has great information and resources for students to look into and use. He loves participation and his lectures are always very exciting. Show up to class, participate, and complete assignments- you'll do great. Great professor!

Child is incredible, best TE 341 prof. Very cool, kind, understanding, and knows how to run a good TE class. Assignment and homework intensive but he is supportive of any help needed and he grades extremely well. Lectures are cool and interactive. Definitely take Child if you want an easy (so long as you participate well) 4.0, he's awesome.

Professor was okay. The main issue was the amount of unnecessary time spent in class. The course could've been fully online since there wasn't much taught in the class, rather it was just the professor stating what the next project was and the requirements. She also grades assignments pretty late and makes everyone work in groups often.
professor was ok, lots of group work though, if you coast you'll get a b, try hard and you'll get an A, super nice and lenient
Professor is very helpful and work criteria is easy to understand. Lots of homework each week and grade is heavily dependent on the papers.

Honestly Ms. Walter is an amazing teacher! She allows multiple revisions of projects and their reflections, plus the work is fairly easy. Now one thing I will say that I disliked is that she grades VERY late. Assignments from January did not get graded until end of March/April(basically the end of the semester).

Loved this class! She was so sweet and truly cared about her students. Getting a 4.0 is easy if you make sure you hit all of the requirements in her papers! Lots of group work and collaboration with classmates. Would 100% recommend
Easy class, very involved with the learning.
Grace was so sweet! Her class was easy, as long as you participate you'll get a good grade.

has a ego and it's clear by the way he treats his students after communicating with him to fix a grading mistake that he made He sent me an email lacking professionalism, then after I approached him in class to follow up on my grade he created an awkward situation in front of my other classmates

Greg is a great professor! He knows the industry inside and out, so he's super knowledge and does his best to prepare students for the real world. Everything is group project based. He does give the option to work alone, but the projects can be a lot for a single person to do, so just hope that you get a good group.

The best class I have ever taken at MSU. Greg is a tough grader but it all comes from experience and prep for the real world. He knows the industry and knows how to not waste our time. He stands on the fact of No tests or readings, just experience. He gets a bad rep for being tough but it really helps. Greg was able to even get me a job! Do take!
He's so mean first off. He makes you present and never has anything good to say.

Professor Taucher is a very knowledgeable and good lecturer. This class is all group projects that are very reflective of what you would see and do in the real world. Be prepared if you present for constructive criticism because he will tell you what's on his mind. However, he is probably the best speaker and professor I have ever taken.

Professor Taucher needs to retire. He's a complete narcissist. He insulted me and many of our classmates on several occasions. He is a bad lecturer and says nothing of substance so you learn nothing about advertising. His random attendance checks are also unfair. The peer evaluations literally force you to fight with your group members as well.

Yes, he is tough, but the projects reflect what you do in the real world. His lectures weren't my favorite, but the projects are meaningful if you put effort in.
