He is very cool and his lectures are interesting to learn about. He is also very understanding and does show leniency. I would highly recommend him for any student that has to take an ISB course.
His passion for the course is infectious. The only thing to be wary of is pop quizzes.
Good professor, better human being. Easy class if you have a few brain cells. Show up, there are pop quizzes. Sometimes curves test grades, offers select opportunities for bits of extra credit.

I very much enjoyed this class. I only took it because I had to for a requirement but I enjoyed it much much more than I thought I would. It is important to go and listen to the lectures but everything he talks about is in the exams and there were no surprises for me.

Everyone that's saying "this class is all memorization and not understanding concepts" is completely wrong, I finished this class with a 100% and cant remember my name most days. If you understand the concepts there is no reason that this class will be hard. Most of the "pop quizzes" you get 100 for just doing it, same for homework. Best professor.

Prof K is getting a lot of hate here so I wanted to defend him a bit. He is a fun guy and loves what he teaches and his material is not difficult. Students who struggled with the class did what he said not to do and spent class taking notes instead of just listening to his lectures. Go over the lectures again to study and the class is an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Awesome person, super interesting Lectures. All you need is flashcards. Does not allow computers during lectures, all handwritten notes which I typically converted into flashcards. USE FLASHCARDS!!!

I loved Professor K because his classes are always super fun and interesting. He is also a super funny guy and I will really miss having him. The class is pretty easy if you stay on track I never felt like he asked for too much of his students. Definitely take his class if given the opportunity.

Dr. K was a very fun professor, I recommend taking this course. I found it pretty interesting. There are in-class pop quizzes, if you are there in class, then you will get 100%. Very lecture heavy, so make sure you attend class. He explains the material and what he means in the slides in class, so reading just the slides will not help.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr K is a very well meaning man with an absolutely abysmal teaching style. He insists on having you learn "full concepts as opposed to memorization" then makes tests 100% based on memorization (e.g. having multiple choice be a-h and you have to select a+b, b+c etc). His class was overly difficult for being a gen-ed course, and I don't recommend it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Really loved his class! Dr. K made learning about bugs super fun, he wants you to be successful and all you need to do is go to class to understand everything. Not too much homework, a couple pop quizzies, and lots of extra credit on tests!! Really enjoyed him as a professor.
Class is entirely based around memorization. Topics felt more like trivia than course materials.

Only took this class to get my ISB credit but was honestly worth it. He is such a funny guy that really cares about his students. He occasionally gives homework that is relatively easy. Four tests and a couple quizzes. Super easy class if you go to every lecture.

I don't recommend this prof at all. Has nothing to do with insects it's completely environmental and ecosystem-based. He gives lots of homework and always has pop quizzes so you don't miss class. He's overly nice to fill in for the fact he wants to confuse you on the exams. Not an easy 4.0.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Such a great professor. His lectures are awesome and you can tell he really cares about his students and loves his job. While attendance was not mandatory there were pop quizzes so that is something you should take into account. Defiantly would take him again given the chance.
Chose a different professor for this class, he is a great dude but terribly tough prof, so many exams and they are long and difficult. I attended every class yet still continued to do bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Beware of his exams and expect to actually have to try super hard. There is no way you can get an easy 4.0 I am a 4.0 student and I struggled to keep my head above water. Im praying I do well on the final but his exams are awful, he expects you to be an environment science major apparently.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr, K is a super nice guy and for the most part understanding but his class was awful. I attended every lecture, completed all the homework and studied yet I could never do well on the multiple choice of the exam. He purposely tries to confuse you by using answers like a, b, c, a and b, a,b,c, a,b,c,d so even when I knew the content it was hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I would never recommend this for an ISB, it was so hard especially if your major is no where close to insects and sustainability. We spent so much time on sustainability and it was not easy at all a lot of science heavy content that was then tested on exams with multiple choice with a million different answer choices
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He gives random pop quizzes so you should attend every lecture because the day you dont you will have one, his exams were awful in person, scantrons with a written portion as well. I attended every lecture yet I kept doing worse and worse on the exams. Tough prof for sure
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The exams were awful, in person, scantrons that consistented of 40 or more multiple choice questions that had 7 different answer choices. I went to every single lecture yet I consistently couldnt keep my head above water. I took this class due to the other reviews on here but my experience was nothing similar.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Ryan's classes are not difficult and are actually interesting. He is a nice guy and gives you everything you need to know for the exams in his lectures. He posts the lectures online, so I would recommend not trying to take notes while he teaches and just to listen, because the material is not heavy and can be digested well by just listening.

Ryan was a great professor. He was funny and down-to-earth. The class is easy as long as you show up to the lecture, he has pop quizzes during the lecture, then you will be fine. If you have any issues in the class go to him right away and he will try his best to help. Would recommend taking one of the ISB courses for your prereqs!

Easiest test ever, he gives you 24 hours to take them with open notes. His lectures are optional but they're helpful for test. On the test there's a couple questions he only answered in class. Overall easy class and would take again.

Ryan is one of the nicest professors I understand. He makes you want to pay attention and participate in class. I took it online (obviously given the circumstances) and he was so understanding and kind to everyone. We often start class with a song of his choice and it makes your day. My only complaint is his exams are a little difficult.

Ryan was a pretty good professor throughout, he is definitely passionate about what he teaches which makes this course a lot easier to get over with. The class isn't really about bugs all throughout so that's kind of the only off thing. He also got rid of the final and pop quizzes this semester, not sure if he'll do the same for the spring semester
He has been the funniest prof I have had in years. Dr. K cares about your education, and his class was easy and fun.

Dr. K was a really great professor. It's an easy 4.0 as long as you show up to class. He was really funny and it was one of those classes where I feel like I actually learned. He did have a lot of pop quizzes, though, so be prepared for that.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amazing-- Ryan is so passionate about what he's teaching. He makes bugs so fun, and it's a super easy 4.0. If you have a 4.0 before the final, you don't have to take it which is always nice

I definitely recommend you choose professor Kimbirauskas for ISB class. First, he is a really fun and nice guy. Even though the class is about insects, he makes it really interesting. Exams are really easy as long as you pay attention in class and go over the slides. Because of how easy his class is, It helped me focus on my other classes.

Homework most of the time after each class but fairly easy. Attendance not required but dont except to pass if you dont go to the lectures. Really nice and funny guy, enjoys participation. Test can be hard but are fair.

He really tries to relate to his students and uses words like crap. He can be funny or sometimes try to be and fail. The lectures were what helped me pass the tests, if I hadn't gone to the lectures I would have probably failed. Overall all a good teacher, in love with the topic, and fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher. I had an 8am course with him and his lectures would actually keep me engaged. His tests were the hardest part of the class since his multiple choice questions usually have six or seven potential answers to them. Only other thing to watch out for are his pop quizzes, which can really help your grade if you just go to class.

He is an awesome teacher. He loves what he is doing and makes his class very entertaining. There are pop quizzes every once and a while, but they are usually very easy. I am not a biology major, yet I would take another class that is taught by him because I learned so much from him!

Overall, a great professor. Attendance is mandatory, though it's not bad since the lectures are actually interesting. It's easy to listen and pay attention, he explains everything very well. Very fair grader and actually cares & wants you to do well. Highly recommend this class to anyone that needs to complete an ISB
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Definitely the best professor I have ever had. You need to attend class because of pop quizzes, but it isn't that bad because he makes it interesting. Do the homework and study what he gives you, you'll be fine. However, make sure to double check your exams when you get them back, the TA's messed up my scores multiple times.

He's really chill, and funny. There are a lot of pop quizzes though, so if you don't go to class you can miss them. As long as you pay attention in lecture and study tests are pretty easy. A good amount of homework is given, but it's graded easily and is easy to do. Class is straight points so just do the homework and study and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Coolest guy ever I would definitely take again. Very funny and keeps the lectures light because it is interesting stuff. If you just do the bare minimum of what he asks you will do fine. Very chill and laid back and will help if you need it.

I absolutely hated science and everything about it but this class is amazing! He is a great professor that makes the material interesting and keeps the class motivated. He is not a hard grader, as long as you know you're stuff then you are fine. I recommend this class If you need to take an ISB.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Students tend to like him because he's "relatable" which is fine but he tries a bit too hard imo. His grading is unusually harsh, I got half the points taken off a correct answer because I didn't put it in bullet point format. He acts like he's a college student which can be annoying.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: He is literally the most inspirational man I have ever met in my entire life I love him so much. He genuinely cares how his students do and wants to see them learn and succeed. Please take his class it will make you love going to class and hes just a great guy to talk to.

He rocks, he's passionate, he'll try to connect with you, and he'll do his best to make it enjoyable. His exams are tough, he's the type to give options A-G where D is A&B, E is A&C, F is B&C, and G is All the Above. So you gotta know your stuff and be prepared to explain in detail. He assigns homework and give pop quizzes but he warns you.

He's the toughest grader I've ever had. This class is so unnecessarily and excessively difficult for a required freshman level class. I'm a senior graduating this semester and this class is going to ruin my GPA for the term because his grading is bogus. Even with knowing the material and studying I almost failed every exam because of his grading.

You do have to pay attention and really learn the material to do well, but he's pretty funny, makes a lot of jokes, and is really helpful. If you have to take an ISB, I'd recommend taking 201 with Ryan. You'll do well and he makes it interesting even if you're not big into biology and environmental science.
Ryan is awesome. It's an easy A if you attend lecture. No book, so that's nice. Occasional pop quiz, but rarely ever. He's very funny and makes learning fun, interactive, and valuable.

He truly cares about the learning of his students and makes class extremely interesting. Would take again! Attendance is not mandatory however there are occasional quizzes at the beginning of class covering homework or last lecture. No textbook for this class.

I had no prior interest in anthropology, but she made the class engaging and approachable. Her lectures were organized and easy to follow, and she created a relaxed learning environment. The workload was manageable with weekly Top Hat assignments and discussion posts, and the exams were straightforward if you kept up with the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Although this class was not the most interesting the work was minimal each week and the exams were online.

There was a lot of homework and exams, but the professor dropped a lot of stuff, and the exams were easy if you knew the information. The class is easy to manage as long as you pay attention to due dates. Dr. King gives you a week/month for each assignment, depending on the assignment. Overall, a really good professor.
Great lady, really funny. Lectures were interesting and quizzes/ exams were easy and open-note. Only one other assignment that was fun, easy, and interesting. Easiest class I've taken, easy 4.0

If you can get past dropping $70 to do homework, its an easy class. You learn a lot about anthropology and Dr. King is pretty passionate about it. Almost everything is online, but you have to come to class in order to get participation. 4 units with accompanying exam, quiz, and homework modules. Follow her rubrics/guidelines and you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Good 8 am class to have.

This class is very easy but there is a lot of homework that counts toward your grade. Quizzes and exams are taken in your own time so they are open book and straightforward as long as you take notes from the textbook and attend lectures. She uses an app to ask questions for class participation which also goes toward your final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Very easy class that can be done online, and all the tests and quizzes are open note. The weeks you have a test she cancels class for the week. Also she would end class at least 30 minutes early all the time
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Dr. King's class was very fun and eye-opening. Lecture participation questions via TopHat are worth points, so please go. Readings could be a bit heavy (several articles/papers each week), but once you get the hand of efficiently reading them, they aren't bad. Quizzes and tests were very manageable and online. Great class overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: All online open note tests and assignments were easy.

She was a pretty good professor! I will say her lectures did feel like they were dragging on, but she seems very passionate about what she was talking about. there was one writing assignment, but she gave you a bunch of options, and it was pretty easy. All of her tests were online/open note.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is based on weekly PackBack assignments (1 drop), 4 exams (1 drop), 4 quizzes (1 drop), one essay (less than 200 words), and TopHat in class questions for participation. Exams/quizzes are online and open note. Weekly readings were sometimes a lot, but you could skim them and still understand the material. Lectures were boring at times.
Loved her, I'd take her class again. She's retiring soon and that makes me sad.

Dr. King is very sweet, but if you have no interest in this subject, please do yourself a favor and find another ISS. The lectures are long and can be boring if you aren't genuinely interested in anthropology. Still, I managed to get a 3.5 in the class not being very interested. She uses TopHat and online assignments.
Turns in grades very late, she is pretty laid back and attendance isn't mandatory but gives bad feedback on projects.

Dr. King is a sweet person and she teaches very nicely despite not a lot of people participating. She's relaxed in all the good ways. You can miss the participation and still 4.0. Her work is doable, or else I couldn't have added this class on. It's the weight it should be. Exams are doable, class is canceled. HW is HW but she sets up for success.
Chillest prof ive ever had. It can be boring but no more than any other iss classes.

King is maybe the most chill and laid back professor at state. All quizzes and exams are open note and technology. class is cancelled the whole week for exams. Homework every week, and a big top hat assignment due before each exam, not hard, but time consuming. attendance isn't required but there are participation points you will miss if you skip.

Simple weekly discussion posts, online textbook work completion that guides you through it, and the fact I didn't show up to a single lecture and still got an A is probably why you should take this class. Professor responds to emails in a timely manner (rare at MSU). Overall nice person
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Second time taking Dr.King. Super easy, online heavy course. There are in person participation points but as long as you do good in everything else, you'll be okay. Interesting course and Dr.King is super nice!
If you need ISS 2XX credit, take this class with her. Easy grading and somewhat interesting lectures.

It is not required to come to class but you must participate by answering questions on Top Hat to get participation points. You will have 3-4 modules to read per test, if you stay on pace they are very manageable. Quizzes and tests are online, you can take them anytime in the week. She is very helpful, easy to approach, and wants the best for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: ISS220 with Professor King has been great! She is extremely knowledgeable, caring, approachable, and incredibly clear on the class structure. Attendance isn't required, but there are in-class points that you'll miss if you skip. The textbook is online. Highly recommend her class. Definitely an easy A if you put in a little bit of work.
easy would recommned

There's a moderate amount of reading and work but it's not at all overwhelming. There is an attendance grade but it comes from answering lecture questions virtually. You can answer them from home if you can't make it to class. It's really easy as long as you show up for most of the classes and don't procrastinate too much.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Take her course if you are looking to compete your 300 level ISS credit. She is such a great professor and it is very easy to pass her classes. Quizzes/exams are all online and you can work on each unit at your own pace. Very great professor and even though it was an 8 am course, I enjoyed going to lecture.

Overall an easy and enjoyable class, she gives plenty of extra credit opportunities through homework and attendance! Exams were straightforward as long as you went to lecture, not too much reading, and plenty of documentaries viewed in class!

Dr. King is a great teacher! She has interesting lectures. The readings are not usually very heavy. There are weekly packback posts, but those usually don't take very long. The quizzes and exam were all online, and you have the week off to complete them. There was a final paper that took a while to write, but if you start early it's not bad at all.

King gave an honors option for the class along with a volunteering extra credit opportunity. She wrote the textbook for the class which is very informative and insightful. Attendance is taken through TopHat, so you can get your attendance points from your laptop if you can't go to class. Not a lot of workload and the best ISS class in my opinion.

Be carful with this professor. She would get upset multiple times at students for little things like coughing and actually threatened to kick the student out of class for it. She has a bad temperament and I would really advise other students to consider other courses unless you want to deal with someone like her.

I had to take this class at 8AM, and I went anyway because I liked this class so much. Great professor, super interesting topics. The best IAH or ISS class I have taken. There are pack pack discussion posts, which are a nuisance, but everything also I really enjoyed.

Overall the class was super clear and organized. The exams were all online and straightforward and the homework was just one packback and some tophat work every week. Professor King is also very understanding and kind which was nice.

Our homework was a TopHat assignment for each unit and a Packback discussion each week. It was relatively easy. You have to buy both TopHat and Packback, but I don't think it is too big a purchase. The exams are pretty easy and all online. For every exam week, she didn't hold class (which was obviously very nice). She is a very sweet prof.

I loved taking her class, she is a very inspirational person and her course was eye opening. For pre classes and homework it was usually video based which I found to be helpful, but time consuming. Overall I recommend!!
She is great!

Prof King is great at helping students understand class material, but her class uses top hat, packback, and multiple textbooks, so be prepared to spend money on those. attendance and participation are both mandatory as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. King's lectures were helpful for understanding course material. She used Tophat to measure participation. There were readings for most classes, but she usually went over the main points in class. There were 4 open note quizzes and exams, with 1 drop (including the final/exam 4 and quiz 4). This class was interesting and easy to succeed in.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. King is super sweet and really takes a liking to the content that she presents on. I found that her lectures were super knowledgable for all that were present to listen to her speak. Her exams and quizzes are straight-forward. As long as you take the notes, come to class for the TopHat questions, and do the pack backs, you're golden.

Prof King is super nice and provides an interesting insight into the medical field through this course! As long as you do the PackBacks and participate in the TopHat, you will do just fine. She gives you a week to do the quiz and exam, both of which are open note and easy. I recommend this course to anyone with an interest in anthropology!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor King was great. I had her for ISS 310, and besides the lectures we used packback and tophat. Both of the two were super easy to navigate and not too content heavy. All the quizzes/exams were open note, though they were a little difficult. It was overall a good class, and Professor King was great and I would recommend.

She is super sweet and very easy to listen to! Exams and quizzes are easy as long as you take notes on her lectures. Likes to give personal stories related to the topics in class. Would definitely take again! She does have weekly pack backs, but they are super easy.

Dr. King is super cool. This class was really easy and really opens your mind if you want to pursue a career in the healthcare field. I wish anyone who wants to be a doctor, nurse, PA, etc; to take this course, we would have stronger leaders. As long as you go to lecture, do the packbacks each week, and do the study guide you'll 4.0

I didnt get the opportunity to take this class in person due to Covid, but even so, prof. King was easily the most uninvolved professor Ive ever had. One of the first things we reviewed on the syllabus was a list of types of emails/questions that she just wouldnt respond to and it felt like every module was just copy and pasted from quizlet.

Not very tech savvy, used Tophat for everything besides some discussion posts. Very sweet person, but had a hard time meeting her own deadlines. The module was always released a day or two late. My class was completely asynchronous and I could get the work done weeks in advance pretty much. Easy, but you get out of it what you put in.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class caused me a lot of stress for sure. A lot of things due at the end of each week, and she's hard to get a response out of. Make sure to read the syllabus so you don't miss any important info about how things are graded and the criteria you must meet. Since the class is online, she uses a lot of different websites for different assignments
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. King was nothing but unprofessional, unethical, and frustrating. She responded to a student's concerns about lessons being released late with "This put me into therapy," and at the end of the semester, she changed the syllabus in such a way that destroyed several people's grades, and when confronted, claimed it never happened.

I took this asynchronous class online in Fall 2020. We had to use a platform called Packback to post and answer questions every Sunday. These posts are worth 20% of your grade, but theyre really easy. Homework is reading the online textbook and answering questions. Quizzes and exams are open note. The class is really easy. No problems w/ prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class was very easy. The only annoying part was that we had to pay 100 for her personal textbook that like half of the grade is based on. The 4 quizzes and 4 tests were completely online and easy to do along with everything else she assigned. Almost always got out way early.

SHE WAS THE WORST TEACHER
She often perpetuated that doctors are untrustworthy, and discredited their intentions,also discouraged the use of C-sections to a predominantly female class.I felt that it was very wrong and dangerous for a professor to discourage students from seeking out diagnoses for conditions and the treatment of those diagnoses.

such an interesting class! attendance and homework are through top hat (not wifi-based). easy homework. easy tests and quizzes on d2l. no class during test weeks. 1 essay (i think it was only like 250 words). such an easy ISS and learned so many interesting anthropological things!

Prof. King uses three platforms for teaching: D2L is free, Top Hat cost me almost $100 for a single semester just to be able to access her (typo-filled) textbook, and Packback grades its assignments using AI. Professors who use AI to grade simple discussion assignments clearly don't care about student learning, so I'd steer clear of her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: fine teacher easy A but she somehow messed up inputting all my grades I got a 95 on participation and she gave me a 14% which I got fixed but I had to send an email for like 4 grades she messed up badly and during finals which were unneeded stress and pain for something that should be easy
Professor King is very knowledgable about different cultures and she showed a lot of really important documentaries. She is passionate about what she teaches and is a very kind person.
I had her for ISS 220 and the class was so easy. Everything was really straightforward and you do not have to go. As long as you do all the assignments you will do well. She slays.

Super nice lady and very interesting lectures. Exams and quizzes are all online, a very easy 4.0, even if you don't show up. only negative is she uses packback and tophat, so that is over a $100 down the drain.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Lectures were kind of pointless, also the use of packback was completely unnecessary and lazy on the professor's part. She uses 3 different platforms for assignments, one of which is not free. 60% of lectures are spent watching YouTube videos. Also scheduled an exam for right when we got back from spring break.

Lectures were long. She makes you pay for TopHat for the homework assignments: $75! Easy 4.0 if you attend class and pay attention as the exam questions are directly from the notes. She assigns 3 other textbooks and films for you to watch/read, but covers them in lectures and plays the movies in class so it seems unnecessary to do for homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment:
Lectures were horrible, she tended to under prepare and would just ramble the rest of the time. I stopped going, as you can participate remotely. Have to pay for TopHat. If you do the TopHat, lectures become unnecessary. Real easy 4.0 here, if a bit annoying.

Did not enjoy, but would take again for the ease.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr.King was a really nice and easy going professor and was extremely understanding with some of my situations I had going on during the school year. We did tophat and packbacks for participation and homework in the class, and had to attend lectures. The class was interesting and easy, I'd definitely take it again!

Professor king overall was a good professor. Her class was just lectures, along with tophat and packbacks for homework. She was rude once to me in a one on one session, but towards the class she was nice and very helpful! Easy class for a pre-req. Would definitley recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was absolutely amazing and eye-opening. Professor King was an amazing lecturer and I was excited to go to class every day. This class was easy as well as super interesting and I would recommend this class to anyone who wants a gpa boost and become more informed on womens issues and medical issues. Love the professor and class!!!

I had her spring semester 2023. We used Tophat as the main source of coursework, with a weekly post on Packback. There was also a book to help complete Tophat coursework. She gives extra credit in the form of easter eggs hidden in the Tophat work, which boosted your grade up to 3%. As long as you pay attention and do the work, you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor King is a very caring woman. I took ISS 310 as an 8am on M/W and she made it something I looked forward to attending. I really felt the material we covered was broad and promoted critical thinking. Top Hat was used for assignments and participation as well as Packback

Professor King was such a great professor. From day 1 she was clear in what she expected and was willing to help students get there. Very relaxed in general, has amazing stories to tell, and makes lectures interesting. Would take her again any day of the week.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Lots of reading every week and 3 discussion posts due every Sunday, but an easy A as all answers to the online tests are on the posted slides. Must buy and participate in tophat for every lecture. She offers easy extra credit in the form of easter eggs. Overall, a pretty easy class, just pay attention to the lecture and it will be enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Took this class online. Just had to pay for TopHat to read textbook and do homework, which was just answering questions based on the reading. Every weekend, there was a post due to Slate, a participation platform. This is worth 20% of your grade. Do not skip the participation. Professor was nice, and very clear. Quizzes and exams are open note.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: First things first, good luck getting Lynette to reply to any of your emails! During COVID19 when MSU shut down, she would not respond to any of the emails I would send her regarding questions about the class. The class wasn't necessarily hard. To me, she doesn't seem to care much about her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Grading was a bit confusing, but he tries to set you up for success. He cares about his students and tries to get everyone to engage in class through the discussions. On all of the projects, he has them clearly paced out and gives tons of helpful feedback throughout the process.

Dr. HK is one of my favorite professors. He is so funny and easy to talk to. He is very caring and is willing to work with you if you need help or accommodations. His grading is a little confusing but its not that difficult to do well in the class if you follow directions and ask questions.

Kirk's class is very interesting. I was genuinely intrigued at every lecture, and all of his assignments were meaningful. It was a decent amount of work, but if you put in the effort you will exceed. He is very helpful with feedback and does a great job teaching. He is very intelligent and is passionate about what he talks about. I would recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I was hesitant about this class at first because it seemed like a lot of work, and it was, but I genuinely felt that every assignment was meaningful. Kirk's class taught me so much and I still think about it everyday. I loved his teaching style and he is very intelligent. He was also super helpful! I would definitely recommend his class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Everything Dr. Kraetzer assigned, you had a chance to revise if it didnt meet the expectations set in the rubric. The rubrics were very straightforward. It was very easy to get a 4.0 in this class because you could revise literally everything. He also gave in-depth feedback on everything, so it was super easy to revise if needed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: LB133 was very boring and long, however it was made tolerable and even fun at times because of the way prof. Kraetzer teaches. He is passionate about what he talks about and how he talks about it. This class is very easy and it's pretty easy to 4.0, he can be a little unclear with what exactly he wants, but if you put in effort, you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Kirk was a very kind, considerate and passionate professor. He genuinely wants to see you succeed in his class and provides you the feedback to do so. Although his class does require a decent amount of effort, it's rewarding in the end. I would definitely recommend taking his class for LB133!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Kirk is a professor that cares about your improvement in writing. Although he has his quirks, I would recommend him. Especially since he makes you write a personal statement, which is great for any pre-health briggs kids. As long as you are a student that puts in effort, this is a fine class for you. Feels like the full four credits.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He would give a cheat sheet on every exam, and the exam questions consisted of problems that we had solved in our problem sets. Lectures are posted after every class in case you have to miss one, and he will point out key concepts/equations to remember for the exams. Definitely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's decent. He isn't hard or rude or anything, but sometimes doesnt interact much with the class and it feels robotic, but it gets the material through. Exams are not too bad, you get a cheat sheet. You can work together for homework which is nice too. Class is fine, a lot of points there, but he just isn't very passionate imo.

His lectures were pretty useful, especially for the Midterms. You get a cheat sheet front and back which is nice and helpful, but he doesn't post midterm reviews, so he emphasizes what are on the tests during lectures and on his posted slides. Iclicker attendance with 4 drops. Midterms like problem sets, great econ professor would take again.

Class is based on 2 midterms and a lot of problem sets. You get a cheat sheet front and back which is helpful. The content itself is really straightforward and easy. He also posts outlines of what you need to know for the midterm. Difficulty level is a 5/10.

This was his first semester at MSU, so I'll go easy. The grade is based off of 2 exams (80% of grade) and 5 HW(20% of grade). The midterm average was 50%, he said he was not sure on a curve. I got an 80% but I was busting my ass to get that. He allows a cheat sheet, but it will do nothing for you. He is unempathetic and sensitive towards criticism.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's passionate about the topic. Personally, I would have preferred if she answered emails and/or published grades throughout the semester. The expectations of work load are unreasonable.

She has been one of my favorite professors here in the school of social work. She's so passionate about her work and it translates so well in lectures. She had three big group assignments throughout the semester, I highly recommend going to office hours to ensure the best score possible as they can be a bit difficult. Choose a topic you love!

Dr. Klein is a very harsh grader who does not give clear directions for assignments. Additionally, she gives assignments with quick turn around times making them almost impossible to complete given that they have such high expectations
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Notice lessons taught indirectly, what feelings come up when discussing real life impacts and questions proposed in class. Even if you strongly disagree try to understand an opposing perspective. In order to help people understand a social problem you have to speak their language, but communication is useless w/o comprehension.

You're lucky if you're one of the people that get to be in this class. EVERY. SINGLE. LECTURE. We are talking about REAL problems with REAL examples,REAL things that everyone should know about. It's “just the tip of the iceberg” of the reality of our systems. Trust that Klein has a reason for each lesson, you shouldn't have to look to hard for it

She would lecture the entire 3 hours and would rarely be engaging. We would receive a single 5-10 minute break within the class time. I was in an accident and totaled my car. I am a commuter student and went without a car for a week. No excused absence. Requires proof of appointments and auto repair bills to be shown to her to be excused. Total BS!

Professor Klein was one of the most challenging courses I've taken thus far. This is not due to the actual content, but rather because the course was so disorganized. This professor would often go on tangents during lecture and was totally inaccessible outside of class, often taking more than a month to return grades to students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Klein is very knowledgeable and knows what she's talking about but the class is not an easy A - you have to work for it. She will lecture the entire class period so don't expect to ever get out early. Try to participate as much as you can and ask your questions in class - answering emails is not a strong suit for this prof.

Expect to work extremely hard in this course. She is knowledgeable for sure, however this class is more of a Phd level course...a lot of homework and in my opinion, too much room open for interpretation. Emailing students back is not a strong suit of this professor.
Very clear and accessible, ready to support students who are invested in their work and career. Pointed me in the right direction and was patient. Passionate and committed to her work.

Amazing Professor! She is open to clarification and very consistent in her expectations. By far the most manageable amount of reading in all my classes and gives lots of opportunities to build a good grade. She is very clear about what will be on exams and is over all very straight forward about what she expects from students.

This is a graduate level course, a heavy course-load is expected. But I did not expect to have the liberal ideology shoved down my throat at every turn. I pay thousands of dollars to receive an EDUCATION that will allow me to build upon a career, that is not in political science. I do not appreciate her agenda or lack of inclusion for other stances
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Very knowledgeable about community practice.  Incredibly willing to advocate for students in their community placement.  Good lectured and involved in students' learning experience.  Great Professor.

Dr. Robach is such a sweet professor. Class is easy if you study, hard if you don't. Two exams and some assignments. Nothing is cumulative which is nice. Textbook isn't actually necessary to purchase for an A and clear understanding.

Ruth is wonderful and an amazing professor. She cares about each of her students and makes an effort to get to know each of them. She has practical experience in watershed management, which makes her lectures both interesting and truly useful.

Ruth is an amazing professor that can teach not only the class but other great life lessons as well. She does an amazing job with keeping the topics interesting and has so much knowledge. The class is very test heavy so there is a midterm and a final along with two homework assignments. She always has open arms with any questions you may have.

Ruth is like an aunt you want to get a beer with. The class has a lot of components and can get pretty technical, but she will carry you through. Great stories, and the genuine passion she has for water and sewage definitely shines through. The tests aren't the greatest, but the course load is relatively light. Ruth is slay, big fan.

I don't know what to say, she's got the sweetest soul, classes were very early so I found myself struggling to attend, but I still got a 4.0 due to participation and papers. she's not a tough grader, u just have to ask her about homework often, class requires talking to students and it kind of made me nervous but overall it was a good experience :)
She's very nice and understanding, but lectures are very boring and long. Don't take her House of Dragon course! She also takes a while to grade but and cancels class often :)

I have never had a nicer professor I had her for my german class once I was sick and she moved my midterm. she also has fun with the students and would ask us about ourselves she cares and wants to know her students.

Would not take again, it is a boring class taught in a very boring way. She did not stick to the syllabus that she gave to us at the beginning of the year, didn't start grading things until almost the end of the semester, the syllabus does not give you any dates for when anything is due, and there is no grading scale. Would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: overall pretty good! he liked creative essays and the assignments were fun. giant fan of hamlet

Best English teacher I have had..listen, do your work, participate in class.. he's not a stickler like most English teachers..
when you first meet him, he may seem like a not so cool dude( he can be though if you take him there) he's a really nice guy just treat him with respect he will do the same...overall great guy, easy work...

He isn't specific about the criteria for assignments and grades harshly because of his own poor communication. I spent the entire semester on a wild goose chase trying to figure out what is required of me. He isn't responsive to emails whatsoever so good luck if you're having a hard time. He's totally disorganized and hard to keep up with.

he wants you to have opinions, and even better if theyre also his. lots of papers but isnt very specific in the criteria and grades harshly. doesnt answer emails for 3-5 business days but answers instagram dms within 5 minutes. loves the plague good luck
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: kind of pretentious, but easy going. Really, really flexible on deadlines, he once said "the only thing good about something being on time is that its on time. and thats not a good thing". not too much of a harsh grader but classes are hell as they can get really boring really fast. Talks alot about his personal life and beliefs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Heavy workload and grades tough but extremely flexible about deadlines
Chemistry is considered to be a tougher course at msu. She is a fine professor.

Challenging course. Clear explanations and organized lectures. Answers questions and is helpful during office hours. Makes the material easier to understand. The best professor rver, highly recommend.
This professor lectures very slowly. Expect softball questions to be asked and seriously answered.

Prof Kijeska was very sweet and a great teacher. She explained the concepts very easily, and the lectures were well-paced. There's a bunch of extra credit, and they make it easy to access help when you need it. The class definitely isn't easy, but if you do the homework and practice exams, a good grade is easily attainable.

I would rather chew off my hand than take this class again. I have always done well in school, and I went to every lecture and studied after every class, and even had a tutor I met with twice a week for two hours, but it still barely helped. The problem is that the stuff in the homework and lectures is NOTHING like the content on the tests!!!!!!!!!

Dr K was a good professor and she explains the concepts of general chemistry very well. Most of the grading besides testing was based on completion and often times I found myself struggling on the tests because I felt that I did not receive much feedback in general. Use your peers and ULAs in recitation to your advantage!

i am taking her class again for chem 142 but she does explain things pretty well and explains things very well when it comes to the time of having to take a test and or what homework we have to get done the ta's were pretty good but overall you have to go to lecture if u want to do well.

She explained things very clearly and concisely; however, upon talking to other students, they said they either really liked her or really didn't. I myself liked her, but just be aware of the polar opposites.

I was nervous about taking chemistry for the first time, but it became my favorite subject. This professor explains concepts clearly, and what she teaches matches the exams. The iClicker questions each lecture are engaging and count as attendance, with only two drops allowed. I wish I could take her for every class—she is the best professor.

If you pay attention and study outside of class, you'll be absolutely fine. She clearly cares about her students' success. There are extra credit opportunities and your final grade replaces your lowest exam if beneficial. All the people that hate her just didn't try, its easy if you read the textbook and do the homework, which a reasonable amount.

It's a miracle I got a B in this class. It made me miserable and I hated going but attendance is mandatory and I needed every point I could get. Set up reminders for the homework, there is LOTS of it (it's easy and graded by completion.) Unfortunately i've heard bad things about the other MSU Chem teachers so good luck.

She was very articulate and good at explaining everything in lecture very well. The slides were very accessible and easy to follow along with in class. She also recorded each of her lectures so you could go back and watch them if you missed class. The only downside was iClicker.
She's really nice, but the class is so large that you won't interact with her much.
This class is so hard and it's very exam heavy. The professor has an accent so it's really hard to understand her. She's really nice though.

Dr Kijewska was very caring and understanding but exams were so much harder than lectures, the lectures only briefly mentioned a topic and there would be a question on the exam way more difficult than we ever discussed, there was a lot of material to be covered but slides were just read off of. Don't take it with her if you can't learn self taught.

cem 141 is a course with LOTS of material to cover. I liked this course, but she may have to rush through a few lectures because of how little time she has. She records all of her lectures, so it definitely helps to go back and watch them and take notes for anything you missed. If you pay attention, and study every day I promise you will be fine.

The one piece of advice I would give for this class is to listen to her when she tells you to study after every single lecture. This is a very difficult course and there is a lot of information you have to learn. Looking back on the BeSocratic assignments and the recitation activities is also very helpful before exams.

Lectures=life. lectures quick and doesn't waste time, stay awake and alert. study after each lecture- and do all homework (quite a lot) do practice exams, show up to class, go to recitation and you'll be fine. textbook is easy to read and connects. besocratic was annoying, but was graded and ec opportunities were given.

missing a day of lecture can set you really far behind. The CLUE online textbook was very easy to follow, and a quick read once you know what you're supposed to be reading. (you can skip a lot of the examples and equation stuff shown, it gets repetitive with the lecture notes)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was super easy to pass if you put in the work! She explains things well, but you do have to study a little outside of class, but tests are very fair. She is a caring professor and I def recommend.

I hate CEM 141. I can't understand anything my professor tries to teach us. I thought I just didn't understand chemistry, but when a fill-in professor taught us during our professor's absences, I understood so much better. Try to avoid her.
she isnt as bad as people make her out to be. when she says anyone else for the iclicker questions its a little annoying but you get used to it

She talks extremely fast and goes through the lecture slides before you can get the information down. The practice exams given are not very helpful. Take detailed notes and spend every day outside of class reviewing notes and you'll be fine.
She was fine. I think the class is fair. I have never taken chemistry before, and I did good, if you try youll be fine.

I think that chemistry is seen as a difficult topic to begin with and this professor made is much easier than without her! No matter which professor you have this class is going to require you to study but she gave us amazing resources and outlined things to know for the exam.I am actually taking her next semester!

She is a very kind and passionate professor. Her class is very well organized and her lectures are very easy to grasp. I didn't feel the need to study and aced the exams (though everyone is different!). Attendance is mandatory though and is done through iclicker so make sure that your iclicker is reliable (unlike mine).

She is the sweetest, she records lectures and tells you exactly what is needed to pass. Unfortunately for me I will be retaking this class by no fault of hers. You need to pay attention and study everyday, this class it is very important to understand everything you are learning.

With iClicker attendance only being 5% of the final grade, I found it easier to simply watch the lecture videos on 3x outside of class, as she moves very slowly. This class has many resources to help you succeed, should be easy 3-4.0

The lectures end up being very short because she spends a large amount of time at the beginning of class reviewing homework and restating prior lessons. Usually the concepts are simple to grasp and the homework is easy

Prof K as a prof is good. She tells you how to succeed. My only issues are with the class. The material is pretty straightforward in class and on homework, but the exams are just stupid. Very unclear in the wording, makes me think this is a weeder class.

Goes a little fast in lectures but posts them after so you can go back and fill in your notes if you missed anything. You have to pay attention in class but if you do it's pretty easy to follow along. The exams will be hard. Study, study, study. If you put in effort, you will do fine.
Amazing lectures, super great at explaining concepts and makes sure class understands topics before moving on.  Super kind and helpful if you ask for help.

Finish the ALEKS 100% before the deadline and the class should be a decently easy pass. Not super accommodating past the allotted absences so save them for emergencies. Lectures were actually helpful and I highly recommend going, even if you don't have to. If you survived AP Chem, it's basically a guaranteed 2.0. Chemistry is awful, she's great!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Super nice professor, some people can't get past her accent but she was super nice and her lectures were straight forward. She's a good teacher and her TAs/ULAs are amazing and super helpful during lecture. Attendance for credit is annoying but all of her lectures are recorded and up to date if you happen to miss any of them.

Prof Kijewska is super patient and caring with her students, even when course material can be overwhelming. She is always willing to go through and explain things during lecture and it makes learning super easy.

I found this class to be paced well with the professor not wasting any time during lectures. She provided ample practice activities that helped with learning. Some mandatory aspects of the course felt pointless and a waste of time that could have been spent studying and some exam questions were too vague for chem. Decent, but could be better.

Chemistry is like math, you have to try in it. I thought gen chem was fine as long as you understand what is going on and study. One of the exams can be replaced by your final score in case you do terribly or miss an exam. I missed one due to an ER visit lol but it ended up working out due to this. Study after each class.

Prof. Kijewska is an incredible teacher! Very knowledgeable w/ chemistry, explains concepts very well. Willing to explain things in detail. There's homework, recitations, EC, and exams. Prof uses iClicker for points, but the concepts help you learn more. Class is easy if you know how to apply concepts instead of memorizing facts. Dr. K is so great!

This professor was reluctant to help students who were confused, wasn't good at explaining the material. I relied on the TA's for help and they were so much better than the actual teacher. I was less than 1% away from a four point because of a grading error and didn't bother to round it up. She's a little rude, if you have her ask the TAs for help
You think you know what's going on then you open the exam and you're cooked. Tbh she gives a lot of opportunities to raise grade and I got my A so no worries! Hope this helps.

People rate her badly because they didn't show up or do homework and they're salty about it. She explains things very well, and if you don't understand her there are so many resources available. If you do the bare minimum (so what she tells you to do) you'll get a 4.0. Minimal homework too, just don't cheat on it and you're fine.

Very enthusiastic about teaching and success of her students. Attendance is required and very lecture heavy. Dr. Kijewska can talk fast at sometimes, but is very nice and will go over again. Many hours of studying for this course. Exams are only in the late evening or early mornings.

Lectures are fast paced, but if you take good notes, you'll do well. She's clearly very passionate about chemistry and wants students to do well. Exams are difficult, but the class is very organized and gives you plenty of ways to get help if you need it.

I think she's a great professor. She'll spend the first 20ish minutes going over the homework from the night before and then go into the lecture. She does talk and goes through slides fast so make sure to keep up. Also on some days, if you're lucky, she'll let you leave lecture early. There's about 3-4 TAs that are there to answer questions also.
She's honestly just your average chemistry professor. If you really put in the work and study the objectives and read the textbook, you'll be good. The TAs help answer most of my questions.

In the lectures it seems so easy and simple to understand, and I feel confident I have a grasp on the material. When i get into the exam, it's like it was written for a completely different class. The fact that this class also isn't curved when students tend to get like a 50% on the tests is beyond annoying. Also barely posts any study material.

she'll often spend the first 20 minutes or so going over homework which sometimes throws off the pacing of the lecture and it can get very fast. 
i liked that she talked the class through more difficult iclicker questions. 
homework is very very easy but can sometimes take some time. you definitely need to study for the tests though

Easy professor. Everything is graded off participation- study for exams and you're fine. Problem is her lack of empathy for students and lectures you that you don't understand the concept, but won't go back and explain it. Also, every. single. iClicker question she says, "Anybody else" in a really annoying way. Easy A, but annoyed every lecture.

When I had a death in the family and arranged grief absence, she gave me so much work to "make up what I missed" which was right before an exam and 2 weeks before the final with a stupidly short due date. I was not told of this until after I came back and saw all the zeros. Next time, I'll ask my sick family members not to die, I guess.
hated this class so much and she made it 1000x harder

Professor Kijewska has a really strong accent which can be hard to understand. She talks very fast and goes through the lecture slides very fast but there is always a lot of slides with a lot of information to retain. Must study after every class if you want to be on top of the work.

Professor Kijewska's class is challenging but rewarding. Attend lectures and recitations, and use resources like the free textbook and unstuck ai to really grasp the content. The tests are tricky, so stay engaged and you'll do well.

Lectures are pretty fast-paced, but if you develop a good note-taking system and just write the things said you'll do great. Great explainer, clearly loves chemistry, regularly surveys class with iClicker, then re-covers topics that a lot of people were (anonymously) confused about. There are no trick questions, just pay attention, loved this class
lectures were engaging, she breaks down the material well and is good at fully answering any questions asked
Lectures are easy to follow but she moves fast. Almost everything is graded based on completion.

Professor Kijewska very clearly cares a lot about chemistry. Lecture heavy with iClicker attendance, easy homework after most classes, a few extra credit assignments. If you study the material you'll do well on tests. Easy to get an A if you care to try.

She was very kind and clearly very knowledgable on the subject. If you take notes and pay attention in the lectures, you will do very well. I really appreciate that there are always multiple TAs walking around the lecture and it feels very easy to ask questions and get quick answers. Overall an enjoyable class.
Dr. K was incredible at explaining topics, very patient, and was easily reached when you needed help.

Professor Kijewska is very knowledgeable in chemistry and oozes passion, professionalism. It is important to listen to her closely, and write notes as she's speaking during lectures. If you re-write the lecture jutes in your own way after each lecture and study them for at lest 15 minutes twice a day, you'll be set for the exams.

She's a great teacher who covers a lot of material in a way that's easy to understand and manageable. She's always available during office hours to help, though sometimes she goes through the slides a bit quickly.

This class can take a lot of effort (depending on how well you grasp the subjects). Granted, CEM 141 has many students. So, this course is designed to teach roughly 300 students at a time, making it rather impersonal. SEEK HELP FROM TA'S IF NEEDED! Prof. Kijewska is not bad, but you need to put in hard work too. Her provided checklist was helpful.

Hated being immediately bombarded with Aleks topics but I know she doesn't control that. Be ready to spend a decent amount of time on those topics if you haven't taken chemistry in a while.

On a positive note, she seemed genuinely caring but did have her days. Tons of material on lectures so she did go at a very quick pace.

7/10.

Most of the lectures are her reading off of the slides and asking questions in relation to the slides, not a bad style but if you prefer more in depth learning I would choose a different professor. Exams are either 6 am or 7 pm ish which can be annoying but overall a very easy course.

There are 4 tests in the entire course and they are worth 60% of your grade, all of which are taken at 7:30 at night or at 6:00 am. She's a brutal grader, a great lady, but getting all of my points taken off for a question because I "Didn't draw an arrow long enough" in a diagram just leaves a bad taste in my mouth. Weirdly difficult for a starter.

Dr. Kijewska is a tricky little bugger. She is the sweetest human ever but is simply not fit to teach this class. She is a little feisty and appears to not enjoy her job very much. The exams are very difficult and don't even reflect a lot of what we have learned. I would not take her as a teacher again, but she seems like a lovely individual!

I was so worried going into chemistry as I've never been a science/math person but Kijewska is incredible! I actually really enjoyed her class and she did a great job at presenting the material in a way that helps you to actually understand the concepts and piece it all together. She doesn't give too much homework and has extra credit assignments.

Dr. Kijewska seems very passionate about the material. She goes a bit fast on the slides, and if you never took chem before in high school, you may struggle to keep up during class. The tests are tough and very detailed, but they match the lecture slides. Haven't read the textbook and I did just fine. Just go to class and study for the exams.

I would rather gougue my eyes out and eat them than take this class again. I had reached out multiple times to her with questions via email and gotten no response. She goes through lecture slides very quickly, and as someone that has taken a chem class in HS, I was still very confused. I attended every class and did every assignment and exam.

Lectures are super important and are graded for participation. Exams are hard and pull from lots of different sources (textbook, recitation activities, homework, and lectures). Make sure to read the textbook and go to recitations.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Anyone who has gotten below a B is probably not that bright. The content covered is honestly so easy to understand, the only possible way for you to not get a good grade is by not coming to class. The teacher is also very good and gives extra credit from time to time.

Dr. Kijewska is an extremely kind, intelligent, and skilled lecturer! She answers questions thoughtfully, and always explains things extremely slowly and intuitively in a way that guarantees everybody in the room understands the content perfectly. She scaffolds her lessons very well, and her kind disposition and passion for teaching are apparent :)
Professor Kijewska was a great teacher and all i could have asked for for CEM 141. Attendance is mandatory but she knows her stuff and will make sure that you understand the material.

This general chemistry course is very straightforward. The exams are highly dependent on the learning objectives (which students have continuous access to) as the professor mentions numerous times. YOU WILL PASS AS LONG AS YOU ATTEND CLASS, PAY ATTENTION, AND COMPLETE THE RECOMMENDED PRACTICES. The time-commitment is average for a 3-credit course.

This class is a lot of very general content all at once. Go to class, get the free points for homework and attendance and go to the help room. My best advice is to never assume you are prepared for exams, and don't wait to go to office hours or ask for help. She is super thorough and willing to help if you ask!

I think the lecture is way too info heavy and we move past things way too fast. There's no time to process what you are learning. Sometimes the homework doesn't even match up with what we're learning as well. I know some students think her accent is a little heavy and makes it difficult to understand, so be aware of that.

Dr. Kijewska gives very good lectures. She explains topics very clearly and she seems to enjoy teaching the class. she could do slightly better with pacing during the lectures as it sometimes the end of the lectures feel rushed.

Honestly, she was one of the best professors I have ever had for science. Attend lectures (preferably 3 times a week, not 2 since they can feel dragged) and she was very clear on what she grades. The exams felt aunting but when you took them they were not bad. All are based on mock exams and lecture slides which are easy to follow.Take her if u can

If I had a few hours left to live, I would spend it in her lecture. Due to the fact that each lecture seems to last an eternity. She isn't passionate about this content due to the fact that it is work that is below her knowledge level. Would not suggest this class or professor. Pay attention, do the work, and don't forget to study for exams.

This professor covered very interesting material and is passionate about the things she teaches. She sometimes dumbs-down material if you aren't good at Chemistry (I'm not,) however I had to teach myself a few topics. She often made me feel rushed and seemed passive aggressive to those who didn't understand the material, which made me uncomfortable

She posts Lecture Slide videos so if you need to review these are very helpful, Do your ALEKS as soon as possible! She seems snarky at times,sometimes she'll be like "I can't answer that, but a TA can." with a sarcastic smile. This can be frustrating. She also has an accent that isn't too hard to understand but definitely has you listening closer.

(Taken Spring 2023) 

Good lecturer, can sometimes go a little fast but is very nice with clear explanations. Her exams are easy to score high on if you follow along with the material intently. The people who scored poorly didn't study well or didn't care to set time aside to actually learn the material.

Dr. Kijewska was a fair grader and was accessible outside of class, but she often went through slides a little bit fast and some of the content was difficult to understand. The tests and important assignments are full of trick questions designed to catch the slightest slip-up, which I guess is good sometimes, but it felt excessive for this course.
This teacher was a tough grader and a poor lecturer. You will have to teach yourself. Additionally, she would make fun of in-class questions and then become upset when no one would raise their hands.

Super nice but she goes way too fast on her slides. The lectures are so important but there is not enough overlap between lecture and exam. It is hard to stay engaged but she explains very thoroughly and is great at answering questions.
All exams are terribly worded and designed to be confusing. Alecs is annoying make sure to do it.
extremely lecture heavy. goes through slides way too fast. however, if you pay attention and attend recitation you will be fine
Attend lectures and do the practice exams.
This class was enjoyable. As long as you go to lecture and recitation and pay attention you will do fine. The tests can be tricky so make sure to have a good understanding of the contetn

I went to every lecture, did all the homework, went to help room and office hours, and studies 3 weeks in advanced for exams exactly how she asked us to, and I still did terrible on every exam. When I went to her office hours to talk to her about it, she was so rude and condescending. I'm considering a career change because of her

I received an ADR from her and she would not give it up until I took it to court and got it reversed. Giving a falsely accused student an ADR and having me do all the work just to show that I did not cheat was enough for me to rank her 1 out of 5. I highly recommend switching out of her class if possible. I did not like the way she treated me.

She was a good professor; she knows how to do her job and was always open to answering questions during class and break down IClicker questions that students got wrong. Definitely wasn't an easy class so make sure you do study, and you should be fine.

This class is not at all difficult thanks to her excellent lectures. Without a doubt I would take this class again. Everything you need to for the exam is in her lectures. Just paying attention and studying guarantees a good grade. I highly recommend asking her question ASAP if confused. She always provided excellent explanations. Love her!

Dr. Kijewska was great! CEM 141 is super lecture heavy, but she had us do iClicker questions throughout the lecture, and if it seemed like people weren't understanding the questions she would break them down and go through them. She was open to questions and wouldn't judge, there was even an online anonymous form for questions.

This professor was horrible. She was super condescending. I had COVID with a doctor's note and she told me to come anyway or take the 0. Not available out of class, not helpful in class, really just a professor who made me cry a lot in a course that I needed support in and never could get.

Clear expectations. Lecture heavy, weekly homework, and 4 total exams..  Exams are based off of lectures and readings.  The content builds on itself throughout the semester so if you miss a lecture, I recommend going back and watching it - it is hard to catch back up if you fall behind.  Study after every lecture and you will do fine.

She definitely cares about her student's success and provides many resources. The first exam is by far the hardest of them all. I never read the textbook and did well in the course. Attendance is mandatory since there are iclicker questions. There is a lot of homework but it is easy and only graded on completion. Very hard to fail this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Kijewska is clearly passionate about what she teaches, and wants her students to succeed. She made sure that when students weren't understanding a certain topic to spend additional time going over it. The exams were reasonable for the content, and the homework is incredibly easy.

The professor seemed like she did not have any interest in the subject material that she was teaching and always seemed condescending towards our class like we were stupid for not understanding the material. The class itself is not too terrible, but it's easy to do somewhat poorly on exams just based on the number of questions and their worth.

Very kind professor, incredibly helpful and Cleary wants her students to do well. Homework is unbelievably easy but the content is of course difficult. Class is hard but she definitely helps with the terror.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Exams are really difficult so make sure to really study for them. she doesn't really bother to review 141 material when you need to know it for some material in this class. Class exam averages are quite low. Attendance is mandatory as there are clickers for which you need to get at least 75% of them right each lecture. Take Cangelosi, shes amazing.

Each lecture is unbelievably slow, and the professor's monotonous way of speaking does nothing to help. The concepts are explained somewhat thoroughly, but oftentimes it takes a rewatch of the lecture afterwards to properly understand it. Any examples given are extremely basic, and don't do much in the way of helping to explain the concepts.

She is very nice and good at explaining concepts. Do the homework + extra credit, go to class, go to recitation, go to office hours w/ questions, and you get a lot of free easy points. Study for the tests because they are the hardest part by far, but do well on 2 of them and you should be fine for the final.
I love chemistry but these lectures were so boring and monotone, I almost fell asleep every lecture.

She is kinda hard to understand due to accent but a good teacher. The class is VERY lecture heavy but you can easily do good in the class if you take good notes and study hard for exams. She is super nice and understanding.
Dr. Kijewska is great at lecturing and is really good at getting the point across and making chemistry easy to learn. Attendance is mandatory, and after every class there is a homework assignment.

you guys are LYING. she is not a good professor. she has never explained or written down absolutely anything in our class. please i beg you, do not take her. go for virgina cangelosi, please!!!!!!!!!!!!
She is great at giving the information you need and is willing to help in office hours out of class. highly recommend

Krystyna was the nicest professor I had my first year, she is so caring and willing to help. It was very easy to make a connection with her. If you pay attention in lecture and put in the work to understand the material rather than memorize it, you will easily ace the class.

HW is based off completion and most of class grade is exams/online ALEKS work. That said, most of exam questions are repeated HW/recitation/class activities so if you study you should get an A. Records lectures + gives EC. Love Kijewska + am taking her for CEM 142, highly recommend cause she's a sweetheart even if her class can be tough at times.

Dr. Kijewska did a great job at explaining content in a way that is easy to understand. There are a lot of easy points in her class, and you can drop one of the exams so it isn't hard to pass. She is an absolute sweetheart and I will be taking another one of her classes next semester.
She gives boring but very informative lectures, and the class is fairly easy to do well in as long as you focus or have some prior knowledge of the course.

I didn't think i would do good in chemistry and somehow passed with an A pretty easily, her lectures are very easy to follow if you just print off the notes and follow along, the homework isn't long and always goes along with what you learned. The exams are fair but you have to study a good amount, but don't read the book, got to drop a exam too
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Kijewska was lovely. She is brilliant and really cares about participation in class so that she can see how well we understood things. This class was difficult for me, but I passed with a decent grade and would honestly take a class again if she was the one teaching it. As long as you pay attention and use help rooms, you literally can't fail.

She is an amazing professor. She explains stuff clearly and explicitly while trying to connect different knowledge points. She uses an average pace to teach, which gives me enough time to absorb the knowledge. The test is really well designed since we were allowed to have 1 test grade dropped for both MC and short answer questions.

Do not read the textbook. Only use her slides and the practice tests (almost the same as the actual one). As long as you complete the ALEKS (do it asap trust me), do the homework, and pay attention in class, you will succeed in this class. She is always kind and available outside of class.
