reviews.comment: Schwaba is by far the best professor I've had at msu. He really tries to make lectures and class interesting and more than just reading from a slideshow. He's kind and truly cares for his students and actually enjoys teaching. There's quite a bit of material but it's not difficult at all.

Please please please take this class. You will have no regrets. Dr. Schwaba was an amazing professor and made this class so fun. The lectures were always fun and easy to follow along with. Make sure you take notes and pay attention in class for exam study guide material.
Love love love Tedmond. Take his class pls, it was easy andddd super interesting. Took this class to fulfill a credit and it ended up being a top 3 class ever.

DO NOT MISS THE FIRST 3 QUIZZES. The first is the easiest and I had to miss it, makeups are not allowed. Study hard for the quizzes thats basically your entire grade, get on the extra credit opportunities early!

Dr. Schwaba's PSY 395 class was excellent! The lectures were engaging and easy to understand. Labs used R Studio with worksheets graded on completion, and you could miss two. Exams were fair and easy if you completed the study guide. The final grade included 3/4 exams, 10/12 labs, and five SONA hours, totaling 100 points. Great class!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I just finished PSY 395 with him, he's really nice and makes lectures interesting. The exams were easy for me (he phrases the questions in a way that's easy to understand) but I also attended most of the lectures.

Best professor ever. Tests are fair and he only tests on study guide content. Prof is pretty funny and keeps you engaged. You could probably not come to a single class if you wanted to and as long as you studied for exams you'd be fine. Labs were easy and often ended early. If I could take every class from now on with him I would.

The lecture was amazing, he was so entertaining and I went to class even though attendance wasn't mandatory. The labs were short contrary to how long MSU says they are, but it also depends on your TA. They use R, but you aren't tested on any coding, just your ability to interpret a statistical result. He posts study guides before exams which helps!
The goat of michigan state university. His lectures are all posted online and he's very thorough in his explanations. I refuse to watch any other lecture video that isn't his.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Maccomb's lectures were some of the best math lectures I've ever experienced. I took this class online, so I never interacted with the guy in person, but he was very accessible by email when I had questions. Cares a lot about his students and wants you to succeed!

Absolutely phenomenal at teaching math. Math isn't my strong suite, but his lectures are clear and made the class manageable. The quizzes are a little challenging, but the exams are overall ok. Best math teacher I've ever had. Homework is relatively easy, with only 2-3 assignments a week composing of around 8-12 questions. Don't fall behind.
This guy is the goat, only reason I learned calc 1-3 extremely well.

I got a C+ in Calc 1-2 back in high school, and was very anxious about taking Calc 3 after years of no math. Somehow, he manages to make Calc 3 fun & has a teaching style that makes the material intuitive. I loved the class so much I changed my major to math--never would have seen myself getting an A+ in math; can't recommend this professor enough!

I never actually took Ryan Maccombs' class. I was in another Calc 3 section but after averaging a 1.0 I stopped going and only watched and attended Ryan Maccombs' lectures. I ended with a 3.0 and I will never be more grateful to anyone more than I am to this professor. He saved my grade.

Amazing professor, has guided notes that you can print out, and listens to in-class questions. You do need to watch his pre-class videos as that will teach you what you will end up doing in class. He did recommend a textbook but it is not necessary. Attendance isn't necessary (he posts recordings on his youtube), but definitely show up to class.

Fantastic professor. Teaches content very well. While Calc 3 is inherently difficult, This teacher did a great job at teaching it in the best way. Would absolutely recommend if you can learn asynchronously

Maccombs is a nice prof. He helps when you need help, and he makes videos that you can watch on YouTube that thoroughly explain the content, and what you need to do to be successful in this class. To me, Calc 2 was extremely difficult. I got a 2.0 and I studied very hard. Maccombs is great, the content/class itself is not.
I did not even have him as my professor, but his lectures are what taught me all of Calc 2 and got me an A. Doing his video notes and webwork prepares you well for tests.

He is an amazing professor and thoroughly explains everything. However, Calc 3 is a TOUGH class and prepare to be doing tons of homework and studying for it. There are quizzes almost every week to make sure you're on top of the material. Midterm was especially difficult.
This man is infamous amongst engineering students at MSU. Everyone loves him and he got me through one and a half years of college calculus. Do anything you can to get in his class.
Maccombs is an amazing professor for such a difficult course. He is easily accessible and cares about his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: amazing teacher very passionate and clear when teaching

One of the best math professors. Has videos online to help you learn the content better and the lectures are at a good pace to understand. The only thing is the exams especially the quizzes are hard but having open notes is helpful. Answers fast on Piazza and answers any follow-up questions. Available for help on Zoom. Please take this professor!

You cant escape from his online tutorial
If you hear his sound from YouTube, you know you are doing well
His sound makes you feel relax and confident when you are facing tons of math assignments
The goat, I used his videos instead of my professor's lectures.
Amazing teacher

Super nice guy who can actually teach calculus. He is not difficult to understand and the pre lecture videos are excellent. I found myself using his videos when I had another professor in Calc 3 because of this.

He is the best, he knows how to teach Calculus. I hated doing online classes before but doing Calc 2 with his videos wasn't bad at all, some problems are hard to do and it's not the easiest class, but he definitely makes it easier to understand.

very nice and kind.great lectures compared to other professors who teach this course. He is open for office hours often. sometimes didnt answer my questions properly and was confusing at times especially the harder ending units. tests and quizzes were annoying because of theory questions or t/f can be very confusing, easy to get those wrong.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Although I do not like calculus at all, Prof. Maccombs was excellent at explaining and helping during lectures, in private meetings/communications, etc. His course structure was very helpful for me (taking notes ahead of time and then doing practice problems in class). I still absolutely believe that I could have 4.0'd the course if I tried harder!

This prof has the BEST lectures on Youtube. You can learn all of the material independently through watching the videos on your own time. The chapters are accurate and line up with any professor that you take Calc III with. You missed a lecture? RM has your back. Professor that you have isn't your learning style? RM has your back. Best prof ever!!
Maccombs is a great instructor. There are open paper notes for all quizzes and exams, which has been a huge improvement from calc 1. If you can, pick this professor!

If you've taken Calc 1 and 2, it's very similar to those. Lectures 3 days a week and about 2 instructional videos as well. Will always go into detail if students are confused and was always active in answering student questions on Piazza. If you have the option to take this prof, DO IT! Best prof in the math department

By far the best professor in the math department. He is extremely knowledgable and his guided notes and videos make the class feel very organized. He explains very challenging material in a way that is easy to understand. If I had the opportunity I would 100% take his class again.
Had a different Prof for MTH133, but used his pre-class videos to learn the content instead of the real lectures I was given and they were excellent.

I felt very uneasy talking to him. I felt like there was no help for me outside of the MLC. I learnt more calculus three from a class on introductory electromagnetics. Although he is a very caring individual and inspirational too. It is because of him and a pep talk he gave me that I am now majoring in Mathematics as well.
Literally the best math professor ever! His lecture and explanations are so clear and any doubts you have will be respectfully answered by him!!

I didn't officially have him. I had some Greek professor that I could not understand and I started out basically failing... stopped going and only watched Ryan's lectures and my grade shot up and I did well in the course. If I started calculus over I would chose to only have him as my professor.
Absolutely amazing at explaining everything, his lectures make it super easy to succeed in the class.
Great videos and explanations, never met him in person but was very likeable and funny in the lectures

He's an awesome guy and gives amazing lectures. There's a note packet for every chapter and that's just super helpful for learning. However, the only thing I believe is insufficient for this class are some of the class notes, and hw/recitation just doesn't match up. What's included in the hw doesn't covered by what he taught in the lecture.
best professor ever he does an amazing job making you understand very complicated material
Watch this guy's YouTube lectures to pass MTH 133. Trust me. Ryan Maccombs is an absolute beauty.

This man quite literally carries the entirety of MTH234 on his back. His lectures are legendary and the provided notes templates are a ticket to success so long as you actually do them. The grading on the online quizzes and tests was extremely unfair/tough, but you can still get a good grade.

I took this online so I watched his lectures before the recitation later in the week. Quizzes every week and a test after every two quizzes. Homework due Tues, Thurs, Sat. Class got to the point that the lectures didn't explain every hw problem, so I had to resort to piazza and eventually chegg. Overall not a bad experience, but a hard class.

If new to calculus, watch the lesson videos, still not understand, do homework, homework make lesson videos click and help you understand the lesson. Tests has few questions, exams have few more questions than tests. Some homework questions may be on test and exams. Summary: Class is straight forward and Ryan Maccombs will carry you to an A.

If new to calculus, watch the video lessons and do the homework as the homework will help make the lesson you watch make more sense. Tests and exams are somewhat easy, there may be some questions from the homework on the tests and exams that have different numbers or wording. Summary: Class will not give hard questions and or make you suffer.
Fantastic professor, really makes calc 3 a breeze if you watch all of his lectures.
I absolutely love Dr. Maccombs. I have been watching his videos for calculus 1 and 2 and owe all my success to him. He is fantastic. Unmatched. a true genius.

Ryan carries the entire math department on his back. He is amazing at explaining complicated concepts that other professors just glaze over. I didn't attend a single in person lecture last year, I just watched his videos and now I am taking 234 in his online section. Even other "good" math profs won't get you as far as Dr. Maccombs and his vids.

I was in Algebra 2 extended and hated math senior year of high school but thanks to Dr.Maccombs's wonderful  lectures I breezed through calculus 1-3 and got admitted to the college of engineering. Unlike all of the droning monotone robots you've probably had before, he actually sounds like he enjoys being there and knows how to explain things!

The ideal calculus professor. By far the best professor I've had in math at MSU and one of the best professors period. Something about the way he teaches makes lectures engaging and keep you paying attention.

Genuinely the best instructor I've had at MSU. This instructor's supplemental videos and live lectures have made mastering Calc I-III, an extraordinarily challenging feat, far more achievable. His dedication to breaking concepts down and explaining everything in a way that is accessible to any person is mind-blowing. Truly a gem.

I have never given a professor a rating before because I have never felt that strongly about them or their class. HOWEVER, I had to make one for Ryan Maccombs. He has single handedly taught me my last two math classes from using his online lectures (calc 1 and 2). I haven't been to math class in 2 semesters but his videos made me 4.0 both.

Forget mathematician, Ryan Maccombs is a math-magician. A true renaissance man; there is not a single person on this planet that this guy could not teach calculus too. Professor Maccombs definitely has an IQ of at least 160 because out of all the math professors I've had (a lot of them), none have been able to come remotely close to his ability.

Ryan's back must hurt from carrying the MSU math department on his BACK. Here's a disclosure: I have never actually had him assigned as my professor in either Calc 1 or Calc 2. He posts his lectures and amazingly organized notes that you use to follow along with him, on D2L, and youtube. Without both of these things, I would never have passed.
Great videos and lectures, very clear.

By far the best math professor at MSU. Attendance isn't actually required because all of the lectures are posted online right after class is over, so if you miss a class, don't worry too much. The classes are very hard, but Professor Maccombs makes it a lot better. I wish he would always be my math teacher. Just remember to stay on top of homework!

Professor Maccombs has a variety of materials available to help students succeed. He creates guided notes to go with his videos and lectures, making it easy to study for the exams. I took him for MTH 133 and am now taking him for MTH 234 because he is that good.

Had him for calc 2 and 3 - safe to say this man is an absolute prodigy of a professor! Im convinced professor Ryan could teach calc to a chimp. He does basically everything right from great lectures to being accessible outside of class. You will learn so much in his class if you put in the work. Easily the best math teacher I've ever had.

Ryan Maccombs was a phenomenal professor. He was always ready to answer any questions and would always go into enough detail so that you would understand. He is extremely nice and his lectures are great. The class itself is brutal, but Maccombs is so competent that even someone like me who's awful at math can pass. Best math prof at MSU PERIOD!

Ryan Maccombs is the absolute GOAT. The man records videos for each section and throws them on the tube. He also hosts asynchronous lectures that go over the tougher questions in the section. Lecture attendance not required if you watch the youtube vids. The material is hard, I went to MLC or CoRE 3 days a week to secure the bag. Gotta work for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The best professor I have had so far at MSU. Pre-class videos essentially taught all necessary content. The class was difficult but with help rooms, office hours, and great teaching the class was manageable. It was clear Maccombs really cared and tried. He wasn't just another clown on tenure.

Daddy Ryan is an absolute hoss of a professor. He is very enthusiastic and good at explaining math concepts in a way that is linear and simplifies things down to first principles. He makes math lectures about as interesting as a math lecture can be. His class is by no means easy but also not unreasonably hard like some professors.

Participation for a grade, textbook used for extra practice (optional). Always took time to answer student questions, even if he had to repeat what he just said. Ryan is the best calc professor at MSU, take his class if you can, you won't regret it. Just be ready to put in the work needed to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Ryan Maccombs is a gem of a professor. He's welcoming and invites questions at all times. He answers tons of questions on the class forum as well, and generally seems to care deeply about his students. If you ever get the opportunity to have him as a professor, take it. The class is very hard but Ryan makes Calculus II bearable, which is a feat.
Absolutely wonderful, content was very hard; however, I felt that no one could have done a better job.

Taking MTH234 as an online course due to COVID actually helped because I could attend the lecture with the profs I liked the best and could attend Ryan's office hours which were always very good. Highly recommend going to his office hours or even emailing him for help. Very nice and you can totally tell he loves what he does.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Tough grader. I took this class twice. Both times with Ryan. He is a great teacher. He really cares about teaching math and it shows. Hands down the best professor at MSU. I would recommend taking him for all of your math classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: If you want to succeed in ANY math class he teaches, TAKE HIM! He's honestly the best professor
Super organized, absolutely no surprises. Was a very difficult course would not have wanted to take it with anyone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The material is hard for some but he shows genuine passion for what he does.
Fantastic teacher and even better guy. Attendance isn't mandatory but the class moves fast so just show up. Going to office hours is very helpful because he cares about each student.

It's a hard class for sure. He's the professor at MSU to have for this class. Attendance is not mandatory but it is important to attend every class and recitation. 3 exams and a final. Quizzes every other week. Webwork due every few days. It is a fast-paced class.

Professor Maccombs is very easy to approach. Extremely friendly and will, in no doubt, help you in Calculus 2. Aside from lecture, he also makes the video notes for calc 2 and has his students join piaza, which is a discussion forum to ask eachother questions, and he frequently checks up on that site. He makes sure we know whats going on in class.
Very good at explaining the topics

Amazing Professor, I had a hard time learning the material and went to every one of his office hours. And no matter how many stupid questions i asked, he sat there and explained the concepts until we found a method I understood. Super patient and the best teacher this school has to offer. Not to mention Harry Potter fan and he makes class fun!!!
he is super awesome. hard class but if you really study you will do well. he's the best prof for this class DO NOT take it with anyone else.

Hands down the best professor Ive ever had for any subject. He loves what hes teaching and he gives out plenty of extra resources to help students succeed. Also, lecture attendance isnt mandatory and the exact notes we take in class are posted online, if your not invested in a 4.0 you dont need to go to class.
Very good professor, this guy know what he is talking about.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The best teacher to have for my first calc class in college
Prof Maccombs is absolutely dedicated to helping his students succeed. His lectures are clear and well guided and he even puts in the time and effort to make great math videos for help.

ive taken many math classes and even from a year ago I remember ryan he is definitely a really good teacher, really easy to understand AND he puts all the notes online. he also is very willing to help and take questions during class
Ryan Maccombs is a math god. You are lucky if you take his class. He is too good for all of us.

Best professor I have had here at MSU. There is a pre-class video and video check/ easy mini quiz online that count for quiz points. So if you stay on top of your pre class work you will automatically get 3 points on your weekly quiz. Lecture attendance is not necessary if you keep up with the posted notes, its easy to do well without showing up.

Easy 4. if you do all the notes, attend class, go to the MLC, and actually study for the exams. He's pretty straight forward in his expectations, and if you're willing to put in the work its not a hard class. All the notes are on youtube, and he's very clear at explaining the concepts. He genuinely cares about his students and it definitely shows.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Maccombs is awesome! He makes great videos and really tries to make sure everyone succeeds. Go to lecture and do the WeBWork and you'll get an A. Maccombs and his TAs are available all the time for extra help too!
Honestly best professor I've had at MSU. He is very well organized and gives his class all he can to make sure we succeed on the exams.

Maccombs was honestly the best professor I had this semester. He genuinely wants everyone in the class to get a 4.0 and he does a wonderful job explaining the material of the course. He is always available if you need extra help. If you have him for MTH132 consider yourself lucky.
Take this class

This professor genuinely cares about his students. He is always available for help and does his best to make the class interesting. He made our class Harry Potter themed! He goes over the material thoroughly and the level of difficultly of his quizzes are indicative of the exams. One couldn't hope to have a better professor for this class!

Homework and quizzes are easy and his lectures are generally helpful and entertaining. Get ready to do a lot of work outside class, but with the MLC you should be fine. Exams however are ridiculous and they are harshly graded. Don't feel shocked if you see questions on the exam you never learned. Otherwise he's chill.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Helpful videos, a very good teacher that explains thoroughly, exams are fair game
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Wolfe is one of the best lecturers and professors that I've had at MSU. He makes the material very accessible and explains everything thoroughly. Attendance isn't technically required, but you will do much better if you just go to class and take notes from his slides. Grade is based off 4 exams and 3 in class assignments, very manageable.

Best professor i've had at MSU. Came into this class expecting to hate it because it was boring but his passion and humor made it so fun. If I could take another class with him I would. I actually am going to miss it when the semester ends.

I can't say enough about what a great prof Wolfe is, he is understanding, unbiased, and entertaining. His lectures are incredibly valuable and his research experience makes him incredibly educated on policing. There are a few assignments and a handful of exams, all very managable. His expectations are reasonable, attainable A with effort.

Your whole grade depended on a number of 3 exams. He doesn't post notes so you have to make a friend in the class if you do ever miss a class. He was funny and answered questions good so I could understand. The lecture material was understandable

Super entertaining professor, made the lectures entertaining and included real world examples. Worst thing is that the grade is solely based off of 3 exams, nothing else. If you're anything like me, a distractible person accompanied by a bad test taker. This class is probably not for you.

loved dr. wolfe. Only 3 tests make up your whole grade. He gives study guides and the tests follow the textbook and his lecture notes. Attendance isn't mandatory but he doesn't post notes so if you want a good grade you have to go.

Had him for 220 and 335 and it was great. He is very clear on what he is grading and gives opportunities to make things up as long as you are open and honest with him. He doesn't have a lot of points in the class so make sure you are paying attention to that. Very open to conversations about real life events and treats you like an equal.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Cares about his students and is willing to work with you if you need to take exams on different days. Gives extra credit sometimes for showing up to class. Great guy.

One of the few professors who can synthesize CJ academics with real-world implications. Incredibly smart and personable. Will challenge you intellectually and helped me develop a comprehensive worldview on the subject. Note-taking and slides translate to exams, best professor I've had here.

He's a cool professor. He makes the heavy lectures easy to understand and uses a lot of real-world examples to help you remember things. The grades for the class is made up of 4 exams. They can be tricky because of the wording of the questions so read carefully. You don't have to go to class but he gives a lot of hints to what's on the exam.

If you're looking for a prof for criminology, TAKE WOLFE. Grade was based on just three exams and a few in-class extra credit opportunities, but the exams were easy if you go to lecture and take notes. He doesn't post slides. There is a little exam review he does which was helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Wolfe makes lectures fun but doesnt post them so its best to show up. Book questions come up so you should read!! His reviews help a lot for exams (when time allows)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Wolfe is a great professor! He's very funny and loves/knows what he is teaching. He provides extra credit attendance opportunities (at random). There is no homework. The grade was made up of 4 exams only (he grades very quickly). You have to attend class because he doesn't post slides, but it's an easy A if you study the lecture notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Absolutely incredible professor. Some people think that the concepts are hard, and my advisor even said it would be my most difficult course. However, I found it fairly easy due to how good Professor Sendova is at teaching. There is a few hours of homework a week, though, but it definitely prepares you very well. Awesome professor 10/10
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Sendova is the best and kindest professor I have ever had. She teaches the material so well and she is incredibly patient with any student. She puts in extra effort all the time, and will respond to all emails in a timely manner.

Despite the content being difficult, homework assignments and assessments weren't too difficult. The class is set up for you to succeed, with clear grading criteria, and exam drop, and useful recitations that actually help you learn. She is also always willing to help students with anything math related at MSU.

Tsveta made MTH-317H a fun time, taking an infamously hard class and making it fun and doable. The material is challenging, but she does a great job at explaining it and providing feedback on HW to help you improve. She lets you drop 2 HW assignments and 1 exam, which allows for flexibility if you get sick. Can't recommend highly enough!

Sendova was an incredible professor who cared about each and everyone of her students. She made differential equations feel like an easy A, and should be taken above any other professor if given the opportunity.
Very kind and always willing to answer questions. Clear lectures that do a good job explaining the material as well as what to expect on tests and quizzes. She is super chill

Dr. Sendova was really great. Make sure to show up to class. Quizzes were somewhat difficult and only 3 written questions added up to 60% of that quiz. Make sure to study off the quizzes because most questions on the Exams are from the quizzes. Would take again.
Class is tough (easier than Calc 3 though), but she does a great job of combating that. Will always answer questions when asked and gives good feedback. Not much to really complain about.

Professor Sendova is by far the best professor I've had thus far. Although the material is somewhat tricky, she cares about her students and wants them to succeed. Her lectures are clear and understandable, coming from a student who struggles more in math. I would 100% take her class again if I had to.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Sendova is a highly articulate professor who encourages questions and student understanding of material. This professor made the class very simple, even for a high level math class like Calculus 4. Highly recommend for students, one of the best professors I have ever had.
Amazing professor; this class was such a relief after taking calc 3. I would highly recommend taking Dr. Sendova's lecture if you have to take MTH 235.
He was a great professor. I'd highly recommend taking this course. Just trust me on this one.

I had Scott for HDFS 238 which was a really simple course. Used McGraw Hill for assignments and was willing to reopen assignments if you did not submit them on time. He would post the midterms and final exam questions and answers after class and allows to take pictures of them, my class also had a GroupMe if you missed a class. Really chill guy

He is really easy, but he's also really disorganized. While his class is definitely an easy 4.0, the lectures were super boring and he goes off on tangents unrelated to the main topic, and his D2L was a total mess with incorrect dates and information. He's definitely not a bad person or rude, but he's just not a good professor.

Incredibly helpful, kind, and understanding professor. Prof makes sure everyone feels seen and classes honestly feel like just having a chat with your friend. As other reviews have mentioned, he does talk about politics, but he is extremely respectful of other views and consistently emphasizes that.
Course had a late start and met only once a week. Very lenient guy and during lectures will sometimes just go off topic and tell stories. Cares more about your mental health than your grade

Late start course, lecture once a week but not mandatory. Everything is on D2L and SIMnet, which was a little hard to navigate but it was fine. Super lenient on late work and helpful if you miss an exam (extended deadlines) and both exams were online. There was no final exam. Cool guy and talks a lot about his life and random stuff.

Dr. Matteson is a kind and laid-back professor who gives clear grading criteria, is an easy grader, advocates for mental health days when students needs, and provides a basis of how management systems in the nonprofit sector work. Capstone project, one-minute writes (had to be in class), and workbook is pretty much your entire grade.

Although there is not much structure to this course, I really enjoyed it and learned a lot. I liked the "social hour" of it. The stuff he speaks about is not as political as other posts are making it seem. He cares a lot about his students and just wants participation. No exams or quizzes, just a capstone and one minute writes.

LOVED prof matteson! best class i have ever taken. no exams just random in class assignments (SUPER EASY) and capstones. the capstones were based on creativity not research. easy grader and cares heavily for his students.

Dr. Matteson focuses on preparing students for life after college, not just covering material. He values participation and communication about needs. He's kind and understanding—I've seen him give “dad hugs” to students. He cares about effort and following the syllabus, with brief attendance checks.

For anybody reading the negative reviews for fall 2026, don't listen to them. This guy is a good professor. He treats you like a real person and acts like a real person himself. You do learn things in this class and he is a great person to talk to. He's funny and cares about you. Just take the good grade and enjoy a class for once.
He is a nice dude, but all he really does is complain about his home life. I stopped going to class halfway through the year.

absolutely terrible, it's social hour. learn 0. talks about politics/how God isnt real, super liberal, weird/uncomfortable. nothing about subject. 0tests, 0projects, just a paragraph/week doesnt grade on time. singles out the only black man in class, should b fired. beyond lazy, complains about the university HE CHOSE to work at.

I'm sorry 4 people who spend money on this class you will learn nothing. I want to learn something. All he does is talk about politics, & his comments has made me uncomfortable, where I have wanted to report it to the university. A lot of his lectures dont relate to the topic, saying God isnt real, comments on his wife's body...dissapointing MSU

This class is super easy, really poorly organized but assignments are easy and due dates don't matter. Prof is caring and kind to students but he's a narcissist and literally just talks about himself and complains the whole hour. You have to buy a coursebook that he wrote and its super poorly written and he doesnt even know when stuff is due.
SUCH A KING. so funny. super understanding when it comes to deadlines/ grading. exams all online and open for a full day

He lets you take pictures of the exam questions/answers at the end of class as an incentive to go every day. It's the easiest class in the world. There are assignments you have to do but they're easy too and don't take long at all. He's nice and funny and enjoys his students. Even if you hate personal finance, take it anyways.

Dr. Matteson really cares about his students and their well-being. Come to class and sit in the front he loves to get to know consistent students. He starts doing attendance when people stop showing up, but he gives points back if he recognizes your face. People saying he's disorganized did not come to class because everything was clearly outlined.

This was one of my favorite classes at MSU. He cares deeply about his students and truly wants us to succeed in life. It's an easy course because he would rather us focus on our mental health or the words he speaks as opposed to stressing over assignments and grades. If you're planning to take personal finance, please take it with him!

Lazy professor, does not even know his own assignments and is constantly asking students for whats due and when. Hypocritical of his own policies and went back and forth twice on if he was going to do one-min writes for random attendance points. Stated he was not going to do them anymore and then 3 in a row. did not like this class, everyone 4.0s

Take him, he is so kind and fun. He just asks that people show up and participate, grading is easy and the homework is easy. I liked the digital workbook, easy to navigate and it grade your homework immediately. If more people participated, it would've gone better, but no one ever came. Just go to class and participate, he doesn't ask for much.

Dr. Matteson was my favorite teacher this semester. As long as you go to most of the lectures you will do great because he gives you the exam answers at the end of class. He cares so much about his students and wants them not to worry or stress about his class. There are a few assignments but they can all be completed easily during class.

Dr. Matteson is such an amazing professor that genuinely cares about the wellbeing of his students. His lectures are interesting and you will be successful in his class as long as you do all of the work. I would recommend this to anybody!
Dr. Matteson is amazing. He lectures the material but provides anecdotes, which make the class much more lively. HIGHLY recommend this class.

Professor Matteson is great! For the internship class he makes sure that the work is not overloading on top of the hours needed to work. As long as you stay on top of the couple assignments he gives, this is an easy A. He grades easily and fairly and expectations are made super clear.

Dr. Matteson was the best prof. He talked about his life, which was sometimes useful. The slides didn't matter much because even he didn't always know what was on them. You had to do all the SmartBook tasks and quizzes. The exam questions and answers were given to you before the exam, so it was easy to get 4.0
Best professor at msu by far. easy 4.0 very little work

Prof Matteson is awesome. Took his class for an elective, and I am very glad that I did. He cares a lot about his students, is very transparent, and a respected prof. The content is not too hard, not too heavy either. Defintely recommend him!

You're making a mistake if you don't take this class. Highly suggest taking if you need another honors experience project. Best professor I've had, he wants you to succeed and is so helpful if you ever have questions, very caring. Exams are easy, quizzes are usually only 1 question, not much homework and they can all be completed during lectures.
Pretty easy class, extended deadlines if needed
An amazing professor and one of the best professors at MSU. The class is very laid back, but very helpful at the same time. I would have this professor over and over again if I could.
Best professor at MSU. He teaches important information and is very light-hearted and funny.

I was very excited to take this course but I was disappointed to find that the lectures had no structure. There was no incentive to come to class because everything was discussion based and there were no assignments to apply what we had talked about because everything was open ended. I still attended classes but I never felt challenged.

This was the easiest class I have taken at MSU. Being in class was important but there was almost no homework, assignments, and no exams whatsoever. Dr. Matteson is an amazing person who cares about true learning and not grades. He is very approachable and will work with you on anything. Great professor and easy class.

Dr Matteson is a super chill dude. He helps out with exams and quizzes are super short. His lectures are very engaging and he is a very entertaining and kind professor. The assignments are very manageable as long as you give yourself a comfortable couple of days to do them.

Attendance is not taken, and you don't need to attend lectures besides exam review day. There are weekly quizzes on d2l that are very easy and 3 projects throughout the semester that are very doable. The exams are easy, this class was my easiest this semester. If you take personal finance, you need to take it with this prof.

Professor Matteson is by far the nicest professor I've had. He is understanding and lenient with due dates. Quizzes and exams are easy, and you only have 3 homework assignments for the entire semester. The assignments only take a few hours each. Overall, I would 100% recommend this class, especially to anyone who already has a lot of harder classes

This is by far the easiest class and professor you'll ever have. Highly recommend this class with him. If you have an opportunity to take this class, do it. You only spend about 5 hours the whole semester on work in this class. Easily the best professor at MSU.

Professor Matteson was the best professor I had and I don't think I will ever find a professor as genuinely caring for his students. His class is awesome, very easy, and teaches life tips about personal finance.

Professor Matteson is a great guy and his HDFS 238 class is a cakewalk. If you are looking for a blow-off class, take it. He is very laid back and if you miss an assignment he gladly grants you extra time. Exams are also very easy and practically given to you if you pay attention in class.

I took this class as a freshman. I believe everyone at the University should take a Personal Finance class. Mr. Matteson is an awesome dude if you get to know him. Class size decreased as the year went on; he gives you EVERY test answer if you go to the class review session. I enjoyed this class. Easy A, but pay attention, the content matters.

Definitely recommend taking his course, especially if you are looking to lighten your courseload! I learned a lot from this course, there's just 3 assignments, exams, and quizzes. He is very straightforward with everything. I liked his random stories during lecture, makes it more entertaining.
Awesome professor! He truly cares about his students. A very easy grader if you do the work! Take this class! You won't regret it!
Scott was a great professor- he really cares about his students and wants the best for them!
Not many assignments. Easy grader. Responds to emails. Truly cares for his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Matteson is amazing. He cares about his students so much and he keeps class interesting even when the topics aren't
she really likes her dog. just pay attention and participate in class and easy 4.0, also ask questions whenever you have them because she will give you the answer

She is the first professor I have had who genuinely prioritizes learning over grades. She makes it her goal to ensure her students are not overly stressed and is also very flexible with exam dates. Everything on her exams is based on material we have covered in class, just presented in different scenarios. I promise that you will like her!

I often found myself confused in class, but learned the material. Dr. Masani is a very understanding professor and wants her students to pass. There are plenty of opportunities for extra credit, but even without it, its easy to 4.0 her course. Do the preclass assignments and you're golden.
Dr. Masani is a wonderful teacher and by far the most understanding professor I have had. All her lectures are very engaging, and the tests are straightforward.

She's an amazing professor that focuses on her student's ability to understand the material. The classes are group-based so that you can learn to work with others. She offers so much extra credit throughout the course and ensures that you get the grade that you want. You only have to take the final exam if you don't have 4.0 by end of semester.

She is super flexible with deadlines and wants every student to succeed! Loved having her for intro to bio and her lectures were not overwhelming. I could ask many questions during her office hours and she didn't over-explain. Lab was kinda boring for LB 144 but I did like most of the lecture materials compared to lab.

I believe this is the best professor at MSU without a doubt. She cares so much for her students, and it made me want to show up to class and learn. I was able to ask questions without feeling judged, and she would explain topics to me even if it was in the middle of the night. Please take her if you can.

This professor is one of the best I have met at MSU. She genuinely cares for her students and will help you whenever you need. She listens to her students and makes adjustments to her course to help you succeed. Communication is key in this course. Nothing but love for this class, as it made me feel supported, capable, and confident.

Honestly one of my favorite professors I've ever had. She wants you to succeed, and will walk with you every step of the way to make sure you do. Exams can be difficult, but as long as you prep and take your time, you'll be okay. All in all, if you engage in class, ask questions, and go to office hours if you're struggling, you will 4.0 this class.

Dr. Masani is hands down the best professor in Lyman Briggs. I have never met a professor that cares so deeply for her students and will take as much time as needed to support them as best possible. She once started a zoom meeting at 11 pm just to help me understand something I was stuck on. Challenging content, but she will make sure you succeed.

Dr. M is the best professor I have ever had. She truly cares for each student and wants you to succeed. The exams are open note and proficiency based with an emphasis on applying your knowledge to new scenarios and the course is loaded with extra credit. Attendance is not mandatory but you need to go to lecture if you want to succeed.

Dr. Masani is an amazing professor who cares deeply for her students. Exams are tough, HW is light, lectures are material heavy but she is super helpful and fun and will help you with whatever you need. Lab is apart of course grade but it is easy and based on an independent project that is worked on all semester.
She's the best.

I've never met a professor that cares more about her students than Dr. Masani. She will work with each individual to ensure that they get out of the class what they want to get out of it, and she will never make you feel embarrassed for asking questions. Her class content is not easy, but it is necessary, and you're guaranteed to learn so much!

she is very easy to create a relationship with and is very passionate about biology, her students, and her students success. However, her teaching style is different but once you get the hang of it and everything begins to piece together and you can understand without crazy studying. She loads the class with extra credit as well

Amazing professor. Do the pre-class and really pay attention as she asks questions in class and makes you really know. I've genuinely never learned content better than in this class. It is hard and it does require a lot of work, but you can always text her on GroupMe. You get a scenario before each exam, as long as you prep it right, easy A.

She really cares for her students and makes herself very accessible outside of class. She also makes sure you understand what is being taught. Personally I don't think you need to study much outside class except for the preclass assignments. If you want to do well in the class just pay attention, go to review sessions, and ask a lot of questions
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of the best professors at LB college! She makes it so easy to communicate with her out of class via groupme & office hours. Dr. Masani offers many opportunities for extra credit. She truly cares about how students can improve and grow. Her exams are not traditional. If you prepare a lot for the exams and work hard, you will ace!

Masani is great. Cares a ton for her students. She focuses a lot on society and redlining and the interplay of power struggles with biology, and all that stuff, so if you want a more "normal" biology course where you are strictly learning about bio, I might not recommend her. But she's a Lyman Briggs prof, what do you expect.

She is easily my favorite professor, as she truly cares about you and understands that you are a student with other responsibilities.
