She was a great prof that really wants students to succeed. Grades entirely on if you do the work and that's it. Easy 4.0. She has a lot of discussions with groups and the class. Really fun and caring professor overall.

Very good professor.  Let's you submit most things late as long as there's no activity on it in class the next day.  All grades are participation/effort, even the essays.  I was even able to submit an essay in comic sans and I didn't lose anything from it.  Frequently does in class discussions.  As long as you put effort in you can expect a 4.0

One of my favorite profs. She is an extremely understanding and great teacher. However, she really wants students to participate in class so if you are not willing to talk about your opinions in class, she isn't for you. Easy class, attendance isn't mandatory but I would recommend going at least once a week to show your face.
Not enough uplifting words- she is AMAZING! The best teacher I have had my first year of college. Very genuine.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Super nice professor. Leaves great feedback on work. Well constructed course which teaches lots of helpful things applicable in and outside the classroom. Overall experience was top-notch.
Lots of great learning in class!
Super sweet, gives really good feedback and lots of essays and projects but helpful and thorough process for each paper
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Swada is amazing, this class is super fun and the labs are actually informative and engaging. The class is mostly based on lab reports ~65% of the grade. Swada genuinely cares about student success in and out of the classroom and is a wonderful person to be around. Can't recommend him enough!

Dr. Swada is such a passionate and kind professor who is very helpful in and out of class. He responds to emails super fast and is very supportive and wants everyone to succeed. Study guides are almost copies of the exams which was very helpful, and the group project at the end isn't graded super harshly. Overall great person and professor.

Swada is awesome! He is super knowledgeable about food science and cares about the students and their success. The exams are 60%, but the study guides are extremely helpful. He frequently brings in products to taste test that correlate with the lecture topics. He posts PDFs of the required readings on D2L, so there is not required text.
Amazing dude. Teaches his language classes in english half the time, but he's a great guy.

Garret is literally the BEST teacher ever. He is so hilarious and makes coming to class worth it! He is slow in explaining things which is really nice if you get off track easily. And he is willing to help on whatever, whenever. I wish i could take this class over and over!

Profe Swinton was by far the best professor I have had for any of my language classes. He is very informative, explains everything in ways you can understand, and makes the class fun. He genuinely cares for his students, but also pushes you to be your best. Not to mention, he is very easy on the eyes. Dios mio!

Madame Sylvie wasn't the best French teacher I ever had but, she is very caring and helpful. Her accent can make it hard to understand her sometimes but, she really cares about all her students. Lots of homework online and if you miss 10 classes you fail.

My biggest gripe about Mme. Wanda was her tendency to not answer questions completely; classmates and I made sure to do extra reading in order to compensate for her lack of explanations. Her being from Cameroon was interesting as I was able to hear about the use of French in a setting other than France. A lot of her focus was on speaking, as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Wanda seemed new to teaching last fall when I took her FRN102 class. At MSU the 100 level language classes are incredibly easy. The only sucky part was paying a bunch of money for access to the iLrn homework which was required for the class. Just show up and try during the short classes and you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This was a very easy class, Very lecture heavy at the beginning which got very boring. at the halfway point it switches to a lab which you are doing groupwork which wasn't the greatest. but it was a very easy 4.0.
Ken was great
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class. Ken did a great job of keeping lectures engaging and providing useful information. I enjoyed the lecture parts of this class and would definitively recommend this class to anyone interested in starting a business.

Professor Szymusiak is very easy going. The lectures are dry but he tries really hard to make them fun. You split into group work and its actually pretty fun. The class is easy and the professor tries to make it fun. This is an easy A. Attendance isn't required in lecture but once you split into group work it is. Easy class for a last minute option
Easy and fun class. You can learn a lot in this too. Second half is all group work so if you have a bad group it could make the class harder

Professor Szymusiak is a great professor who tries his best to give the students his insights. There are 6 quizzes and 3 engagement activities. There are also a ton of group deliverables that are fairly straightforward. You must attend lectures because that is where the information needed for the course is provided.
awesome professor, made class interesting and i found it quite easy

Half of the semester were lectures that were boring in a massive lecture hall and the other half were in a small classroom. the use of forcing you to attend events for a portion of your grade was frustrating and pointless. I thought the content was interesting but why force me to spend my free time at events you host for points in the class?
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Szymusiak teaches the first half (lecture part) of ESHP 190. He does a good job of trying to make (sometimes dry) content interesting. He brings in a few guest speakers that help change the pace of the class which I appreciated. He teaches a few sections of the second half (lab part), but I did not have him for that.

He's a good teacher and he knows what he's talking about, and he does his best to keep it interesting, but I couldn't help but become disinterested in the subject because of the lecture part of this course. So, only take this class if you have an actual interest in entrepreneurship and want to learn more about the foundations of it.

If you take his BUS190 class you have to do 5 engagement events which are kind of annoying but it's easy points if you do them. You can use your notes for online quizzes but the exams are a little more difficult.

He is very personable and class is fun! Worth showing up to lecture even though you do not have to. Simply do the work and you can easily get the A if you just follow the guidelines. Exams are exactly like the weekly quizzes, but are not too easy.

Ken is a really funny guy and cares a lot about what he's teaching. His lectures are pretty simple to understand. Everything is done online except the exams. Super enjoyable to go to class. A lot of guest speakers. Would recommend to take.

Ken is a great professor! He is very laid back (and young) so his lectures are normally pretty interesting. There are a lot of guest speakers that are from big companies like Biggby Coffee, ect. so it made lectures enjoyable. Overall, I would recommend taking this class, you learn a lot, and quizzes/tests are fairly easy if you just go to class.

While her class is hard, she is a great professor and teaches the subject about as well as you can. As long as you pay attention in lectures you'll be fine. I didn't pay enough attention so I didn't get the best grade but she definitely knows what she's doing. She's super nice and was one of my favorite professors!

Went to her office hours weekly, and she gives good feedback and help for the weekly homework. The quizzes are a little hard, so you do have to put extra effort into them. Offers one quiz and homework drop, and the final exam is optional, which is great. Explains the content well and is organized. The homework is difficult, but she helps you.

Horrible teacher overall. Lectures are completely useless and don't help you learn at all yet are required. You learn everything from the textbook. A ton of reading assignments but the weekly hw isn't the worst. Impossible for her to stay consistent with her own key. Worst grading I've ever seen. Doesn't like people who don't participate in class.

I find it frustrating that Dr. Kendrick has difficulty explaining genetic terms despite teaching this class for years. Leads to a lot of confusion for students. Tough grader and gets overwhelmed/flustered easily. She was late to class half the semester
Gives little to no time for exams and does not take feedback well.

This professor gives 30 minutes for exams that other classes have an entire class period for. Grades very harshly and offers no explanations for why. She acts all sweet during lectures but is unbelievably rude when you talk to her one on one or email her. I wouldn't recommend this class unless you want to suffer

I would not recommend taking this course unless you enjoy having a bad professor. She allows 30 minutes for multiple choice exams including multiple free response questions. She grades very harsh on things we do together in class. When you try to email her with concerns you are met with no response or no care for the concerns. Terrible experience.

She teaches a basic 200 level class and the average for our first exam was a 62%; barely passing. The exams are insanely hard, timed, and you have a case study directly after. You have 30 mins to do roughly 25 questions include short answers, which is where most of your points come from. I didn't think this was fair, esp only having 30 min. like no

Dr. Kendrick is a nice person, however I would not recommend her as a professor. For ANS 210 there are 3 exams and a final exam at the end. No exam grades are dropped and she gives us 30 minutes to complete exams which have multiple choice and open ended questions at the end. On exam days, we have to do a group case study after as well. Good luck.

Dr. Kendrick acts like she's your friend but destroys your grade without caring. She grades harshly and gets upset when multiple students say they are confused. Her lectures are rushed and don't cover all of the exam material. Exams are too long for the given time and some questions are even about topics that were covered only once in passing.

This class was very interesting. I enjoyed the challenge it posed, but I was initially scared about how well I would grasp the content. I suggest picking a strong way to study for the exams straight off the bat. I went thru all presented homework/discussions and redid them myself. If you put the work in and ask questions, you can do good.
Grades super hard

Dr. Kendrick is super nice! I took 210 which is a lot of guest lecturers so I didn't interact with her much, but she is always approachable and happy to help students. There are online open-note exams throughout the semester then an in person cumulative closed-notes final. Overall the class is not super difficult if you show up and pay attention.

Was scared to take her class after seeing all the reviews before but this semester she changed the format of the class so it was easier. I really liked her, she is a very caring teacher who you can tell genuinely cares that we succeed in not only this class but outside of it. She dropped many assignments and offered a lot of extra credit.

Good luck. She is a super nice person but her classes are incredibly disorganized and exams are usually not aligned with the content she teaches. I recommend getting very comfortable with disappointment and having YouTube as your professor, which is tricky because her material is extensive.
Dr. Kendrick is my favorite teacher, despite the fact that he is a tough grader, is an amazing teacher who cares about her students

Dr. Kendrick definitely doesn't make he class super easy. However, I learned so much from her and felt that she genuinely cares about the wellbeing of her students. No her classes are not easy, but she is great.

Dr. Kendrick as a person is very sweet and understanding but as a prof is not so good. She never fully explained things and her tests were always very tricky. There is a big project you work on in groups of 4 that I didn't really like because you could end up working on 90% of it alone and everyone would get a good grade. Overall, she was okay.

She's very kind as a person, but not as a professor. Her quizzes and tests are designed to trick you and her explanations are vague. The final is an essay that you work on in teams of 4-5, which is inconvenient especially when you get paired with a group that procrastinates. I got a 4.0 by spending hours doing my group's work by myself.

She was one of the best professors i have ever had! You do need to put in the work in this class, but it is so rewarding. If you do the work the exams are a piece of cake. She was so caring and understanding and she was a really good role model for us all. I would have loved if i could take another class with her!

Dr. Kendrick is a great professor! You have to put in hard work to be successful, but that is to be expected as you progress through college. She is very helpful and wants to see her students learn. I also did an ANS492 project with her, and she has been an amazing mentor.

Dr. Kendrick was a great professor! I could tell that she really cared about her students and genuinely wanted to see them succeed. There are a lot of assignments for the class, but they are necessary because it is better to have practice with math problems. I really enjoyed having her as a professor and felt like the course material was useful.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Even though shes the instructor for this course, you learn from specialists in the different units. There are some units that were more challenging in my opinion, you also have exercises you complete for each unit, and term paper you work on with your group throughout the semester. She also will give you more time to complete things if needed

Dr. Kendrick has a great personality and cares about her students. With that being said, I hated her class. She grades very harsh and gives a lot of work. Topics covered were very in depth and youre expected to master them in 3 days each. Tests and quizzes full of vaguely worded or tricky questions that u can get wrong even if u know the material

Good teacher, moved back our due dates multiple times. Easy to ask questions, rubrics available. Small homework assignments and quizzes for each unit, exams are short. Group work for a large term paper that's due at the end of the semester. She brings in experts in each field and I learned a lot from both the class and answers from the experts.

She presents herself as someone who is your friend and willing to work with you, yet gives unclear rubrics and expectations and expects you to figure it out. When we ask her to change something or that everyone got that hw or question wrong she blames you for not looking at the rubic. she is condescending, and makes everyone do the work for her.

Dr. Kendrick/Taxis is the best teacher at MSU! She will drop everything to help you and loves to see her students success! She is so nice and although the class can seem like a lot, if you stay up to date on lectures youll learn a lot! Dont take advantage of how nice she is! Best teacher ever!!

Dr. T is amazing! Truly cares about her students and wants them to succeed. She is always asking for feedback about the class and shes super nice. The class is tough and the material requires a lot of practice but help is easily accessible for whoever needs it. No textbook required and online recitation is offered.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Taxis genuinely cares about the class that she teaches, and she does her best to make the information as clear as possible. She does everything she can to make sure students learn and is extremely supportive. She always asks for feedback about the course and describes the class --including herself & the TAs--as being a team. Everyone loves her!
I loved having her as a professor, she was very understanding of personal issues that may hinder your attendance. I enjoyed all of her lectures and would love to take her class again.
She is a kind individual who actually cares about her students. She is very flexible and understanding when it comes to class work and papers. Overall one of my favorite professors.

I had Professor Tetreault this past semester and I thought she was a sweet woman, but she wasn't the best professor. She gives you extra credit for coming to class more than 5 times which is nice. Only a few people showed up to class every day and most people were on their devices, not participating. I personally didn't like the class.

Such an interesting class with a sweet, wonderful professor. She gives so much extra credit (attend class for this) and cares so much about all her students. The tests are super easy. The textbook isn't necessary but the novels definitely are for the exams. Takes a long time to put in grades which can be frustrating. Would highly recommend!

Great prof! the lectures can get boring but she does a great job of making sure you understand the important parts. the second exam grade was a paper&her other exams consist of multiple choice&short answer. there are some in class assignments so go to class & there is a very easy group project. Have to read a lot of articles & a book but not bad!

I had this teacher for ANP 201 and I loved the class. I don't however love taking the class twice. We have not covered any lectures that we didn't do in 201. She uses the same slides and shows all the same material. She is a smart teacher, but she waters down the material too much for non Anthropology majors, in a way that can become problematic.
Great class and she is a wonderful professor. Very easy curriculum and easy to talk to, too.
Great class. As an Anthropology major it was a great class for a Freshman just starting out. Really interesting an EASY. No homework, just a little in class work. Very nice professor.
Not too many assignments and he grades really easy. I didn't do any of the readings and I passed with a 4.0. As long as you show up to lectures you'll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He was very kind and understanding. Be brought candy/snacks in the mornings. He thoroughly enjoys his work and the conversation.

Dr. Burgess was amazing, he brought us snacks for our long lectures and was very understanding and attentive. He cared about his students and about the material that we were learning. Lots of content to engage with though. I would not say it's an easy A, but you will grow as a student and as a person. If you have the opportunity, Terrance is great.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Burgess is a good professor, but doesn't make this class interesting. We have talked about the same thing for the past 10 weeks. I have always wanted to be a teacher, but this class has made me want to try a different major. There is readings every week but I have never done them and been fine.
Pretty awkward and boring guy but definitely knew what he was talking about. Half of class spent on Clash Royale “listening”, and half of class working on coding problems with your table group.

He clearly knew what he was teaching but he would constantly talk using the words "Um" and "Uh" every few seconds. Way too often than how frequently a person normally would. The in-class assignments are sometimes too long for how much time we're given for it. That's more so the class curriculum maker's fault rather than him.

Chill and friendly, but a little awkward in his lectures. Monotone voice, but it's a flipped classroom, so you're not listening to him lecture for long. PCAs usually take an hour minimum, and both those and ICAs are graded on effort, not correctness. You get two weeks to do HWs, and they're not fun. Big project at the end. Open internet on quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class moves fast and covers a lot of material. There are weekly quizzes and exams that make up most of your grade. Because of this, you have to study a lot outside of class. Overall, she is kind and helpful, but if you are not strong in algebra, you may need extra help like a tutor to keep up.

such a difficult professor, so much to do on webwork but she says its not important. You only learn in lecture (not recitation), so if you miss the lecture or part of the lecture you're done for. She won't answer questions that she answered in class already, which made it feel like you couldn't email her with questions, also won't reteach concepts.

If you're good at math do other students a favor and take her lecture (people not good at math will struggle with her teaching style so let them take a better prof.) Lectures are too short for the amount of chatting she does. I retaught myself content after class. She's sweet and wants to help you when 1-on-1 but she should teach a smaller class.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment:
She's a sweet lady, but I think she should retire soon.

She makes mistakes during lectures that students often have to call out. There's a quiz or midterm exam during recitation, with the quiz being 20 minutes and the midterms being a full period.

You'll do great if you're good with math, but I suggest taking a different class if you struggle.

I don't like the structure of MTH 103, Professor Allen is nice but expects far more than you would think for a class of 400-500 people. A lot of my lectures, the first 20 minutes would be spent yelling at various students and complaints about the students.

The structure of this class is awful, but it will be the same regardless of your prof, so no hate to prof Allen. Just SO much hw, quiz/exam EVERY week, 2 50 min 500 person lectures so there is no time to ask questions. If you want to succeed, go to every class, office hours, and watch videos. There is a reason why so many people fail this class.

She makes so many flaws in her lectures and teaches at a really fast pace. She also stops the whole lecture if she hears one person talking and wastes time when lectures are only 1 hour. Lots of webwork problems that don't give any good feedback if you're wrong. Some exams also don't resemble the study guide so know every single bit of material.

Only graded on homework, quizzes, tests, no extra credit
Office hours help alot sicne she is normally slow during lectures 
Quizzes and tests are decently hard I'd study vocab such as "what makes a polynomial a polynomial, etc"
Literaly algebra 2 just in college 
Webwork (hw) is due every week 
Go to the MLC or office hours for help
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's a very sweet lady. The lessons are so easy if you print out the notes and go to class. She makes a lot of mistakes during the lecture, so it can get a little confusing at times, but overall, she's decent.

Her lectures are full of flaws and she prefers to rush through content instead of teaching it. 
The grading for this course is also awful. Work has to be exact in a way that feels like walking a child. 
If you can take another, please do.

I want warn you that this class will be difficult, that is not say you cannot pass it but you are going to have to WORK FOR IT. This is NOT a class where you can no show lectures, not go to extra review sessions, and skip office hours. Without office hours I would have failed this class! She is extremely devoted to helping you learn!! Just try!!

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!! If you are already struggling with math, taking this class will push you back even farther from where you started. Sue Allen is not consistent with teaching in her lectures, and everything earned must be studied outside of class. The workload is excessive, and the professor doesn't know how to properly teach.

Don't take this if you struggle with math in the first place. She made a mistake at least 2 times every lecture and students would have to correct her. She spends way too much time bashing the students for grades instead of teaching, and her teaching style is horrendous. Her class made me feel like I was in high school again.

Prof Allen is not great at teaching. She will rush through lectures and just do the work without explaining how she got her answers. Talks multiple times about how if you get the answer but not her way you will not receive credit. Be ready to have to teach yourself. Do Not Take

DO NOT TAKE THIS COURSE IF YOU WANT A GOOD GPA AND TO NOT HAVE TO RETAKE AGAIN!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  you can put in 20 hours of studying and still will get bad grades, does not know how to teach and I end up watching lecture videos online. take it with a different prof.
Can not teach. She will do the work without any explanation with it. She is easily agitated and will stop lectures to walk up to and yell at students. If you can do not take.

Terrible. If you can get out of having her as a prof, I would. She does not teach the material, and quite literally tells you, "You should have learned this in High School." instead of helping. If you do poorly on weekly quizzes and exams, you will not pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Susan Allen cannot teach math. I spent most my time in the MLC (Math Learning Center) where they actually helped. She rushes lectures and goes way too fast. There was also times when she made her own mathematical errors, and other students in the lecture hall corrected her. She has a sweet personality, but is not a good professor!
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Mrs Allen is so sweet, the content is difficult but she really cares about students success, She hosts extra office hours and review sessions to help with any difficult content. The lectures are fast paced but there is a lot of content to get through, I would highly recommend taking 103 with Mrs Allen.
She's good, she just doesn't explain her answers, rather just gives them to you. She moves on very quickly in lectures

Poor teaching style. Talks too much before class then rushes at the end, overall not organized in the slightest (which I need in a professor) her explanations are not cohesive/helpful. Treated class like high school, she's very funny but not a good math professor fit, she should be a highschool history teacher! If you're bad at math don't take her.

I didn't enjoy professor Allen's teaching style. She treated the class like a highschool class, and showed us the same sort of respect as highschoolers. She tends to start talking way before class started and usually ended class late. She was also sensitive about people leaving early. She was fine, but I didn't love her teaching style or anything.

Shes a very sweet older lady.She often treats her class like grandchildren. She will often open up more office hours, exam study sessions, extra practice before exams, etc. She is there for you if you need help and genuinely wants all her students to do well. She can sometimes make mistakes but she fixes them quickly.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Sue Allen is a caring, light-hearted professor.  She wants the best for her students and is very personable. She loves to joke around, but often gets off task during the short 50-minute lectures. I struggled with her lack of organization during lectures. She tends to over-explain the easy stuff, not focusing enough on the difficult content.

Sue Allen is an amazing math professor. I've always struggled with math, but she explains it clearly, making it enjoyable. The class is tough but manageable with effort. By attending office hours, doing practice problems, and learning from mistakes, I improved significantly. She genuinely cares and goes the extra mile to help her students succeed.
Please Please do not make the same mistake that so many people in that class went through, spare yourself and do not take this class with her

Dr. Allen was not a horrible professor, however if you are taking math 103, DO EVERYTHING YOU CAN to take one of the other professors. Dr. Allen messed up in class very frequently and did not explain things in an easy to understand manner. From what I heard, the other professors had much higher grade averages and were more well liked.

I was one of the few people I knew who passed this course, and I earned a 3.5. I think Mrs. Allen was one of the best professors you can get for MTH 103. Your grade in this class is based on how much effort you put in. Any good advisor will have you take CEM 141 and this class separately. You get to drop 2 quizzes and 1 exam, which was generous.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Was kind and helpful. Made mistakes during lecture but fixed them quickly. Make sure you attend lecture or else you will probably fail the class. There is a quiz every week. Homework was easy but there was a lot of it.

She is just too old to be teaching still, constantly making mistakes which makes it hard to follow the lecture. She is always confused and gets upset/hurt pretty easily about not coming to class or leaving early. You have a test or quiz every recitation, but if you do the reviews and go to the mth help room not her office hours it wasn't very hard

Allen is a very sweet lady, and cares about her students.If you want to pass, go to the lectures!! She often holds review sessions before exams. She's definitely too old to be teaching still and is sometimes hard to hear in class and makes mistakes. This IS a harder class, but you have all the recourses to get a 3.5 or 4.0.

Allen is an alright professor, although she often makes mistakes in lectures. I think the issue is less with her, and the MTH103 class as a whole. It goes by way too fast and can be very difficult to learn with the notes provided. Be prepared to use a LOT of outside resources, and consider taking MTH103A instead (because I really wish I did).

Super sweet, often hosts study sessions before exams and occasionally before quizzes. Easy to reach out to. Provides a schedule for the week every Sunday night or Monday morning via email as well as on D2L. Follows her syllabus. Allows two quiz drops and one exam drop. Lectures are effective and easy to understand as well as posting online lectures

Sue Allen is such a kind proffessor and is very helpful if you reach out for help. Test and Quizzes were very hard for me at the beginning but that's because I wasn't asking for help. After going to office hours and attending the MLC my grades started to go up. You have all the resources you need to be successful in this class
really hard:(
Truly just not a great prfessor, not understanding and I would advise everyone to find a different proffesor
She is a genuinely good professor who actually cares. You honestly have all the resources to get a 4.0.

Professor Allen is a caring instructor who genuinely wants students to succeed. While she occasionally makes minor mistakes during lectures, her notes are clear and the quizzes/exams align well with the material. Utilizing resources like unstuck AI and going to office hours can really help overcome the course's challenges.

I personally dont agree on what majority people here says. I find that she is amazing! Go to office hours, she would guide you through the course. Honestly its just a skill issue if you're struggling.
I didn't struggle but I know a lot of people that did, just make sure to stay on top of your work and be well prepared for the weekly quizzes

Quiz every week or exam. No extra credit opportunity. Allen makes many mistakes every lecture which makes it hard to follow and learn. Many students have had to shout out and correct her multiple times about mistakes she's made during note taking. Would not recommend her if you are taking this course and aren't good at learning by yourself.

If you struggle with math like me you are going to find this class difficult. Allen does the best she can but with the sheer amount of content you have to learn in such a short span of time you can get very easily overwhelmed. She has office hours though which I recommend taking advantage of. Overall MTH103 is gonna be hard no matter the professor.

Sue is a great person and she cares about her students and math. However, she frequently makes mistakes during lectures which is confusing. She will often get off topic and we lose a lot of lecture time because of this. She also hands out a lot of difficult homework that is extremely time-consuming. There is a quiz or exam every week.

Professor Allen is very sweet. She does make mistakes in her lectures often but catches them quickly. I found it most helpful to watch the recorded lectures when studying and rewrite my notes. My ULA had a heavy accent which made it hard to understand sometimes. I felt like I taught myself a lot in this class. Watch the video review before exams

Sue really does care about her students and it helps to make your face known. Go to office hours and get to know her. She is the sweetest and wants to see people succeed. I didn't even do well in the class, math is not my strong suit, but she really tried to help me understand and is overall so nice. Don't listen to people. I 10/10 recommend her.

This class wasn't very difficult for me as long as you keep up with the notes and webwork assigned. There is usually a quiz every Friday for this course. Prof Allen is super sweet and takes her time but does occasionally mess up but is usually able to catch it. I will say is that she isn't usually to fit in all of the content in the time she has.

Professor Allen is so caring and wants all of her students to succeed. The notes were very easy to follow and the quizzes and exams were very similar to the notes in the lecture. The homework on the other hand is a bit harder than what you learn in the lecture so don't get discouraged if you can't get the correct answer to every question.

Professor Allen really cares about her students! She sometimes makes mistakes during her lectures but it didn't really bother me. She held review sessions outside of class to help with quizzes and exams. She really is the sweetest person and was a great start for my college journey ! To pass you'll NEED to take notes and understand the homework!

Shes too old to be teaching, cant get through one lecture without her messing up and having to go back and correct her own work, sweet lady, but needs to retire. Go to lectures, do webwork, go to math learning center, and use the practice exam to study for exams. Sometimes she passes an attendance sheet around, but again is too old to remember.

Sue Allen loves her students, and genuinely cares for their success in this class. I couldn't of asked for a better professor to kick off my start to college. Yes there's a lot of homework, but if you want to pass that's mandatory. Loved this class even though I might not be the best at math. She provides plenty of help to prepare for exams.
Dont take math 103 in general it is a GPA killer.

Key to passing the class is going to lecture. Prof is very nice and has lots of office hours and tries to help. It can be a bit frustrating when she often makes mistakes during lecture. I think she's a nice person, but should retire soon. HW is harder than actual tests/quizzes. Do the work and you'll be fine.

Sue seems like a nice person, but she needs to stop teaching. She doesn't make sense, makes tons of mistakes, coughs every 5 seconds, and gives insane amounts of homework. My roommate and I ended up watching lectures from another Prof just to understand what we were doing. I really don't recommend taking MTH103 with Sue if you can help it.

I loved her, very much sweet grandma vibes. Provided lots of help with many office hours and an exam review session per unit. There was a decent amount of homework but thats expected in a math course. Do your homework, pay attention, and study, and youll be fine

Professor Allen is amazing for MTH103! Right from the start she was very caring and wanted all of her students to pass this class. She has office hours 3 times a week and will answer any question you have for her. She truly cares about her students! YOU JUST HAVE TO PARTICIPATE! How to pass? 1. Do homework. 2. Print notes 3. Go to class. Got a 4.0

Professor Allen is a good teacher, but this class is very test/quiz heavy. You have a quiz almost every week and the grading is very nit-picky. Its very hard to stay confident in this class. The homework assignments are not bad at all. The professor is very sweet and has a kind soul. Ask for help if you need it.

she constantly messes up in each lecture which makes it extremely difficult to follow along. she also gives a quiz every week and the homework is heavy and usually way harder than what is taught in the lectures.

I retook this class as a sophomore after getting a 2.5 the first time. Allen is an amazing professor that treats you like family! I spent a lot of time in the MLC to quickly finish the homework. To succeed you need to attend class, STUDY, and pay attention when she says something could be on a quiz or exam. Very straightforward class, loved her!!

Mth103 as a whole is a disaster at MSU, so I wouldn't put all of the blame on the professors. Professor Allen tries her best to teach this content however, the time constraints of this class make it difficult to thoroughly develop an understanding. GO TO OFFICE HOURS, she is willing to reexplain content that you might be struggling with. LOTS of HW

The lectures were long and unengaging, Professor Allen would often make mistakes and erase or correct the notes that she was teaching us. The class used iClicker, so attendance was mandatory and graded. I did not enjoy this class at all, content was barely taught but was expected to be known. One of the worst classes I have taken.
Hard professor to understand. There are better and easier professors to understand. The homework was heavy and not easy to understand. She was also very short with you.

Really important to participate in class! Prof. Allen is such a sweetheart and is SUPER passionate about the content she teaches. Her students are mostly freshmen (I am a junior) and they don't realize that professors can make errors sometimes. She's super helpful with questions! I'm someone who NEVER understood math until she taught it to me!

I would avoid this class. Sue Allen is a nice professor, but she constantly messes up in lectures and her students have to correct her, making the whole lecture 10x more confusing. The homework (webwork) wasn't related and was much harder than what we learned in class. Used photo math for the majority of the semester. Practice exams were the exams
Took MTH 103. Too fast, did not explain a lot of things thoroughly. Came in with a basic knowledge of algebra, but wanted to take it again to review before going into 124. Did not help.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: old school in my opinion, nice lady, not so great teacher, very fast pace

Professor Allen was kind of all over the place. She was very sweet and I really like her as a person, but not as a teacher. There were quizzes basically every Friday, and I always had to watch the recorded lessons from the other professor because she either never finished the notes in class, or didn't really explain anything thoroughly.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Almost never paid attention to classes but managed my way through by watching the online lectures that is provided for everyone, really recommend them if you're slow with math like me. reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lots of homework, as well this teacher would always go ahead of what the quizzes would be on , taking this class just piles more and more stress like never before, students would always have to correct the professor as well, this class was required for me and I would never take it again.

Sue Allen is a super nice professor!  However, I probably would not take one of her classes again.  She would constantly make mistakes on the notes and a student would have to raise their hand and correct her.  She is a bit dull but I don't think that is her fault because the class is super hard to make fun and engaging.
make sure to go to office hours and it is more helpful than the lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class is a lot harder than what you would expect for a college algebra. Lots of homework and quizzes pretty much every Friday which gets really overwhelming. Also, I had a university approved absence form and she was my only prof who would not give me an excused absence, even though the university approved it

Ahhhhh, this might've been the worst class i've ever taken. Be prepared future students. If you're not already good at math, you will not get any better while taking this class. If you don't want to tank your gpa because of one class.. get a private tutor. Everybody knows at MSU that the math department is a travesty, i just became another victim.

If you are taking MTH 103, Sue Allen is the go-to professor. Out of all the math professors, Sue Allen is the nicest, most considerate, easiest, and most helpful. She helps you prepare for quizzes and exams better. She will go out of her way to help students. You have to pay attention and not talk to people around you because she'll call you out.

Professor Allen is such a sweet lady and she definitely cares about the well-being of her students. But this class was really hard for an algebra class. Students are given quizzes every single Friday before even having the chance to actually learn the material. Be prepared to spend hours of your free time trying to pass this class.

Professor Allen is a nice professor who is available outside of class for help during her office hour and holds review sessions. However, students are given quizzes every single Friday before they're able to even digest the information that is blown through in class. Additionally, the exam reviews are never representative of the actual exam.

For an algebra class it was surprisingly difficult. The lecture do not do much teaching, rather they are just the professor quickly rushing through a page of notes. There is lots of online homework, and quizzes and or exams very often. This class requires an unnecessary amount of additional learning outside of class.

This was a tough class but don't be scared by the other reviews. I went to MLC like once-twice a week and attended office hours before her exams and am passing with a 4.0. You will need to print out the notes and iclicker into class but you can drop two categories that go to your grade which can be exams! Webwork is very hard for no reason though.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Absolutely horrible. Never explains anything thoroughly, but has many opportunities for hep like office hours. Rambles in her lectures so much that sometimes you have to watch the rest of the lecture through video. If I had to take this class again, I would take it with Shannon Griffen.

There is no leniency whatsoever for attendance but the lectures are pointless. Everything is on webwork, w/ 4 exams and a quiz almost every week. She's so boring, it's so bad and I've fallen asleep in this class more than I've learned in it. Assignments are due at 7 am which is the weirdest thing I've ever heard of. You have to pay to do homework.

The worst professor I have ever had forgets what she is doing every 5 minutes attendance is mandatory even though you're listening to a brick wall give information thinks students fail assessments because they don't go to office hours even though most peers I know end up back at their dorms and watch a different professor teach it via lecture video

She is an elderly woman who needs to retire. Makes a lot of mistakes during lecture, such as writes and solves problems incorrectly, and forgets to turn on her microphone until reminded by a student. Does not allow more than four unexcused absences or she will automatically fail you and all lectures/recitations take attendance.

hardest math class ever with short confusing lectures. webwork did not help learn material, exams are difficult. failed first 2 exams even with 100% on all assignments and attending MLC, ended up failing the class because i couldn't get 100% on the others. math department at msu needs work.

Honestly, she isn't the worst professor I've had, but the Math Department at MSU is lacking. Classes last too short to absorb any useful information, and by the time you're done you walk out knowing nothing. It's not difficult if you're able to go over the information yourself, (and make corrections to stuff she did wrong,) but it wastes time.

-SUCH A HARD CLASS 
-attendance taken via iclicker 
-if you don't go to class you miss so much
-webwork is horrible
-does not explain how you get to an answer or why it works the way it does

Just show up to lectures and do your webwork and its a fairly easy class.
-She's a pretty easy teacher but an easy class
Easy class, pay attention.

reviews.comment: Professor was very nice and thorough, however, you have to pay to access the homework and pay to print out the notes because it's basically required if you want to pass the class. And attend MLC. The online program, webwork, is often different/harder material than covered in class. Overall very angering, but the material isn't hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was unusually difficult. This class is a pre-rec for stats and stats is 10000x easier. The lectures move super quickly and are not easy to understand. All of the concepts should be easy but they are way overexplanined and overcomplicated. Not to mention there are tests every single friday. If you can test out of this class DO IT.

I hope to never have to take her again. Her exams were never like the study guides or homework we had every week. I went to office hours and she wasn't helpful whatsoever. I wouldn't recommend her at all.
She is very kind and always wants to help students. She loves to get questions and feedback about her lectures. Just go to lecture and do the homework and you'll be fine!
She wants you to do well, you just have to put in time.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Allen was very kind and seemed willing to help me if I needed it, but her lectures consist of her quickly filling out notes, with very little explaining. I am a step by step learner with math, and Sue pretty regularly neglected to clearly explain what she was doing. Anyone can read over completed math notes. I needed someone to TEACH me

Professor Allen was nice but since the lectures are so big it's not easy at all to build any connections. I think she taught well during the lectures. You don't have to go to the lectures but the class will be a lot harder so you should go. If you don't study or work hard, you'll barely pass or even fail so you really have to put the work in.
She works really well with student-athletes. Is always available and helpful in office hours. Super calm and kind!

Prof Allen really cares about her students and she stays after almost every lecture to help students who have questions. However, if you do not put in the effort to actually learn the material then the homework will be very difficult to complete. All lectures are recorded, so attendance isn't necessarily mandatory but is heavily encouraged.

MTH103 is a large class at MSU so it is hard for Professor Allen to make connections with the students unless they reach out to her. With hard work and studying you CAN 4.0 this class. I attended the math learning center and focused on the first 3 exams so I did not have to take the cumulative final.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Bad teacher lectures are forever long and if you miss even one you can guarantee yourself that you will fail the quiz. So much stuff to do and you have to take time out of you testing to scan your documents turn them into a pdf and turn them in online. I would never take her again she was absolutely no help. If you can't learn fast don't take it.

I took more notes in class than I learned. If you want to learn whats going on, you need to go back and read your notes over and over again, or watch another professors videos. Her class is also very fast-paced. Then theres all the hw on webwork, which has a registration fee. Ive also pulled all-nighters studying for exams.

If you want to do well go to lectures and print the notes she gives you. You can also drop 2 quizzes and 1 exam which is nice. She teaches at a very good pace, just stay on top of notes and homework and you will be fine. Definitely recommend and would take again.
I had to watch the other teachers lectures to understand the material.

I never went in person to a lecture, because I could never pay attention. Exams and quizzes are always more difficult than what you learn in lecture, no extra credit, but you do get drops. Overall wasnt the worst ever, but wouldnt recommend if you cant learn at a fast rate!

I am usually a straight A student and this was the only class I didn't 4.0 in. Ruined my gpa. If you don't attend her lectures (which are fast and don't help at all) you have to watch Griffens lectures which made me feel like I was having a stroke. My TA was also no help. Tests every Friday and no matter how hard you study you will never get 100%.

I would rather eat a bowl of gravel than take this class again. Instructor just does rather than teaches. If you bring the printed notes to class and are trying to follow along and fill them out, good luck. She goes so fast, by the time you're done copying down a problem, she'll be half way through the next one. Tests are WAY harder than the notes.
This class is taught by amazing teachers, but I think that the curriculum was horrible.

reviews.comment: Whatever you do, please do not take this class. I ended with a B average in math in high school and now I am fighting for my grade and spend almost every night crying. The math department does not care about you at all. The tests are significantly harder than what we are taught and Prof Allen gets rude if you ask her simple questions. STAY AWAY.

reviews.comment: I was advised to take this course, but I didn't listen and im fighting for my life before my exam tomorrow at 10:20. Do not take this course please listen

reviews.comment: Sue Allen wasn't a terrible teacher but the entire MSU math department needs work. reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Allen isnt too bad. She helps with webwork if needed and answers general questions. About half the exams/quizzes are nothing like the notes or reviews though and its frustrating.

You do not need to attend lectures, and all notes are posted outside of class. If you are not familiar with the material already you need to attend lecture! All exams have reviews that are almost identical to the tests. Next to impossible not to do well in this class.

Ive never struggled in math before until Math 103. Prof. Allen DOES NOT CARE if you fail. Lack of communication and help in this class. Tests are significantly harder than any review that is given, almost like she wants you to fail. I would NOT recommend taking this class at MSU and I will be retaking the course at my local community college.
She is the worst professor at MSU. She doesnt care if you pass or fail and she can't teach anything. Don't take her class.

So, I am taking this math course for the first time my first year here and a lot of people agree that her teaching is to fast to the point where you can't retain any information. I have always been a straight A student, but somehow have a D in her class. As a professor I think she's ok, but she can d better for sure. She doesn't really explain.

The instruction was hard to understand at best, completely incompetent at worst, The TA and Professor are not hard-working when it comes to review and aren't even making a comprehensive review for the final, there was content on the last exam that wasn't in the lectures, recitation, or review. I wish I had more space to say what I want to.
doesnt teach you and blames the students for failing, i am currently in this course and I know maybe 2 people who are passing

The class overall shouldn't have been as hard as it was, I did not talk to one person throughout the semester that was doing well in the class, so clearly there's a problem deeper than our understanding of the class. Also, the fact she isn't providing an exam prep for the final is absolutely ridiculous. Good luck if you have to take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Loved Professor Allen, probably the professor that cares about her students the most out of all the professors I have had. She goes out of her way to send review videos, finished notes, and ensure her students are ready for upcoming exams and quizzes. Not a super difficult class just follow along with notes and spend some time reviewing before exam

Do not take mth 103 with Sue Allen. This is the hardest class I have ever taken and I ultimately ended up dropping it. Quizzes and exams are very difficult and nothing like the study guides given. Beware

This class was the best. I took ap calc in high school but wanted an easier math class and this was the move for sure. She was so understanding and accommodating in regards to the pandemic. Had a bunch of help sessions and answered emails fast if you needed extra help. Definitely a teacher who wants her students to succeed, 10/10 would recommend.

One of the toughest Professors I had this past semester. Homework was easy to understand and get credit for but the exams were graded tough-every little detail to each problem needed to be shown. However, the lectures were really easy to understand. Technology issues were not excusable in the class (which was difficult when everything was online)

Prof Allen was helpful considering how many help sessions she held before exams but she simply made MTH103 way harder than it needed to be. She has little sympathy for her students and was very rude to me and those who had questions during recitation. The exams were quite difficult and the webwork was brutal. Avoid class if you struggle with math!
I had quizzes every week except for the weeks I had exams! Lectures not mandatory but recitation is!

Professor Allen is extremely nice and caring. If you need help she is more than willing to help during office hours. Print out the weekly lecture notes on D2L because it is easier to follow along. Make sure to study your lecture notes before exams and quizzes. There was a lot of homework, but just use piazza and it can be really easy.
She rushes through everything and notes from class aren't easy to apply to homework or quizzes
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof Allen is getting a bad rep because she teaches math and most students struggle with math. I wouldn't avoid her just because the class is difficult. As long as you show up and put in work outside of class you should be ok. The webwork is difficult but is more about practicing the material. Her class isn't easy, but college isnt meant to be easy

reviews.comment: She puts all of the notes online and quizzes are fairly easy. She gave exam #3 six days before the final exam. She also gets very upset people talking in class and would call them out for it.

I went to every single lecture, recitation, review session, and frequented the MLC along with having a paid tutor -- and even still struggled greatly in the class. However, focus on the notes for exams and not the webwork and you will pass with a good grade.

reviews.comment: If I could give her anything lower I would. She doesn't know hoe to teach. half the time the paper isn't even visible to the class and she is always making mistakes. She always makes you teach yourself and ends up hitting you with a hard test. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS UNLESS YOU WANNA DIG YOURSELF IN A HOLE!!!!! p.s. she can be very rude sometimes

Professor Allen is a very nice person, awful teacher. I never skipped a lecture, went to MLC weekly, and had a paid tutor. Her reviews that she gives aren't even made by her and not even remotely close to her exams. She goes through lectures too fast and the problems she shows us are the easiest ones possible. If you take her prepare to fail.

Sue Allen is a less than mediocre professor. She moves through her lectures VERY fast and does not care to go back to any of the concepts to make sure you understand. She always overcomplicated very simple concepts during lectures. This class is not graded on a curve so you have to work for your grade. I basically taught the whole class to myself.

I would not recommend Professor Allen to anyone and would avoid taking her course(s). She moves extremely quickly through her lectures and often makes several errors while teaching the material. She also focuses too much on how many people are showing up to class rather than putting her energy into properly teaching the students that do show up.

If you have the choice, don't take Professor Allen's class. She makes you feel stupid for asking questions and often makes mistakes while solving problems during the lecture. She makes simple concepts complex and moves through lectures very fast because it's more important that she covers as much material as possible than if students understand it.
She gets really irritated if you ask her a basic question and she goes over notes REALLY fast
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She teaches "simple" things that most students have learned already in high School. This should make her class an easy A, but the way she teaches makes everything more confusing. Some examples of this are when a girl raised her hand asking how she got a certain number in a problem she said "I Just know that"
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Sue Allen is a good professor that gives students every opportunity to succeed. In-class lectures give you a base knowledge of subjects but the webwork includes more challenging problems that you will likely have to get help with. As long as you come to class and do the homework the class should be a breeze.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Excruciatingly long and boring lectures with weekly homework that can barely be completed and has little to do with what she teaches. She's not very sympathetic and refused to round up .01% to go up a grade. She doesn't take attendance and that's probably the only good thing I can say about her.
Get ready to teach yourself because she'll show easy examples of how to find the solutions but then the webwork will be completely different. Thank god the quizzes were easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you took precalculus in high school, this class should be fairly easy. Quizzes every Friday, though, and a lot of Webwork. Webwork was probably the worst thing about this class honestly, exams were not too bad as long as you look over your notes. Class is not really that necessary, all of the notes are online.

Sue Allen is a great choice for a math teacher! I loved the was she taught and how she really cares if you do well in the class. She actually cares if you understand the material being taught. I highly recommend taking her class!
Lots of webwork and quizzes, tough grader when it comes to credit on those quizzes, but she does want you to succeed.

Lectures are hard to pay attention to. She skips over a majority of the notes and doesn't go into detail on what she does cover. Cares more about completing notes in time than if the class actually understands. WebWork is nothing like the content of the notes or the exams. If you don't do good on the exams you're screwed bc that's half your grade.

Professor Allen is AMAZING. She's such a sweet lady who is an amazing teacher!! She's always willing to help, and she explains everything thoroughly. She cracks jokes during class and as boring as math can be, her class is the opposite!

Really good teacher. I barely went to class and thats on me but you really dont need to. All of the notes are online and you can watch videos to understand things you didnt get from the notes. Good at office hours and very helpful. Super sweet lady.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: One of best online professors I have ever had. Her lecture videos are very helpful. And the exam questions come from everything she teaches. if you are required to take MTH 103, I highly recommend you take her online summer class to get those credits out the way. I could go on and on explaining how great prof. Allen is but Im going to stop here :)

Math is hard! But prof Allen makes it easier to understand and takes it slow, it also helps that shes funny and relates the material to something interesting about MSU most of the time! Make sure you print out the notes and bring them to class, those are very helpful with the online homework and studying for quizzes and exams
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Liked her abs a person and a prof, it felt like she really wanted everyone to succeed. The class wasnt very challenging but it was a lot of homework and quizzes all the time.

They drop the 2 lowest quiz grades and they're easy. Exams are NOTHING like the practice exams. Exams consist of random things and the WebWork is easily the worst part. You could study for hours and get 70's, which i guess is good since it was normal for people to get 30's. My TA was much more helpful and clear when explaining. Textbook isn't used
Got a 4.0 and never bought or used the textbook. Not hard stuff if you pay attention in lecture. WebWork was horrible though, worst part about the class.

reviews.comment: She will not budge on final grade even if 0.1% away. Ruined my GPA
She's really sweet and helpful and has good pace during lectures.
This class is just super boring in general. Unless you live and breath math then you probably won't get a kick out of this one. Allen is nice nothing really negative to say about her.

She speeds through the lectures but is willing to stop and answer any questions. I like that she thoroughly explains subjects but as someone who naturally struggles with math I asked her a lot of questions after class and usually fell behind. The WebWork was due way too often and I always felt behind. I spent a lot of time in the MLC.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Sue is a really great teacher. Thorough, easy to understand, is willing to take questions, and wants you to do well. I strongly recommend her.

For this being my first college math class, Professor Allen did a great job of making the transition from high school math to college math as smooth as possible. The material is difficult at times, but her lectures are easy to follow and she teaches at a good pace. She is a sweet lady and makes math as enjoyable as it can be!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She was kind and joked in class but also got stuff done. She always explained the material very clearly. Overall enjoyed the class and loved Mrs. Allen.

sue allen is the best math professor that i have ever taken! she is so caring and will respond to any questions that you may have. although I'm not doing well in the class (I'm not good at math), she makes it easy to learn! i would take her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof. Allen is very sweet and nice. Her lectures are not quick but not too slow. She usually keeps pace with her timeframe so don't expect getting out early. 4 exams and 1 final, 7 quizzes, and 28 homework assignments. If you don't make it to class, you can get the lecture notes at MLC.

Professor Allen is great! She's always happy and you can always ask her for help (or the MLC, they're great). Her notes and lecture are EXTREMELY helpful and she's willing to explain things as many times as you need. The work load isn't bad at all, and if you just do the practice problems and the math homework, you'll be fine on tests and quizzes.

She's a great teacher. I am terrible at math but I still managed a 3.0. I suggest attending all lectures and taking notes. Do webwork the same day as the lecture so it is easier. If you struggle GO TO OFFICE HOURS or MLC! She will help you with your homework and with your grades. She gives practice problems that aren't due, but really help.
Very clear lectures, lenient, hilarious ( a must for an early class), and her grading is very fair.
Sue Allen is a very good professor for MTH 103! She is very helpful and has a great sense of humor! Easy to get along with and have a conversation with. Would definitely recommend her for MTH 103!

I really like Sue Allen as a person and a teacher. If you have to pick a professor for math I would recommend her. My only complaint about the course was that we had a test or quiz every week, so if you are not good at testing chose a different course.
Sue Allen is very good at explaining how to do problems and has good notes that will help you loads with webwork and tests. Always there to help before and after lectures, very friendly woman.
Makes constant mistake during lectures, exams often have questions not covered in the sections.

Sue is a great lady and a great teacher.  The class itself is rather fact-paced, but she makes it manageable, and the overall material is not too hard; there is just a plethora of material at all times.
I loved her! She is awesome. Phenomenal teacher and makes the cutest stupid jokes.

I loved Sue Allen. She is very personable and very approachable. She answers any questions you might have and she explains the notes well.

I love Sue Allen. She is my favorite professor. She makes math easy and fun. She always cracks jokes, and makes me laugh. She has the cutest dimples and the softest smile. She makes me want to take MTH 103 twice. I love her so much. I definetly recommend her!
Funny, friendly, great.
Easy class to pass if you just show up for notes. Really nice teacher, explains everything. Don't need the text unless you want extra help.

Super friendly. Didn't use my book once. Sends the notes to you and makes them organized, all you have to do is fill them in. Tends to rush at the end of lecture. I hate math but she made it less painful and is always available to help.

Very nice and helpful lady.  I do not enjoy math, but she made the experience a good one.
She's an awesome teacher. Explains things really well. I def. recommend her for MTH 103!
Sue Allen is a very good math teacher, all you really have to do is the book work and you'll do good on her tests.

I love this professor. She's hilarious and makes cheesy jokes during class but it's still funny because she's just hilarious in general. She makes math easy to learn and she's extremely nice if you ask her a question, i love her. go sue!!
I love Professor Allen! She makes trig fun

Hate math, but if you fail or do poorly, it's your own falut. She's a great teacher and provides great resourses...notes emailed to you to be printed out the day before class so you don't have to write a lot during lecture
Sue Allen is the most awesome teacher I have ever had.  You should definitely take her if you have to take any math classes.
math sucks but i couldnt ask for a better teacher
If math is your weakest link, take sue allen.  She is so sweet.

Take this teacher. Mrs. Allen is the greatest college teacher I have ever had. She explains things so you can understand why. She is also just a genuinely nice person and fun to be around. I strongly recommend taking her whenever possible.

This class was very easy and he seemed like a great guy. All you had to do was complete quizzes and tests.

Great professor and a great class. Surprisingly interesting, and the professor is very nice and wants his students to do good. Despite being fully online, the class is well organized and easy to keep up with as well. Definitely recommend!

Insanely easy 4.0, he wants you to succeed.

I recommend that everyone take this class! It's such a good class when you just need a few extra credits but don't want something difficult. Very sweet professor, and the class is very easy to do good in. It is based off quizzes and exams and you get multiple attempts to do it. He really cares about his students success
If you were unable to achieve a 4.0 in this class you shouldn't be spending your money or your parents money on college. Genuinely would've passed this class when if I were 5 years old.

This class was extremely easy and Thomas Nikolai is such a sweet guy. His lectures (2-3 a week) are available as powerpoints and videos and information is easy to understand. Very interesting class, take it!

Great professor and guy. He gives you all the materials you need to do well on the exams and records all the lectures which are not mandatory to attend. easy to 4.0 if you put in effort.

Dr. Towse is actually the goat. The class is somewhat difficult but showing up to lecture and doing the assignments makes it very manageable. Lectures are long but very interesting and he is very funny. Current favorite professor at MSU.
Dr. Towse is a great professor and wants you to do well. If you attend lectures and study the learning objectives you can do very well in the class.
