He was the best professor i could get and honestly he was very good and understanding, i was sick one and forgot the due date of my hw and then let me do it for 100% credit not 75% late credit. overall i would tell you never take this course because if your not good at math then forget it but i think as someone who loves math this wasn't horrible
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Marios is a nice person and his teaching is understandable. As far as his quizzes, you get one every week in your recitation and there is 7-8 questions on every quiz so if you get one or two incorrect, your grade is heavily impacted.

Professor Velivasakis is by far the best prof you could get for MTH103. His lectures are really easy to follow and he's really good at explaining everything. If you're paying attention, actually take notes along with the lectures, doing the assigned webwork and studying you will be fine. He wants you to succeed.

This class is the worst class I have taken here at MSU. It is VERY fast paced, and the professor goes super quick so it is easy to fall behind even in class. VERY homework and test heavy, majority of your grade is based on the exams and quizzes. Overall, I think I'd rather take ANY class than this one and I pray for anyone who has to take it.

Velivasakis is pretty good at explaining each topic and example problems. But the course, MTH 124, was rough. You have quizzes every other week during your recitation, but you only have 20 minutes to do 8 questions. I usually bombed due to not having enough time to fully read/redo the problems. This isn't the profs fault but just be aware.

humbly think this might be one of the worst math teachers i've had. he moves way too fast. "it is not rocket science" will forever be engraved in my brain. webwork assigned every week but not too bad. you learn new material before recitation that will be on the test next week and not the test on that same week so it gets confusing
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The prof was good, but the class isn't. If you come to believe that MTH 124 is easier than Calc 1, you're wrong. Survey of Calculus is basically statistics for calc and is a pretty business-heavy. It's mostly word problems which was a huge issue for me, whereas Calc 1 is mostly number based question answering.

I TOOK MTH 124! i took it online async. NEVER AGAIN. i am failing this class. it's self-taught, meaning you are assigned videos and have to take your own notes. it is also extremely hard to reach this prof. the tests are impossible, they only have like 13 questions on them :(

I love this guy. He is a great professor and person, very caring, always answers emails, funny, and helpful. This class is test and quiz heavy with either occuring every week, as long as you don't skip lecture, do all homework and notes, and review, you will be fine. One of my favorite professors at MSU and made a difficult clas fun and engaging.
Test and quizzes are every week, but if you actually do the notes and homework you should have no issue

I loved Marios! He was so funny and a great Math Prof! Prof Marios is great at explaining things and may be the best math teacher I've ever had. Beware there are quizzes and exams every week, but if you look over the notes and lock in you will be fine. Overall, this math class requires some work, but you will learn a lot.

I mean I suck at math and am failing the course because its just so fast paced and the tests and exams are every week. I tried to get help but the resources were lacking when I went for extra help! He is a good professor though- def not a class for the week. Kudos to all of you
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I've had some horrible math teachers in the past and was scared to have a math class in college because of this, but Prof Marios was very good at explaining algebra and took questions unlike some other professors. Though you have quizzes or exams every week, this course is fast paced but not difficult. Homework is NOT too much.
Great professor.  Explains things well.  Recommend this course!

I love Marios. Lots of material to cover in class, but he really cares to help you understand if you ask. Go to his office hours before quizzes, he will make sure you understand. Do the practice he posts for quizzes rather than relying on webwork to study. Super funny guy, really cares to know his kids during office hours too. 100% would recommend.

The Professor tried his best with what he had, this course is very difficult to teach. Use textbooks & work problems form D2L for Webworks. Use his recorded vids and practice exams for exam studying. WebWorks should be done as early as possible so you can get corrections in office hours. Good quiz scores lessen the burden for exams.

Marios is very great person, and a good teacher. Seems like he was trying to rush through the semester though. While we were on D4 it seemed that the other classes were still behind learning other material. 
College algebra is a difficult class to teach, so I understand.
lots of material to self teach, prof tries his best

Attendance doesn't matter but you get extra credit if you do show up. The exam are very doable if you go to class and study the information from the lecture. She also likes to get to know her students!

Don't be fooled this course is NOT brain and behavior, it is a neuroscience course. Class is graded by four exams that can have a 6 point bump with in-class questions. Exam content can be confusing but if you understand the content you will succeed. Attendance is not mandatory as long as you complete tophat questions. Would not take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Only graded by 4 exams, lectures is easy with tophat to keep you engaged (she mostly reads of slides) but exam questions are very deep and complicated. Possible to do good if you commit to studying and really understand material not just memorize. She offers some extra credit but its like 3 points each exam so not much to really improve your grade
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: When deciding to take Dr. Veenema's class, please keep in mind that there are a lot of political opinions that are skewing the RMP data. Republicans are upset over an email that she sent out after the election and you can read about it from "The State News"  to form your own opinions. Put effort in this class, and you will pass.

I'm not rating her based on the recent political controversy, she made a mistake and to me that's ok. Professor Veenema was always very nice and passionate. She tries her best to teach, but the material itself is hard to fully understand. I had to drop the class because of the harsh grading criteria, but I would still recommend her as a professor.

Taking this course during a time when the country is so divided really put things into perspective. The content is tough, but she is willing to work with students, even giving an optional final to help boost students grades. There are pros and cons to every instructor, but don't let the current events deter you from taking one of her courses.

If you are coming in as a freshman just be aware that s this class is a lot different than most highschool psychology classes. It requires a lot more commitment and studying.  Professor Veenema herself is such a nice person and I would personally would say she did an excellent job teaching. I loved this class and I wish I could take it again!

Professor Veenema is a very sweet and caring woman. This year we lived through a very major political event, she has never pushed an “ agenda “ or indoctrinated us adults, only allowed us a space to feel grief. Please do not listen to the other comments when deciding if you should take this course, You will take 4 exams to determine grades.

She is a kind professor that cares about her students as both people and academics.  She strives to make sure people understand the content and genuinely wants everyone to succeed.  The entire course is graded off the exams, but she gives lots of extra credit. DONT LISTEN TO THE COMPLAINTS ABT POLITICS, as a woman she is scared rightfully.

Content is lecture heavy and no homework just four exams. Course is difficult but she does her best to help out her students. Overall a sweet and caring professor who watches and truly cares for her students. Recommend her truly so nice!

Her class is pretty difficult, your grade is solely based on the four exams you take and sometimes the questions are worded confusingly or are something we haven't gone over. However, she cares about her students! Class starts with cute animal pictures to brighten our day, and she offered an optional final for those in need of a grade boost!

Dr. Veenma is fantastic! The class was online and only based on 4 exams, but they are open note, and all of the content is only within the slides she goes over in class. Tophat questions during class are for extra credit towards that exam, and it is very easy to 4.0 if you have an interest or any background in the content!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: this class is only based off of 4 exams, the first one is extremely easy but after that they are difficult. she is a good teacher but you need to pay attention and understand what we're learning
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She went superrrr fast during lectures and I could not keep up. Content was a lot packed into each exam.  Wish there was more opportunities than exams

She is super nice, but the class format isn't great. I went to every lecture and took extensive notes, but the multiple choice exams had many questions that had 7 options and you had to pick one and some content not in the textbook. Also, exams are the only part of your grade, and each is 25% so if you do poorly on one exam, you can't recover.

The only things in the grade book were the 4 exams but they are not cumulative and there is no final. The first test was easy but the other you do need to study more for application of ideas learned. The tests are open notes though.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's really nice and shows her dog a lot during lecture. This is a PSY class but is pretty neuroscience-y, so if you're not into that be careful. Opportunities for extra credit during lecture. Exams made up all of the grades but they were open-note and non-cumulative so it was definitely manageable. Pay attention in class because she moves fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is a very nice professor, but it is difficult to contact her outside of class. If you ask her to go over something in class, she tells you to just rewatch the recording. I usually wouldn't have a problem with this but the concepts are not super easy. The grades are only based on the exams as well, so I definitely recommend studying a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very very nice person, but she was not really available to us when we needed help. When asked questions in class, she did not always answer them. She did not seem concerned that the majority of class was  overwhelmed by the content. Exams are hard to study for because topics are vague and there are lots of them.

Very nice professor, only exams are graded and there's no homework, plenty of oppurtunity for extra credit!! She's very understanding and passionate in what she does. Only thing I wasn't a fan of was the guest speakers.

Best prof. I've ever had. She always showed us her dog during online lectures just to cheer everyone up. She doesn't give out homework so grades are entirely based on 4 exams. She is super understanding (especially when it came to internet issues) and there is some opportunity for extra credit. I would recommend her to anyone; she's amazing!

Dr. Veenema is passionate about her studies and is a great professor, but this class was pretty hard. It is only graded based on exams, which made the class pretty miserable. The information is interesting, but it is a lot to take in. If this isn't needed for your major and you just want an elective, I recommend taking a different 200-level class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She's a really nice professor and pretty easy going. She uses TopHat for everything & it's easy to get all of the questions correct because she posts them before class so you can just write them down & put the right answer during class. She also uses a lot of those questions on exams. There are 4 exams total & no final exam.
Bill is a very good teacher for film, as you can tell, he cares deeply about the industry and his students. Isn't especially technologically savvy, so keep that in mind. Would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you cannot make every class, do not take this class you can only have 3 absences on a Thursday night class from 7PM-10PM when a lot can happen on a Thursday night.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Loved taking FLM 355 with bill. He is hilarious and great to work with. He takes everyone's opinions into consideration, but isn't afraid to debate you on your film takes. He was an easy grader for this course, so as long as you turned something thoughtful in you receive a good grade. Bill is a legend, I would recommend taking his class.
Seriously wish I would have looked him up on here before I took his class. Terrible structure and too harsh for what is supposed to be an intro class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst professor I have ever had. Gives no instruction as to what the assignments entail, and the syllabus is literally half a page long. He puts barely any work into the course but expects the opposite from his student. He also plays favorites and your grade matters more about his opinion of you rather than the work.
Worst Professor ever.

As a person, I really liked him and thought he was funny, but as a teacher? This man had me going through it. The quiz + exam questions can be really vague, and when it comes to essays, he'll critique things that you didn't know about. I honestly enjoyed the class a lot, but I would recommend a different professor.

He rarely goes over what to expect on quizzes and exams, so be prepared to do a lot of work outside of class. He's a tough grader when it comes to essays and other written assignments. He's a nice man, just don't expect this class to be an easy 4.0.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I've had Bill for 3 different classes, that's how great they are. He's funny and an amazing professor with great stories to tell. His classes are pretty easy but to do well you have to show up, do the work and readings, and participate in the class. All his classes have been some of my favorite film classes. Would highly recommend.

Amazing teacher and a very easy class. A bit of reading but you can survive without doing it. No textbook. Great film selection. Lots of discussion time and very interesting lectures. Quizzes and papers are easy. Wants everyone to do well and will offer extra opportunities for that. Passionate about film, overall a very fun class to be a part of.

Amazing professor who is passionate about film and has so much knowledge on the topic. Has seen all the classics when they came out and has acted in a few films. Super funny and it's amazing to hear about his life with film. Attendance is necessary, but the class is easy. Rare homework, definitely could make it without the textbook.  He's awesome.

I've had Prof. Vincent for several film and humanities classes. His passion for film and the arts is unparalleled, as is his knowledge of those subjects.  His classes are somewhat of a haven for intellectual students and therefore a struggle for those use cell phones and video games for cognitive stimulation.

You either get what he is saying or you do not. His classes are not cookie cutter courses. He will want to see how much you are really paying attention, how involved you are or if you think you are just there because you thought it was going to be an easy 4.0. He can point you in the right direction. Effort  success.
What this guy said pretty much sums it up: "he is feast or famine. you'll either be friends with him and get awesome grades, or you'll be a regular student and just pass the class."
Your grade is based on how much he likes you, so play his games. If your class is small, he might invite you to his creepy, trashy house at the end of the semester.

I took him for screen writing and advanced screen writing.  He is one of the best profs at Michigan State.  He is much like the older father figures that you see in clichéd movies and books--a warm and friendly figure.  Just make sure to use proper grammar (it is possible your work will get stomped on during class--leaving the shame of footprints).
he is feast or famine.  you'll either be friends with him and get awesome grades, or you'll be a regular student and just pass the class.
No Comments

Bill is a great prof and knows his stuff. However, if he likes you, you'll get a better grade than if he doesn't. But, the more classes you take w/him, the more you'll consider him a friend than a prof.

He's pretty goofy, but very passionate about what he does.  His eccentricites alone make attending class a must.  As far as learning from him, yes, you can get a good chunk of screenwriting knowledge from him, but he's more about getting creative ideas flowing then boring "traditional" learning
No Comments
Enjoyable but boring.  Taught Sam Raimi way back when, never gets tired of talking about it.  Disrespects animation.  Otherwise decent.

There was far too much work in the class for what it was. Especially since daily attendance is done as an assignment, it gets to be excessive. She was nice, however, I found the lectures to be quite long and drag on, especially when covering more dense topics. The work isn't hard, it's just busy work, making it more annoying than anything else.

Took this class because I was interested in URP as a major, ended up realizing I cant do it if each class has this much work. I had more work than any of my other classes, and the lectures are so long and draining and she lectures the ENTIRE time. Projects are very tedious and take a lot of energy. She is a nice prof, but I have other work too.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took for my major, I really enjoyed the class, but I was already interested in the class material. Not a whole lot of reading and assignments are fairly simple and straight forward. Attendance is mandatory, very easy group assignments will be given every class period and count towards attendance. Exams are fairly easy if you study.

For starters, if you don't wanna talk about urban planning then don't take this class. Every lecture is paired with a discussion assignment. If you do like talking about urban planning then you'll have a great time. She's super knowledgeable and very open to questions. Was a shame so much was online due to her health.

First of all this class is a waste of money. Dr. Morckel is a joke and shouldn't be taken seriously. Her voice is like nails on a chalk board and induces head aches. Took this class for an easy 4. and it ended up having a heavier work load then all my other classes. SAVE YOUR MONEY!

Great professor, readily engages with students and very understanding. She lectures a LOT so be aware of that, but she uploads the slides after every class. Attendance isn't mandatory, but she says a lot of stuff during class that isn't on the slides. Assignments and exams were easy overall, make sure to pay attention to court case names.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I loved this class and Prof. Visconti! She really helped me learn the structure of journalistic writing and was always super understanding. The class is mainly focused on writing three articles, but Prof. Visconti will help you with them and they aren't that hard if you get started early.
She really help me find my love for journalism and really cares for her students and tries to help with everyone needs

Professor Visconti was super helpful. She gave in depth feedback on every assignment, and was always available to answer questions. She answers emails super fast which is really helpful when you procrastinate on assignments like I do. She gives great advice and genuinely cares about her students.

Overall one of the BEST teachers ever! I was skeptical about taking her class, especially since it's an everyday class besides Friday. She made the lectures fun, and for the first time I actually wanted to be there. Plus she let the class out early. Attendance is mandatory, there are only three exams, two reflections and four in class assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best professor I've ever had. Would highly recommend for easy GPA boost

Overall great professor. She is very kind, humorous, and clearly is passionate about what she teaches. She does well at not making the class boring. There are barely any assignments in the class too. Only complaint is that her mild accent made it difficult to understand her, and I disliked that she made attendance mandatory. Otherwise, fantastic.

This woman is wonderful, she does a great review the day before exam. If you cannot come to class you just have to email here. She gets the room to participate and is very sarcastic. You can tell she cares and is very educated. Take her class if you want a class that reminds you why you like learning and will also boost your GPA.
best teacher ever

I loved her FRN202 class. Lots of Lingco work, 3 hand written essays done in class, 3 TalkAbroad conversations, and lots of grammar. But she teaches in a fun, engaging way that makes the class enjoyable.

I dont recommend taking this class unless you have to. 85% of the information we discussed was un-useful & irrelevant. However, the other 15% was useful. This class is NOT about how well you can speak French. Its about bizarre & abstract concepts. She teaches almost exclusively intrinsically, which is not how I learn well. I wasnt a fan.
Easily one of the best professors at MSU. I highly recommend taking any French course with her.
She knows what she is doing and is incredibly easy on grading everything.

Although I hate phonetics, I love Professor Violin-Wigent. She is so generous, caring, and passionate. She also has a hreat sense of humour! I will truly miss her, despite hating literally everything about phonetics. You're lucky you get to suffer with someone so great!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: SOOOO much homework that consumed my weekends. This class is graded mostly by quizzes and exams and barely the homework. Von Manteuffel is horrible at breaking things down and answering questions. DO NOT RECOMMEND!!

Teaches the course like it is a graduate course instead of an undergraduate course. Does not explain things well. The lectures are super boring but you get points by being there so you have to go. Quizzes every other Friday.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Attendance not mandatory, but clicker questions are extra credit. There are pre and post-lecture assignments, and weekly assignments are good portion of the grade. 1 exam and that's the final exam. Quizzes every other week.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very caring and will explain anything to you if you just ask. He really wants you to succeed in this class. Straightforward class: show up to lecture, study, and do the homework, and you will do well.

The class is okay, and I've heard a lot of mixed feelings about it. Clicker questions are for extra credit, and the lecture is very simple compared to the homework and quizzes. A lot of people fail the quizzes, since they are only out of 10 points. Be prepared to go to the help room.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Mad hottie ;)

Dr.Vroom made calc so easy to understand, the material doesn't really get difficult until the last unit. No tests, there's quizzes every week during recitation that you can attempt 3 times and 3 unit projects. She's super helpful during office hours and very kind!! She's always trying to make the class easier so students can 4.0

Dr. Vroom is the only professor you should be taking for LB118. The style of her class is set up where you actually learn and retain the information. I didn't take AP Calculus in high school and I STILL 4.0'd the class. She genuinely cares about her students success and always listens to feedback!

Dr. Vroom makes it very easy to 4.0 Calc 1. The class might be a little bit difficult if you didn't do AP Calc in HS but you get up to 3 attempts on every standard's quiz. She's really sweet and embraces different learning styles.

She makes it very clear what it takes to pass the class with a 4.0. Lectures are very helpful in understanding the overall content and doing the homework is a must. Dr. Vroom cares about her students succeeding and gives good feedback.

Required attendance with random engagement assignments to prove you attended lecture. Very clear requirements to get a 4.0, but if you miss one requirement by the smallest thing you will get a 3.5 or lower, so be sure to watch that. If you've taken a calculus class before you will be perfectly fine, if not you gotta put in work.

You get 3 attempts for quizzes in order to pass which are easy. She sometimes can overcomplicate things in class but she cares about her students a lot, I feel like it's impossible to not get a 4.0 in her class as long as you attend lecture.

She really cares about her students, is willing to work with students outside of class, & is accommodating. Her explanations aren't the best and sometimes leave people confused. Weekly quizzes with 3 attempts, unit portfolios instead of exams, & weekly homework assignment. Easy 4.0 if you take the time. Not sure I'd recommend if taking 119.

Focused on student understanding rather than grades or test scores. Truly cares about her students and is willing to adjust plans based on how the class is doing/feeling. Always willing to work with you and will help you out. Grading is set up so it is almost impossible to not 4 point as long as you are putting in the effort.

Dr. Vroom is incredibly caring, this class is literally structured for as many students to get an A as possible. No exams, instead she does portfolios for every unit. It is impossible to not 4.0 the class, the only reason she is getting a 4 is because she doesn't teach the material the best, so if it's your first time taking calc, you may be lost.

Super amazing professor who truly cares about her students on a person and academic level. She was very much oriented on making sure students are understanding the content. If you ever need support or grace or anything of the sort, she is amazing. I can't recommend her enough.
She is super nice and really cares about her students. Her lectures are super easy to understand and this class had minimal stress because it focused more on projects rather than exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She's very good at teaching

Super nice and caring professor. Really wants her students to do well and would give us a pep talk before every exam. She is not the best at teaching and I would often have to use youtube to understand the material, but the tests were pretty easy and she offers corrections based on the average. Would take her class again.

I took LB 118 with her and it's very clear that she cares about her students' success. She teaches complex topics in a very student friendly way rather than just ripping definitions from the textbook. Exams are based on quizzes and can be difficult, but she offered test corrections on a few occasions.

She seems very nervous while teaching. Go to office hours, they are helpful and she does want you to succeed. Attendance is taken randomly. Class is easy if you took calc in high school, but moves very quick if you haven't. Recitations have quizzes every class. Lots of group work, grade opportunity.

Dr. Vroom is a wonderful, caring professor that makes it clear she is on your side and excited to help you. She is just as much as considered with your success and understanding as she is with the math. It was a very well organized, rewarding class. I will definitely look to take a class with her in the future.

she has been my favorite professor at msu! she is super sweet and caring and really wants her students to succeed, so she is accommodating. she records her lectures, but the group worksheets that she does a lot in class were helpful. i also really like her teaching style, i feel like i actually understood math. i wish i could take her again!!

She is not the best teacher. Seemed very nervous while teaching. The amount of homework given some weeks is insane. I spent 4-5 days a week in the help room to get an A because I couldn't understand the material from her lectures. Overall a very tough class and I would avoid Dr. Vroom.

She is an amazing teacher, you can definitely tell she cares about the students and their mental health. Exams are negotiable if you end up sick om exam day or even if you just want to take them another day that works better for you. She makes her office hours around the students schedules or try's her best too. Overall I would take her class again

Vroom is very nice but doesn't know how to teach well. It's very all over the place. I retook this class from high school so I could have an easy A first semester but I had to work for the A. I'd only take her if you have some sort of prior knowledge on what you're learning.
Fantastic professor.  Had him for several classes.  If there were more profs like Jon, I'd have a PhD!
Exam is difficult, but assignments are fun.

This professor loves teaching and really wants you to apply the information. The class is basically how to use the design principles to better your life and career - very motivational and directly useful for any major. And the class is an easy 4.0 as long as you pay attention to the details.

This class is really easy as long as you follow the book and practice the exam before you take it.  Before you buy the book make sure your getting the current one and the right class book.  I accidentally bought the book for IDES 250!

He's a good teacher and is always willing to help you out. If you had a problem with something, just ask him. DON'T RELY ON YOUR TA'S...mine sucked. He is very unorganized, but if you follow the book you will be ok.
Overall this class is easy. Just need to practice for exams or you will not do well.
No Comments
No Comments

Exams are extremely easy, but be careful, the assignments can screw you over if you don't follow in instructions exactly.  He is not helpful at all if you have questions, so use allmsu and ask other students.
EXTREMELY early class, but worth it! Very friendly, tests are extremely easy, but you need to GO TO CLASS!
A lot of work, but the teacher was really nice.
Vy is not an easy "A." She is a bit demanding. But, if you can accommodate yourself to her pace, you find everything in her class helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures--So many papers

reviews.comment: Vy is an amazing teacher. She must have worked very hard to become such a teacher given her non-U.S. background. She is my teacher model. She gave me more confidence, continuing to believe in myself as a Chinese student in MSU.
Vy did a good job with this course for this being her first time teaching it. She is one of the best international instructors I have ever known. I would like to take the course with her again.

I loved this class and all the material that came with it. Also, the way the material was delivered was very accommodating to a diverse group of students, and encouraged students to answer questions in a creative manner that was unique to them, rather than just filling in bubbles on a scantron. Vy was an amazing instructor, and such a kind woman.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Class requires a cultural back ground and professor has thick accent that is hard to understand.
Take him if you need IAH class!
He's great! Definitely take his class if you have the chance. As long as he sees that you put in the effort, you're guaranteed a 4.0.

TAKE HIS CLASS!!! We had 4 assignments all due at the end of the semester and he didn't hold lecture at all in the second half. Every class was a really fun discussion, he has the best stories to tell. He just wants you to succeed and get to know your peers. There's no way not to 4.0, just show up to class when you can bc he rarely emails/uses D2L.

Entertaining lecture and understanding. Assigned like 4 assignments and they were all basically due by the end of semester. Stopped doing lectures like mid way through the semester. Make sure you go to class though, he doesn't really post much on D2L. He never really got close to taking two hours in his lectures

Dave is the best professor I've had. I also took his REL102 class which was engaging, and easy. I would rearrange my whole schedule just to take his course. We only have 3 papers and one very simple project. You literally can't not get a 4.0, unless you don't do the work.

Genuinely cares about his students and their success. Only does 3 papers and one project. Only ways to not 4.0 is not doing the work and being a dick. Best professor ever and 100% recommend him. Interesting stories and hilarious. Only wants to set you up for success in life
Super easy course, and super kind, funny and chill prof. he's very understanding and keeps it simple I would 100% love to have him as a prof again. TAKE HIS CLASS!!
If you prefer a very very small work load take this class with this teacher. Rearrange your schedule just so you can get in his class. It is SO worth it if you want less coursework.
He is a cool and interesting guy. The topics we had somehow related to some crazy story he had. There was about 3 assignments and the final exam was worth about 50% of your overall grade
The final is worth 50% of your grade, wouldn't recommend.

He stopped holding class in early November, which was great. WRA101 is a grad requirement almost everyone has to take, and he is 100% the best professor to get for this course. They only graded on 4 assignments. It was very easy, but I loved him. Funny guy.

He is honestly one of the best professors I have ever had. His class was life-changing. We talked and debated the best topics and he is so so so funny. I actually wanted to go to class and not miss him saying something funny. 4 assignments based on completion no exams or anything else. super super easy and best guy ever.  A+ for everyone

I don't think he teaches this class normally, but he is one of the best profs I have had. The topics we discuss are really mentally challenging to wrap your head around, but he makes sure to break up discussions with random crazy stories that somehow relate to the topic at hand. Super cool guy! I would love to have him as a prof in the future!

This is seriously the easiest class you will ever take. The semester is almost done and I have done nothing for this class. Free credits basically. Only 4 assignments. He is a super funny guy, doesn't post anything online so you kinda have to go to class but usually he lets you leave after 10 minutes. Take this class!!!!! Easiest wra offered

Literally the easiest class I have ever taken. No due dates, only 4 assignments, and the most I ever had to write was 1000 words. Attendance isn't mandatory but he doesn't post anythinggg online, so you kinda have to go to get the assignments. No class for the last month of the semester to "focus on other classes," he said. 100% would recommend

His class was unconventional but in the best way possible.  Really nice, relatable guy who actually cares about how everyone's doing and all assignments are super thought-provoking and reflection based.

Dr. Watson is very funny and lenient on assignments/grading. I will say he did cancel class last minute a few times but it is very easy to get aa 4.0, just turn in all the assignments. I would definitely recommend Dr. Watson for WRA101 since it is a requirement and he grades super easy.

After the events in February, he allowed us to move to an online course with an alt subject (the subject before was about death). Very kind and understanding. Doesnt respond quick to emails and everything graded at the end of the semester with no feedback at all. Overall, not a bad class to get your required stuff done. Dogs always out and barking
He never answers emails, has not posted one thing in D2L and is not informative on what is due. He talks about nothing relevant to writing. No idea whats going on in the class, as he is unclear.
My favorite professor I've taken so far, he makes all the class periods fun, such an easy class and I recommend taking him.
Dave is amazing, he has the most interesting stories and activities. He seems to really care about his students as people. Definitely my favorite teacher I've had, he's hilarious.

This professor is an easy grader and only assigned five assignments over the entire semester, however, he is extremely unprofessional. He always showed up late to class, if at all, and was dressed unprofessionally. Finally, he never opened the assignment dropboxes on time and was extremely disorganized.

David is a real standup guy! It was a time when nobody showed up for class but me and he sat down and helped me with everything I needed. He's super easygoing and fair. This class was really easy and wasn't tedious at all.There are only 5 assignments for the entire class and he even let you turn it in late if you need more. Take him if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor showed up late to almost every lecture only for it to only to end early. Never received any feedback on any of my papers and he always waited till the last minute to allow us to turn things in. Absolutely dreaded coming to this class as it was a complete waste of my time. Completed all of my other courses while in class.

Great professor in every way. I know a lot of people struggle with the writing courses and he made it super simple and convenient. He gives you a lot of time to work, is lenient with extensions, and super easy to talk to if you have an issue. You don't even do a lot of writing my class was mainly based on class disscusion

This class is really easy. There are 5 assignments, that's it. You should attend every lecture. Dave offers some really thought provoking discussions and really helps you come up with ideas for the assignments. Only thing that I would change is just that Dave was kind of unclear about due dates and things like that.

This is just a pre-req class every freshman has to take. But Prof Watson does it right. It's not mandatory, but the way he teaches makes you want to go to each class. He does everything in the favor of the students, meaning that he does not give any work during midterms and finals. Great professor and funny, love showing up to class

This will be the easiest class you will take at MSU. There are only 5 assignments and they are all super easy. Show up somewhat often and you'll be set. He is very caring as well. Take him if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dave was a very nice professor, we only had around 2 zoom meetings the semester but he was very consistent with kind emails. Only grades in this class were papers and they were straight forward. If you turn everything in with effort you will get a good grade!
No tests, just writing, but make sure you keep all of your progress! (He'll explain when you start.) Lectures were super fun, something to look forward to, even at 8am, haha!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He was so sweet and hilarious. He tells crazy life stories and I actually look forward to coming into class everyday
Hes a cool guy
I had him for 371, but El-Rayes is such a kind man.

Professor El-Reyes is a super smart guy and knows his shit. You can tell he really cares about his students, as he is always willing to sit down and talk through your paper. I would take his class again for sure.

Not a bad professor however he likes to talk at you. His lectures are informative but often completely unnecessary because the class focuses on your own research paper topic. Was slow on feedback and grading.

I liked El-Rayes, but when I heard about what other sections were doing in MC270, I kind of felt like we were really behind in the curriculum. His lectures and office hours were very helpful, but we rarely had class discussions or small group time, which probably would have been helpful given the content. Overall, though, he was helpful and nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Extremely genuine and wants you to learn and understand the material. He is very supportive but a respectable man. One of my favorite James Madison professors

Professor El-Rayes is a very nice man, but I did not enjoy his class. English is not his first language. He has a hard time coming up with the correct words sometimes to get his point across which is difficult to follow. His pop quizzes are tough, they are not short answers they are fill in the blank based. His lectures are very dense as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Great Prof. Really does care about you understanding the material. Really helpful.  Any class he teaches is bound to be awesome.

She was very kind and accessible outside class. Attendance wasn't required, and recitation was optional help. With many online resources and recorded lectures, the class could function like an online course. The course was extremely organized, not too difficult, and generous EC makes it hard to do poorly. Just don't fall behind the content.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great teacher, make sure to go to lectures to do lecture activities. There is a lot of work in tophat and on D2L but it's pretty easy with resources that we all use these days. Try to get a groupchat with people at the start of semester.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: In-person, but could be fully taken as an online class. Attendance is optional, and Wassink cares about her students! Recitation is super helpful. Slightly difficult class but not a terrible 4.0.
Gives you every change to be successful and get a good grade in the class
Class content itself could get pretty confusing at times but professor wassink was a great resource and was always very helpful. Class was set up very well too

This class is very laid back. I didn't go to a single lecture/recitation after the 1st week. Lectures are never mandatory and recitations can be skipped if you finish the lab early. Overall the class is not too difficult but some units can get confusing. Prof Wassink is great and always seemed willing to help anyone who needed it.

She was very willing to help students to succeed in this course. Although there is a lot of work to do weekly, I felt it was manageable. I would recommend Wassink to other students that have to take 317.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Super organized course and very helpful professor. Workload is high but basically the same stuff every week. 3 exams + final and you drop one of those. TONS of resources if you're struggling. Weekly recitation is optional if you do the weekly lab early, and attendance in lecture is optional but I'd recommend going. Going to need TopHat.

Class is only run through top hat, but the class I found was extremely difficult. Lectures are only helpful if you are stuck on homework, and recitations aren't mandatory if you have everything completed the day before. She's a lovely person, but boring lecturer.

MKT317 is an easy class if you keep up with your work. Everything is on TopHat so there is no need to go to class. I went to class once and still got a 4-point in the class. Best advice would be to stay up to date on homework.

Professor Wassink is great. She cares about her students, thoroughly explains everything she teaches, and is very helpful whenever you need her. Although her class may have quite a few assignments, most of them are not too time consuming. You also get quite a few drops on assignments and exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor if you're good at online classes. Class is all run through Tophat and majority of the learning is done by the student. Lectures are optional, and so are recitations if all the work for the class is completed on the day of recitation. Class is well-formatted, but 90% of all the learning is done without the help of the professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: If you like online classes this professor is for you. In person lectures were optional so I never attended them and opted to do the online reading instead. Recitation/lab was optional as well provided you completed the lab before-hand. The online resources are excellent for this class, and she does a great job of taking you through step by step.

Had to take 317 and I did not like it at all. I didn't like how the class was setup, (online lectures and in person recitation with a TA). Recitations were not useful. Most of the times we had questions, our TA didn't know how to answer them. The topics are not too hard, but I had to teach myself
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Wassink is incredibly organized, and makes it very easy for students to understand expectations and requirements for the course. She lays out a schedule and checklist for every week, and it is easy to get into a routine. All work (quizzes, labs, tests) are open book, open note and not incredibly challenging.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class is not challenging as long as you keep up with your work. You have weekly readings, labs, and quizzes, but as long as you do the readings, they are not too difficult. The class is mainly self taught though. She provides practice exam questions which are just like the actual exam questions so there are no surprises which is very nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: layout of the class is not good, it is entirely self taught through top hat. Her lectures were not very useful, but she was quick to answer any questions which evened it out. Recitation is mandatory, but no point in going since it was just doing your homework in there. Material is fine but class layout needs to be changed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I made an account on here to leave this review. She is amazing, and she is always available to help. I recommend joining the groupme, she is always answering questions and willing to meet  on zoom or in person.
Her lectures and directions are great; very clear instructions and clarifications. She is also extremely helpful in the class groupme and is quick to respond
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Lecture content is integrated into TopHat, and lectures/recitations are completely optional. If you are struggling, GroupMe is your best resource to get explanations from others.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Her setup for this class was not setting students up for success. Tophat was required and you basically had to teach yourself everything. Recitations were not helpful, TA's didn't really know what they are doing. If you can find a different professor, I would strongly suggest it. This class was my least favorite so far at MSU.

Good luck learning entirely out of a textbook. Lots of people like to bash on their professors teaching skills by exaggerating how bad they are. I'm not kidding when I say I haven't been taught ANYTHING by Wassink. Never replies to my emails in a timely matter, everything I learned from this class was from a book. Absolutely avoid this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: great professor for people who hate math. took this and got a 4.0. she lets you work in groups for lab & you get cheat sheets for exams. monday quizzes are online for a random book but theyre easy if you read. i recommend reading bc you have a project on the book later. show up to lecture & listen and you will be fine. she is kind & emails back!

Professor Wassink is cool. Her lectures are pretty boring, so I never went lol but her assignments are fairly easy if you pay attention! Midterms are a breeze, lets you make a cheat sheet for exams, weekly "lab" with groups, TA's are kind of annoying but.. that's MSU. Wassink is very receptive to email if you have questions or stop by her office!

I have bad adhd and absolutely hate math, but she made it easier to understand. If I accidentally zoned out for an entire lecture I could go up to her at the end and she would basically re-explain the whole thing. She's a bit like a cross between a kindergarden teacher and a bad but endearing comedian, but overall she's cool.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: She really is so easy to get along with and honestly this class is made so you can show up, get your 4.0, and peace out. Perfect for people not at all strong at math, just be sure to show up to do the labs and do the super simple project and you'll be golden.

Wassink is a good professor, but she has lost control of her TAs. There are two recitations for this class and they are both taught by TAs. The TAs rarely know what is going on in the class and show up completely unprepared. They make mistakes on grading. I have talked to Wassink about their performance and little to nothing has been done about it.
When I did attend lecture it was painful. The material was too easy for a college course and she taught lecture as if we were 4 years old. She means well, though.

Dr. Wassink is a great professor. The MTH 101/102 program is a great. It's designed for students whose career fields won't involve heavy math, so the focus is spent on every day, common math that is especially useful in interpreting data & problem-solving. I learned a lot from this program, and I feel more confident in my day-to-day math abilities!
Bronlyn is a good teacher but most of the test material is based off of recitation so def go to those
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is an excellent professor! I would highly recommend her and the MTH 102 course to anyone. If you are determined, you should be able to 4-point this class without too much stress. I am mad at myself for getting a 3.5 simply b/c of missing assignments. You can & you will 4-point if you don't get lazy! Dr. Wassink cares about you and your success.

You can use a practice sheet with every quiz and exam. Homework 2 times a week and a quiz every other week.  This class is not your typical math class, and it would be really hard for you to not get at least a 3.5.

Dr. Wassink is truly the best professor I have had yet. SHE IS AN EXCELLENT TEACHER who provides clear, concise examples that are actually relevant to completing the homework and studying. She truly nails it. She also has such a big heart and I feel that she is the most kind-hearted professor I have ever had. She exceeds the expectations.

I wouldn't have done as well if it weren't for Wassink. The professor wasn't always able to explain things in an effective way, but her recitation lectures were clear. I stopped going to lecture after the first two weeks and only went to recitation. If I took another stats class, I would look for her section.

I would not have passed this class if it wasn't for Ms. Wassink. The professor doesn't speak English and the notes he makes are garbage. Wassink made everything crystal clear and I got 100% on an exam without going to main lecture and relying on only her help. She did all the review and worksheets and generally is so more together than RV. Love her

Bronlyn is hands-down the best TA that I have had at MSU as a whole. I hardly bother with my actual lecture. I go to recitation and learn more during that weekly, 50 minute recitation than I do during my 110 minute, biweekly lecture.   She saved my stats grade. If I ever have to take another stats class here, I'll look for her sections.

Bronlyn is the only reason I am going to pass this course. I stopped going to the 2 lectures per week because the main professor is horrible. She saved my semester. Very helpful and thorough and I put a 5 for easiness because she makes it easy to pass, this course is really really hard otherwise.

Bronlyn was amazing! I want to be clear about my easiness rating. The class isn't  simple. However, the criteria for giving that category a 5 was show up and pass. If you go to Bronlyn's recitation, you WILL pass. She is that helpful. My professor was totally worthless. He showed a lot of proofs then blew through PP examples. Bronlyn cleared it up!

Honestly, I didn't go to the normal lectures after the first few weeks because the professor I had SUCKED. I mean, really SUCKED. But recitation with Bronlyn was amazing. I normally don't rate professors but she basically taught me more in that 50 min recitation than I could get out of the two actual lectures during the week. SHE NEEDS TO BE PROF.
Dr. Wassink should be teaching this class over the Professor.
great professor

The best TA of the entire class. I have no idea why she didn't teach the actual lectures. The professor was incompetent and could not speak English. Dr. Wassink explained everything exceptionally and sent out a ton of useful information for quizzes and test. If she taught the actual class it would be a breeze.
Great teacher!! I highly recommend her!
great patience

He is a good person but an okay professor. His teaching style was reading off of semi-ambiguous slides and delving way too deep in the concepts. Since he didn't teach it like an intro class, it made it hard to figure out what to study. Class structure was clear however. Overall an okay experience.

It felt very hard making myself go to his lectures, becuz they are all just slides that he reuses every  year. The class itself is not interactive except random days (2) where he makes people do like a random survey, and then yells at people the next day when they didn't do it. On his own, he is very nice, and a very interesting guy to talk to.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He teaches like you already know everything. Lectures are kinda boring. Not many assignments other than tests and quizzes.

Hes a good prof, the class is not structured in his favor. Its a lot of information in a short amount of time with no application besides quizes and exams. Its interesting information just a lot to digest. Since quiz questions are from slides, and exam questions straight from quizes its easy to pass. I would recommend him for a smaller class fs.

He was an alright professor, the class is very easy to pass. All exams along with the final are all past quiz questions. You get a note card front and back for each exam, just write down all of the past quiz questions and you will do fine. He was impossible to get a hold of by email. He never answers emails, not even for RCPD emails.
I LOVE SOIL

Easy A based on memorization, but don't expect to learn much from this class since he doesn't teach it like an intro. Don't get the textbook unless you're actually interested in soil, I only ever skimmed it to add to my lecture notes. The midterm and final are mostly past quiz questions, but some are very specific things he mentioned in class.
He was a good proffesor, very informative and fun lectures. Just make sure you do the readings and ask questions if need be. He was great!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Wessel is a great human being, but not that great of a professor. He clearly knows a lot about the subjects he is teaching, but does not teach it as an intro course. The grade is very test heavy, but they are not on lockdown and you get a notecard for exams. He is REALLY bad at answering emails, including answering RCPD accommodation letters.

Dr. Wessel is great. His lectures are interesting and he is inspirational in his accomplishments. He is a good grader and all of the exam questions come directly from the quizzes and all the quiz questions come directly from the lectures, so it is easy to study for. Overall a great class.

Dr. Wessel is clearly knowledgeable and passionate about what he teaches. If you put the right amount of effort in, the tests are the right amount of difficulty. You definitely have to put the time in, but the course is interesting and you learn a lot.

he is great!

Exams are 75% of your grade, assignments 25%. The class is very application-heavy, D2L materials won't make much sense if you don't go to class and you WILL be confused on the exams if so.
