reviews.comment: With two weeks left, decided to stop curving grades. "After last exam, the mode and mean were almost the same--so i'M gOnNa StOp CuRvInG". If anyone taking a class under this guy thinks that there's gonna be a curve no matter what this guy promises, look elsewhere. Especially when all we have are 3 exams and 6 quizzes. Don't play with my GPA.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this class as an elective course. Dr. Weaver shows great interest in what he teaches and is willing to help students in and out of class. The only difficulty I had with the course was the exams, which were more difficult than the quizzes and assignments. Other than that, this was an enjoyable course with a great professor!

I took it online and I thought it was alright. There was a discussion post and a quiz every week so not too much work, exams were about every 4 weeks with a discussion. It is pretty lecture heavy with 13-14 parts each week but they are sort of interesting, easy to stop watching after a while. I got a 3.5, he does not round or have much extra credit

Greatest professor ever. I had him for PSY 101 and 235, 235 was exceptionally great. His lectures are great because he doesn't just read off of the slides and he tells funny stories. He's just a great, funny, easy-going guy. He's available to help and wants everyone to succeed. He incorporates drops and has a very fair grading system.
I took this class as an elective. It was the hardest class I took and lowered my GPA. Do NOT take this class if you don't have to !!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: By far one of my favorite professors at MSU, Ive taken two classes of his and he is awesome. His class and tests are mostly lecture content, so attendance is key and good notes. Overall amazing, he is easy to follow and explains topics well.

Dr. Weaver is a fantastic professor who genuinely cares for all of his students. I've taken two of his courses (PSY 339 and PSY 235). This man knows his stuff! He always updates his lectures to current research and provides interesting & optional readings to supplement his PowerPoints. I'm not sure if he's up for/wants tenure, but he deserves it!

Professor Weaver kept lectures very engaging and genuinely cares about his students. If you attend the lectures, the class will be pretty easy. Quizzes are open for a long time with unlimited attempts, and he lets you drop a quiz, an exam, and an assignment. He is super clear about expectations and fair in his grading. Highly recommend!

He was so nice, and made learning fun. he tries his best to make sure you truly understand the material and is genuinely a nice guy all together. he understands we are humans trying to just be a student and do our best and wants that for us and does his best to do good for his students
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Honestly the material was a lot but the exams are really easy if you just watch the lectures (it's open notes), I'm taking him again for PSY 235 he really knows how to teach.
Honestly, the nicest prof I've met at MSU. His class is chill and is absolutely world-class in lecturing.
Nice guy who really cares. You will get what you put into this course. For being a two hour course it can drag on a little bit, but you do not have to do much after class so it makes up for it.
He provides the book. His lectures were boring so I just followed the slideshow instead. Decent professor, however, I didnt care much for his style of teaching. 72% of our grade was based on exams.

This class was super easy expect for the exams that make up 72% of your final grade. He does not allow retakes for the exams, so if you're not a good test taker I wouldn't suggest this. Other than that this class allows you to drop a decent amount of assignments. No extra credit though.
Super understandable lectures. very nice guy

His policies seemed generous with a lot of drops.  I only attended about 1/3rd of the lectures and got an A so even if you aren't good at this type of class, you could probably do well by putting in effort.  From the lectures I attended, he seemed caring and often tried his best to teach the material.  One of my favorite profs so far at MSU.

Lectures are boring, but he tries his best. Grade is based on top 5/6 quiz scores, top 2/3 essays, and top 3/4 tests. You can get by without attending class because most quiz and test answers are online, but information is still hard to find and study.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Professor Weaver is a great lecturer and I can tell puts a lot of effort and care to his teachings. I would've absolutely loved to have him in a class that has greater difficulty, because it was hard to sit through a 2 hour lecture two days a week when much of the content is not very difficult. He is funny and entertaining though.

For ISS 305 he expects a lot in a short amount of time. It was statistics-heavy, he would go over at least 3-6 units in one lecture and expected us to do well. I have always been a good student and I can't keep up. Also, when I ask him questions he gives a rude and condescending answers. If you care about your GPA please do not take him.

Dr. Weaver is one of the best professors I've ever had, if not the best. He's so kind, compassionate, and accommodating. He doesn't go into teaching with an "I'm doing my best" attitude, but a "I will be the best and more". Having professors who genuinely care about their profession and every individual is rare and I'm so thankful to have had him.

Professor Weaver was an amazing teacher for PSY101! It was a very large class so I never interacted with him one on one, but I never had the need to either.  His class is very organized and he is very well equipped for both online learning and in person.  He includes drops for assignments and lectures are very engaging.

Very lecture heavy but Dr. Brown is obviously passionate about the work so it made me eager to learn. Very knowledgeable and understanding of trigger warnings throughout the course. He was also honest and showed that he truly cared that we succeeded in his course. Highly recommend.
Material was repetative learned nothing new.

Weaver is very genuine and engages his students well with appropriate lecture content. The quizzes and packback guidelines are straight forward. Extra credit questions on exams are about his personal life.
reviews.rating_tags: Inspirational--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Lots of work but interesting class.

This was the best class I've taken at MSU and Dr. Weaver is the best professor I've ever had. Nothing is worth too much, so if you bomb something its very easy to make up. Offers extra credit, but you probably won't need it. He was very well organized and understanding so going to online was unstressful. 100/10 if you can take this class do it.

If you want an easy ISS, DONT take this class! Heavy workload and quizzes/discussion posts every week. Does not respect students in the slightest and if you email him with concerns he'll basically tell you to suck it up. One of the worst profs ive had a MSU.

Nice guy, but awful instructor. Gives out too many readings and information each week, which makes it very difficult to retain information. His tests are very hard and his study guides are useless. I Thought this class would be fun and interesting, but it is easily the hardest class I have this semester and its just a Gen Ed.
He was a great professor who obviously cares about his students and the material hes teaching.

Weaver makes PSY101 way harder than it should be. Iclicker questions happen every lecture, at random, and are graded on accuracy alone. Exams are very hard, and the lectures are very long. He tries to make them entertaining but he is hard to pay attention to. He also likes it when the average on exams is around 70, so don't expect extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Weaver is one of the best professors I have ever had. He truly cares about his students and wants us to do well. He makes lectures engaging and interesting and provides great examples from his life. He makes sure everyone feels comfortable and welcome in his class. I highly recommend!

By far the best professor I have ever had. Passionate about what he teaches and is determined to help you pass the class. I enrolled in the class late and he was very helpful with making sure I was caught up with both notes and receiving a good grade. He's great at going in depth in lectures by giving many examples and keeps you engaged.

I LOVE Dr. Weaver. He makes his lectures engaging and doesn't force students to attend; however, please note that there are pop quizzes. They aren't hard at all and are more of a reward for students who regularly attend. He's very kind, understanding, and an easy grader. He loves meeting students during office hours and is passionate about his job.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Great professor. Really cares about his students, and wants you to succeed. He does give random quizzes, not too hard but you need to be in class & pay attention. Tests can be hard, but as long as you study and know all of the information in depth, youll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I cannot say enough good things about Dr. Weaver. He exceeded my expectations for this course, which even led me to change my minor to gender studies! There are five pop quizzes throughout the semester. He gives thorough exam guides and they are pretty easy. I wish I could take this class again because of how informative it was!

- Two hours worth of HEAVY lecture (imposs to take notes and pay attention simultaneously) - Test are very hard, the study guides help (some repeat questions but not enough to help) - I hate this class - Sure he has extra credit, but there's a limit on how many poker chips you get and the other option is an essay or a 5 hour long study
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Mr. Weaver is very articulate and great at explaining concepts. He also makes the class very interesting because he has a good sense of humor, and he allows everyone to participate if they wish(does not make you participate in discussion if you don't want to, which is nice.)

Weaver is amazing! This is the second class I have taken with him and I would love to take more! He is incredibility intelligent and very respectful of people's differences and very open minded. He gives disclaimers ahead of time for potentially triggering material, which is always great especially given the nature of some of his lectures. 10/10

Dr. Weaver is my favorite professor of my time @ MSU! He made lectures interesting with stories and jokes and I found him to be very respectable and likable. He was light on assignments and the exams determined most of my grade. The exams were not difficult. I plan on taking an ISS with him next year! Highly recommend!

I could have honestly picked so many more tags. I have never met a more caring professor. Not to mention he is an amazing lecturer who does everything possible to help you remember things from Lecture. I would recommend this professor a thousand times over.

Great professer! He definitely cares about his students and wants them to do their best. I bought the book but never used it, it was uggested to read it before exams. You are able to get extra credit from sona but none in class. Pay attention, take good notes and you will do fine.

Weaver is a great choice for any Psychology class. Lectures are clear and easy to follow and all lecture notes are posted after class. Uses iClicker for mini quiz questions during lecture, but allows 6 classes worth of misses for these quizzes. A respectable guy who wants you to pass. Only need to do 2/4 easy writing assignments. Trust me! Take him

Lectures are funny and nice but his exams are very heavy and hard. I failed the first exam because I did not know how his tests were the next exam I received a C+. And it takes a lot of studying and make sure you go to lecture cause he makes you answer quizzes through a iclicker. Very tough. Would not recommend if you are looking for an easy A.

Best professor I have ever had. I cannot stress enough how amazing his lectures are, and he really cares to teach his students/ make sure they succeed. 1000% sure you should take him for any psych class he offers. A great professor but also a great human being in general.

By far the best professor I've ever had. He relates the class to his personal life to make the course material easy to understand. There are clicker quizzes everyday but half the time he will give you the answers to them and the other times the questions are common sense based on lecture. Also gives extra credit. Best PSY101 prof from many sources.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Weaver is amazing! Really wants you to pass, works with you and gives plenty of room for extra credit. There was a group project this year that added about 25-30 points of extra credit (Easy A) but the exams were pretty tough. If you miss a lecture (there's attendance) then it's hard to understand the material. Take him if you get to!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Very enthusiastic during class. Encourages discussion and questions by giving poker chips for extra credit. This is the first semester where he's given group projects so they might change, but mine were easy. They added up to 30% of the grade but were quick and painless

AMAZING. He cares about his students a lot, his lectures are hilarious, and is down to the point on the content. There are clicker questions so don't plan on skipping. Exams are real-world situations, so make sure you spend your time applying the material. Practice exams are very useful, so use them. If my major req'd more PSY classes, I'd pick him

I love this professor! He's the reason I changed my major to Neuroscience--because I wanted to take more psychology! His grading is a little tough, with exams being worth the majority of your grade. However, if you pay attention to lectures and write down clicker questions, you should do fine! I really enjoyed this professor.

Print out the lecture slides and take notes on those. Everything you need to know is in them except for the occasional thing he asks you to look up in the book which there were probably only 3 of when I took it. He makes the class enjoyable even though it's long.

One of my favorite professors, he is a great lecturer, so funny, and teaches a great and interesting class. There are pop quizzes which can be tricky, but the exams are easy if you study. Textbook is not necessary, the class notes are very comprehensive. No mandatory attendance. Fairly easy papers. Extra credit available. Amazing class and teacher!

Dr. Weaver is an amazing lecturer, but his tests are very hard. Your whole grade is based off of 7 pop quizzes and 3 exams, and as a bad test taker, this has been hard for me. But he's a great guy and I would recommend his courses if you don't struggle with tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: A funny and cool professor. He gives clicker questions but drops a reasonable amount of them as well as other assignments. He doesn't answer questions in class, but will in email quite promptly. He makes class fun and provides extra credit!

This professor does not answer questions. If you are a student who can just take notes and not ask questions to understand, you'll be fine. I need to ask questions to understand and he just ignores my arm up. Im a 4.0 student and not doing well at all. He doesn't typically teach social psych but this year he did and it wasn't a good experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is so nice and made the class really interesting. This was one of my favorite classes I have ever taken.

Dr. Weaver is a great prof. I have had him for 2 classes now and I highly recommend. He is lecture heavy but they are not mandatory. He rarely if ever gives homework and the exams are pretty straight forward if you are someone who takes notes and pays somewhat of attention. Great dude. Highly recommend.

Favorite professor at MSU! Class is not too difficult if you attend and listen at the lectures and study hard for the exams. A lot of content but is very do-able. He is very personable and relates the lectures to everyday life so you can understand it. Take this class with him if you have the chance!

He is the best Professor I had so far. He is really good at teaching and makes the class interesting. The class is very manageable. Grading is super fare and you will get a 4.0 if you do everything and do decent on the exams. it requires a lot of studying but not too much. I would print the notes out before class and then write notes on them!

He cares about his students and their success, so the set up is clear and simple. This class requires a good amount of studying, memorizing, and practicing some applications; but there is no homework. Cramming is difficult, but possible. I highly recommend writing down things he says along side the powerpoint (already should be printed out).

He is honestly the best!! He gives his students so much leniency and extra credit. You can tell that he cares about his job and his students. This class is super easy as long as you go to the lectures and study. Its super interesting and he is super funny. If you take the class chances are that youll love him!!
I took this class because I had him in PSY 101 and he is so funny and a great professor. I found this class very challenging though, and wish I would have taken an easier ISS class for a GPA boost.
He is super nice and funny. Makes lectures fun and interactive.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Weaver is one of the best professors I've had at MSU. He gives great lectures that keep you engaged in the material. You do have to show up to class as there are clicker questions that count for participation points. You are almost better off not buying the textbook because it is only used for about 2-3 pages per chapter for a few questions.

Weaver is the best! If you show up and work, he'll notice you. His lectures are incredibly helpful and he really works to make sure that the information is presented in a way that can be understood. Also he shows a ton of cute pictures of his wife and kids, which is always a bonus.
Super fun and personable! Highly recommend! Best professor I've ever had

Dr. Weaver is one the best professors I have taken at MSU. He makes his lectures relatable  and tries his hardest so his students understand the concept. As for the textbook, you're better of not buying it as it is used to read small sections in the chapter for about 3-4 questions on the test. I highly recommend him. Extra credit is also available.

Dr Weaver has really engaging lectures. There's clicker questions but he drops your six worst scores, and he posts the slides online before lecture (although sometimes he leaves stuff off so you have to come to lecture). The exams can be really hard, but it helps if you go through his review materials.

I loved this class until I got my final grade back and I was 0.1% away from a 4.0. I had personally spoken with Prof. Weaver on multiple occasions and completed all the extra credit and went to the reviews, however he couldn't be bothered to give me 0.1 %.

While his lectures cover all of the material on the exams, the exams are difficult. I missed few lectures and the best grade I received on an exam was a 74%, and the average was usually around there. Luckily, there are three very easy papers to cushion the grade! Dr. Weaver is funny and weaves (no pun intended) in applicable personal stories!

Professor Weaver is amazing!  He made this class enjoyable, and I learned more than I ever have from most classes.  He uses many real-life experiences which makes learning fun and relatable.  The exams are difficult, but if you study hard, you will pass!  Homework consists of 3 exams (one of which is dropped), 3 short papers, and 1 cumulative final
He's very entertaining and funny, and most importantly good at explaining concepts.

He's a really nice, personal, and funny guy. He talks about his family a lot and connects them to lectures. There's clicker questions so you have to come to class, but there are TONS of opportunities to raise your grade. Tests were pretty tough, though. You need your textbook for readings that we don't go over in lecture.
Need to go to class- can drop 6 days of clicker questions uses a clicker very nice love the class love teacher

Dr. Weaver is extremely knowledgeable and he wants his students to be as well when they leave. He will help you out if you ever need it; he's very supportive! Very funny and his lectures are thorough.

I loved going to Dr. Weaver's class.  He is an amazing professor and great at explaining everything.  He also really cares about his students doing well.  Lectures were very interesting and funny as well.  He was such a great professor that I enrolled in another one of his classes just because he was teaching it.
Dr. Weaver is a great professor. He's super helpful and great at explaining everything. Not only is he funny but he keeps lectures interesting. I would highly recommend him.
He is by far one of the best college professors I've ever had. Not only is he hilarious, he also is extremely helpful and very clear with his lectures.
There were iClicker quizzes every day, but he dropped six.  Tests were easy if you'd done the reading and come to class.  Fun lectures, informative and clear.
Dr. Weaver is probably one of the best professors I've ever had. He's hilarious and knows how to keep his students awake. I recommend his class to anyone interested in the course.
He's funny and very interested in the subject matter which makes it easy to listen to his lectures. Not the easiest class, but definitely fun.

The class and professor are great. There's no exams, instead you show your learning through the videos that you make. You will need to set up appointments outside of class known as "grading appointments" as that's how some of your projects are graded.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lisa has been my favorite professor throughout my time in the Digital Storytelling program at MSU. It is evident that she cares for her students and makes efforts to get to know who they are. She is supportive, funny, personable, and very good at what she does!! I recommend everyone take a course taught by Lisa, DS major or not.
Lisa is an absolute gem of a professor at MSU. I've had her throughout my final 2 years for all things multi-cam and I couldn't be more happy with the class as well as herself.

Took this class for fun and really enjoyed it! If you don't know much about video production, or even if you do, she goes in to detail about a lot of techniques and aspects of video production. Work Consisted of a few papers and workshops, but most of it is video projects where you go out and practice the different techniques you learn in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lisa never ever even made a D2L page for our class, claiming our school homework and class access site to be "too difficult". She knows broadcasting and is ok at engaging and interacting with students, but due to her insistence on turning in hand-written difficult assignments when she gives ZERO notes, I would never ever take another class by her.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: She is one of the most caring professors I've had. Kind, understanding, and respectful. She has interesting lectures and tells stories of her experiences in the field. Highly recommend

One of the most caring, and best professors out there. I repeatedly forgot assignments and she let me complete them for full credit. Class had switched to online halfway through due to COVID-19 and she handled it excellently.

This class is super fun and easy. If you choose to take it, I guarantee it will become one of your favorite classes you will take that semester. Although in the beginning, Lisa may seem intimidating or sassy, she is a very caring person and only wants to make sure that you understand what you are doing and why. I couldn't recommend a class more!
By far, one of the best classes I've had the opportunity to take. I would recommend this class to anyone looking to go into media, performance, writing, singing, movies etc...

Excellent Instructor! Leaves a lot of room for you to come to your own conclusions. Gives you a detailed list of assignments which enables you to work ahead. A very enjoyable class! If you need a low stress class, this is it!

Lisa will make sure you learn the material. If you don't get it right the first time, you get to re-do it until you get it right. She's a great lady and her TA's will help you if they're able to. You learn a little about using a high-tech camera, but unless you have the money to pay for one, you won't use it for a few years!

Easy class but WOW she needs to be a little more organized. I've had her for 4 years, never once has the syllabus for the class been younger than two years old. Very frustrating. Also occasionally very difficult to get a hold of outside of class.

Its almost impossible not to get a 3.5 or better in Lisas classes. Shes awesome! Always willing to help, extends deadlines and always makes herself available to her students. Had her for 4+ classes throughout college.

Lisa is awesome. You get her from beginning level to advanced, and she's an amazing resource. Due dates are flexible. She will re-grade anything you want to turn in again. A ton of work, but if you want to 4.0 any of Lisa's classes, you can.
No Comments
2 hour lectures in the studio at 8am were hell, but the projects and everything i got to do in the class were awesome. she knows her stuff.
Very fun and insightful labs and lectures with helpful and nice instructors! The quizzes, exams, and lab practical are reasonable. Don't treat this class like a blow-off class and you'll learn a lot.

Class was great, but it was a lot of work for a 2-level class. Wholehan was super nice and even rounds your grade at the end of the course! The quizzes and exams are easy IF you study, otherwise, you will do poorly. Attendance is mandatory and no drops for it. Lectures are online, so be prepared to be accountable for doing them.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Ms. Wholehan was a fun and effective instructor. I truly loved this class, even though I didn't do as well as I had hoped, due to some personal issues towards the end of the year. I really look forward to taking BLD314L with her again in a year or two. For a 2-credit class, the amount of work was a little heavy, but it wasn't too bad at all.
This is a lot of work for a 2 credit class. Lectures are online so you have to be accountable to watch them in order to do well on quizzes.
Loved her class! She is a great prof with clear expectations and a fair grading system. I would highly recommend her and this class to anyone.

Sometimes looks a little judgmental but she really isn't. Very nice, has clear professional expectations and is very knowledgeable about the course- will use real life examples and points out potential career choices related to class material. You can tell she cares about her students
She is amazing! Great class would take again!
If you are ok with a class that sometimes does not have a set structure you will do just fine in this class. I strongly suggest attending class, it is true if you attend class you will pass.
Great professor wish he taught more classes.

This class had very little organization. Although there was a detailed syllabus, it was not followed at all and he was behind schedule the whole semester. His lectures were very boring and many times off topic. Very unclear instructions given for the final exam, which was in person and on paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He does not post grades until the last day of the semester and does not have a class schedule. He is a nice guy but runs his class horribly.

(AFRE 130) Whims is a good lecturer and genuinely wants his students to succeed. Homework assignments are gone over in detail before they're due so you know exactly how to do them. However, his organization skills are lacking. Don't bother with the syllabus due dates because he won't follow them. No tests other than the final and only a few HW sets

Whims is the real deal. He's clear, gets to the point. Has applicable industry experience. Exams are tough, but doing even the slightest bit of prep and you'll be fine. He has pop quizzes daily for attendance but they're simple. The semester long trading is super fun and he gives a gift card to the person who wins. HW is a short paper per week.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The material is so easy if willing to learn! Gives practice sets that are identical to the exams. Gives extra credit sometimes if you answer his questions (wants interaction), allows a index card for the final. If I have to take any more ABM classes, I will go with him. Project at end of sem. but it pretty straightforward. 5 quizzes 100% all em
If you show up and pay attention it's a very easy class.

He did a fantastic job teaching the class in my opinion. He made sure that everyone "comfortably" understood all the material and tried to go over it again in different ways if the class gave their understanding and/or comfortableness  to be "less than 5 out of 10" when he asked.  He is very approachable and willing to answer any questions.

I did not enjoy this professor. Always seems confused. The class moves extremely slow. He over uses the term "at the end of the day" until you want to vomit. Not an enjoyable course. However, the material was easy and easy to understand. It was not easy due to his teaching. His teaching actually made the course more confusing.  Good class, bad prof

Dr. Mayo is very nice but an extremely tough grader. I write well/am a 4.0 student and no matter how many hours I put into each weekly paper, I never got 100%. Homework wasn't graded until months after the due date & agendas were pushed that I didn't agree with. I hated this class. I don't recommend this class with this professor, avoid if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Mayo's online FA 150 class at UND (RMP needs to be updated). You can write a page per week and be very engaged with the material, and she'll still give you an 8/10 because you haven't reached total enlightenment about the arts like she has. Also takes almost a full semester to grade your homework. She is responsive to emails though.

This class takes so much brain power and is very difficult. It should not be this hard. She gives a ton of homework and has very high expectations in terms of performance. Grades are not given back in a timely manner. She does work really hard to give good, constructive feedback, however it seems like you can never do enough in the end. Never again
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Could not recommend him enough. His course was easy to understand and very organised. If there ever was an issue with the page, he owned up to it and fixed it as soon as possible. Genuinely one of my favorite professors ever. Incredibly great guy.

This is for MTH 299. I didn't know what to expect walking into this class, but it can best be described as a math writing class. David knows what he's teaching for the most part; sometimes he would confuse himself when writing on the board. I'd say attendance is definitely encouraged, but he posts notes at the end of the week usually. Not horrible

This man does not explain things very well at all. He will skip the hardest problem "for the sake of time". His lecture videos are an hour and a half long so I used my friend's professor's lectures which were only 30 mins and made a lot more sense. You will be watching a lot of middle school teachers on youtube if you take this class.

Explains well. A bit quiet, but he wears a mic and offers zoom so you can hear him better. You dont have to show up to every class because he does post the zoom recording of the lecture immediately after class. The only time you have to go is if there is a quiz but you know when they are in advance. Exams are not during class time. P/F.
Most horrible professor I have ever taken at MSU, horrible experience, if you can avoid one class at MSU avoid this one at all costs. NEVER AGAIN.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. White is an amazing professor whose class is set up to ensure you understand what you are being taught. While the lecture videos and notes can be tedious, you will come out with a greater understanding of what he is trying to convey. Tests are often a copy and paste of his practice exams and there are lots of extra points.

Dr. White clearly cares about the success of his students. His feedback on projects is very helpful and he is almost always available to help. This proffesor was terrible. If you go to class, it should be easy to get an A because of his extra credit. Other than that, he made the material more confusing than clear.
Professor Sinha is simply amazing. One of the best professors I've ever had.  His lectures are wonderful, I still can't believe how much I've learned.  Love, love love him.

His lecture style is painfully boring, and the books assigned are the same way.  I was really excited about this class before the semester began, but I ended up absolutely hating it.  I respect his love for the subject, but the lack of enthusiasm was anything but catchy.
Not meant to be a professor. Teaches according to the rusty Indian standard where the professor never gets up from the chair and keeps on talking in a monotonous tone and never stops.

Lectures are pointless.  He repeates himself endlessly, and in a given week, I could only take about half a page of real notes.  He conducts the class as if we were in 4th grade.  Even though I thought the subject material was interesting, I HATED the class.
As long as you read the rubrics carefully, this class is quite simple! Exams were clear and straightforward.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Fully online class with a few exams and mini projects. The mini-projects were graded strictly, so make sure to read the rubric thoroughly. Does not curve grades. Easy class overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Lectures were like 8 minutes and says to just read the textbook. Super specific test questions and make sense to the textbook or lectures. The projects are super easy and probably saved my grade. The honor's option was super weird, you have to get approval from a journal to post your writing. Given extra credit but not guaranteed the full points.

I loved this asynchronous course, it was very easy and well-organized. The prof is very chill and is not a strict grader. It is hard to miss an assignment since he sets clear due dates on the syllabus. Definitely one of the easiest classes I have ever taken. Highly recommend!
Funny guy. Assignments online that require reading the textbook. Easy 4.0 if you do all the work. Exams are online so you can use notes!

This was an online class and it was so easy. If you do the assignments, you will pass with flying colors. My only criticism for Professor Kiuchi is that she did not engage with us students at all. I know it was online, but some check in emails would have been nice.
Easiest class I have ever taken at MSU. Literally show up you pass
Gives lots of extra credit opportunities, 3 open book tests, doesn't take attendance every day.

I liked the class. It's not an easy 4.0 but Dr Kiuchi will help you if you email him. Just put time into it. You listen to his lecture and do the assignments. You will get a good grade. If you have to take ISS, this is the class to take.

The class was good. Just put time into it. Instead of being in a classroom for 2 or 3 hours a week, you just listen to his lectures online and do assignments for a few hours a week. If you do the work he tells you to do, you will be fine.

I don't know why anyone is complaining about this professor. I took his IAH course over the summer online and it was the easiest thing. You do have to watch lectures that take time but the book reading isn't even necessary. I would buy the books though bc you will want to refer to them for writing assignments or for the exam. Put time in. Simple!
I think he is great. I enjoy the class.
Why the hell would he do 91% or above as a 4.0? why does he has to be so different than other professors? we are not UM. So lower the expectations and just let us have the 4.0.

I am taking his ISS course right now and it is the worst! I have to say something.We have so much reading to do every week and on top of that we have 2-3 online lectures to watch. He only opens it for 4 days. It sucks. I have a life and I don't want to sit there and read his crap all day long. One of the book is not even related to the course.
I was never clear on what he wanted written there is like 5 papers back to back every one has to be 5-6 pages ( take a different WRA class)
He helps you a lot. This is the best class you could take with WRA.

Really helpful. You will be a great writer after this class. It's a required class, but he makes it as fun as anyone could possibly do. If you work a lot, he will help you a lot. I got a sense he wants you to succeed but if you show him you're dedicated, he will help you even more. He's available face to face or email. He is great.
Horrible professor. He was never clear on his assignments, and not very helpful at all. Be prepared to write many papers, 4~6 pages each.

He's awesome! Very helpful class, informative and helps tremendously with writing papers. He's funny, (at least he is to me) and finds interesting was to incorporate class lessons with things like The Big Bang Theory, or other odd things MSU professors don't usually do. Very interesting class on Race, be ready to write like a pro once your done!
amazing
Great Professor
Great Professor Best ever
Best professor ever.
Pretty easy class, got a 4.0. Helps with papers a lot
best prof ever

OMG Professor Nishizawa-Brennan is amazing! Her lectures were so interesting, and she keeps you engaged. She is also hilarious and wants all of her students to feel welcome. She wants to make sure everyone passes the class and puts the effort in to meet the students halfway. Please take her, you won't regret it!
Hard working professor that notices effort, she does an amazing job with compelling lectures and interesting topics, one of the top MSU professors.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The class was kinda dry but Dr. B made it fun and intresting with alot of stories. She keep attendance but it doesn't impact your grade unless you want extra credit and she seem to really care about the students

Dr. B is an amazing professor. She cares about her students and is very educated in the field of biomedical sciences. She does have an accent, but still can be understood. Quizzes and exams were open note and fairly easy. Attendance is required and usually smaller class sizes.
She was great! I thought her lectures were very interesting, and she was funny and easy to talk to.

I loved Dr B! She is super nice, and is also my advisor so I'm biased. This class was super easy as an elective, and had online quizzes that were 1-3 questions and had two attempts. If you have a hard time understanding accents she may not be the prof for you. Its pass-fail so just take the quizzes and go to class and you'll pass!

This course is an elective within my major and I loved having Dr. Brennan for it! She is so funny, but if you have a hard time understanding accents- she does have a very heavy one. This class was super easy and informational, and a plus is that you can tell Dr. Brennan is very passionate about what she teaches.
The best professor I have ever had! She wants you to succeed. Cannot recommend her enough.
Dr. B is awesome! The class is hard but the exam questions are taken from the online homework so just study that and you will do great.

Dr. Brennen goes out of her way to make sure students understand and learn the material. She also has a great personality, which helps you stay focused in class! She was great for online lectures, and had multiple review sessions when asked, without hesitation. She constantly gives out extra credit too. Definitely would take her again.

Dr. Brennan cares a lot about her students and manages to make the class interesting despite the fact that the material itself is quite boring. She gives lots of extra credit just for showing up to class, I would definitely want her as a professor again.

I had Professor Dai for WRA 101. She was very sweet, but I often found myself confused by her instructions. Our in-class lectures consisted of her rambling on for two hours about things that could easily be said in a three-sentence email or post on D2L. Overall, this course was fine, just confusing and boring at times. Attendance was mandatory.

Professor Dai was an amazing professor. I would take this class again. There are group projects and individual projects that make up a vast majority of your grade, but she is a very lenient grader. You can also tell she cares about her students and provides extensions if they are struggling. I would 100% recommend taking her class.
Had Dr. Dai for a WS class. Super straightforward and easy to understand for a non-WS major. Definitely take if you're a senior needing it to fill a requirement.
An online asynchronous class, Professor Dai grades fairly and generously.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof Dai started the semester off strong, her syllabus is very clear and explains everything thoroughly. She is caring and gives good feedback on papers. However, her lectures about the 5 projects over the semester are anything but interesting. They are long and repetitive.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Dai was a really caring prof that genuinely does try to engage the class. A lot of her lectures (attendance mandatory) aren't really helpful pertaining what the assignments/projects are, but just make sure you're participating. There's no textbook and she's easy to reach outside of class.

Had her for WRA 101 but wasn't an option. Only 1 class a week (at least for me) and mostly do writing on your own. She genuinely cares about her students (she moved a paper due date because she noticed the majority of students needed time). Basically only 4 papers and it's all about you (narrative). You will do fine if you turn paper in time.

Dr Dai is an amazing person, you can tell she truly cares about her students and how she teaches. Prepare for there to be a lot of reading and writing. There are about four major projects that each include roughly 3-5 essays for each person, so its a lot of work, but manageable. If you are confused, she responds very fast via email.

There is a lot of writing in this class, but other than that, the most positive energy in class, and if you go into assignments with a positive attitude, your grade will be that much more secure. The main thing is that he's so understanding and will adapt to anything that you need to make sure that you're putting forward your best work!

Very caring about students and is great at making people feel comfortable in class. Beware of the midterm and final. Those you want to start at lest a week before due as it can take a while to go through the material for them.
Very nice guy and is always available to reach by email. Very lenient if you have to miss class, especially if you are sick. Seems like a super caring guy that wants you to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Yumibe is so awesome! This is the first FLM I've genuinely enjoyed an been excited to attend. With COVID forcing the class online, it's probably pretty different than it normally is taught, but Prof. Yumibe has been so understanding and cooperative with how things work. I wish I was an FLM student so I could take more of his classes!!

Professor Yumibe is very kind and cares about his students. The class is relatively easy to 4.0 as long as you put in the work, are interested in film, and go to lectures. The lectures are brutal because you have to focus on what Prof Yumibe is saying the entire time, there are no slides with information to help you when you zone out for 3 minutes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: While you definitely had to put in the time and work to 4.0 this class, I enjoyed doing it and it was mostly because of Prof. Yumibe's lectures. He knows exactly what he is talking about, is easy to talk to and makes you feel comfortable enough to voice your own opinions and take part in the discussion, favorite professor as of yet.

Sabrina was absolutely amazing!!! If you have the option to take class with her, take advantage of it. Everything was covered in detail and she was more than willing to help in and out of class. Homework, tests, and exams were exactly like class. Loved her and loved this class 10/10

I was afraid to take MTH 103 because it was the highest failing class at MSU, but doing the recitation-type class with Sabrina made learning a lot more intimate and easy. She made it very hard to fail the class and is always willing to help. She does encourage a lot of participation, especially with others around you.
Nice person overall but not a good professor. She did not teach throughout the course and for every lecture she would just give the answers and not teach. All she would say was talk to your neighbor.

MTH103 with Sabrina has made me feel better about math in general. The quizzes/exams aren't long and everything is covered in class. Homework is only a couple pages and you're given a week to do it. Group work for guided notes are a large part of the class. I took this with co-instructors in the education college which makes it easier. Love her!

I DO NOT recommend taking this course with this professor. She shows zero mercy and will punish you for very tiny mistakes. I had the worst experience in this course and have never been shown so much disrespect from a professor before. Proceed with extreme caution in this course and make sure your work has no flaws. She also gives useless feedback

The class content was very interesting overall, however the professor is a VERY harsh and nitpicky grader. You have to read the rubric verbatim and basically do the assignments perfectly. Also, expect to do a lot of reading and research to write the discussion posts.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The class itself was not too hard, but make sure to do your assignment PERFECTLY, or she will mark points off.

Ms. Emma was an amazing teacher. She was very understanding of every situation regardless of how late you email. She is very prompt at responding to emails which helps a lot. She is a very tight grader so get ready to write a lot. She gives like nearly a 100 points of ec in a class where u can only lose 20 so its impossible not to get a 4.0
Extremely nitpicky and almost refuses to give full credit on assignments. Beware. You'll be expected to read hundreds of pages a week. Very heavy workload.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Prof. Moreno is very sweet and kind, and open to discussing social justice issues today. She is also very funny and loves to tell stories. This class is very writing-heavy, so just be prepared. She can be a harsh grader, but she does give good feedback so that you can get a good grade on the final draft. Overall, an amazing professor personally.

Profe Moreno Mosqueda is an extremely down-to-earth person. She is very kind and not afraid to give constructive criticism. This class can be very tough, but as long as you follow her clear guidelines and expectations, this class can be very enjoyable.

Professor was very nice and kind, but could be super professor-y at times. Had clear rubrics and as long as you followed them it was good. I missed a month due to illness and for the most part she was accommodating, up until the last week of my illness. I definitely learned and thought she was funny, would take her again!

She was funny and nice to talk to, but was difficult when it came to grading. You need to be participating a lot during each class as she will take away points every lecture if not. The essays are worth 50% of your grade and the 2 tests had no study guide and we had no idea what would be on them. When I was sick I could not make up work missed

I would never take this professor ever again at MSU. Has no desire for her students, and is rude to many. Participating in class and asking questions would never get you the full attedance points. She believes study guides are a form of cheating, so be prepared to fail your exams. If you have her I suggest dropping out immediately.

Absolutely dreaded this class every week because of her. Consistently complained about her job, was impossible to reach via email and for office hours, and docked attendance points even if you participated and were paying attention. Showed no understanding for her students, lacked professionalism, and was condescending and rude multiple times.

Professor Moreno Mosqueda was the worst professor I've experienced at MSU and many other people in our class agreed. It was almost impossible to get a 4.0 in her class unless you are a native Spanish speaker. She graded so harshly and then offered no further help or feedback. She was rude at times and very inaccessible outside of class for help.

I love Profesora Moreno! She is very kind and makes her class very interesting and fun. We did a couple essays but if you put your best effort you would get a pretty good grade. She always spoke in Spanish and interacted with the students no matter their skill level! Such a great person too and very funny!

The worst prof i've ever had. Even attendance was graded absurdly harsh, being early, asking/answering questions & group participation wasn't enough to get full attendance points. Lectured forever with no visuals, anti-technology, & has ridiculously difficult exams WITH NO STUDY GUIDES. I would never ever recommend this professor, I barely learned.

Do not select this professor. There are classes that fulfill the requirement that are way easier. Midterm was 2 essay questions with no rubric to follow and is graded based of what seems to be opinion, not to mention most of the class failed it. Prof did not make it easy to work with her leaving students feeling hopeless in terms of grades.
This professor does everything possible to make an IAH difficult. She is not understanding, forgiving, or helpful when students are struggling. Avoid taking her classes at all costs.

Had zero care in the world whether her students did well or not and didn't seem to care whether or not anyone understood the material. Over half the class failed the midterm paper she assigned and rather than admit she didn't adequately teach the material she belittled us and told us how disappointed she was. If possible DO NOT take her class.
lol you better hope your mom doesn't die while you're in this class because she will give you a 0 for missing class to go to the funeral.

She never taught, she just had us pay for a $75 online Spanish learning program and called it a day. She'd grade projects, but everything else was automated by the website. When I reached out to her with a problem, she would be very rude and blunt when emailing back. Do not take this professor.

This professor has no care for her students. Since the first day of classes you could tell she had no heart to see her students succeed nor was clear with her complex curriculum and the expectations she had for all assignments and projects. She is flat out rude and does not have email etiquette or skill of respecting those "below" her. 0/5!

Overall, the class content was not difficult. Her grading was harsh and she was condescending. For a language class, we should be given room to learn from our mistakes and improve them. However, Professor Moreno is unforgiving. Did not seem like she cared.
Do not take this class, I regret it so much. The professor grades so hard and the lectures are very difficult to follow. You're better off taking any other IAH course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I've never seen a prof non-stop talk for an hour and 50 minutes like she does. Lectures are incredibly hard to follow. Unforgiving if you are sick/have any issues. Assignments are due at 5 pm twice a week which is VERY inconvenient. Grades way too hard for an IAH. I've never had a worse professor here

Worst professor I've had at my time here, hard to follow along, does not care for students issues with homework, grades unfairly in every possible aspect. You could be have the worst illness of your life and she would still expect you to turn everything in. Avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Was a very bad grader, also very hard to follow along in class.
Hard to follow along in class,  extremely tough grader, would not provide sympathy at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Grades very diffcult.

The class was easy and I did fine but she didn't really do any teaching. The class was asynchronous and she just had us buy (expensive) spanish teaching programs online that did the teaching. When I did interact with her she responded quickly and also sent emails to make sure we were on track.

The class itself wasn't that hard. There was an average amount of homework but it was all pretty repetitive. Her as a person is where I grade her low. She was very uptight and condescending. Would interrupt you before you could finish your question, refused to give extra credit and was overall inflexible and stubborn. Passable, but bad attitude.

I absolutely loved Profesora Mosqueda! I was genuinely excited for my 8 am classes every Friday with her. She seems like she really cares if you are struggling with any concepts and is great at giving very helpful feedback.

She is such a great professor and makes class really easy and fun. She likes to get to know her students and makes class interesting. She teaches the class entirely in Spanish, which I find to be very helpful since I am minoring in Spanish. I would definitely take another class with her again!

Prof. Zeidan does a lot in this course just to help the students out - extra notes, practice assignments, zoom sessions for more practice, and helpful office hours. Sometimes moves too fast, which gets difficult as the material is hard. Take 132, unless you really are ready for a challenge.
Amazing professor, but she usually teaches difficult classes. Don't take 152H, just take 132.
Actually got to learn at her class! Love the professor, would definitely recommend!
Although he says he wants to know our opinions, he couldn't care less.

I'd rather eat drywall than ever take this professor again. I'm pretty sure I'd learn more from that experience alone then sitting through one of his extremely mind-numbing lectures. Has a tendency to make jokes that aren't funny which was the real cherry on top. Please be taught by a rock before this guy.

No other professor has been so impactful in my college career and education. Grateful for the opportunity to have learned from him last semester. He is caring and will take the time to teach you diligently. Any students (even at another school) will be lucky to learn from him. He did his best to reduce the impact of his resignation this semester!
Class was good and professor was nice. Lectures were long at times but interesting, all of them were on the reading. A lot of pop quizzes but like half are dropped.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The content of the class is interesting and the lectures are good. Attendance is mandatory and there are 8 pop quizzes (4 drops). 80% of the grade is based on 3 exams which I am not a fan of, but to each their own. Professor Bennett is a nice guy but has a weirdly big ego, which seems to be a trend among young philosophy professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A thorough professor who will enhance your understanding of the material. Read the assigned reading and consider answering the optional reading questions for extra credit. Lectures are engaging and sprinkled with humor to help keep them fun. The syllabus is clear about the expectations. Professor Bennett sets you up to succeed in his courses.

Professor Bennet is a good teacher if you don't mind reading the book. Class discussion was fun, if not challenging. Be prepared to support your thoughts. Quizzes matter, but only half count. Tests are primarily essay based, but if you pay attention during discussion, you'll be fine. The questions are given out before the test, too.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Lectures are not engaging. Focused on showing off more than teaching. I got a good grade by memorizing his lectures, but had to do it outside class. He's a tough professor who thinks about himself too highly. He's cute, though.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: 80% of the course is exams, 10% attendance, and 10% pop quizzes, enough said.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lowest grade I've gotten in a class here at MSU, and I've taken calculus, stats, and multiple upper-level economics classes. It is bizarrely difficult for a 100-level course, though it sharpened my writing skills somewhat, I wouldn't recommend to anyone--especially not freshmen aiming to establish a strong first year GPA. He's just not a nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor made the biggest impact on me in college so far. His lectures d are amazing. If you're not a reader and don't enjoy class discussions, then this professor isn't for you. Throughout the semester, we were graded on quizzes and midterms/finals; consisted mostly of essay questions. He grades fairly! Extra credit is given! Taking again!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: I took PLS170 two years ago, but now take PLS371 with Prof. Bennett and he is just as insufferable as before. He is on a power trip. He thinks he is smarter than you and make sure you know that. 8 pop quizzes (drop 4 lowest), midterm and final are all you are graded for. Reading is extreme, very hard to comprehend and extremely old literature.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: LOVED HIS CLASS! He is really sincere about his course and would help you understand the context. Bit tough exams because it's closed book, closed notes. But really enjoyed learning from him :)

Professor Bennett is one of the few professors who gives his heart to his subject. I found myself actually learning from his lectures and finding the course materials interesting along with it. However, it was a bit difficult because the course mainly depended on exams that consisted of 10 multiple-choice questions and 2 essays (3 in the final).
My teacher's grading was very strict, which caused my GPA to drop significantly because of his course.

I did not like this class. We read 5 books all written by old white philosophers and the entire class was memorizing the arguments of these 5 men and comparing them in essay format. If you hate writing essays for your tests, do NOT take this class. I had to for a requirement and did not enjoy it at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Grades the class like it is graduate level. Doesn't understand that this is the first philosophy course for many students. Would recommend taking it with someone more understanding of these facts.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Kind of a narcissist, really needs his opinions to be validated. He also berates students with tough questions when they disagree. He gives you the test questions in advance, which is nice if you don't want to pay attention during class. There is also 8 pop quizzes. Also a 93% 4.0 with 80% of the grade being exams, dude is doing way too much.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: this class is extremely difficult to grasp- Professor Bennett created a hostile environment due to his strong opinions- if a student disagrees with him, you're failing. I've never had such frustration and feelings of disrespect from Michigan State's Political Science program DONT TAKE ANY OF HIS CLASSES
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I highly recommend taking the intro level class prior to this, i also highly recommend going to office hours and asking questions. Using outside resources was what helped me connect everything together and learn everything that was discussed. His slides aren't very informational so you have to pay attention class discussion.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He will spend many lectures on a single slide and have a class discussion. Wherein he wont the points himself but wait for students to say it. For the honors paper i wrote, he took points off for not mentioning a more niche aspect of one philosophers text, when it would have not added anything to my thesis and wasn't necessary for understanding.

Difficult and rude. Wouldn't acknowledge my accommodation letter from RCPD. He treats this class as a 3-400 level class, which I argue are easier. You only need 1 political philosophy class now instead of 2 so save yourself and take it with someone else. He also seems to get offended when you say something against his philosophy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The grading structure of the course is easy, sitting through lectures on the other hand is much harder. There were multiple class periods where he covered a singular lecture slide and then proceeded to engage in a "discussion" where his main objective seemed to be proving his own intellect rather than teaching content.

He's a hard professor, but that doesn't make him a bad professor. He assigns a lot of reading but I literally read nothing and ended with a 4.0. You just have to go to most classes (I missed a few) and take good notes. There is a LOT of stuff you have to learn in this class, but it's manageable. All negative reviews are from lazy people tbh.

I don't know why there are negative reviews. The class is not hard if you attend class and take notes. There are pop quizzes on the reading, but he only grades your top 4 out of 8. His lectures are concise and he opens up a lot of discussion and questions. He summarizes and interprets the material really well. Good professor, easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very slow and monotonous lectures. Most of my learning was done on my own time, he was just not very engaging. Also a bit egotistical/impudent at times, which made me hesitant to participate. I just stayed quiet and took my notes. The two midterms and exam were not too bad. Hardly retained any information from this class compared to others.

I'm kind of surprised by how many negative reviews there are, I loved this class and Prof. Bennett was a wonderful instructor. There is a lot of assigned reading, but as long as you attend the lectures and pay good enough attention, you'll get a good grade. He's great at engaging the class, was helpful if you needed it, and clearly cared a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Worst class I've taken. Incredibly boring but he clearly doesn't care. Avoid at all costs.

This is the last person you would want as a prof. His lectures are just him standing there and talking for hours in the most monotonous tone. He has the nerve to not teach a single thing then proceeds to grade everything like he wants you to fail. If you ask a question he gets mad. This is the worst prof I have ever had.

I'm a bit confused by some of the reviews here. I didn't read any of the books aside from light skimming here and there, and received a 4.0 in the course. Papers weren't graded too harshly, and the final was very easy.
Lectures can certainly be a bit boring, but the slides summed up everything I needed for papers and the exam.

Professor Bennett takes this course very seriously. Lots of readings every week, followed by quizzes. The essay prompts are hard. Take extensive notes on his (long and mandatory) lectures and you will be ok. He is knowledgable, cute, and a very nice person. I think he just needs to treat this course like what it is, an 100 level class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Very uptight and strict. He makes the lectures, quizzes, and
long, required lectures, but hes passionate. easy 4 if you do the work
had 3 papers all year that determines ur grade and he grades hard af
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: For a low-level PLS class...he takes the course WAAAYYYY too seriously. He has long lectures that go on and on about one topic, and it has sent me to sleep SEVERAL times. No breaks and the class is two hours. He's not that interesting but at least he's passionate and seems to be understanding if you have any personal issues that affect academics.
Be aware for hella pop quizzes
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Just go to the lectures and take notes from the slides afterward, he typically posts them.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things
